title: Beyond the Good, the Bad, and the Ugly: Colormap Assessment through Data-Aware Perceptual Metric
comment: 11 pages, 9 figures, IEEE VIS 2026 conference full paper
summary: Continuous colormaps are widely used to visualize scalar fields, and their quality is typically evaluated using measures such as discriminative power and uniformity. Existing measures primarily characterize the intrinsic perceptual properties of the colormap itself, largely independent of the underlying data distribution. In practice, however, user perception arises not from the colormap alone but from the visualization generated by mapping data values through the colormap. The perceptual differences that users actually experience depend jointly on the colormap and the underlying data. We propose a data-aware formulation that complements existing data-independent colormap assessment approaches. Rather than analyzing the colormap in isolation, we model the color-encoded visualization as a composite mapping from the spatial domain of the data to perceptual color space. This approach yields data-aware counterparts of established measures, including discriminative power, uniformity, and smoothness, as well as additional measures such as perceptual anisotropy and degeneracy. We validate the proposed measures against both the existing data-independent framework and empirical results from perceptual studies, extend the formulation to 2D colormaps, and demonstrate its integration into colormap optimization. An interactive system is provided for exploring colormap assessment under varying data distributions. Results demonstrate that our formulation offers a principled foundation for data-aware colormap assessment and design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种数据感知的连续色图评估框架，将颜色编码可视化建模为从数据空间到感知颜色空间的复合映射，扩展了判别力、均匀性、平滑度等经典度量，并新增感知各向异性与退化性等指标。
AI.motivation: 现有色图质量度量主要刻画色图本身的固有感知属性，基本独立于底层数据分布。而用户实际感知来源于将数据值经色图映射后生成的可视化，其感知差异同时取决于色图与数据。
AI.method: 将颜色编码可视化建模为从数据空间域到感知颜色空间的复合映射，从而构建数据感知版本的既有度量（判别力、均匀性、平滑度），并引入感知各向异性、退化性等新度量；将公式扩展到二维色图，并集成到色图优化流程中，同时提供交互系统探索不同数据分布下的评估。
AI.result: 所提度量与既有数据无关框架及感知研究的实证结果进行了对比验证，并成功扩展至二维色图与色图优化，交互系统可支持不同数据分布下的评估探索。
AI.conclusion: 该数据感知公式为色图评估与设计提供了有原则的基础，可补充现有数据无关方法。

title: EvoMaestro: Toward Interpretable and Steerable LLM-Driven Program Evolution
summary: Recent program evolution systems use large language models (LLMs) to generate and iteratively improve populations of programs, producing striking advances in mathematics, algorithm design, and scientific computing. Yet these systems largely operate as fully automated black boxes. As populations grow, domain experts must make sense of the scores, code changes, reasoning, and algorithmic ideas across many programs, while current interfaces provide limited support for understanding or redirecting the evolution. We characterize this need to understand and steer populations of evolving algorithmic ideas as semantic oversight. A formative study with 8 domain experts yields six design requirements for this emerging human-computer interaction problem. We then propose a steerable program evolution framework that lets expert judgments shape subsequent evolution. Built on this framework, EvoMaestro is an interactive visual analytics system that organizes evolution information from population overview to source code. It helps experts locate and compare noteworthy programs, guide evolution with natural language, combine promising ideas, and prune unproductive directions. A seven-day system demonstration illustrates how an expert applied these capabilities throughout a long-running evolution process. A within-subjects study with 12 participants shows that EvoMaestro improves users' understanding of evolution processes, reduces cognitive workload, and supports expert steering. These findings suggest that preserving expert agency in open-ended LLM-driven search requires support for both informed judgment and the ability to shape subsequent automation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"语义监督"概念，并设计可引导的程序进化框架与可视化分析系统EvoMaestro，帮助领域专家理解与引导LLM驱动的程序种群进化。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的程序进化系统虽取得显著成果，但多为全自动黑箱：随着程序种群增长，专家难以理解众多程序的分数、代码改动、推理过程与算法思想，现有界面也难以支持理解或重新引导进化方向。作者将这一需求定义为"语义监督"。
AI.method: 对8位领域专家开展形成性研究，提炼出6项设计需求；提出可引导的程序进化框架，让专家判断影响后续进化；在此基础上构建交互式可视分析系统EvoMaestro，组织从种群概览到源代码的进化信息，支持定位与比较关键程序、用自然语言引导进化、合并有前景的想法、剪除低效方向。
AI.result: 为期七天的系统演示展示了专家如何在长时间进化过程中运用这些能力；12名被试的组内实验表明，EvoMaestro提升了用户对进化过程的理解、降低了认知负荷，并支持专家引导。
AI.conclusion: 在开放式LLM驱动搜索中保持专家能动性，需要同时支持"有依据的判断"与"塑造后续自动化的能力"。

title: Judgement and the Feeling of Agency When Instructing a Computer to Act
summary: In cognitive psychology, the sense of agency refers to the feeling of controlling an external event through one's own actions. This paper asks how people experience agency when they give an instruction to a computer, which then acts on their behalf. Research in human-human interaction has found that while people experience agency over the initial actions taken by another in response to their command, they may not experience agency over the ultimate outcome of those actions. We present two experiments. The first draws on prior studies of human-to-human interaction but replaces a human co-actor with a computer. The second study addresses potential limitations in the first, exploring the effect of more meaningful outcomes, and assessing both pre-reflective feelings and post-reflective judgements of agency. We find that participants experienced agency over the initial action taken by the computer in response to their command, but did not experience pre-reflective agency over the final outcome. Interestingly, however, they did judge themselves to have caused the final outcome when it was meaningful and their command specific. This difference between the pre-reflective feeling and post-reflective judgement of agency has important implications for design. If designers want people to feel in control and take responsibility for outcomes that result from instructions given to a computer, they cannot rely on pre-reflective intuition. Instead, we should design systems that encourage people to reflect on their actions and make deliberative judgments regarding responsibility.

AI.tldr: 当人们向计算机下达指令并让其代为执行时，会产生对初始动作的能动感，但对最终结果缺乏前反思性的能动感；不过在结果有意义且指令具体时，人们会在反思性判断中认为自己导致了结果。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于：随着计算机越来越多地替人执行指令，理解人们在这种情境下是否以及如何体验"能动感"（sense of agency）具有重要意义。已有的人与人交互研究表明，人们对他人响应自己命令所采取的初始动作有能动感，但对最终结果可能没有。作者希望检验这一现象是否同样出现在人机交互中，并区分前反思感受与反思性判断。
AI.method: 本文报告了两个实验。实验一借鉴此前人际交互研究，但把人类合作者替换为计算机。实验二针对实验一的潜在局限，探讨更有意义的结果所产生的影响，并同时测量两种能动感：前反思性感受（pre-reflective feeling）与反思性判断（post-reflective judgement）。
AI.result: 参与者对计算机响应其命令所采取的初始动作体验到了能动感，但对最终结果没有前反思性的能动感。然而，当最终结果有意义且其命令足够具体时，参与者会在反思性判断中认为自己导致了该结果。
AI.conclusion: 前反思性感受与反思性判断之间的这一差异对设计具有重要启示。若设计师希望人们感到掌控感并对由指令产生的结果负责，就不能依赖前反思直觉，而应设计鼓励人们反思自身行为并作出关于责任的审慎判断的系统。

title: No speech articulator robustly favours retroauricular electrodes over canonical jaw sites: a volume-conductor model with orientation and electrode-count controls
comment: 23 pages, 11 figures. Code, electrode definitions and result tables: https://github.com/Somach-Systems-Inc/ear-emg-forward-model
summary:
Objective. Ear-worn biopotential devices are being designed around a coupling that has not been computed: how strongly each speech articulator reaches electrodes on the jaw and around the ear. We compute it, and test the answer against the three things that could produce it spuriously - source orientation, electrode count, and the level of anatomical detail in the volume conductor.
  Approach. Articulator-to-electrode coupling is computed by reciprocity on MIDA, a head model with 116 labelled compartments at 500 microns, treating muscle as both the generator and its own conducting compartment. Twenty-two electrode positions - spanning the canonical jaw montage, a retroauricular cluster, and a cEEGrid C-path - are compared against ten individually segmented articulators. Source orientation is swept over the hemisphere, not assumed, and every comparison is repeated at matched electrode counts.
  Results. Five articulators - orbicularis oris, buccinator, mentalis, depressor anguli oris, and platysma - favour the jaw montage at every sampled orientation and at every electrode subsample. No muscle robustly favours the retroauricular montage. The strongest ear-leaning candidate, temporalis, reaches -2.57 dB under a uniform orientation sweep; but derived from the label volume, its fibre field gives -1.15 dB with an interval of [-1.45, +5.46], and only half of four-site retroauricular subsets favour the ear.
  Significance. For device design the result is one-sided, not a trade: a retroauricular montage loses lip and chin activity entirely and buys no muscle back reliably in exchange. What remains a design lever is placement - a four-site cluster chosen by anatomical target outperforms arbitrary placement around the ear by up to 1.07 dB.

AI.tldr: 本文通过交互定理在MIDA头模型上计算语音构音器官到耳周与下颌电极的耦合强度，并排除三种可能的伪影来源，发现下颌榬极在所有条件下均优于耳后榬极，耳后布局无法可靠获得任何肌肉信号。
AI.motivation: 耳戴式生物电设备的设计依赖于一个尚未被计算的耦合关系：各语音构音器官与下颌及耳周电极之间的耦合强度。同时需要检验该结果是否会被源方向、电极数量和容积导体解剖细节水平等因素虚假地产生。
AI.method: 利用交互定理在MIDA头模型（116个标记隔室，500微米分辨率）上计算构音器官到电极的耦合，将肌肉同时视为发生器及其自身导电隔室。比较22个电极位置（经典下颌阵列、耳后集群、cEEGrid C路径）与10个单独分割的构音器官。源方向在整个半球上扫描而非假设，所有比较均在匹配的电极数量下重复。
AI.result: 五个构音器官（口轮匝肌、颧大肌/颊肌、颏肌、降口角肌、颈阔肌）在所有采样方向和所有电极子样本下均偏好下颌阵列。没有任何肌肉稳定偏好耳后阵列。最强的偏耳候选颞肌在均匀方向扫描下达到-2.57 dB；但由标签体积推导的纤维场给出-1.15 dB，区间为[-1.45, +5.46]，且四个位置耳后子集中仅一半偏好耳部。
AI.conclusion: 对于设备设计而言，结论是单侧的而非权衡：耳后阵列完全丢失唇部和下巴活动，且无法可靠换回任何肌肉信号。真正的设计杠杆在于放置位置——按解剖靶点选择的四位置集群比耳周任意放置最多可提升1.07 dB。

title: Bayes-Sufficient Compression Is Not Enough: How Does Communication Help Multi-Agent Systems?
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems pair a sender with broad context and an executor with a limited local view. We study when a short message improves the executor's next decision, when raw context is preferable, and when a stronger sender helps. Our framework, \emph{receiver-relative bounded coordination}, expresses message utility as receiver gain minus protocol tax. Compression beats raw context when tax savings exceed losses from omitted information and decoder mismatch. Even \emph{Bayes-sufficient} compression can fail when a bounded executor cannot use its surface form. A three-stage decomposition separates externalization, absorption, and \emph{action closure}, explaining how errors remain after the correct content reaches the receiver. Under a single-crossing condition, sender upgrades help above a receiver-burden threshold. Across six benchmarks, the same Qwen protocol raises ContextBench joint accuracy from $0.633$ to $0.775$ but lowers ToolSandbox from $0.889$ to $0.653$. Fixed-message replay reveals closure failures despite correct artifact recovery. These results guide an inference-time selector that improves the accuracy-cost frontier on the evaluated communication regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"接收方相对有界协调"框架，用"接收方收益减协议税"刻画多智能体LLM通信中短消息的效用，分析压缩与原始上下文的适用边界，并给出推断时选择器。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM系统中，发送方拥有全局上下文而执行方只有局部视野。何时短消息优于直接传递原始上下文、增强发送方是否值得，此前缺乏统一的理论解释。
AI.method: 构建"接收方相对有界协调"框架，将消息效用表示为接收方收益减去协议税；用贝叶斯充分压缩与解码器不匹配分析失败情形；提出外部化—吸收—行动闭合三阶段分解；在单交叉条件下推导发送方升级的收益阈值。
AI.result: 在六个基准上，同一Qwen协议将ContextBench的联合准确率从0.633提升到0.775，却使ToolSandbox从0.889降到0.653；固定消息重放显示即使正确恢复工件仍存在行动闭合失败。
AI.conclusion: 消息效用取决于协议税与信息损失的权衡，压缩并非总是最优；该分析可指导推断时选择器，在评估的通信情境下改善准确率—成本前沿。

title: Training Numerical Intelligence via Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery
summary: AI agents are becoming increasingly capable of generating scientific code, but generating code is not the same as improving the algorithms behind it. For numerical solvers, execution feedback can expose poor performance, but rarely reveals its underlying cause and how to address it. We introduce Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery (ADSD), a framework that links numerical diagnosis to reusable solver self-improvement. ADSD follows a diagnosis-first paradigm that first explains why a solver performs poorly, then uses this diagnosis to guide the discovery of appropriate numerical methods. The resulting knowledge is packaged into reusable solver skills, turning solver improvement from trial-and-error editing into a structured process of diagnosis, discovery, and implementation. Across four challenging numerical domains--power flow equation, AC optimal power flow control, stiff ordinary differential equations, and heterogeneous diffusion PDEs--ADSD consistently improves solver accuracy, robustness, and efficiency. On GOC-500 power flow, for example, ADSD reduces mean solver error by nearly $71\times$, with improvements further transferring to unseen grid topologies and operating regimes.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ADSD 框架，将数值诊断与可复用的求解器自我改进相链接，把求解器改进从试错式编辑变为“诊断—发现—实现”的结构化过程，在四类数值任务上均提升精度、鲁棒性与效率。
AI.motivation: AI 智能体虽能生成科学代码，但生成代码不等于改进底层算法。对数值求解器而言，执行反馈只能暴露性能差，却很少揭示其根本原因及解决方式，因此需要一种能解释失败原因并指导改进的方法。
AI.method: 提出 Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery（ADSD）框架，采用“诊断优先”范式：先解释求解器表现不佳的原因，再用该诊断引导发现合适的数值方法，并将所得知识封装为可复用的求解器技能。
AI.result: 在潮流方程、交流最优潮流控制、刚性常微分方程、异质扩散偏微分方程四个数值领域上，ADSD 一致提升求解器精度、鲁棒性和效率。在 GOC-500 潮流上，平均求解误差降低近 71 倍，且改进可迁移到未见过的电网拓扑与运行工况。
AI.conclusion: ADSD 表明将数值诊断与技能发现相结合，可将求解器改进转化为结构化、可复用的过程，并具备良好的跨场景迁移能力。

title: From Community Values to AI Design Constraints: A Mixed-Methods Study of a Proposed AI-Driven Wildfire Risk Assessment Tool in Los Angeles County
summary: AI-driven hazard tools are increasingly proposed for resident-facing risk communication. However, residents are often asked for feedback only after decisions about data use, privacy, and explanation have been made. This study takes an earlier approach by examining residents' values, concerns, and practical expectations for a proposed AI-based risk assessment tool before a predictive model or functional interface is developed. The proposed smartphone application would use property photographs to estimate parcel-level wildfire risk and provide an interpretable risk score, uncertainty information, and mitigation recommendations. Using a convergent mixed-methods design, we surveyed 30 Los Angeles County residents, seven of whom also participated in a virtual town hall. We analyzed the data using descriptive statistics, exploratory FDR-adjusted Spearman correlations, and inductive thematic coding of open-ended and town hall responses. Participants were cautiously receptive: 66.7% said they would be very likely or likely to use the tool. They linked fair risk assessment to whether the tool considered relevant property and neighborhood conditions. Privacy and data security were the most common concerns (64.3%), while cost was the main barrier to acting on recommendations (65.5%). Likelihood of using the tool was strongly associated with likelihood of saving or sharing risk results ($ρ= 0.752$, $p_{\mathrm{FDR}} < .001$). We translated the findings into the AI Value Map, a community-grounded artifact with nine value dimensions. The Map connects participant findings to provisional design requirements and possible consequences if they are not addressed. This study provides exploratory evidence on residents' responses to a proposed AI wildfire tool and offers a pre-model procedure for translating early community input into traceable design constraints for resident-facing AI hazard tools.

AI.tldr: 该研究在AI野火风险评估工具开发前，调查了30名洛杉矶县居民对隐私、公平与使用意愿的看法，并据此归纳出包含九个价值维度的"AI价值地图"，为面向居民的AI灾害工具提供可追溯的设计约束。
AI.motivation: 面向居民的AI灾害风险沟通工具日益增多，但居民通常在数据使用、隐私和解释方式已定之后才被征询意见。作者希望在预测模型和功能界面开发之前，就了解居民的价值取向、顾虑和实际期待，使社区输入前置到设计阶段。
AI.method: 采用收敛式混合方法设计，对30名洛杉矶县居民进行问卷调查，其中7人另参加线上市政厅讨论。该拟议手机应用通过房产照片估算地块级野火风险，并提供可解释风险评分、不确定性信息和减灾建议。数据分析使用描述性统计、探索性FDR校正的Spearman相关分析，以及对开放式回答和市政厅记录进行归纳式主题编码。
AI.result: 参与者持谨慎接受态度：66.7%表示很可能或可能会使用该工具。居民把公平风险评估与工具是否考虑相关房产及社区条件相联系。隐私与数据安全是最常见顾虑（64.3%），成本是采纳建议的主要障碍（65.5%）。使用意愿与保存或分享风险结果的意愿高度相关（ρ=0.752，p_FDR<.001）。
AI.conclusion: 研究将发现转化为"AI价值地图"，这一社区扎根的产物包含九个价值维度，把参与者反馈与临时设计需求及未满足时的可能后果联系起来。研究提供了居民对拟议AI野火工具反应的探索性证据，并提出一套在建模前把早期社区输入转化为可追溯设计约束的流程。

title: Least Squares for Time Series Forecasting
summary: A time-series forecast is scored on a future value of the series. A representation loss that regresses the next latent, as in LeNEPA, is a different least-squares problem on the same bottleneck. We write both programs down. The forecast program minimizes the error of a decoded latent on the coordinate that will be reported. For a scalar target and a linear decoder, every latent rank of at least one matches ordinary least squares, and an isotropy constraint is only a rescaling: after the decoder is refit, the forecast does not move. The other program fits the whole next vector at a fixed rank, then freezes the encoder and attaches a head. On a four-dimensional series whose last three coordinates are the same autoregression, that rank-1 fit puts mass $0.9998$ on the repeated coordinate and forecasts the remaining signal at the marginal variance $2.794$. The forecast program puts mass $1$ on the signal and matches the innovation variance $0.992$. Rank $2$ gives the vector fit a second direction, and the two programs agree. Iterating the fitted one-step coefficient $0.803$ raises the open-loop error from $0.992$ at one step to $2.700$ at eight steps.

AI.tldr: 论文比较了两种时序预测范式：直接在报告坐标上最小化解码潜变量误差的"预测程序"，与先以固定秩回归下一潜向量再冻结编码器接头的"表示损失"程序（如LeNEPA）。理论证明在线性解码器与标量目标下两者（秩≥1）与普通最小二乘等价，各向同性约束经解码器重拟合后不影响预测。四维序列实验显示秩1向量拟合将0.9998质量放在重复坐标、残差按边际方差2.794预测，而预测程序将全部质量放在信号上并匹配0.992的新息方差；秩2时两者一致。
AI.motivation: 表示损失（如LeNEPA）把对下一潜向量的回归当作训练目标，但预测的最终评分只针对某个未来标量值。作者希望厘清"拟合整个下一潜向量"与"只优化被报告坐标"这两种最小二乘问题是否真的不同，以及秩、各向同性约束等设计选择是否会影响实际预测，从而揭示表示损失设计中的潜在偏差。
AI.method: 将两种训练目标显式形式化为两个优化程序：预测程序最小化解码潜变量在将被报告的坐标上的误差；表示损失程序在固定秩下拟合整个下一潜向量，然后冻结编码器并接一个预测头。在标量目标与线性解码器设定下做理论分析（证明与OLS的等价性、各向同性约束仅为重缩放），并在一个四维序列（后三个坐标共享同一自回归）上做秩1与秩2的对照实验，包括开环迭代一步系数0.803的多步误差分析。
AI.result: 理论上前者与普通最小二乘等价，各向同性约束在解码器重拟合后不改变预测。秩1实验：向量拟合将0.9998质量集中在重复坐标，剩余信号预测为边际方差2.794；预测程序将质量1放在信号上，匹配新息方差0.992。秩2时两种程序给出相同结果。迭代一步系数0.803使开环误差从一步0.992升至八步2.700。
AI.conclusion: 单纯的表示损失（回归下一潜向量）与直接预测目标在低秩容量受限时会产生实质差异，可能把预测质量错误分配到无关或重复方向上；一旦秩足够（如秩2）二者趋于一致。各向同性等约束在解码器重拟合后对预测无影响。开环多步误差随迭代快速累积，提示表示损失设计需与最终预测评分对齐。

title: REACT: Physically and Chemically Consistent Reconstruction of Marine Active Tracers
summary: Reconstructing global sea surface pH from sparse observations is critical for monitoring ocean acidification and understanding marine carbon cycling. Traditional assimilation and inverse models are physically grounded but costly for large-scale reconstruction. Recent black-box and physics-guided AI models improve efficiency, but are mainly designed for passive tracers, where the reconstructed variable is also the transported inventory. In contrast, pH is an active carbonate tracer: it is the prediction target, while dissolved inorganic carbon (DIC) is the conserved carbon inventory. This mismatch can produce low pH error while violating carbonate closure and source-free carbon conservation. To address this, we introduce \textbf{REACT}, a carbon-first reconstruction framework that decouples transport, active correction, and chemical decoding. REACT transports a latent carbonate state with a conservative advection--diffusion solver, captures non-conservative carbon-cycle variations with a source module, decodes the corrected state into pH, and constrains the output through carbonate equilibrium. This design keeps pH as the target while enforcing consistency on the underlying carbon state. On simulation data, REACT reduces pH NRMSE by (14.7%) and chemical consistency error by (24.0%) over the best baseline. Cross-temporal-scale evaluations show robustness against error accumulation from coarse to fine temporal scales, and ablation studies validate the effectiveness of each component.

AI.tldr: 提出REACT框架，将pH重建解耦为潜在碳状态传输、非保守源修正与化学解码，并通过碳酸盐平衡约束输出，在模拟数据上优于基线。
AI.motivation: 从稀疏观测重建全球海表pH对监测海洋酸化与理解海洋碳循环至关重要。传统同化与反演模型有物理基础但大规模重建代价高；近期AI模型虽高效，却主要针对被动示踪物（被传输量即重建量）。而pH是主动碳酸盐示踪物：pH是预测目标，保守碳储量是DIC，这种不匹配会导致pH误差低却违反碳酸盐闭合与无源碳守恒。
AI.method: REACT是"碳优先"的重建框架，将传输、主动修正与化学解码解耦：用保守平流-扩散求解器传输潜在碳酸盐状态；用源模块刻画非保守碳循环变化；将修正后的状态解码为pH；并通过碳酸盐平衡约束输出。设计上保持pH为目标，同时在底层碳状态上施加一致性。
AI.result: 在模拟数据上，REACT相较最佳基线将pH NRMSE降低14.7%，化学一致性误差降低24.0%。跨时间尺度评估显示，从粗到细时间尺度均对误差累积具有鲁棒性；消融研究验证了各模块的有效性。
AI.conclusion: REACT通过碳优先解耦与碳酸盐平衡约束，在保持pH为目标的同时保证底层碳状态一致性，提升了pH重建精度与化学一致性，并具备跨时间尺度鲁棒性。

title: Sycophancy Through a Five-Level AI Response Validation Framework
summary: AI sycophancy, the tendency of AI systems to excessively agree with, flatter, or validate users, is an emerging concern in human-AI interaction. It is especially consequential in problem-sharing contexts, where users may seek both information and emotional validation. This paper conceptualizes AI sycophancy as excessive response validation and introduces a five-level AI Response Validation Framework (ARVF), measured using a six-item Perceived AI Sycophancy Scale (PASS). Across three phases, the study validated the framework with human participants through an online questionnaire, tested LLM-as-evaluators in answering PASS, and examined how ten contemporary LLMs generated and evaluated responses to real-world work and personal conflict scenarios. Results supported the intended progression of perceived sycophancy in ARVF and the reliability of PASS. Trust and perceived competence followed an inverted U-shaped pattern. LLM ratings reproduced the five-level structure but showed calibration differences from human ratings. Based on the LLM ratings, the ten contemporary LLMs were grouped according to their behavioral pattern. Text-based analysis provided further support on the linguistical structure for sycophantic responses generated by LLMs. Findings highlight AI sycophancy as a graded, context-sensitive interactional phenomenon.

AI.tldr: 本文将AI谄媚概念化为"过度回应认可"，提出五级AI回应认可框架（ARVF）及六项感知AI谄媚量表（PASS），经三阶段验证后发现信任与能力感知呈倒U形，十种当代大模型在生成与评估中呈现不同行为模式。
AI.motivation: AI谄媚（过度赞同、奉承或认可用户）在人机交互中日益引发关注，尤其在用户既求信息又求情感认可的问题分享情境中后果显著，但缺乏对谄媚程度的分级概念化与测量工具。
AI.method: 研究分三阶段：一是通过在线问卷以人类被试验证ARVF框架与PASS量表；二是测试"LLM作为评估者"回答PASS的表现；三是考察十种当代大模型对真实工作与个人冲突场景的回应生成与评估，并进行文本层面的语言结构分析。
AI.result: ARVF的谄媚程度递增顺序与PASS信度均获支持；信任与感知能力呈倒U形关系；LLM评分复现了五级结构但与人类评分存在校准差异；依据LLM评分，十种模型按其行为模式被分组；文本分析进一步支持了谄媚回应的语言结构特征。
AI.conclusion: AI谄媚是一种分级的、情境敏感的交互现象，本研究为其概念化、测量与模型间差异提供了框架与实证依据。

title: Memory-State Critic for Asymmetric Actor-Critic with Application to Vision-Based Pursuit-Evasion
comment: Accepted at the 19th European Workshop on Reinforcement Learning (EWRL 2026), Lille, France. Non-archival workshop
summary: In partially observable Markov decision processes, the optimal policy generally depends on the history of observations and past actions. Asymmetric actor-critic methods have become popular to learn such policies when additional information, such as the true state of the environment, is available during training. The critic, which is not needed at execution, is given access to the state. A critic conditioned on the state alone is generally ill-defined and yields biased policy gradients. Conditioning on the state and the history, the history-state critic restores both. In this paper, we show that conditioning the critic on the state and the policy's own memory, i.e., the internal representation of the history through which the policy selects its actions, is already well-defined and gives unbiased policy gradients, removing the need for a second recurrent approximator of the history. We call it the memory state critic. It follows that a critic based on the policy's memory need not backpropagate its loss into that memory, even though the memory is a lossy encoding of the history. We evaluate the memory-state critic in a vision-based pursuit-evasion environment between two quadrotors across two arena types. The pursuer is the learning agent, and the evader is sampled per episode from a fixed pool of heuristic behaviours. The results show that the memory-state critic outperforms the history-state critic and converges faster. In addition to being unbiased compared to the state-only critic, it maintains a slight edge in the wall arena, where the actor's history carries information that the privileged state alone does not.

AI.tldr: 提出"记忆状态评论家"（memory-state critic），仅用状态与策略自身记忆作为条件即可得到良定义、无偏的策略梯度，省去第二个循环网络对历史建模，并在四旋翼追逃任务中优于历史-状态评论家。
AI.motivation: 在部分可观测MDP中，最优策略依赖观测与动作历史。非对称actor-critic在训练时可用真实状态，但仅以状态为条件的评论家通常定义不良、导致策略梯度有偏；而以状态+历史为条件的评论家虽可恢复无偏性，却需要额外的循环近似器来建模历史，代价高。
AI.method: 论证以"状态+策略自身记忆（策略据以选动作的历史内部表示）"为条件的评论家已经良定义且给出无偏策略梯度，从而无需第二个循环近似器；据此提出memory-state critic，并指出基于策略记忆的评论家无需将其损失反传到该记忆中，即使该记忆是历史的有损编码。在两个竞技场类型的视觉四旋翼追逃环境中评估：追者（pursuer）为学习智能体，逃者（evader）每回合从固定启发式行为池中采样。
AI.result: memory-state critic 优于 history-state critic，收敛更快；相比 state-only critic 保持无偏，并在墙式竞技场中略有优势——该场景下actor的历史携带了特权状态所不具备的信息。
AI.conclusion: 以策略自身记忆为条件的评论家足以同时保证良定义与无偏策略梯度，无需额外的历史循环网络，实现了更简单且更高效的训练，并在具有历史关键信息的复杂任务中体现优势。

title: Proxy Confidence: Auditing Black-Box LLM Agents with a Surrogate's Log-Probabilities
summary:
A deployed LLM agent emits tool calls, queries, and code that can be silently wrong -- by the time the error surfaces, the action has run. Frontier chat APIs hide the model's token probabilities; the agent's stated confidence barely beats chance on the mistakes that matter; and resampling does not help, since frontier models are highly repetitive, reproducing the same call across samples.
  We recover the missing signal from a low-cost open-weight surrogate run in parallel. It reads the same context, schema, and proposed action as the agent, then scores the call from its own log-probabilities through a family of complementary readouts: teacher forcing and request-PMI weigh the likelihood of each argument value, a discriminative verdict judges the call as a whole, and tool-choice competition tests the function against its siblings. One principle says which to trust: a generative likelihood localizes wrong argument values, while the verdict catches holistically wrong calls. When the error type is unknown, an ensemble is the low-regret default. The readout is training-free, needs no access to the agent's internals, and costs one prefill pass alongside the tool call.
  On difficult coding tasks it reaches AUROC 0.825 where the actor's stated confidence is near chance (0.598), and the generative readouts beat it by +0.07 to +0.28 across three further actors. Against self-consistency it gains +0.14 to +0.19 on near-deterministic actors, at 1/K the cost. The signal drives two deployment modes: a real-time gate escalating the least-trustworthy calls for review (+0.05 to +0.30 accepted-action accuracy at 50% coverage), and confidence feedback, returning the tool result with the score so the agent adapts its next step -- lifting task success on live-execution benchmarks (+0.119 and +0.137, p <= 1e-4) and beating a random-value control where step errors are silent (+0.078, p = 0.003).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用低成本的开放权重代理模型，通过其对数概率对LLM智能体的工具调用进行错误检测，无需访问前沿模型内部即可实现实时门控与置信反馈。
AI.motivation: 部署中的LLM智能体会发出可能静默出错的工具调用、查询和代码，错误在行动执行后才浮现。前沿聊天API隐藏token概率，智能体自报置信度在关键错误上接近随机，且重采样无效（前沿模型高度重复）。因此需要一种无需访问模型内部、低成本且能可靠检测工具调用错误的方法。
AI.method: 使用并行运行的低成本开放权重代理模型，读取与智能体相同的上下文、schema和提议动作，通过一组互补读法从其自身对数概率中为调用打分：teacher forcing与request-PMI衡量各参数值的似然，判别式判决整体判断调用，工具选择竞争则将其与同类函数比较。核心原则是：生成式似然定位错误参数值，判决捕捉整体性错误，错误类型未知时用集成作为低遗憾默认。该方法免训练、无需访问智能体内部，成本仅为一次预填充pass。
AI.result: 在困难编码任务上达到AUROC 0.825，而actor自报置信度接近随机（0.598）；生成式读法在另外三个actor上超出+0.07至+0.28。相比self-consistency，在近确定性actor上提升+0.14至+0.19，成本仅1/K。信号支持两种部署模式：实时门控在50%覆盖率下将可接受动作准确率提升+0.05至+0.30；置信反馈使智能体调整下一步，在实时执行基准上提升任务成功率（+0.119和+0.137，p≤1e-4），并在静默步骤错误上优于随机值控制（+0.078，p=0.003）。
AI.conclusion: 通过开放权重代理模型的对数概率读法，可在免训练、无需访问智能体内部、单次预填充成本的条件下可靠检测工具调用错误，并有效驱动实时门控与置信反馈两种部署模式，显著提升准确率与任务成功率。

title: Designing Adaptive Affective Chatbots for Online Learning: Trade-offs Between User Control, Automation, and Transparency
summary:
Online students often face emotional challenges such as frustration, isolation, and fluctuating motivation, which can hinder sustained engagement in online learning. While affective chatbots have shown promise in healthcare and wellness, most learning support chatbots focus primarily on cognitive assistance with limited attention to learners' emotional and motivational experiences. In this work, we investigate how adaptive affective chatbot support can be designed for online learning through an iterative design process.
  Through a mixed-methods needfinding study (n=38), we identified substantial variation in how learners respond to affective support, with no single strategy universally preferred. This led us to develop three adaptive design alternatives: user-controlled, AI-driven, and hybrid co-controlled adaptation, and examine key trade-offs between automation, transparency, and user control. A final evaluation (n=25) showed that 88% of participants favored the adaptive hybrid design over a non-adaptive alternative, highlighting the value of balancing transparency, user control, and interaction simplicity. We discuss design implications for adaptive affective chatbot systems in emotionally challenging online learning contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何为在线学习设计自适应情感聊天机器人支持，通过需求调研发现学习者对情感支持偏好差异大，进而提出用户控制、AI驱动与混合协同控制三种方案，最终评估显示88%参与者更青睐混合自适应设计。
AI.motivation: 在线学习者常面临挫败、孤立和动机波动等情感挑战，影响持续参与。现有学习支持聊天机器人多聚焦认知辅助，对学习者情感与动机体验关注不足，因此需要探索自适应情感聊天机器人支持的设计方式。
AI.method: 采用迭代设计流程。首先进行混合方法需求调研（n=38），识别学习者对情感支持的响应差异；随后开发三种自适应设计替代方案：用户控制型、AI驱动型和混合协同控制型，并考察自动化、透明度与用户控制之间的权衡；最后开展终期评估（n=25）。
AI.result: 需求调研发现学习者对情感支持的响应存在显著差异，没有单一策略被普遍偏好。终期评估显示，88%的参与者更偏好混合自适应设计，而非非自适应方案，体现了在透明度、用户控制与交互简洁性之间取得平衡的价值。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明自适应混合协同控制设计在情感挑战性的在线学习情境中具有较高接受度，并为自适应情感聊天机器人系统的设计提供了启示，强调平衡透明度、用户控制与交互简洁性的重要性。

title: Where Does Jagged Competence Come From?
summary: Capable systems often show jagged competence: low average error alongside failures on particular inputs. We ask where it comes from in a task built from two known layers. A lower layer A computes five per-slot sums from records; an upper layer B uses the slot-1 sum and a mode carried over from earlier boards to predict the next board's category, so B cannot be computed from the current A alone: B is a strict extension of A. We train small recurrent networks on B and measure, against exact ground truth, what they acquire of A. The central finding is that learning B gives the network a jagged version of A, measured through probe readability and supervised outputs. It is readable where B needs it (slot 1, 97-98% by a linear probe) and becomes less readable where B does not (the other slots, 5-10%); category misreads concentrate near the slot-1 cutoffs; and when A is trained explicitly it comes out only approximately right. The networks show jagged competence in B: natural KL below $3\times10^{-4}$ bits coexists with a maximum law TV of about 0.25 on constructed histories. Matched experiments show that even a good A is not enough: connecting a learned A to B cuts misreads 1.3 to 17-fold, the same exact A gives fewer misreads as one-hot inputs (0-2) than as numerical inputs (10-317), one B update makes an exact A inexact unless the B gradient is blocked, and exact A still leaves some B failures. In this task, uneven acquisition, access and preservation of the lower theory explain part of the jagged competence of a network that learns the theory built on it; some failures remain unexplained. Whether the same holds in larger systems is a test to run.

AI.tldr: 研究揭示：学习上层任务B时，网络只获取了下层理论A的“锯齿状”版本——B需要的部分（slot-1）可读性高达97-98%，不需要的部分仅5-10%，这种不均衡的获取、访问与保持解释了部分锯齿状能力，但仍有失败未被解释。
AI.motivation: 能力强的系统常表现出“锯齿状能力”：平均误差很低，却在特定输入上失败。作者希望在一个由两层已知结构组成的任务中，追问这种锯齿状能力从何而来，尤其是下层理论A在上层任务B学习过程中被网络以何种方式获取。
AI.method: 构建两层任务：下层A从记录计算五个逐槽求和，上层B使用slot-1和从先前棋盘继承的模式预测下一棋盘类别，因此B是A的严格扩展、无法仅从当前A算出。训练小型循环网络学习B，并用精确真值通过探针可读性和监督输出来测量网络对A的习得情况，并进行匹配实验（学习到的A、精确A、one-hot/数值输入、梯度阻断等）。
AI.result: 网络习得的是A的锯齿版本：slot-1（B所需）线性探针可读性97-98%，其他槽仅5-10%；类别误读集中在slot-1截断附近；显式训练A也只近似正确。B上KL自然低于3e-4比特，但构造历史上最大law TV约0.25。即便A很好仍不够：把学习到的A接到B使误读降低1.3-17倍；同一精确A作one-hot输入误读更少（0-2）而作数值输入更多（10-317）；一次B更新会让精确A变得不精确，除非阻断B梯度；精确A仍留下部分B失败。
AI.conclusion: 在该任务中，下层理论的不均衡获取、访问与保持解释了学习其上所建理论的网络的部分锯齿状能力，但仍有失败无法解释。这一机制是否在大规模系统中成立，是值得验证的后续测试。

title: SGAnalog: An End-to-End Circuit Benchmark from Open-Source Silicon Tapeouts
comment: Accepted at the AI for Chip Design Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Existing analog integrated circuit design benchmarks make two questions hard to answer: whether a model has learned transferable circuit skills rather than recalled familiar examples, and whether its output works under defined process and test conditions. We introduce a benchmark built from human-designed, open-source circuits associated with Tiny Tapeout manufacturing shuttles. The collection contains 273 topologically distinct top-level designs. Every source is retrieved at the revision recorded for its shuttle submission and processed in a fixed containerized environment. The pipeline exports each eligible schematic image and its SPICE netlist from the same source file, giving transcription an exact structural reference. Commit dates support model-specific training-cutoff analysis, while author testbenches provide the simulation context for sizing. The benchmark evaluates schematic-to-netlist transcription and device sizing. Across seven models on a fixed set of 66 transcription tasks, the strongest model reaches 56.1% exact graph isomorphism, and six of seven models drop sharply from the small to the medium tier. For one frontier model, removing author-chosen labels reduces exact matches while preserving aggregate structural F1, suggesting that labels can aid connectivity tracing. On the 17 sizing tasks, the leading model converges on all 17 proposals and reaches 91.2 out of 100 against the human reference, while the two newest Claude models refuse 4 and 11 of the same prompts they transcribe without objection; a proposal without sizes scores zero. The two tasks produce different model rankings, exposing distinct visual and design capabilities and, in one family, a policy rather than capability limit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于Tiny Tapeout开源电路的模拟IC设计基准，包含273个拓扑不同的顶层设计，评估原理图到网表的转录与器件尺寸设计两项任务，并揭示不同模型能力差异与某些模型的政策性拒答现象。
AI.motivation: 现有模拟集成电路设计基准难以回答两个问题：模型是否学到了可迁移的电路技能而非仅仅回忆熟悉的样例；以及其输出能否在明确的工艺与测试条件下工作。因此需要一个基于真实、可制造、有明确工艺与测试上下文的设计基准。
AI.method: 从与Tiny Tapeout制造班车关联的人类设计开源电路中构建基准，包含273个拓扑不同的顶层设计。每个源文件按提交时的修订版本获取，并在固定的容器化环境中处理。流程从同一源文件导出原理图图像与SPICE网表，为转录提供精确结构参考；提交日期支持模型训练截止时间的分析，作者测试平台提供尺寸设计的仿真上下文。基准评估两项任务：原理图到网表转录、器件尺寸设计。
AI.result: 在66个转录任务上评估七个模型，最强模型达到56.1%的精确图同构，七个模型中六个从小规模到中等规模任务骤降。对某前沿模型，移除作者设定的标签会降低精确匹配但保持总体结构F1，说明标签有助于连线追踪。在17个尺寸任务上，领先模型对全部17个提案均收敛，对人工参考得分91.2/100；而两个最新的Claude模型对它们能无异议转录的同一提示分别拒绝4个和11个；未给出尺寸的提案得零分。
AI.conclusion: 两项任务产生不同的模型排名，揭示出不同的视觉与设计能力；在某一家族中，拒答反映的是政策限制而非能力上限。

title: viaCross: A Pen-Based Technique for Selecting Objects and Attributes of Interest using Crossing-Based Gestures
summary: Crossing-based selection is well-studied, yet past research has overlooked multi-object and attribute selection with crossing gestures. We present viaCross, a pen-based technique in which crossing strokes define attribute constraints, paired with attribute widgets that visualize and allow subsequent edits to these constraints. A controlled study compared viaCross with traditional WIMP filter panels. Results show that viaCross was more efficient for complex object-level selections, requiring fewer strokes and maintaining efficiency as task difficulty increased. WIMP panels were faster and more intuitive for simple attribute-based selections, but participants encountered repeated deselections and occasional misclicks. viaCross matched panel performance for creating attribute selections but was slower during refinement, as widgets had to be recreated, indicating the need for persistent widgets or hybrid support with a WIMP-style interface. Overall, viaCross demonstrates that crossing-based gestures can provide an efficient and scalable approach to multi-object and attribute selection.

AI.tldr: viaCross 是一种基于笔的划选（crossing）技术，用划选笔画定义属性约束，并配合属性控件来可视化和编辑这些约束；对比研究表明它在复杂对象级选择上更高效，而 WIMP 面板在简单属性选择上更直观。
AI.motivation: 以往关于划选（crossing-based selection）的研究虽多，但忽视了多对象与属性选择结合划选手势的场景，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 提出 viaCross 笔式技术：划选笔画定义属性约束，配以属性控件可视化并支持后续编辑；并通过控制实验将其与传统的 WIMP 过滤面板进行比较。
AI.result: viaCross 在复杂对象级选择中更高效，笔画更少，且随任务难度增加仍保持效率；WIMP 面板在简单属性选择上更快更直观，但出现重复取消选择和偶发误点；在创建属性选择上两者相当，但 viaCross 在细化调整时较慢，因为控件需重新创建。
AI.conclusion: viaCross 表明基于划选的手势可为多对象与属性选择提供高效且可扩展的方法；未来需引入持久化控件或与 WIMP 风格界面混合支持。

title: LLM-enhanced spatio-temporal learning for grid-level docked bike sharing demand prediction
comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE 29th International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC)
summary: Short-term bike-sharing demand forecasting is complicated by spatial-temporal non-stationarity and the practical difficulty of incorporating unstructured external text into numerical pipelines. Conventional approaches rely on historical flow sequences and fixed graph structures, thereby constraining their accuracy when anomalous social events perturb normal travel patterns. We propose a forecasting framework in which a Large Language Model (LLM) drives a semantic shockwave mechanism that converts free-form urban text, such as municipal event schedules, local news, and transit bulletins, into quantified spatial-temporal perturbation fields. The LLM extracts three physically interpretable parameters per event (intensity, spatial reach, and temporal lag), from which Gaussian decay fields are constructed and injected into a Zero-Inflated Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Graph Convolutional Network (ZI-ASTGCN). To handle the pronounced sparsity of grid-level measurements, the model couples a dual-branch output head with a multi-task zero-inflated loss that jointly trains a gating probability and a conditional flow intensity. Experiments on the operational Barcelona Bicing dataset show that ZI-ASTGCN outperforms established neural baselines, with particularly strong gains during high-demand periods, validating the utility of physics-grounded semantic signals in spatial-temporal mobility forecasting.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用LLM将城市非结构化文本转化为时空扰动场，注入零膨胀自适应时空图卷积网络（ZI-ASTGCN），在巴塞罗那Bicing数据集上优于现有基线，高需求时段增益尤为明显。
AI.motivation: 共享单车短时需求预测面临时空非平稳性，且难以将非结构化外部文本融入数值模型。传统方法依赖历史流量序列和固定图结构，当异常社会事件扰动正常出行模式时精度受限。
AI.method: 构建以LLM驱动的"语义冲击波"机制：LLM从市政活动日程、本地新闻、交通公告等自由文本中，为每个事件提取三个物理可解释参数（强度、空间影响范围、时间滞后），据此构造高斯衰减场并注入ZI-ASTGCN。针对网格级测量稀疏问题，模型采用双分支输出头与多任务零膨胀损失，联合训练门控概率与条件流量强度。
AI.result: 在巴塞罗那Bicing运营数据集上，ZI-ASTGCN优于既有神经基线，尤其在高需求时段提升显著，验证了物理化语义信号在时空出行预测中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将非结构化城市文本经LLM转化为物理可解释的时空扰动信号，并耦合零膨胀建模，可有效提升共享单车需求预测精度，为时空出行预测提供了新思路。

title: MLLMs Fail to Refuse when Using Tools Agentically
summary: Agentic multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have recently pushed the frontier of visual reasoning by calling tools such as zooming and tagging. Despite the recent strong success of agentic MLLMs, this work uncovers a critical safety failure in the tool-use paradigm: agentic tool-using MLLMs become less capable of refusing harmful requests. Our experiments confirm that, across three popular safety benchmarks, all the top open- and closed-weight MLLMs we test exhibit significantly lower safety in tool-using settings than in non-tool settings, with a relative refusal failure rate increase of up to 68.7%. Based on analysis of 100,000+ responses, including extended experiments, we also propose two possible reasons for this safety degradation.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现智能体式工具使用多模态大模型（MLLMs）在工具使用场景下拒绝有害请求的能力显著下降，安全基准上相对拒绝失败率最高增加68.7%，并基于10万余条回答提出两种可能的退化原因。
AI.motivation: 智能体式MLLMs通过缩放、标注等工具调用推动了视觉推理的发展，但其工具使用范式中可能存在被忽视的安全隐患，即工具使用会削弱模型拒绝有害请求的能力。
AI.method: 在三个主流安全基准上，对比测试了多个顶级开源与闭源权重MLLMs在工具使用与非工具使用场景下的安全性表现，并分析了超过10万条模型回答，辅以扩展实验。
AI.result: 所有被测试的顶级MLLMs在工具使用设置下的安全性均显著低于非工具设置，相对拒绝失败率最高上升68.7%。
AI.conclusion: 工具使用范式会导致智能体式MLLMs安全性退化，论文提出了两种可能的原因来解释这一现象。

title: Assessing Acceptance and Privacy Preferences of Third-party Financial Data Sharing in Bipolar Disorder
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, preregistration available at https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/5AKEB
summary: Bipolar disorder is strongly associated with financial instability. We examine how different interventions motivate individuals with bipolar disorder to share financial data with others. This approach can inform the development of tools for digital monitoring and intervention designed to promote financial stability in this population. 500 individuals with BD completed a pre-registered factorial vignette survey to examine level of comfort with hypothetical scenarios involving third-party financial interventions during symptomatic and euthymic periods. Scenario components were systematically varied between third-party actors, mood states, and intervention types. Participants rated sharing comfort on a 0-10 point scale. Multilevel models tested differences alongside clinical and financial histories, relational trust, and personality. Participants were most comfortable involving care partners in financial planning. They were more comfortable with temporary spending restrictions during symptomatic states than euthymic periods, underscoring the importance of accurate mood detection for intervention delivery. Prior financial help-seeking behavior and higher relational trust predicted greater comfort. Bankruptcy experience --- declared by 11.4% and considered by 31.7% --- was associated with increased comfort with spending restrictions. Individuals with psychiatric advance directives (8%) were significantly more comfortable sharing spending behaviors than those without. Comfort with financial interventions was higher among those with prior financial challenges or help-seeking histories. Participants distinguished between symptomatic and euthymic periods, favoring targeted, time-limited restrictions over general monitoring. These findings extend prior work on financial data sharing for illness self-management.

AI.tldr: 双相障碍患者最愿意让照护伙伴参与财务规划，且更接受在症状期而非稳定期实施临时支出限制，既往财务求助经历、关系信任和破产经历会提高其接受度。
AI.motivation: 双相障碍与财务不稳定密切相关，研究希望了解不同干预方式如何激励患者与他人共享财务数据，从而为促进该群体财务稳定的数字监测与干预工具开发提供依据。
AI.method: 500名双相障碍个体完成预注册的析因情景调查，情景涉及第三方财务干预，系统变化第三方角色、情绪状态和干预类型，参与者以0-10分评价共享舒适度，并用多层模型结合临床与财务史、关系信任和人格特征进行分析。
AI.result: 参与者最愿意让照护伙伴参与财务规划；相比稳定期，更接受症状期的临时支出限制，说明准确情绪检测对干预实施很重要。既往财务求助行为和更高的关系信任预测更高舒适度。11.4%有破产经历、31.7%曾考虑破产者更接受支出限制；有精神科预立医疗指示（8%）者更愿意共享支出行为。
AI.conclusion: 有财务挑战或求助经历的人对财务干预接受度更高；参与者能区分症状期与稳定期，更偏好有针对性的、限时限制而非一般性监测。研究扩展了财务数据共享用于疾病自我管理的工作。

title: KVE-KD: Key Visual Evidence-Guided Knowledge Distillation for Vision-Language Models
summary: Knowledge distillation is crucial for deploying vision-language models on resource-constrained devices. However, existing methods typically impose uniform supervision across visual tokens or rely on static token selection, which confuses task-relevant cues with background noise and degrades cross-modal reasoning. To address this limitation, we propose Key Visual Evidence-guided Knowledge Distillation (KVE-KD), a framework that dynamically focuses feature distillation on task-relevant visual tokens identified by the teacher model. Specifically, KVE-KD appoints the final pre-generation textual token as a unified semantic anchor and identifies the target cross-modal fusion layer by analyzing changes in the anchor representation through iterative visual-token contribution removal. Within this layer, KVE-KD ranks visual tokens via the anchor-conditioned attention distribution and selects the most informative visual tokens as key visual evidence with normalized entropy. The key visual evidence subsequently guides focused visual feature distillation, making the student align closely with the teacher's task-relevant visual representations while suppressing irrelevant background information. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate that KVE-KD outperforms state-of-the-art cross-modal distillation methods, with particularly pronounced gains on tasks requiring complex reasoning and fine-grained visual understanding. Importantly, these improvements are achieved without introducing any inference-time overhead. The source code is available at https://github.com/zhangjianbin07/KVE-KD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KVE-KD框架，通过教师模型动态识别任务相关的关键视觉证据，指导视觉特征蒸馏，提升视觉语言模型跨模态推理能力且无推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有知识蒸馏方法对视觉token施加统一监督或采用静态token选择，混淆了任务相关线索与背景噪声，导致跨模态推理性能下降。作者希望动态聚焦于任务相关的视觉token以改进蒸馏效果。具体地，作者希望将蒸馏监督集中在由教师模型识别出的、与任务真正相关的视觉token上，而非对所有token一视同仁。
AI.method: 提出KVE-KD框架：1）将最终生成前的文本token作为统一语义锚点；2）通过迭代移除视觉token贡献并分析锚点表示变化，定位目标跨模态融合层；3）在该层中基于锚点条件注意力分布对视觉token排序，用归一化熵选出最具信息量的token作为关键视觉证据；4）以关键视觉证据引导聚焦式视觉特征蒸馏，使学生对齐教师的任务相关视觉表示并抑制背景信息。
AI.result: 在六个基准测试上，KVE-KD优于当前最先进的跨模态蒸馏方法，在需要复杂推理和细粒度视觉理解的任务上提升尤为显著，且不引入任何推理时开销。
AI.conclusion: KVE-KD通过动态识别任务相关的关键视觉证据来指导知识蒸馏，有效提升了视觉语言模型在资源受限设备上的部署性能，兼顾了效果与效率。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Model Decision-Making for Autonomous Driving Guided by Chinese Philosophical Wisdom
summary: Autonomous driving decision systems must balance safety, efficiency, and social norms in complex traffic interactions. Philosophical and ethical considerations have received limited attention in existing autonomous driving decision-making approaches based on numerical optimization, sequence prediction, and large language models (LLMs). We propose Chinese Philosophical Wisdom-Guided Driving (CPW-Drive), a closed-loop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework that incorporates value guidance derived from Chinese philosophy into autonomous driving decision-making. Using Chinese Confucian thought as its knowledge source, CPW-Drive consolidates LLM-extracted keywords from relevant classical texts into driving-relevant value principles through manual screening and validation. It then contextualizes these principles through scenario-specific cases to form retrievable and reusable value guidance. We further propose Physics-aware Spatial Similarity Retrieval (PSSR), which compares vehicle layouts and velocity-extrapolated states to retrieve physically relevant historical cases. On Highway-env's multilane highway-driving task, CPW-Drive achieves success rates of 93.0%, 86.0%, and 72.0% across three traffic configurations. These results outperform the strongest baseline by 8.0, 22.5, and 25.0 percentage points, respectively. Across all configurations, CPW-Drive achieves the highest collision-free step count and maintains a low lane-change frequency. The results suggest that structured value guidance can improve simulated closed-loop safety and stability while introducing efficiency and latency trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 提出CPW-Drive，将中国哲学价值指导引入自动驾驶决策，通过闭环RAG框架与物理感知检索提升仿真安全性与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于数值优化、序列预测和大语言模型的自动驾驶决策方法，对哲学与伦理价值的关注有限，难以在复杂交通交互中兼顾安全、效率与社会规范。
AI.method: CPW-Drive为闭环RAG框架：以中国儒家思想为知识源，将经典文本经LLM提取关键词并人工筛选验证，整合为驾驶相关价值原则；再通过场景化案例形成可检索、可复用的价值指导；并提出物理感知空间相似度检索（PSSR），比较车辆布局与速度外推状态以检索物理相关的历史案例。
AI.result: 在Highway-env多车道高速驾驶任务中，三种交通配置下成功率为93.0%、86.0%、72.0%，分别超过最强基线8.0、22.5、25.0个百分点；各配置下均取得最高无碰撞步数，并保持较低换道频率。
AI.conclusion: 结构化价值指导可提升仿真闭环中的安全性与稳定性，但会带来效率与延迟方面的权衡。

title: A study on human-agent teaming through spoken interaction: the impact of human individual traits and agent characteristics
summary: Human-agent teams are collaborative systems where humans and agents work interdependently to achieve shared goals. The success of such teams is associated with the human's perception of the agent as a legitimate teammate. This perception is thought to depend not only on the agent's capabilities and reliability but also on social factors. We explore whether simple changes in an agent's communicative behavior can influence the human's perception of the agent's teammate-likeness. To this end, we developed a protocol based on a collaborative game requiring spoken interaction, in which a human subject and a virtual agent collaborate to identify a target object and place it on a board. Each subject interacted with two agents which provided the same task-relevant information but differed in behavior. While one was a neutral tool-like agent, the other was a team-building agent that used simple social strategies such as empathy, politeness, and positivity. Our analysis shows that the team-building agent was perceived as significantly more teammate-like, even in terms of its ability, despite both agents having identical capabilities for game-solving. Further, subjects with a higher propensity to trust automated systems and lower neuroticism tended to have a more favorable perception of the agent. Finally, we found that subjects tended to change their prosodic patterns when talking to the team-building agent, as a classifier based on prosodic features was able to predict the type of agent with better-than-random performance. A practically relevant conclusion is that minimal changes in spoken communication behavior of the agent, easily implemented in a variety of scenarios, can have a significant positive impact on the human's perception of its teammate-likeness.

AI.tldr: 通过协作游戏实验发现，智能体简单的社交沟通行为（共情、礼貌、积极）即可显著提升人类对其“队友感”的感知，且人的信任倾向和神经质会影响这一感知。
AI.motivation: 人机团队的成功依赖于人类是否将智能体视为合法队友，而这种感知不仅取决于能力与可靠性，也可能受社交因素影响。作者希望探究仅改变智能体沟通行为是否能影响队友感感知。
AI.method: 开发基于协作游戏的协议，需语音交互，人类与虚拟智能体合作识别目标物并放置到板上。每位被试与两个智能体互动：一个中性工具型，一个团队建设型（使用共情、礼貌、积极等社交策略），两者任务相关信息相同。
AI.result: 团队建设型智能体被感知为显著更具队友感，包括能力方面，尽管两者解题能力相同。信任自动化系统倾向更高、神经质更低的被试对智能体评价更正面。基于韵律特征的分类器能以优于随机的性能预测智能体类型，表明被试对团队建设型智能体说话时改变了韵律模式。
AI.conclusion: 智能体在语音沟通行为上的微小改变易于在多种场景中实现，并能显著积极影响人类对其队友感的感知。

title: BAT-NO: A Boundary-Condition-Aware Transformer Neural Operator for Crashworthiness Prediction of Vehicle Components
summary: High-fidelity finite-element simulations provide accurate crashworthiness predictions, but their cost limits iterative design exploration. Deep learning surrogates can reduce this cost, but many component-level models are developed under a single prescribed boundary condition, limiting generalisation to boundary variations. This work proposes a Boundary-Condition-Aware Transformer Neural Operator (BAT-NO) for autoregressive prediction of transient displacement fields and scalar crashworthiness responses under variations in geometry and boundary conditions. A B-pillar simulation framework evaluates generalisation across variations in geometry, impact position and velocity, and support stiffness. BAT-NO combines recurrent mesh processing with latent-grid Fourier operator processing. Boundary-condition information is transferred to the latent grid through a hybrid local--global mechanism. Slice-based attention models interactions among physically related regions, while direct boundary-to-grid projection preserves local spatial structure. Across the validation sets for the shape-only, shape-and-loading, and shape-loading-boundary cases, BAT-NO achieves the lowest mean final-step mean nodal Euclidean displacement error among the evaluated baselines. In the most challenging case, it reduces the mean error by 32.6% relative to the second-best model. Hyperparameter tuning reduces the validation error from 0.451 to 0.269 mm, with a comparable error of 0.267 mm on 300 unseen test simulations sampled within the investigated design space. An attention-based scalar decoder jointly predicts six response trajectories with a mean relative error of 2.46%. Most derived crashworthiness indicators have median errors below 3%. These results show that explicit local and global boundary-condition representations improve crashworthiness prediction over expanded component-level design spaces.

AI.tldr: 提出一种边界条件感知的Transformer神经算子（BAT-NO），用于在几何与边界条件变化下自回归预测瞬态位移场和碰撞性能响应，误差显著低于基线模型。
AI.motivation: 高保真有限元仿真精度高但成本大，限制迭代设计探索；深度学习代理模型虽能降低成本，但多数部件级模型在单一预设边界条件下开发，泛化能力受限，难以适应边界条件变化。
AI.method: 提出BAT-NO，结合循环网格处理与潜网格傅里叶算子处理；通过局部—全局混合机制将边界条件信息传递至潜网格；使用切片注意力建模物理相关区域间交互，直接边界到网格投影保留局部空间结构；采用注意力标量解码器联合预测六条响应轨迹。
AI.result: 在形状、形状与载荷、形状—载荷—边界三类验证集上，BAT-NO均取得最低的平均末步节点欧氏位移误差；最困难情形下较第二优模型降低32.6%。超参数调优将验证误差从0.451 mm降至0.269 mm，300个未见测试仿真上误差0.267 mm；标量解码器六轨迹平均相对误差2.46%，多数导出碰撞指标中位误差低于3%。
AI.conclusion: 显式的局部与全局边界条件表示可有效提升扩展部件级设计空间下的碰撞性能预测能力。

title: LatentQuant: Preserving the Policy-Facing Latent Contract under NVFP4 VAE Quantization
summary: Recent world action models (WAMs) reuse pretrained video VAEs whose encoder latents directly condition downstream action policies. Quantization must therefore preserve not only reconstruction fidelity but also the policy-facing latent contract expected by the frozen policy. Direct NVFP4 leaves W4A4 quantization error uncompensated, whereas joint quantization-aware training (QAT) can recover reconstruction by moving this representation. On Wan2.1, joint QAT nearly matches FP32 VBench-7 (0.7403 versus 0.7409), yet LIBERO success collapses from 95.5% to 10.5%. Controlled decoder-only experiments show that activation quantize-dequantize operations alter the reconstruction signal and decoder Jacobian, redirecting the gradient returned to the encoder and inducing persistent latent drift. Based on this mechanism, we introduce LatentQuant, a two-stage NVFP4 QAT framework that first aligns the quantized encoder with its high-precision counterpart, then freezes it while adapting the decoder. Across Wan2.1 and Wan2.2, LatentQuant preserves near-baseline control and high reconstruction quality, achieving 95.75% success on LIBERO and 68.8% on RoboTwin. On NVIDIA B300 GPUs, NVFP4 execution achieves 1.17x-1.26x end-to-end VAE speedups over BF16 cuDNN.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LatentQuant，一个两阶段 NVFP4 量化感知训练框架，通过先对齐量化编码器、再冻结编码器并适配解码器，解决了世界动作模型中量化导致策略潜空间契约被破坏的问题。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型（WAMs）复用预训练视频 VAE，其编码器潜变量直接用于条件化下游动作策略，因此量化不仅要保持重建保真度，还须维持冻结策略所期望的潜空间契约。直接使用 NVFP4 会留下未补偿的 W4A4 量化误差；而联合 QAT 虽能恢复重建质量，却会因移动表示而严重破坏控制性能。
AI.method: 基于对机制的受控实验分析（激活量化-反量化操作改变重建信号与解码器雅可比，重定向回传编码器的梯度，造成持续潜空间漂移），本文提出 LatentQuant：一种两阶段 NVFP4 QAT 框架，第一阶段使量化编码器与其高精度对应版本对齐，第二阶段冻结编码器并适配解码器。
AI.result: 在 Wan2.1 上，联合 QAT 的 VBench-7 几乎匹配 FP32（0.7403 vs 0.7409），但 LIBERO 成功率从 95.5% 崩至 10.5%。LatentQuant 在 Wan2.1 与 Wan2.2 上均保持接近基线的高控制性能与重建质量，LIBERO 成功率达 95.75%，RoboTwin 达 68.8%；在 NVIDIA B300 GPU 上，NVFP4 相对 BF16 cuDNN 实现 1.17x–1.26x 端到端 VAE 加速。
AI.conclusion: 量化视频 VAE 的关键在于保护面向策略的潜空间契约，而非仅优化重建。LatentQuant 通过编码器对齐与冻结解码器适配的两阶段策略，在维持控制性能的同时实现 NVFP4 高效推理加速。

title: LINK: A Corpus-Grounded Design Pattern Library for Educational Technologies
summary: Designing learning interfaces is often an ill-structured problem: effective solutions depend on learning goals, subject matter, learner characteristics, and interaction context that are difficult to generalize. Designers must integrate knowledge from learning sciences, interaction design, and subject domains when translating learning goals into interface decisions. Yet, prior efforts to connect learning theory and design have largely focused on learning activities or specific technologies, leaving interface-level design knowledge fragmented across systems. In this work, we take a bottom-up approach to surface this knowledge from existing educational interfaces. We present LINK (Linking INstructional Knowledge to interfaces), a library of 27 recurring interface patterns, organized under nine higher-level design commitments, which describe broader learning-science-grounded goals for interfaces. As part of developing LINK, we conducted a user study (N=14) with designers to evaluate LINK's generative power. Our findings suggest that LINK helps designers generate interface ideas and articulate theory-grounded rationales for design decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LINK，一个包含 27 个界面模式的库，归纳为 9 项设计承诺，旨在将学习科学知识连接到教育界面设计，并通过用户研究验证其生成能力。
AI.motivation: 学习界面设计属于劣构问题，有效方案依赖学习目标、学科内容、学习者特征与交互情境，难以泛化。设计者需整合学习科学、交互设计与学科领域知识。然而以往连接学习理论与设计的努力多聚焦于学习活动或特定技术，界面层面的设计知识碎片化。
AI.method: 采用自下而上的方法，从现有教育界面中提炼知识。提出 LINK（Linking INstructional Knowledge to interfaces），一个包含 27 个可复用界面模式的库，并组织在 9 个更高层次的设计承诺之下，用以描述基于学习科学的更广泛界面目标。开发过程中开展了一项 N=14 的设计师用户研究以评估 LINK 的生成能力。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，LINK 能帮助设计师生成界面想法，并为其设计决策阐述有理论依据的理由。
AI.conclusion: LINK 将碎片化的界面级设计知识系统化，为学习界面设计提供了连接学习科学与交互设计的结构化支持。

title: Retrieval-Centric Deep Learning in Growing Nonparametric Neural Networks
summary: We investigate a general-purpose layer for deep learning that, instead of compressing arbitrary-size training data into fixed-size weight matrices, stores a new pair of key-value representations for every data point during training, and retrieves and recombines these representations through an attention mechanism at inference time - resulting in a growing neural net (NN). While Irie et al. (arXiv:2202.05798) have put forward this perspective from the classic duality expressing any linear layer in a deep NN trained by gradient descent as linear attention (LA) over the training data points, replacing LA by more powerful attention functions, as they suggest, turns out to be non-trivial: we show that naively applying learning rules from the LA case to advanced kernels does not lead to principled optimization. Here we fill this gap and develop functional gradient-based learning rules for kernelized attention layers, based on radial basis function (RBF) and softmax-like kernels - establishing the principled "retrieval-centric deep learning" (RCDL) paradigm. Empirically, we demonstrate the promising performance and learning-efficiency of RCDL on image classification and synthetic teacher-student learning tasks. Moreover, we show that replacing LA in the dual form of NNs by advanced LA variants, namely MesaNet/DeltaNet, yields a formal connection to recently proposed optimizers for conventional fixed-size NNs, offering a novel perspective on deep learning optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"以检索为中心的深度学习"(RCDL)范式，为核化注意力层推导基于函数梯度的学习规则，并在图像分类与教师-学生任务上验证其性能与效率。
AI.motivation: 传统深度网络将任意规模训练数据压缩进固定大小的权重矩阵；Irie等曾提出用注意力直接检索训练数据点表示（增长型神经网络），但把线性注意力替换为更强注意力函数时缺乏有原则的优化方法，朴素套用原学习规则并不可行。
AI.method: 基于函数梯度为核化注意力层（RBF核与softmax类核）推导学习规则，建立RCDL范式；并将NN对偶形式中的线性注意力替换为MesaNet/DeltaNet等高级变体。
AI.result: 在图像分类与合成教师-学生学习任务上展示了RCDL的较好性能与学习效率；此外，用高级LA变体替换对偶形式中的LA，可与近期针对固定大小NN提出的优化器建立形式化联系。
AI.conclusion: RCDL为增长型神经网络的注意力学习提供了有原则的优化框架，并为深度学习优化提供了新的理论视角。

title: ROAR: Unifying Runs across Heterogeneous AI-Driven Research Systems
summary: Each run of an AI-driven research system (ADRS) is an expensive search over a vast solution space, and dependable evaluation requires many runs, making run data both costly to produce and valuable to retain for large-scale analysis. Yet this data remains fragmented: teams operate in isolation, ADRS frameworks emit results in different formats, and no shared infrastructure exists to aggregate or compare runs across problems and systems. We present ROAR, a solution for systematically unifying and analyzing heterogeneous ADRS outputs. ROAR addresses two challenges: reconciling heterogeneous ADRS outputs and enabling analytics across runs with different objectives and scoring functions. We achieve this through a relational schema and parsing layer that normalize heterogeneous ADRS outputs while preserving data lineage and temporal structure, and accommodating new systems without requiring schema modifications. From building a corpus of more than 900 runs from multiple ADRS, we show how pooled data can reveal properties of problem landscapes that are difficult to observe. Consistent with prior work, runs with identical configurations may converge to different scores. We find that many runs realize most gains early, and that the effectiveness of different strategies for incorporating prior solutions into the search process varies across problems. We further show that the pooled corpus is actionable and not merely analytical by using ROAR to configure ADRS runs. Together, these results illustrate how pooled ADRS data can expose problem-dependent structure in search behavior that is difficult to detect from any single system, team, or benchmark. Such cross-cutting insights are difficult to obtain while runs remain siloed; ROAR is the first infrastructure designed to unify them.

AI.tldr: ROAR 是一个用于统一与分析异构 ADRS（AI驱动研究系统）输出的基础设施，通过关系模式与解析层规范化数据，构建了 900+ 次运行的数据语料并揭示跨系统的搜索行为规律。
AI.motivation: ADRS 每次运行都是对庞大解空间的昂贵搜索，可靠评估需要大量运行，因此运行数据既昂贵又宝贵。但数据高度碎片化：团队孤立运作、各框架输出格式不同、缺乏共享基础设施来跨问题与系统聚合和比较运行结果。
AI.method: ROAR 通过关系型模式和解析层，规范化异构 ADRS 输出，同时保留数据血缘与时间结构，并能在无需修改模式的情况下兼容新系统。设计应对两大挑战：异构输出的协调，以及在不同目标与评分函数下实现跨运行分析。基于此构建了涵盖多个 ADRS 的 900+ 次运行语料库。
AI.result: 汇集数据揭示了难以从单一运行中观察的问题景观特性：相同配置的运行可能收敛到不同分数（与既有工作一致）；许多运行在早期即实现大部分收益；将先验解融入搜索过程的不同策略，其有效性因问题而异。此外，ROAR 还能用于配置 ADRS 运行，表明该语料库不仅可分析，而且可付诸行动。
AI.conclusion: 汇集的 ADRS 数据能暴露搜索行为中依赖问题的结构，这是任何单一系统、团队或基准难以察觉的。此类跨领域洞见在运行数据孤立时难以获得，ROAR 是首个旨在统一这些数据的基础设施。

title: DimSteer: Steering LLM Authoring with Automatically Discovered Stylistic Controls
summary: Large language model writing interfaces often make users steer outputs by repeatedly articulating desired changes in natural language. Yet writers may recognize useful stylistic directions only after seeing alternatives, making revision recall-heavy. We present DimSteer, an authoring interface that samples prompt-local completions, discovers high-variance activation-space axes of variation, labels them, and exposes them as sliders with pole previews, diff comparison, and reset controls. Users can manipulate discovered dimensions, reducing the need to reformulate prompts for each stylistic adjustment. In a within-subjects study with 16 participants against a matched prompt-only baseline, DimSteer reduced mental demand, effort, and frustration while preserving comparable perceived success. Participants valued the surfaced dimensions, yet 15 of 16 disagreed that they would have thought to request the same changes in a prompt. Results suggest prompt-local controls can shift LLM authoring from recall-based prompting toward recognition-based exploration and direct manipulation, while preserving prompting for open-ended edits.

AI.tldr: DimSteer 是一个 LLM 写作交互界面，通过采样局部补全、发现激活空间高方差维度并转化为带极值预览的滑块，让用户直接操控风格变化，降低认知负担，实现从"回忆式提示"向"识别式探索"的转变。
AI.motivation: 当前 LLM 写作界面要求用户用自然语言反复表述想要的修改，用户往往在看到备选方案后才能识别有用的风格方向，导致修改过程高度依赖记忆与提示重构，认知负担重。
AI.method: 提出 DimSteer 交互界面：采样提示局部补全，在激活空间中发现高方差的变化轴，对其进行标注，并以滑块形式呈现，配合极值预览、差异对比和重置控件；用户可直接操作这些发现的维度。通过 16 名被试的组内实验，与仅提示的基线进行对比。
AI.result: 相比基线，DimSteer 降低了心理需求、努力感和挫败感，同时保持了相当的主观成功率。参与者重视所呈现的维度，但 16 人中有 15 人表示自己不会想到在提示中主动要求这些相同的变化。
AI.conclusion: 提示局部控件可将 LLM 创作从基于回忆的提示转向基于识别的探索与直接操控，同时保留提示用于开放式编辑。

title: Reinforcement Learning on the Discrete Composition Channel of a Crystal Generator: Validated Gains and Reward Hacking
comment: 26 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables. Code: https://github.com/paprakash/OMatGRPO. Models and structures: https://huggingface.co/paprakash/OMatGRPO
summary: Inverse materials design is a long-standing goal of computational materials discovery. Generative models for crystalline materials are typically trained to match the distribution of a structure database, while nothing in their training objective points them at specific design goals such as targeted properties. We use group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) to align a generative model based on stochastic interpolants and discrete flow matching with general black-box reward functions through reinforcement learning. Atom types are generated by a discrete flow and the policy gradient of our generalization of GRPO directly acts on the likelihoods of the atom-type transitions, which differentiates our work from previous reinforcement-learning approaches for diffusion and flow-based generative models of crystalline materials. We introduce a reward function that raises the yield of metastable, unique and novel structures (mSUN) from 13.4% for the pretrained model to 45.5% for the reinforced model, as evaluated by a community benchmark. Our reward also improves the performance of a reinforcement learning framework for crystalline materials based on latent denoising diffusion models. At the same time, we find that directly reinforcing atom-type transition likelihoods enables reward exploitation that has to be prevented with explicit guards. The same analysis also exposes a gap in the community metric. Single-element structures in distinct packings are counted as metastable, unique and novel materials and inflate mSUN without yielding any new compounds. A stability claim is only as good as its reference hull. We report every result split by the number of reference phases behind it and argue that benchmarks should do the same.

AI.tldr: 本文用GRPO强化学习对齐晶体材料生成模型（随机插值+离散流匹配），直接对原子类型转移似然做策略梯度，通过奖励函数将亚稳、独特、新颖结构（mSUN）产率从13.4%提升至45.5%，并揭示奖励利用风险与基准指标缺陷。
AI.motivation: 逆材料设计是计算材料发现的长期目标，但现有晶体生成模型仅被训练去拟合结构数据库分布，训练目标中没有任何指向特定设计目标（如目标性质）的成分，因此无法按需生成满足设计要求的材料。作者希望用强化学习将生成模型与通用黑盒奖励函数对齐。
AI.method: 采用组相对策略优化（GRPO），对基于随机插值和离散流匹配的晶体生成模型进行强化学习对齐；原子类型由离散流生成，所推广的GRPO策略梯度直接作用于原子类型转移的似然（区别于以往针对扩散/流模型的强化学习方法）。设计了一个提升亚稳、独特、新颖结构（mSUN）产率的奖励函数，并设置显式防护机制以防止奖励利用。
AI.result: 在社区基准评估下，mSUN产率从预训练模型的13.4%提升到强化模型的45.5%；该奖励函数还能提升基于潜在去噪扩散模型的晶体强化学习框架的性能。同时发现直接强化原子类型转移似然会引发奖励利用，需显式防护。分析还暴露社区指标的缺口：不同堆积方式的单元素结构被计入mSUN，虚高产率却不产生新化合物。
AI.conclusion: 将GRPO对齐与直接作用于原子类型转移似然的策略梯度相结合，能有效引导晶体生成模型实现特定设计目标，并获得显著更高的mSUN产率。但奖励利用风险需显式约束；稳定性声明依赖于参考凸包的质量，作者按参考相数量拆分报告所有结果，并主张基准评测也应如此。

title: Teaching Agents to Code Reliably
summary: Autonomous coding agents solve repository issues by reading code, running commands, editing files, and submitting patches. Extra inference-time compute yields gains only when it produces a useful repair and supplies reliable evidence for choosing one. Three behaviors decide both, and we argue they are teachable rather than byproducts of scale, so a policy can carry them instead of a scaffold. Location diversity remains narrow, since attempts return to the same site and extra samples add no coverage. Edit diversity is left unexploited, since methodologies that differ resolve complementary issues no single run reaches. Verification misleads, since a test the agent writes for its own patch accepts many incorrect ones. Directing search by execution feedback and scoring each patch against its own reverted tree resolves 52.8% of SWE-bench Verified using 48.1% of the agent-steps an eight-sample baseline spends. Training moves these behaviors into the policy. On the 270 issues held out from SFT and RL training, weighted supervised fine-tuning raises pass@1 from 31.9% to 35.2% and pass@8 from 46.7% to 51.1%. A reinforcement objective then trains the verifier against gold-labeled repairs and incorrect variants, crediting the assertions that detect them. It raises pass@1 to 43.0% and pass@8 to 60.7%, lifts verifier precision from 26.8% to 41.7%, and more than halves false acceptance. Resolution improves on two of three out-of-distribution suites and verifier precision on all three, and the gains hold at 7B, 14B, and 30B against published coder baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究自主编码智能体的推理时间计算利用问题，提出将位置多样性、编辑多样性和验证三种行为通过训练而非脚手架内化到策略中，从而在更少步骤下取得更高修复率。
AI.motivation: 自主编码智能体在解决仓库问题时，额外的推理时间计算只有在产生有用修复并提供可靠选择证据时才有收益。现有方法中位置多样性狭窄（重复访问同一位置）、编辑多样性未被利用、验证不可靠（自写测试会接受错误补丁），因此需要将这三类行为内化为策略能力。
AI.method: 通过执行反馈引导搜索，并将每个补丁与自身回退后的代码树（reverted tree）对比评分；利用加权监督微调（SFT）将行为移入策略；再用强化学习目标，基于金标修复和错误变体训练验证器，奖励能够检测错误的断言。
AI.result: 仅靠引导搜索即可用48.1%的步骤解决SWE-bench Verified的52.8%（对比八样本基线）。SFT将pass@1从31.9%提升至35.2%、pass@8从46.7%提升至51.1%；RL进一步将pass@1提至43.0%、pass@8提至60.7%，验证器精确率从26.8%升至41.7%，错误接受减半以上。在两个OOD套件上修复率提升、三个套件上验证器精确率提升，且在7B、14B、30B规模上均有效。
AI.conclusion: 三类关键行为（位置多样性、编辑多样性、验证）是可训练的而非规模副产品，可作为策略能力携带。训练后的策略在更少步数下显著提升修复率和验证可靠性，且在不同模型规模和分布外场景中具有泛化性。

title: Evaluating Just Noticeable Differences in Layered Opacity Visualizations
summary: Opacity is a widely used channel in data visualization, but it remains less well understood compared to channels such as color, length, size, etc. Recent work from Meng et al. investigated the impact of opacity across competing color schemes, finding that certain color schemes were associated with better participant accuracy. We examine these effects further in a controlled two-alternative forced-choice setup to determine whether opacity differences are truly equal across possible opacity comparison ranges. In a within-subjects study with 96 trials, including two competing color schemes (best and worst from Meng et al.) and 48 opacity pairs, we find little differences between color schemes but larger individual differences in accuracy. Further, results show stable performance in middle opacity ranges, with more errors occurring when comparing extreme values. We discuss potential implications for design guidelines and further study and make our study materials, analysis scripts, and data available at https://osf.io/zv9dx/overview?view_only=38d03cea1b3d42788593e3e6b1016cfd.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过受控的二选一强迫选择实验，检验不透明度（opacity）差异在不同比较区间内是否真正等同，并考察配色方案的影响。
AI.motivation: 不透明度是数据可视化中广泛使用的通道，但相比颜色、长度、大小等通道，其理解仍不充分。Meng等人的近期工作发现某些配色方案与更高的参与者准确率相关，本文希望进一步验证这些效应，并探讨不透明度差异是否在所有可能的比较区间内都相同。
AI.method: 采用受控的二选一强迫选择（2AFC）实验设计，进行被试内研究，共96个试次，包含两种竞争性配色方案（Meng等人研究中的最佳与最差方案）以及48组不透明度配对。
AI.result: 不同配色方案之间差异很小，但个体在准确率上的差异较大；在中间不透明度区间表现稳定，而比较极端值时错误更多。研究材料、分析脚本和数据已公开。
AI.conclusion: 不透明度差异并非在所有比较区间内等同，极端值比较更易出错；配色方案的影响有限，个体差异更为显著。研究结果为设计指南和后续研究提供了启示。

title: AdaEva: Accelerating LLM-Driven Algorithm Design with Adaptive Partial Evaluation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for automated algorithm design. However the computational cost of evaluating the generated algorithms can be excessive. We consider the common LLM-driven automated algorithm design (LLM4AD) setting in which a candidate algorithm is evaluated by aggregating its performance over a shared set of training instances. This instance-wise structure raises a natural question: must every candidate be evaluated on the entire instance set before deciding whether it remains competitive? Taking inspiration from algorithm configuration, we introduce AdaEva, a drop-in adaptive partial-evaluation framework that progressively evaluates candidates on larger subsets of the same instance pool and eliminates unpromising candidates as evidence accumulates. Importantly, AdaEva leaves the underlying LLM4AD procedure and per-instance evaluator unchanged and requires no prior knowledge about instance difficulty. We instantiate this idea using successive halving (AdaEva-S) and statistical racing (AdaEva-R), and evaluate both mechanisms across three representative LLM4AD frameworks, multiple LLM backbones, and optimization domains spanning combinatorial and continuous black-box optimization. Under matched evaluation budgets, AdaEva more reliably balances evaluation effort across candidates than fixed partial-evaluation strategies, yielding strong search efficiency and anytime performance together with improved held-out generalization across the evaluated settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了 AdaEva，一种用于 LLM 驱动自动算法设计（LLM4AD）的自适应部分评估框架，通过逐步扩大实例子集并淘汰劣质候选，显著提升搜索效率而不改变原有 LLM4AD 流程。
AI.motivation: LLM4AD 中候选算法需在整个训练实例集上评估，计算成本过高；作者受算法配置领域启发，质疑是否必须在决定候选是否具竞争力前评估全部实例。
AI.method: AdaEva 作为一种即插即用框架，在同一实例池上逐步扩大评估子集并淘汰表现不佳的候选；不改变底层 LLM4AD 流程与单实例评估器，也无需实例难度先验知识。具体实例化为连续减半（AdaEva-S）和统计竞赛（AdaEva-R）两种机制。
AI.result: 在三个代表性 LLM4AD 框架、多种 LLM 主干以及组合与连续黑箱优化领域上评估，在相同评估预算下，AdaEva 比固定部分评估策略更可靠地平衡候选间的评估投入，带来更强的搜索效率与 anytime 性能，并改善留出集泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: AdaEva 证明在 LLM4AD 中采用自适应部分评估可在不牺牲泛化性的前提下降低计算成本，是一种通用且有效的效率提升方案。

title: Behavioral History Outperforms Descriptions of the Person for LLM Synthetic Personas
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as synthetic personas representing survey respondents. Their validity as substitutes for particular respondents depends on whether they reproduce individuals' decisions. We examine what information helps synthetic respondents predict each individual's later choices, using five conditions that add progressively richer information: no personal information, demographics, personality traits, cognitive scores, and finally the respondent's earlier survey choices as behavioral history. We use a two-wave panel of 845 US adults who completed measures of 14 behavioral biases (spanning risk, time preferences, overconfidence, and reasoning), so each respondent's earlier answers provide a human test-retest benchmark; in the behavioral-history condition, all items that score the target bias are withheld. At the population level, the average number of biases per respondent in every condition is close to the human average (7.1-8.1 biases, against 7.1 for humans). This aggregate similarity masks differences in variance: persona descriptions recover only 53-67% of human between-person variation, whereas adding behavioral history restores it to approximately the human level. At the individual level, description-based personas achieve only 7-12% of the informedness observed in human test-retest responses, while adding behavioral history raises this to 28%. The condition including behavioral history has the highest estimated informedness in all 17 demographic groups, whereas description-based conditions provide little or no information for some groups. Synthetic responses also exhibit stronger education- and income-related differences than human responses. For LLM synthetic personas, a respondent's past answers add more to individual-level prediction than a description of who they are.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究LLM合成人格预测个体选择的有效性，发现被调查者过去的作答（行为历史）比人口学、人格特质或认知分数等描述性信息更能提升个体层面的预测准确性。
AI.motivation: LLM日益被用作代表调查受访者的合成人格，但其作为特定个体替代品的有效性取决于能否重现个体决策。论文旨在探究哪些信息有助于合成受访者预测每个人的后续选择。
AI.method: 使用845名美国成年人的两波面板数据，完成14种行为偏差（涵盖风险、时间偏好、过度自信和推理）的测量；设置五种信息逐渐丰富的条件：无个人信息、人口学特征、人格特质、认知分数、以及受访者先前调查作答作为行为历史。在行为历史条件中，所有用于评分目标偏差的题目被剔除。以人类重测信度作为基准。
AI.result: 在群体层面，各条件的人均偏差数（7.1-8.1）接近人类平均（7.1），但掩盖了方差差异：人格描述仅恢复53-67%的人类个体间变异，加入行为历史后可恢复至接近人类水平。在个体层面，基于描述的人格仅达到人类重测反应的7-12%信息量，加入行为历史后提升至28%。行为历史条件在全部17个人口学群体中估计信息量最高，而描述条件对某些群体几乎无信息。合成回答还表现出比人类更强的教育与收入相关差异。
AI.conclusion: 对于LLM合成人格，受访者过去的作答比对其身份的描述对个体层面预测贡献更大，这凸显了行为历史在构建有效合成受访者中的关键作用。

title: Benchmarking Psychological Dynamics in Generative Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed to simulate human behavior, acting as computational replicas of human subjects. Yet the lived psychological experience of humans is difficult to benchmark, particularly as it unfolds over time. We introduce a psychometric benchmark for computational replicas: personas that carry a fixed identity through an evolving sequence of events. Built entirely from published norms and meta-analytic effects, the benchmark scores two dimensions of psychological realism. The first, internal validity, quantifies whether generated trajectories reproduce the internal structure of repeated human measurement: distributions, the between- versus within-person variance partition, temporal dependence, and range. The second, external validity, quantifies whether replicas recover established trait, state, and indicator relations. Across 36 open-weight and proprietary LLMs from nine developers (1B-671B parameters), most recover the direction of established relations (84.3% mean agreement) and the variance partition (26 of 34), yet the within-person correlation and distributional structure elude recovery. Internal validity is independent of scale and capability: a mid-size open LLM (Gemma-3-27B) strikes the best trade-off between the two dimensions. The benchmark is a precondition for using computational replicas in causal inference across domains (e.g., marketing, healthcare), and identifies within-person grounding as the central challenge ahead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个用于评估"计算复制品"(携带固定身份、在事件序列中演化的AI人格)的心理测量学基准，考察36个大语言模型在内部效度与外部效度两个维度的心理真实性，发现多数模型能恢复关系方向与方差分解，但难以复现个体内相关与分布结构，且内部效度与模型规模、能力无关。
AI.motivation: LLM日益被用于模拟人类行为，充当人类被试的计算复制品，但人类"亲历的心理体验"难以被基准化，尤其当它随时间展开时。因此需要一个心理测量学基准来评估这些复制品的心理真实性，这也是将计算复制品用于因果推断的前提。
AI.method: 构建由已发表常模与元分析效应构成的基准，其中人格携带固定身份经历演化的事件序列。基准从两个维度打分：内部效度(生成轨迹是否复现重复人类测量的内部结构，包括分布、个体间与个体内方差分解、时间依赖、取值范围)与外部效度(复制品能否恢复已确立的特质、状态与指标关系)。在来自九家开发者的36个开放权重与专有LLM(1B–671B参数)上进行评估。
AI.result: 多数模型能恢复已确立关系的方向(平均一致率84.3%)和方差分解(34个中26个)，但个体内相关与分布结构无法被复现。内部效度与模型规模和能力无关，中等规模的开源模型Gemma-3-27B在两个维度间取得最佳权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该基准是在营销、医疗等领域使用计算复制品进行因果推断的先决条件，并指出"个体内基础"(within-person grounding)是未来面临的核心挑战。

title: COVER: Learning to Accept More in Selective Sleep Staging
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures; code and frozen-result reproduction: https://github.com/Kevin11Kaikai/COVER-Selective-Sleep-Staging
summary: Traditional sleep-staging methods apply the same model to every EEG epoch. Such uniform deployment expends computation on epochs that a smaller model could handle reliably, motivating cascades in which a primary classifier accepts its reliable predictions and defers the remainder to a more capable model. In this paper, we study the first stage of such a cascade: maximizing the coverage of fixed primary predictions subject to a prescribed accepted-risk target. We propose COVER (COVerage-oriented Error Ranking), which integrates two key innovations: (i) auxiliary-informed primary-error learning, which replaces maximum softmax probability (MSP) with a learned error score while preserving the primary labels, and (ii) fixed-scale scorer refinement, which builds on this score to directly maximize coverage under an empirical accepted-risk constraint rather than error-prediction accuracy over all epochs. We evaluate COVER on Sleep-EDF-20 at a 5% accepted-risk target, with subjects held out from all fitting and selection. Auxiliary-informed error learning raises mean subject coverage from 31.5% for MSP to 48.8% at similar subject-equal risk. At equal acceptance volume, with MSP accepting the same number of epochs as the learned scorer in each subject (20,639 in total), errors fall from 1,467 to 867. Fixed-scale refinement then adds 1.7 percentage points of coverage over its initialization in nested development, and COVER attains the highest mean coverage among eight evaluated scorers, 50.4% at 4.5% subject-equal risk, above the selective-ranking baseline SELE (49.3%) and the probability-fusion comparator DuoF (43.6%). To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to combine auxiliary-informed primary-error learning with fixed-scale coverage refinement for selective sleep staging, offering a basis for reliability-aware allocation of computation in cascaded sleep staging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 COVER 方法，通过辅助信息引导的初级错误学习与固定尺度评分器精化，在给定可接受风险下最大化初级睡眠分期预测的覆盖率，为级联式睡眠分期提供可靠性感知的计算分配基础。
AI.motivation: 传统睡眠分期对所有 EEG 片段使用同一模型，计算开销浪费在小模型即可可靠处理的片段上，因此引出级联结构：初级分类器接受可靠预测，其余延迟给更强模型。本文研究该级联的第一阶段——在给定可接受风险目标下最大化固定初级预测的覆盖率。
AI.method: 提出 COVER（面向覆盖率的错误排序），包含两项创新：(i) 辅助信息引导的初级错误学习，用学习到的错误分数替代最大 softmax 概率（MSP），同时保留初级标签；(ii) 固定尺度评分器精化，基于该分数在经验可接受风险约束下直接最大化覆盖率，而非优化所有片段的错误预测准确率。
AI.result: 在 Sleep-EDF-20 上以 5% 可接受风险目标评估，受试者从所有拟合与选择中留出。辅助错误学习将平均受试者覆盖率从 MSP 的 31.5% 提升至 48.8%（受试者等风险下）；在相同接受量（共 20,639 个片段）下，错误从 1,467 降至 867。固定尺度精化在嵌套开发中额外提升 1.7 个百分点覆盖率。COVER 在八种评分器中取得最高平均覆盖率 50.4%（4.5% 受试者等风险），高于选择性排序基线 SELE（49.3%）和概率融合对比方法 DuoF（43.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 这被认为是首个将辅助信息引导的初级错误学习与固定尺度覆盖率精化相结合用于选择性睡眠分期的工作，为级联睡眠分期中可靠性感知的计算分配提供了基础。

title: SkillScriptBench: Benchmarking Self-Evolution of Executable Agent Skill Packages Beyond Markdown
summary: Executable Agent Skills combine natural-language instructions and scripts into reusable packages for LLM agents, and revising them requires fixing errors without breaking correct behavior. Existing benchmarks do not systematically distinguish documentation repair, script repair, and preservation when evaluating skill self-evolution. We introduce SkillScriptBench, a 350-task benchmark designed to evaluate these capabilities separately. From a survey of over 35,000 GitHub-hosted Skill roots, we select 100 packages and construct 150 repair tasks. Each task pairs a package containing injected script faults with a maintenance request and executable checks of the required behavior. A complementary controlled track contains 200 tasks from 50 packages, each evaluated under the same maintenance request in four states: clean, documentation faults, script faults, and faults in both. Across four LLMs, methods that edit both documentation and scripts can repair script faults but do not consistently outperform Markdown-only revision on documentation repair or preservation. We therefore introduce AST-Guided Skill Revision, which uses abstract syntax trees and calling relationships to link maintenance requirements to relevant code locations. It restricts script edits to these locations and updates the documentation to match the revised scripts. Averaged across models, this revision stage yields absolute gains in repair success of 21.9% for Raw Package and 27.7% for CoEvoSkills on faulty packages. Absolute gains in the proportion of tasks solved in all three runs reach 20.8% and 31.5%, respectively, indicating more consistent repair success across repeated runs.
