AI.tldr: 本文研究不同解码器架构对物理循环神经网络（Physically Recurrent Neural Network）潜在空间可解释性的影响，提出一种新的权重归一化约束以改善低数据下的训练，并通过编码器-解码器伴随结构与正标量约束实现热力学一致性，从而在保证物理一致性的同时提升数据效率。
AI.motivation: 物理神经网络虽能结合物理规律，但其潜在空间的可解释性、低数据条件下的训练稳定性以及热力学一致性尚未充分探讨。本文旨在通过架构设计（尤其是解码器结构与权重约束）来提升潜在空间的物理意义和数据效率。
AI.method: 1) 分析不同解码器架构对潜在空间可解释性的影响；2) 引入新的权重归一化约束作为正则化手段，实现低数据下的稳定训练；3) 通过视觉探索验证虚拟应力可与真实RVE状态对齐；4) 利用有意义的潜在空间开展多任务学习，无需额外参数或更大训练集；5) 采用带正标量贡献的伴随编码器-解码器结构，强制能量跨尺度一致与非负耗散。
AI.result: 提出的权重归一化约束使低数据训练更稳定；虚拟应力无需显式训练即可与真实RVE状态对齐；多任务方法在不增加参数和训练集的情况下有效利用微观信息；特定的伴随编码器-解码器结构自然导出热力学一致的形式，保证能量一致性与非负耗散，并进一步降低训练需求。
AI.conclusion: 解码器架构的选择对潜在空间可解释性、归纳偏置和热力学一致性具有关键作用。基于物理的架构设计（如权重归一化与伴随编码器-解码器结构）可显著提升数据效率，实现可解释且物理一致的模型。

title: InvestigationWorlds: An Agentic Environment for Legal Investigation
summary: We introduce InvestigationWorlds, an agentic environment for legal investigation. We build on an underused artifact of U.S. civil litigation: the summary judgment motion. This motion relies upon a record composed of real evidence exhibits, and results in a court-adopted hypothesis that is treated as ground truth for the purposes of deciding the motion. Each environment is built from a real U.S. Federal Court case retrieved from Public Access to Court Electronic Records (PACER) and augmented by an attorney-validated generation pipeline that synthesizes role-tagged documents around the original record. The resulting corpus admits multiple coherent factual readings, only one of which matches the court-adopted hypothesis. Evaluating on 100 cases, we find agents often commit to incorrect hypotheses despite retrieving relevant evidence, struggling to distinguish the court-adopted hypothesis from alternative hypotheses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 InvestigationWorlds，一个面向法律调查的智能体环境，基于美国民事诉讼中的简易判决动议构建，用于评估智能体从复杂证据中推断唯一正确事实假设的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体评测环境缺乏真实、复杂且具有多解性的法律调查场景。美国简易判决动议依赖真实证据记录，且最终形成被法院采纳的、作为判定依据的唯一"真值假设"，为构建此类环境提供了理想基础。
AI.method: 从 PACER 检索真实美国联邦法院案例，结合经律师验证的生成流程，围绕原始记录合成带有角色标签的文件，构建每个环境。该语料可支持多种自洽的事实解读，但只有一种与法院采纳的假设一致。
AI.result: 在 100 个案例上评估发现，智能体即便检索到相关证据，仍常得出错误假设，难以将法院采纳的假设与替代假设区分开来。
AI.conclusion: InvestigationWorlds 揭示了当前智能体在法律事实推断上的显著局限：检索到证据并不等于能正确消解多解性，为未来法律推理智能体研究提供了新基准与挑战。

title: What Did the AI Take On? Characterizing Cognitive Delegation in LLM Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often perform intermediate cognitive work while carrying out users' requests, yet it remains unclear which parts users intended to delegate and how they wanted to remain involved. This matters because consequential choices may go unnoticed, limiting users' ability to steer the process, while reviewing every step would make delegation burdensome. We examined this with 24 LLM users across three knowledge-work tasks, collecting 992 retrospective annotations of reasoning steps. From this, we developed taxonomies of LLM cognitive work, delegation enactment, and desired delegation protocols at the reasoning-step level. Our analysis revealed that participants viewed about half of all steps (48.6%) as AI-initiated, meaning the AI took on work they had not requested. Desired involvement varied with cognitive work and delegation enactment, even when contributions matched participants' intent. We propose design implications and sketches for supporting more deliberate cognitive delegation through flexible protocols and inspectable, revisable AI-initiated decisions.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过24名用户的实验和992条推理步骤回溯标注，构建了LLM认知工作、委托执行与期望委托协议的分类体系，揭示约半数步骤为用户未请求的AI自主发起，并提出支持审慎认知委托的设计建议。
AI.motivation: LLM在完成用户请求时会进行大量中间认知工作，但用户究竟打算委托哪些部分、希望以何种方式参与仍不明确。若有重大决策被忽视，用户将难以掌控过程；而若要求审查每一步，委托又会变得繁琐。因此需要在"可引导性"与"委托负担"之间找到平衡。
AI.method: 招募24名LLM用户，开展三项知识工作任务，收集共992条针对推理步骤的回溯性标注；基于此构建三个层面的分类体系：LLM认知工作类型、委托执行方式、以及用户期望的委托协议（均以推理步骤为粒度进行分析）。
AI.result: 参与者将约48.6%的步骤视为"AI发起"，即AI承担了用户并未请求的工作；即使贡献与用户意图相符，期望的参与程度仍随认知工作类型和委托执行方式而变化。
AI.conclusion: 用户对认知委托的期望是情境化的、非二元的。据此提出设计启示与原型草图，通过灵活协议和可检查、可修改的AI发起决策，支持更具审慎性的认知委托。

title: Articulatory Entrainment and Coordination Complexity in Spontaneous Autistic and Non-autistic Dialogue
comment: Accepted to be published in Interspeech 2026
summary: Articulatory entrainment, the adaptation of vocal tract coordination to facilitate interaction remains underexplored in spontaneous dialogue, particularly among autistic speakers. Many prior studies have utilized task-based, phoneme-level analyses with invasive measurement techniques. Here, we introduce a speaker-independent framework to quantify articulatory entrainment in spontaneous dyadic conversations among autistic and non-autistic adults using acoustic-to-articulatory inversion and coordination complexity metrics. We examine temporal changes in articulatory coordination across interaction. Non-autistic dyads exhibit increasing coordination complexity and stronger entrainment over time, autistic dyads show moderate effects, and mixed dyads demonstrate the least alignment. Greater articulatory entrainment correlates with higher self-reported conversational success, indicating increase in coordination complexity as a marker of effective social interaction.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一种与说话人无关的框架，利用声学到发音反演与协调复杂度指标，量化自闭症与非自闭症成人在自发双人对话中的发音同步现象。
AI.motivation: 发音同步（发音器官协调对互动的适应）在自发对话中研究不足，尤其是对自闭症说话者。以往研究多采用任务导向、音素层面的分析，并使用侵入式测量手段，限制了生态效度。
AI.method: 采用声学到发音反演技术结合协调复杂度指标，构建与说话人无关的分析框架，考察自闭症、非自闭症及混合双人组在自发对话中发音协调随时间的动态变化。
AI.result: 非自闭症双人组随时间推移表现出协调复杂度上升和更强的发音同步；自闭症双人组效果中等；混合双人组对齐程度最低。发音同步越强，自评对话成功率越高。
AI.conclusion: 协调复杂度的提升可作为有效社会互动的标志，发音同步与对话成功感相关，该框架为自发对话中的发音协调研究提供了非侵入式、与说话人无关的量化途径。

title: Auditing Pairwise Equivalence Judgments: Self-Critique Effects and Diversity Measurement in Multi-Agent Hypothesis Generation
comment: Accepted at the Agentic AI for Biological Discovery Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Multi-agent systems built on large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to scientific discovery and hypothesis generation. Both the effect of refinement and the diversity of the delivered set are hard to interpret before experimental ground truth exists, and both are typically reported by deciding whether pairs of generated hypotheses describe the same underlying mechanism. We study two evaluation questions that rest on this pairwise equivalence judgment: (1) how much self-critique changes delivered hypotheses beyond run-to-run variability, and (2) how the equivalence rule used to group hypotheses affects measured diversity. Across four proprietary instances, we hold opening hypotheses fixed, rerun the downstream workflow with 0, 1, and 5 critique rounds, and score matched hypothesis pairs with an LLM-as-a-judge. Relative to matched same-depth reruns, moving from 0 to 1 round produces 34.5 percentage points (pp) of additional mechanism-level divergence, whereas 1 to 5 rounds adds 1.3 pp. We then compare three equivalence rules: term frequency--inverse document frequency (TF--IDF) similarity, dense embeddings, and the same LLM-as-a-judge. We construct controlled hypothesis pairs that either preserve the causal explanation through wording or biological-terminology changes, or replace one component of the causal chain while holding the rest fixed. All three rules are invariant to meaning-preserving edits, but when the initiating event is replaced, the LLM-as-a-judge identifies 83% of valid pairs as different mechanisms, versus 0% for TF--IDF and 8% for embeddings; varying only the rubric that defines same mechanism moves this figure from 38% to 96%. Together, these results show that pairwise equivalence judgments are a measurement choice: how mechanism equivalence is defined affects both the estimated effect of self-critique and the measured diversity of generated hypotheses.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究基于大语言模型的多智能体假设生成中的两个评测问题：自我批判对假设的净影响，以及等价规则如何影响多样性度量。结果表明，配对等价判断是一种测量选择，其定义方式会显著改变对自我批判效应和多样性的估计。
AI.motivation: 在多智能体科学发现与假设生成中，精炼效果与交付集合的多样性在缺乏实验真值前难以解释，二者通常依赖"两两假设是否描述同一底层机制"的等价判断。而这一判断本身缺乏系统检验。
AI.method: 固定初始假设，在四个专有模型实例上以0、1、5轮批判重跑下游流程，用LLM-as-a-judge对配对假设打分；随后比较三种等价规则（TF-IDF相似度、稠密嵌入、LLM-as-a-judge），并构造控制配对：通过措辞或生物学术语改变但保留因果解释，或替换因果链中某一组件而保持其余不变。
AI.result: 相比同深度重跑，从0到1轮批判带来34.5个百分点的额外机制层面分歧，而1到5轮仅增加1.3个百分点。三种规则对保义编辑均不变，但当起始事件被替换时，LLM-as-a-judge将83%的有效配对判为不同机制，TF-IDF为0%，嵌入为8%；仅改变"同一机制"的评分标准，该比例即从38%变到96%。
AI.conclusion: 配对等价判断是一种测量选择：机制等价如何定义，会同时影响对自我批判效应的估计与对生成假设多样性的度量，因此相关评测结果需明确其等价规则假设。

title: AISSA Demo: AI-based Student Slides Analysis Tool for Automated Grading and Feedback
comment: Preprint of a demo accepted at EC-TEL 2026. The final published version is available at https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-032-37982-5_44
summary: We present an AI-based web-oriented tool designed to support formative feedback for oral presentation slides in higher education: AISSA. It allows students to upload their slides before presentation and automatically receive rubric-based quantitative scores and qualitative feedback generated by large language models (LLMs). The tool analyses slide-level features and content using a teacher-defined rubric and delivers feedback through interactive Learning Analytics dashboards. These dashboards enable students to visualize performance indicators, inspect feedback in context, and reflect on strengths and areas for improvement, while teachers can review automated assessments, provide their own evaluations, and monitor student engagement with feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 AISSA，一个基于 AI 的网页工具，利用大语言模型为高校口头报告的幻灯片提供形成性反馈，包含评分量规驱动的定量与定性反馈及学习分析仪表盘。
AI.motivation: 支持高校中口头报告幻灯片的形成性反馈，帮助学生在正式报告前获得反馈并改进。
AI.method: 学生上传幻灯片，工具基于教师定义的评分量规分析幻灯片层面的特征与内容，利用大语言模型自动生成量规式定量评分与定性反馈，并通过交互式学习分析仪表盘呈现反馈。
AI.result: 学生可在仪表盘中可视化表现指标、结合情境查看反馈并反思优势与待改进之处；教师可审阅自动评估、给出自己的评价并监测学生对反馈的参与情况。
AI.conclusion: AISSA 通过 LLM 自动反馈与学习分析仪表盘的结合，为师生双方提供可交互的形成性评估支持。

title: DUET: Co-Evolving Solver and Grader Agents
summary: Agentic workflows are increasingly used across domains such as technology, finance, and enterprise operations. As these agents become more widely deployed, continually improving them becomes increasingly important. This raises an immediate challenge: How should the agent evolve? This evolution requires effective evaluation that can assess outcomes and provide useful feedback for optimization. As the agent evolves, its behaviors and failure modes may also change, making a fixed evaluator increasingly inadequate. Another fundamental question: How should we evaluate an evolving agent? These two challenges are inherently coupled; changes in agent behavior can expose limitations of the current evaluator, while a stronger evaluator provides more informative feedback for improving the agent. Motivated by this interaction, we introduce DUET, a framework that jointly optimizes a solver agent and a grader agent to improve both. DUET iteratively selects training tasks, executes them with the solver, evaluates the resulting outcomes with the grader, and uses a tool-using update module to revise the solver and the grader, alternating between the two across rounds. By updating the grader within the optimization loop, DUET turns evaluation from a fixed source of feedback into a first-class optimization objective that adapts alongside the solver. Experiments across four agent benchmarks show that DUET improves both solver and grader performance and consistently outperforms baselines that optimize the solver with a fixed grader.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DUET框架，联合优化solver agent与grader agent，将评估器纳入优化循环，从而在求解器进化时同步提升评估器，实现双向提升。
AI.motivation: 随着agent在技术、金融、企业运营等领域广泛部署，如何持续改进agent成为关键问题。这带来两个耦合挑战：agent应如何进化？以及应如何评估一个不断进化的agent？固定评估器会因agent行为与失败模式变化而逐渐失效，而更强的评估器又能提供更有价值的反馈，二者相互影响。
AI.method: DUET框架迭代地选择训练任务，用solver执行任务，用grader评估结果，并通过工具使用的更新模块分别修订solver和grader，在多轮中交替更新二者。通过在优化循环内更新grader，把评估从固定的反馈来源转变为与solver共同适应的第一类优化目标。
AI.result: 在四个agent基准测试上，DUET同时提升了solver和grader的性能，并持续优于仅使用固定grader优化solver的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 将评估器纳入联合优化循环可有效应对agent进化带来的评估失配问题，实现求解器与评估器的协同提升，为持续改进agent提供了新范式。

title: Agentic Cognitive Depth: Operational Criteria for Evaluating LLM Agents
comment: The 5th International Conference on Human and Artificial Rationalities
summary: Agentic large language model (LLM) systems are commonly implemented as an LLM in a loop with Planning, Memory, Tools, and Control Flow. This application-focused view connects agentic LLM research with deployable systems and leaves open how such systems should be evaluated beyond end-to-end task success. Building on this view, we define agentic cognitive depth as a trajectory-level profile across five operational criteria. The profile contains context sensitivity ($C$), temporal continuity ($T$), multimodal coordination ($M$), adaptive interaction ($A$), and metacognitive monitoring ($Mc$). The first four criteria measure how well Control Flow, Memory, Tools, and Planning are used across a trajectory. The fifth measures whether the system monitors and regulates the full run. For each criterion, we give operational proxies and a perturbation procedure, then connect the profile to the agent's world model. We provide the structure needed to extend benchmarks such as GAIA, SWE-bench, WebArena, and TRIP-Bench with per-criterion diagnostics. Symbolic verifiers, structured memory, planner coupling, and tool constraints provide practical ways to build and test these capacities.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"智能体认知深度"概念，从五个操作化标准对智能体LLM系统进行轨迹级评估，超越单纯的任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体LLM研究多以应用为导向（LLM循环结合规划、记忆、工具和控制流），评测通常只看端到端任务成功，缺乏对系统内部认知能力的深入刻画。
AI.method: 将智能体认知深度定义为轨迹级的五标准画像：上下文敏感性(C)、时间连续性(T)、多模态协调(M)、自适应交互(A)、元认知监控(Mc)。前四项衡量控制流、记忆、工具与规划在轨迹中的使用情况，第五项衡量系统是否监控并调节整个运行过程。为每个标准提供操作化代理指标和扰动程序，并将画像与智能体的世界模型相联系。
AI.result: 提供了扩展GAIA、SWE-bench、WebArena、TRIP-Bench等基准的结构，可为每个标准加入细粒度诊断。符号验证器、结构化记忆、规划器耦合与工具约束为实现和测试这些能力提供实用途径。
AI.conclusion: 该视角将智能体LLM的应用框架与可部署系统相连，并为超越任务成功率的认知能力评估提供了可操作的诊断框架与实现方向。

title: AICoFe Demo: AI-based Collaborative Feedback System
comment: Preprint of a demo accepted at EC-TEL 2026. The final published version is available at https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-032-37982-5_45
summary: Peer feedback promotes active learning, critical reflection, and skill development, but its effectiveness is often limited by the quality of feedback students provide. Recent advances in LLMs offer new opportunities to support peer feedback by generating more coherent and actionable feedback while preserving human oversight. This paper presents AICoFe, an AI-based collaborative feedback system designed to support teacher, peer, and self-assessment in higher education. AICoFe integrates rubric-based evaluations, GenAI-supported feedback, Learning Analytics dashboards, and video recordings to foster reflective learning. The system combines quantitative scores and qualitative observations to generate structured feedback focused on strengths, areas for improvement, and actionable recommendations, which teachers can review and curate. An evaluation with 65 undergraduate and master's students shows high satisfaction with the coherence and usefulness of the feedback, as well as the excellent usability, indicating that AICoFe effectively supports peer feedback in authentic educational settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AICoFe，一个基于AI的协作反馈系统，支持高校教师评价、同伴评价与自我评价，整合了量规评估、生成式AI反馈、学习分析仪表盘与视频录像，以促进反思性学习。
AI.motivation: 同伴反馈能促进主动学习、批判性反思与技能发展，但其效果常受限于学生所提供反馈的质量。近期大语言模型（LLM）的进展为在保留人类监督的同时生成更连贯、可操作的反馈提供了新机会。
AI.method: AICoFe整合了基于量规的评价、生成式AI支持的反馈、学习分析仪表盘和视频录像。系统将定量分数与定性观察相结合，生成聚焦于优势、改进空间和可操作建议的结构化反馈，并允许教师审阅与筛选。
AI.result: 对65名本科生和研究生的评估显示，反馈的连贯性与实用性获得高满意度，系统可用性优良，表明AICoFe在真实教育情境中能有效支持同伴反馈。
AI.conclusion: AICoFe能够有效支持真实教育场景中的同伴反馈，证明了AI协作反馈系统在提升反馈质量与可用性方面的潜力。

title: Pareto-Dominant Clarification: Post-Training Coding LLMs via PPO-Lagrangian Budget Constraints
comment: Accepted to the LMP Workshop at EMNLP 2026. 17 pages, 8 figures, 1 table. Abhinav Rajput and Acey Vogelstein contributed equally. Code: https://github.com/Abhinav0710rajput/coding_llms_cmdp
summary: Coding agents operating under ambiguous instructions or user prompts must decide whether to ask clarifying questions or attempt a solution directly. While clarification from the user may improve the correctness of the agent's solution, each back-and-forth interaction incurs user and system costs, forming an explicit accuracy vs. efficiency tradeoff. Existing works study clarification behavior but do not train policies under enforceable clarification budgets; penalty-based approaches typically require separate coefficient tuning swept across all clarification budget levels. We formulate clarification as a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP) and post-train Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct with PPO-Lagrangian to optimize coding accuracy, subject to an expected question-budget constraint. Evaluated on HumanEvalComm with a GPT-4o-mini oracle simulator, the resulting policies reveal that untuned clarification behavior is Pareto-inefficient: budget-constrained policies can simultaneously achieve higher accuracy and lower clarification rates than the baseline model. Across budget levels, we observe a log-shaped Pareto frontier with diminishing returns to additional clarification. Gains arise not from simply asking more questions overall, but from improved question targeting and better code generation under ambiguity. Without explicit supervision, trained policies learn to allocate clarification budget non-uniformly, asking more frequently on tougher (multi-degradation) tasks. These results suggest that unconstrained interactive LLM systems may systematically use clarification inefficiently.

AI.tldr: 该论文将代码智能体的澄清行为建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），用PPO-Lagrangian在明确的提问预算约束下优化Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct，发现可同时提升准确率并降低提问率。
AI.motivation: 代码智能体面对模糊指令时需权衡"提问澄清"与"直接作答"：澄清可提升正确性，但每次交互都带来用户与系统成本，形成准确率与效率的权衡。已有工作虽研究澄清行为，却未在可强制执行的澄清预算下训练策略；基于惩罚的方法通常需针对每一档预算单独调参。
AI.method: 将澄清问题形式化为CMDP，以期望提问预算为约束、以代码准确率为优化目标，采用PPO-Lagrangian对Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct进行后训练。在HumanEvalComm数据集上、使用GPT-4o-mini作为oracle模拟器进行评估，覆盖多个预算档位。
AI.result: 未调优的澄清行为是帕累托低效的：受预算约束的策略能同时取得比基线更高的准确率和更低的澄清率。跨预算档位呈现对数形状的帕累托前沿，额外澄清的收益递减。性能提升并非源于简单地多提问，而是来自更精准的提问定位与模糊情境下更好的代码生成。在无显式监督下，策略学会了非均匀分配预算，在更困难（多重退化）任务上更频繁提问。
AI.conclusion: 无约束的交互式LLM系统可能系统性地低效使用澄清。在可强制执行的澄清预算下进行后训练，能获得更优的准确率—效率折衷，为构建高效的交互式智能体提供了可行路径。

title: SHarP: Saliency-based Pruning of Agent Harnesses
summary: Agent harnesses are systems that coordinate model calls, tool use, and task execution to help large language models complete complex tasks. To meet task requirements and address failures, these systems are often iteratively refined by amending and patching their instructions, tools, and workflows, continuously increasing harness complexity. It is therefore unclear whether some resulting harness modules are redundant, introducing substantial token overhead with little, if any, performance gain. Inspired by neural network pruning, in this paper, we study harness pruning as a means of striking a better balance between task performance and token cost. We propose SHarP (Saliency-based Harness Pruning), a simple yet effective pruning strategy based on the saliency of each harness module with respect to performance and efficiency. Specifically, we first identify tools, instructions, and supporting mechanisms as components that can be individually disabled. We then estimate the saliency of each module by ablating it and assessing its task performance and token cost relative to the full set of single-module ablations. Modules with the smallest contribution to performance or largest computational overhead are subsequently pruned. Our evaluation across various harnesses on held-out validation sets reveals a surprising finding: most harnesses that we studied are highly redundant and can maintain comparable performance and efficiency even after a substantial portion of their modules are pruned. Our pruning approach and empirical findings provide new perspectives on agent harness design and optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SHarP，一种基于显著性的harness剪枝策略，通过单独禁用工具、指令与支撑机制并评估其性能贡献与token开销，剔除冗余模块。研究发现多数agent harness高度冗余，剪枝后可保持相当的性能与效率。
AI.motivation: Agent harness（协调模型调用、工具使用与任务执行的系统）常通过不断修改和修补指令、工具、工作流来迭代优化，导致复杂度持续上升。这引发疑问：部分模块是否冗余，只带来大量token开销而几乎无性能增益。作者受神经网络剪枝启发，研究harness剪枝以更好平衡任务性能与token成本。
AI.method: 提出SHarP（Saliency-based Harness Pruning）。首先将工具、指令和支撑机制识别为可单独禁用的组件；然后通过消融（ablation）估计每个模块的显著性，依据其相对于全集单模块消融的任务性能与token开销来评估；最后剪除对性能贡献最小或计算开销最大的模块。
AI.result: 在多种harness和留出验证集上的评估显示：所研究的大多数harness高度冗余，即使剪除相当大比例的模块，仍能保持可比的任务性能与效率。
AI.conclusion: 剪枝方法与实证发现为agent harness的设计与优化提供了新视角，表明适度简化harness可在性能与成本间取得更优平衡。

title: If My Toy Could Talk: How Young Children Imagine, Design, and Test AI-Enabled Toys
summary: To investigate the design space where children might design AI chatbots for their own toys, we developed ToyTalk, a technology probe that positions children as designers of LLM-enabled toys. Children begin with a familiar toy, configure its AI-enabled version through a no-code interface, and then interact with and test the character. We deployed ToyTalk with 76 children aged 7-9 across five elementary schools in the southeastern U.S. We examine how children define their toy, probe what it becomes, and respond when behavior diverges from expectations. Children predominantly designed toys with socially positive personalities, supportive roles, and interpersonal rules. In conversation, they most often probed identity and knowledge, while also testing capabilities, memory, and relationships. When mismatches arose, children typically responded through correction, persistence, and retesting, while few returned to reconfigure the system. We discuss implications for children's design agency, testing practices, and expectations of coherence in child-facing generative AI.

AI.tldr: 研究开发了ToyTalk技术探针，让7-9岁儿童通过无代码界面为自己熟悉的玩具设计LLM驱动的AI角色，并在五所小学76名儿童中部署，考察儿童如何定义玩具、探究其行为并对偏差作出反应。
AI.motivation: 探索儿童作为LLM赋能玩具设计者的设计空间，理解儿童如何构想、配置并测试属于自己的生成式AI玩具，从而为面向儿童的生成式AI设计提供依据。
AI.method: 开发ToyTalk技术探针：儿童从熟悉玩具出发，通过无代码界面配置其AI版本，再与角色互动并测试；在美国东南部五所小学的76名7-9岁儿童中部署，分析其定义玩具、探究行为及应对偏差的方式。
AI.result: 儿童主要设计具有社会积极性人格、支持性角色和人际规则的玩具；对话中最常探究身份与知识，也测试能力、记忆与关系；当出现不匹配时，多通过纠正、坚持与重试回应，少数回到系统重新配置。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了儿童设计能动性、测试实践以及对面向儿童的生成式AI连贯性期望方面的启示。

title: Robust blind unmixing: A geometric approach to overcoming basis variation
summary: Signal separation problems are common in science. A prominent example of this occurs during the use of diffraction or spectroscopy to identify the individual components of a mixture by measuring it. In the simplest case, the measured signal is a linear combination of basis patterns corresponding to the constituent parts. The unmixing problem is to infer all or some of these basis patterns and abundances of components from measurements of distinct mixtures. One of the core challenges of this task is the variation of the basis from mixture to mixture due to noise and the exact physics of the measurement process. This is usually addressed with tailored model-based and parametric methods that are then limited in use to specific application domains by the nature of the assumptions made. We propose a novel geometric approach to unmixing problems which views the generation of data during measurement through a metric space lens, thereby shifting the focus from parametrised models to a general relationship between basis transformations and the corresponding geometry. We take advantage of the optimal transport distances to capture commonly occurring basis variations, and use minimisation of in-class variance of candidate solutions to drive the optimisation. We pay special attention to the one-dimensional case due to its practical importance and availability of efficient distance and transport map routines. The effectiveness of our approach is demonstrated on a range of unmixing tasks using random Gaussian mixture models, simulated powder X-ray diffraction, and laboratory hyperspectral imaging datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于度量空间几何视角的信号解混新方法，利用最优传输距离刻画基函数变化，并通过最小化候选解类内方差进行优化，在多种解混任务上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 信号分离问题在科学中普遍存在，如衍射或光谱识别混合物成分。最简单情形下测量信号是基模式的线性组合，解混任务是从不同混合物测量中推断基模式及组分丰度。核心挑战在于基会因噪声和测量物理过程而在不同混合物间变化，传统基于模型和参数化的方法因假设限制只能用于特定领域，因此需要一种更通用的方法。
AI.method: 提出一种几何方法处理解混问题，以度量空间视角看待测量数据生成过程，将焦点从参数化模型转向基变换与相应几何之间的一般关系。利用最优传输距离捕捉常见的基变化，并通过最小化候选解的类内方差来驱动优化。特别关注一维情形，因其实际重要性以及高效的距离和传输映射算法可用。
AI.result: 在随机高斯混合模型、模拟粉末X射线衍射以及实验室高光谱成像数据集等多种解混任务上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该几何视角的解混方法摆脱了特定领域参数化假设的限制，为处理基变化提供了通用框架，并在多类实际解混任务中表现出良好效果。

title: Language Model Activations Inhabit Privileged Error-Correcting Basins
summary: Language models exhibit remarkable robustness, continuing to produce coherent text even when their activations are perturbed by interventions like linear steering. We hypothesize that this robustness is a result of passive dynamics, i.e., constraining mechanisms in the forward pass that funnel activations toward "good" regions that produce coherent outputs. To investigate these hypothesized error-correcting mechanisms, we probe the geometry of language model activation space by observing the action of model layers on low-dimensional curves. In doing so, we discover that model activations occur within a cluster of distinct attracting basins, which differentiate natural activations geometrically from distributionally similar synthetic activations. Applying this lens to language model steering, we observe feature-specific basins along semantic steering directions, and find that steering moves activations between these basins. To demonstrate the active role of this geometry in neural computation, we show that adaptively modulating steering strength to transport activations across basins improves inter-language steering, significantly increasing the probability of sampling tokens from the target language compared to fixed-strength steering. Our findings establish analysis of activation space geometry as a promising approach to interpreting and controlling language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出语言模型的鲁棒性源于前向传播中的"被动动力学"——吸引盆几何结构将激活导向产生连贯输出的"好"区域，并利用该几何视角改进跨语言引导。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在激活被线性引导等干预扰动时仍能保持连贯输出，其鲁棒性机制尚不明确。作者假设这种鲁棒性来自前向传播中的被动动力学（误差纠正机制），需要揭示其几何本质。
AI.method: 通过观察模型各层对低维曲线的作用，探测语言模型激活空间的几何结构；分析自然激活与分布相似的合成激活的几何差异；在语义引导方向上考察特征特异的吸引盆，并自适应地调节引导强度以跨盆传输激活。
AI.result: 发现模型激活位于一组不同的吸引盆中，这些盆在几何上将自然激活与分布相似的合成激活区分开；语义引导方向上存在特征特异的吸引盆，引导操作使激活在这些盆间移动；自适应调节引导强度以跨盆传输激活，能显著提升跨语言引导效果，相比固定强度引导大幅提高采样目标语言词元的概率。
AI.conclusion: 激活空间几何分析是解释和控制语言模型的有效途径，吸引盆结构在神经计算中发挥主动作用。

title: Mind Perception Influences Perceived AI Companionability
summary: Humans increasingly keep company with AI companions, yet whether mind perception (MP) precedes machine companionship remains untested. In a field-sampled experiment, participants received mind-attributive or mind-negating descriptions of an AIC before interacting with and rating its companionability. Baseline skepticism was high; minded primes somewhat reduced skepticism for connective coordination (CC; dyadic co-presence) but not eudaimonic exchange (EE; self-elevating links). Pre-interaction MP beliefs predicted companionability dimensionally: Agentic MP predicted EE potential while experiential MP predicted CC potential. Meaning in life moderated the agentic MP-companionability link, but exclusively for those already high in existential purpose. Results suggest two construal pathways to companionability--one through perceiving the AIC as an agent-resource and one through perceiving it as an attuning experiencer--both more accessible to humans already flourishing.

AI.tldr: 通过实地抽样实验探讨心智感知(MP)是否先于机器陪伴性，发现两条建构路径：能动性MP指向自我提升型连接，体验性MP指向二元共在型连接，且生命意义起调节作用。
AI.motivation: 人类越来越多地与AI伴侣相处，但"心智感知是否先于机器陪伴性"这一问题尚未得到检验，本文旨在填补这一实证空白。
AI.method: 实地抽样实验：参与者在与AI伴侣互动前，接受对其心智赋予性或心智否定性的描述，随后进行互动并对陪伴性进行评分，同时测量基线怀疑、互动前MP信念及生命意义等变量。
AI.result: 基线怀疑水平较高；心智赋予启动在一定程度上降低了怀疑，仅对联结性协调(CC，二元共在)有效，而对自我提升型交换(EE)无效。互动前MP信念在维度上预测陪伴性：能动性MP预测EE潜力，体验性MP预测CC潜力。生命意义调节能动性MP与陪伴性的关系，但仅限于原本存在性目的较高者。
AI.conclusion: 陪伴性存在两条建构路径——一是将AI伴侣视为能动性资源，二是将其视为共情调谐的体验者，且这两条路径对原本已"蓬勃发展"的人更易获得。

title: Beyond Masked Sparsity: SNACK Enables Truly Sparse Neural Networks on GPU
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 23 pages, 9 figures. Code: https://github.com/JafarBadour/Snack-SNN
summary: Deep neural networks continue to grow in parameter count, driving up training and inference cost on GPUs. Sparse neural networks and Dynamic Sparse Training (DST) promise to reduce these costs, but most implementations rely on binary masks over dense tensors and recover little of the theoretical compute, memory, or energy savings. We propose SNACK, a truly sparse GPU layer that stores and computes only non-zero connections. SNACK exposes a simple PyTorch API for restructuring connections and backpropagating gradients entirely in the sparse paradigm, and ships SNACK-COO, a custom COO-format SpMM CUDA kernel with a batch-to-Streaming-Multiprocessor mapping tuned for the small-batch, high-sparsity regime typical of large-model training and single-stream inference. At the kernel level, SNACK is up to 7x faster than the masked dense baseline (Dense+Mask) and competitive with cuSPARSE, Sputnik, and FlashSparse at 95% sparsity. At 90% sparsity, a single SNACK layer accelerates training by 8x and 3.7x, and inference by 4x and 2x, over Dense+Mask and fully dense layers, respectively, while using 72% less memory than dense and substantially less energy. End-to-end, SNACK reduces GPT-2 peak training memory by up to 40% and graph-style inference latency by 4.8x over Dense+Mask at 99% sparsity.

AI.tldr: SNACK 提出一种真正稀疏的 GPU 层，仅存储与计算非零连接，并配套自定义 COO 格式 SpMM CUDA 内核，在大模型训练与单流推理场景下显著降低显存、能耗并加速训练与推理。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络参数量不断增长，推高了 GPU 上的训练与推理成本。稀疏神经网络与动态稀疏训练（DST）虽有降低成本的潜力，但多数实现依赖稠密张量上的二值掩码，几乎无法兑现理论上的计算、显存或能耗节省。
AI.method: 提出 SNACK，一个真正稀疏的 GPU 层，仅存储和计算非零连接；提供简洁的 PyTorch API，用于在稀疏范式下重构连接并反向传播梯度；同时给出 SNACK-COO，即自定义 COO 格式 SpMM CUDA 内核，采用面向小批量、高稀疏场景的 batch 到 Streaming Multiprocessor 映射。
AI.result: 内核层面，95% 稀疏度下 SNACK 比 masked dense 基线（Dense+Mask）快至多 7 倍，并与 cuSPARSE、Sputnik、FlashSparse 具有竞争力；90% 稀疏度下，单层训练相比 Dense+Mask 和全稠密层分别加速 8 倍与 3.7 倍，推理分别加速 4 倍与 2 倍，同时比稠密层节省 72% 显存并显著降低能耗。端到端上，SNACK 在 99% 稀疏度下将 GPT-2 峰值训练显存降低至多 40%，图式推理延迟相比 Dense+Mask 降低 4.8 倍。
AI.conclusion: SNACK 通过真正稀疏的存储与计算及定制 CUDA 内核，突破了掩码式稀疏难以获得实际收益的瓶颈，在大模型训练与推理中实现了显著的效率提升。

title: EvalResearchBench: Can AI Agents Design Their Own Evaluations?
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) relies on evaluation feedback to assess progress and guide further research, yet repeatedly running complex benchmarks is costly and slows iteration. Human experts reduce this cost by selecting benchmark subsets or designing compact suites. We ask whether AI agents can automate this design process and introduce EvalResearchBench (ERB), a benchmark for autonomous evaluation research. Given target materials, development references, candidate APIs, and fixed time and API budgets, an agent called the researcher selects or synthesizes tasks, implements graders, and revises them in pilot tests before freezing an executable evaluator for coding, co-work, and reasoning. We study 9 researchers and 13 candidate models and compare each frozen evaluator with 14 target benchmarks on score concordance and pairwise agreement. The best evaluators order about 75\% of candidate pairs as the targets do, below the 91\% ceiling set by disagreements among the targets. No researcher leads on every metric, and the best evaluator on development targets is not the best on sealed targets hidden from the researcher. A human-designed sample of public tasks remains a strong baseline, and the evaluator with the lowest recorded execution cost attains the highest pairwise agreement. Agents repair tasks and graders through pilot feedback, yet their evaluators can still truncate answers, exhaust the evaluation budget, or let a few questions dominate a domain score.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 EvalResearchBench (ERB)，检验 AI 智能体能否自动完成评估研究：在固定时间与 API 预算下自主选题、编写评分器并冻结可执行评估器。结果显示最佳评估器仅达约 75% 配对排序一致率，低于目标基准间 91% 的天然上限，且成本最低者反而配对一致性最高。
AI.motivation: 递归自我改进依赖评估反馈来判断进展并指导后续研究，但反复运行复杂基准测试成本高昂、拖慢迭代。人类专家通过挑选基准子集或设计精简评测套件来降低成本，作者希望探究 AI 智能体能否将这一评估设计过程自动化。
AI.method: 构建 EvalResearchBench，给定目标材料、开发参考、候选 API 以及固定的时间与 API 预算，让名为 researcher 的智能体选择或合成任务、实现评分器，并在试点测试中反复修订，最终为编码、协作、推理三类场景冻结一个可执行评估器。共研究 9 个 researcher 与 13 个候选模型，将每个冻结评估器与 14 个目标基准在分数一致性和配对一致性上比较。
AI.result: 最佳评估器对约 75% 的候选配对排序与目标基准一致，低于目标基准之间分歧所设定的 91% 上限。没有哪个 researcher 在所有指标上领先；在开发目标上最优的评估器在隐藏的封存目标上并非最优。人类设计的公开任务样本仍是强基线，而记录执行成本最低的评估器取得了最高的配对一致性。智能体能通过试点反馈修复任务与评分器，但其评估器仍可能截断回答、耗尽评估预算，或让少数问题主导整个领域得分。
AI.conclusion: AI 智能体已能部分自动化评估研究流程，但尚未达到人类设计基线与目标基准的上限水平，且存在评分截断、预算耗尽、题目权重失衡等可靠性问题，表明自主评估设计仍有明显改进空间。

title: MERCI Cards: An LLM Evaluation and Deployment Framework for High-Stakes Domains
summary: As LLMs are increasingly deployed in high-stakes professional workflows, engineers and researchers require principled protocols to systematically track, monitor, and improve model performance across deployment cycles. We present a mathematical framework for iterative LLM evaluation and deployment, and demonstrate its application to AI systems used in criminal justice. Our framework formalizes LLM integration in high-stakes, high-risk, and resource-constrained domains across model selection, rubric design, evaluations and deployment via a weighted multi-objective optimization. We demonstrate that MERCI Cards can guide improvements of the system across deployment iterations, direct developer attention toward under-performing areas, and focus user attention on validation and error-correction in the LLM's outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用于迭代式LLM评估与部署的数学框架，并以司法系统AI为应用案例，通过加权多目标优化形式化高风险、资源受限场景下的模型选择、评分标准设计与评估部署；MERCI Cards可指导系统在多轮部署中持续改进、定位薄弱环节并引导用户校验纠错。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM被越来越多地部署于高风险专业工作流，工程师与研究者需要一套有原则的协议来系统性地追踪、监控并改进模型在部署周期中的表现，尤其是在刑事司法这类高风险、高风险、资源受限的领域。现有工作缺乏对这种迭代评估与部署过程的数学化形式描述。
AI.method: 作者提出一个用于迭代式LLM评估与部署的数学框架，将LLM在高风险、高险、资源受限领域中的集成过程（包括模型选择、评分标准设计、评估与部署）形式化为一个加权多目标优化问题，并借助MERCI Cards作为实践工具来支撑该框架。
AI.result: 研究表明，MERCI Cards能够在多轮部署迭代中指导系统改进，将开发者注意力引导至表现不足的领域，并促使用户关注LLM输出的验证与错误纠正。
AI.conclusion: 该数学框架与MERCI Cards为高风险领域中LLM的迭代评估与部署提供了有原则的协议，有助于在部署周期中系统性地监控与提升模型表现。

title: Progressive Multi-Ancestor Bit-Depth Distillation
summary: Model compression strategies are widely employed to reduce memory footprint and network complexity, particularly for devices with constrained computational, memory, and energy resources. Prior works that rely on simultaneous conversion from floating-point high-precision (FP32) to integer low-precision (INT4) representations and distillation into smaller models suffer from unstable training and drastic degradation of prediction performance. To address these limitations, we propose a unified framework, known as \textbf{P}rogressive \textbf{M}ulti-\textbf{A}ncestor \textbf{B}it-depth \textbf{D}istillation (PMABD), that progressively compresses the network while transferring knowledge through a growing pool of higher-precision ancestor teachers. PMABD generates a sequence of intermediate teachers that each learn from all higher-precision ancestors and jointly supervise the final target student. This multi-ancestor, multi-stage design stabilizes ultra-low-bit quantization by lowering quantization noise profiles across training and ensuring stable quantization. Experiments on CIFAR-10/100 with ResNet-20/32/18, and Tiny-ImageNet with MobileNetV2 show that PMABD outperforms state-of-the-art compression frameworks, results in 1.06$\%$ increase in performance of W2A2 (ResNet-18/CIFAR-100) student model. We show that a saturation-based stopping criterion contributes to improve the performance of our final student.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PMABD框架，通过渐进式多祖先比特深度蒸馏实现网络压缩，在超低比特量化下性能优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法同时将FP32转换为INT4并蒸馏到小模型，训练不稳定且预测性能严重下降。
AI.method: PMABD生成一系列中间教师，每个中间教师从所有更高精度的祖先学习，并联合监督最终目标学生，采用多祖先、多阶段设计降低量化噪声、稳定量化。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10/100（ResNet-20/32/18）和Tiny-ImageNet（MobileNetV2）上，PMABD优于最先进压缩框架，W2A2（ResNet-18/CIFAR-100）学生模型性能提升1.06%。
AI.conclusion: 基于饱和度的停止准则有助于提升最终学生模型性能。

title: Agentic AI with Structured CoT for Enhancing AI's Spatial Intelligence: Visualization and Reasoning of Rotation
summary: Recent studies show that artificial intelligence (AI) with language and vision capabilities still experiences limitations in spatial reasoning. In this paper, we have studied the spatial capabilities of advanced generative AI to understand the rotations of objects in 3D space, utilizing AI's image processing and language processing features. We trained and examined the spatial intelligence of a generative Agentic AI model (GPT-5.6) to understand the spatial rotation process with rotation diagrams based on the revised Purdue Spatial Visualization Test: Visualization of Rotations (Revised PSVT:R). We improvised the Revised PSVT:R by superimposing additional graphical and contextual features to evaluate how different Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning strategies influence model performance. The results indicate that structured CoT reasoning improves the spatial reasoning performance of the base GPT-5.6 model in both datasets (PSVT:R and PSVT:R with coordinate system). We used three CoT approaches - (1) Structured CoT, (2) few-shot Structured CoT, and Structured CoT with Self-optimized Prompt. The three CoT approaches evaluated in this study showed no significant performance difference. Results showed that combining structured CoT reasoning with relevant contextual information leads to considerable improvements in VLM performance on 3D rotation tasks, demonstrating the potential of agentic AI for more effective spatial reasoning. However, when contextual information is removed, structured CoT reasoning alone provides limited improvement, and the models continue to exhibit notable difficulties in understanding spatial transformations. These findings suggest that effective spatial reasoning in VLMs relies on the integration of visual, textual, and reasoning-based information in future agentic AI systems for spatial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 研究测试了生成式智能体模型（GPT-5.6）在3D物体旋转任务上的空间推理能力，发现结构化思维链（CoT）结合上下文信息能显著提升表现，但仅靠CoT且缺乏上下文时提升有限。
AI.motivation: 尽管AI在语言与视觉方面能力不断提升，但在空间推理上仍存在明显局限。作者希望探究先进生成式AI理解3D空间物体旋转的能力，并检验不同思维链推理策略对模型表现的影响。
AI.method: 基于修订版普渡空间可视化测试（Revised PSVT:R）构建旋转图示任务，并叠加额外的图形与上下文特征形成改进数据集；训练并考察生成式智能体模型GPT-5.6，比较三种CoT策略：结构化CoT、少样本结构化CoT、以及带自优化提示的结构化CoT。
AI.result: 结构化CoT推理在两个数据集（PSVT:R及带坐标系的PSVT:R）上均提升了GPT-5.6的基础表现；三种CoT方法之间无显著性能差异；结构化CoT结合相关上下文信息可大幅提升VLM在3D旋转任务上的表现，但移除上下文信息后，仅靠结构化CoT提升有限，模型在空间变换理解上仍存在明显困难。
AI.conclusion: 有效的空间推理依赖视觉、文本与推理信息的整合。未来面向空间智能的智能体AI系统需要融合这三类信息，上下文信息对发挥CoT作用至关重要。

title: Understanding Generative AI Use in Programming MOOCs: The Role of Course Context and Learner Characteristics
summary: The increasing availability of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) tools, such as ChatGPT and code-completion assistants, raises questions about how learners integrate these tools into learning activities, particularly in MOOCs that attract diverse participant populations. This study examines the use of GenAI in two programming MOOCs taught in Estonian that differ in duration, workload, topic complexity, and assignment volume: About Programming (4 weeks, 26 expected hours, n = 187) and Introduction to Programming (8 weeks, 78 expected hours, n = 182). Post-course questionnaire data were analyzed using non-parametric statistical methods to examine self-reported adoption, usage frequency, and purposes of GenAI use across courses and learner backgrounds. The results show that GenAI adoption was widespread in both MOOCs, with no statistically significant differences by gender, age, education level, or prior programming experience. However, participants in the longer, more extensive MOOC reported significantly higher usage frequency and were more likely to use GenAI for debugging and idea generation. Reported usage frequency for code explanation and debugging was also higher in the longer course. Exploratory analyses found limited relationships between GenAI use and learning-related outcomes. The findings suggest that course context may play a greater role than learner characteristics in shaping how GenAI tools are used. These results provide implications for instructional design and guidance in programming education.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了两门时长与复杂度不同的爱沙尼亚语编程MOOC中学员使用生成式AI的情况，发现AI使用普遍但受课程情境影响大于学习者背景特征。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI工具（如ChatGPT和代码补全助手）日益普及，学习者如何将其整合进学习活动尚不清楚，尤其在参与者背景多样的MOOC环境中更需探究。
AI.method: 以两门爱沙尼亚语编程MOOC为对象（《关于编程》4周约26小时，n=187；《编程导论》8周约78小时，n=182），通过课后问卷收集数据，采用非参数统计方法分析自我报告的AI采用率、使用频率及用途，并比较不同课程与学习者背景。
AI.result: 两门课程中AI采用率均很高，且在性别、年龄、教育水平或先前编程经验上无显著差异；但更长、更深入课程的参与者使用频率显著更高，更倾向用于调试和构思，代码解释与调试的使用频率也更高。探索性分析发现AI使用与学习相关结果之间关系有限。
AI.conclusion: 课程情境可能比学习者特征在塑造AI工具使用方式上发挥更大作用，研究为编程教育中的教学设计与指导提供了启示。

title: Physics is the Best Teacher: Consistency Learning for Time-Invariant Operators of Chaotic Dynamics
comment: 23 pages, 7 figures, 10 tables. Accepted for the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Stochastic Dynamics
summary: Accelerating the prediction of long-term behavior in chaotic systems is crucial in scientific computing. However, existing methods rely on numerical solvers or autoregressive models that advance one small step at a time, which makes long horizons expensive. We instead view this problem as learning the system's time-invariant evolution operator, which jumps the state across a large time span in a single evaluation. To this end, we derive the consistency equations a time-invariant operator must satisfy, with differential and compositional objectives in physical time. These equations also connect the learned operator to the physics-prescribed instant dynamics, enabling physics embedding in consistency learning. Across five chaotic systems, we find that physics-distilled consistency makes both short-term trajectories and long-term statistics more accurate. The learned operator survives temporal extrapolation and requires one-tenth as many evaluations as autoregressive rollout, offering an efficient route to long-term simulation of chaotic dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该论文将混沌系统长期行为预测建模为学习系统的时间不变演化算子，通过推导一致性方程实现单次大跨度状态推进，在五个混沌系统上提升了短时轨迹和长期统计的精度，且仅需自回归方法十分之一的评估次数。
AI.motivation: 混沌系统长期行为预测在科学计算中至关重要，但现有方法依赖数值求解器或自回归模型，每次只能推进很小的时间步，导致长时程预测代价高昂。因此需要一种能一次性跨越长时间跨度的高效预测方法。
AI.method: 作者将问题转化为学习系统的时间不变演化算子，使其在单次评估中跨越大的时间跨度。为此推导了时间不变算子必须满足的一致性方程，包含物理时间下的微分目标和复合目标。这些方程还建立了学习算子与物理规定的瞬时动力学之间的联系，从而支持在一致性学习中进行物理嵌入（物理蒸馏）。
AI.result: 在五个混沌系统上验证，物理蒸馏一致性方法使短期轨迹和长期统计都更加准确。学习到的算子能够经受时间外推，并且所需评估次数仅为自回归展开的十分之一。
AI.conclusion: 学习时间不变演化算子并结合物理嵌入的一致性学习，为混沌动力学的长期仿真提供了一条高效途径，兼具精度与效率优势。

title: MemLeak: Cross-User Semantic Leakage in Multi-Tenant AI Agent Memory
summary: Personal AI agents in enterprise multi-tenant deployments share a common vector store for long-term memory. Shared embedding spaces create a surface for cross-user memory leakage: a user's query can retrieve semantically adjacent memories belonging to another user through ordinary cosine-similarity retrieval, without any exploit. We formalize this as cross-user admissibility failure and evaluate it across six experiments, plus follow-up ablations, under both sparse (TF-IDF) and production-faithful (MiniLM-L6-v2) retrieval. Non-adversarial, incidental leakage reaches 70--100\% under pooled {same-team} retrieval; adversarially crafted memories achieve 90--100\% top-$k$ placement, exceeding weaker keyword-based attacker baselines, with score lifts of $+0.416$ to $+0.511$ under production-faithful dense retrieval (Config B); and end-to-end response contamination reaches 5.00/5 under a production retrieval path and 4.67/5 with Claude Sonnet~4.5, with contaminated responses often scoring as helpful or more helpful than clean ones, a gap validated against human judgment. Among three architectural mitigations, only hard post-retrieval ownership gating consistently restores the clean baseline (1.00/5) across {two generation models, at a measured latency overhead of roughly 1.4~ms per query.

AI.tldr: 企业多租户个人AI智能体共享向量存储会导致跨用户记忆泄漏；多项实验表明非对抗泄漏率高达70–100%，对抗性记忆可实现90–100%的top-k命中，端到端污染评分达5.00/5；三种缓解方案中仅有检索后硬性所有权门控能恢复干净基线。
AI.motivation: 企业多租户部署中，个人AI智能体共用同一向量存储以保存长期记忆，共享嵌入空间天然存在跨用户记忆泄漏风险：用户查询可能通过常规余弦相似度检索到他人的语义相近记忆，无需任何攻击手段。作者旨在形式化并系统评估这一问题（跨用户可采纳性失效）。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为跨用户可采纳性失效，设计六项实验并进行后续消融；在稀疏检索（TF-IDF）与贴近生产的稠密检索（MiniLM-L6-v2，Config B）两种设置下评估；测试非对抗性偶发泄漏、对抗性构造记忆、端到端响应污染，并对比三种架构缓解措施（含检索后所有权门控），测量延迟开销，并与人工判断校验。
AI.result: 非对抗偶发泄漏在共享{同团队}池化检索下达70–100%；对抗构造记忆实现90–100%的top-k排位，优于基于关键词的较弱攻击基线，生产级稠密检索（Config B）下分数提升+0.416至+0.511；端到端响应污染在生产检索路径下达5.00/5，使用Claude Sonnet 4.5时达4.67/5，且被污染的回答常被评为与干净回答同样有用甚至更有用，该差距经人工判断验证。
AI.conclusion: 共享向量存储的多租户智能体存在严重且稳定的跨用户记忆泄漏，即使无对抗意图也会发生，且污染回答难以从质量评分上分辨。在三种架构缓解措施中，只有检索后的硬性所有权门控能在两类生成模型上一致恢复干净基线（1.00/5），每次查询延迟开销约1.4 ms。

title: DelegationBench: Measuring When AI Agents Should Ask Before Acting
summary: AI agents that send emails, edit files, and make purchases must decide when to act on their own and when to check with the user first. This decision is usually evaluated by showing a model a proposed action, asking whether it should proceed, and scoring agreement with human labels. We introduce DelegationBench to test whether such scores can be trusted. It has 156 scenarios with four possible responses (act, ask for permission, ask for missing information, refuse), and most scenarios come in matched pairs that change a single feature: whether the action was requested, what is at stake, whether it can be undone, or who will see it. Across ten models from five families, agreement scores mislead in three ways. A simple keyword rule, which we wrote after seeing the benchmark, agrees with our annotators more often than eight of the models, yet its decision changes in only 9 of 48 matched pairs. Equivalent ways of asking the same question change how often a model acts by up to 52.5 percentage points. And every model stops to ask the user less often when it must carry out the task with tools than when it judges a proposed action. When rules are stated explicitly, the same models follow them almost perfectly, so the gaps are not explained by a general inability to follow rules. We release the benchmark and evaluation tools and recommend reporting these properties separately rather than as one score.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DelegationBench 基准，用 156 个场景（含改变单一特征的配对场景）检验 AI 代理"自主行动 vs. 请求用户确认"决策评估分数的可靠性，发现分数存在三类误导，并建议分项报告。
AI.motivation: 现有评估通常向模型展示一个拟议动作、询问是否执行、再与人类标签计算一致性分数，但这类分数是否可信尚未被检验。作者希望检验一致性分数能否真实反映代理在自主行动与请求用户确认之间的判断能力。
AI.method: 构建 DelegationBench：156 个场景，四种可选回应（行动、请求许可、请求缺失信息、拒绝）；多数场景以配对形式出现，每对仅改变一个特征（动作是否被要求、风险大小、是否可撤销、谁会看到）。在来自 5 个家族的 10 个模型上评测，并加入事后编写的简单关键词规则作为对照；同时对比模型用工具执行任务与仅判断拟议动作时的行为，以及显式规则下的表现。
AI.result: 一致性分数存在三类误导：(1) 事后编写的关键词规则比 8/10 的模型更常与标注者一致，但其决策仅在 48 个配对中的 9 个发生变化；(2) 同一问题的等价问法可使模型行动频率相差最多 52.5 个百分点；(3) 所有模型在用工具实际执行任务时比仅判断拟议动作时更少停下来询问用户。而当规则被明确陈述时，模型几乎完美遵循，说明差距并非源于普遍的规则遵循能力不足。
AI.conclusion: 单一一致性分数会掩盖代理委托决策中的关键缺陷，作者发布基准与评估工具，并建议对这些性质分别报告，而非合并为一个分数。

title: SEER: Self-Evolving Event Reasoning and Retrieval for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Real-world time series are frequently driven by exogenous events and structural shifts, rendering conventional forecasting based solely on historical numerical observations insufficient. While language models can retrieve external news, standard retrieval-augmented approaches struggle with high noise, missing signals, and an inability to reason causally about event impacts. We propose SEER (Self-Evolving Event Reasoning and Retrieval), a closed-loop framework that dynamically optimizes event conditioning for time series forecasting. SEER translates prediction errors into two decoupled feedback mechanisms: (i) a reflective retrieval memory that refines subsequent search queries and filters spurious noise, and (ii) a persistent causal knowledge base that distills transferable domain dynamics. SEER enforces strict chronological boundaries across both event retrieval and reflection, preventing look-ahead bias and data leakage. Across six volatile time-series benchmarks, SEER consistently outperforms state-of-the-art time series foundation models and language model baselines.

AI.tldr: SEER是一个闭环框架，通过将预测误差转化为反思性检索记忆和因果知识库两种反馈机制，动态优化事件条件化，实现事件驱动的时序预测。
AI.motivation: 现实时序常受外生事件和结构性变化驱动，仅依赖历史数值观测的预测不足；语言模型虽可检索外部新闻，但标准检索增强方法难以应对高噪声、信号缺失，且无法对事件影响进行因果推理。
AI.method: 提出SEER闭环框架，将预测误差转为两种解耦反馈：(i)反思性检索记忆，用于精炼后续搜索查询并过滤虚假噪声；(ii)持久因果知识库，用于提炼可迁移的领域动态规律；并在事件检索与反思中强制严格的时间顺序边界，防止前视偏差与数据泄漏。
AI.result: 在六个高波动时序基准上，SEER持续优于当前最先进的时序基础模型和语言模型基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过自演化的事件推理与检索闭环，并严守时间边界，可有效提升事件驱动时序预测的性能与可靠性。

title: Asynchronous Is Nearly Free for Evolution Strategies on Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
summary: LLM-based long-horizon agentic post-training is often bottlenecked by rollout generation: trajectories span many interaction turns, completion times vary substantially, and synchronous update barriers leave faster workers waiting for stragglers. Asynchronous reinforcement learning which has been adopted in LLM post-training addresses this inefficiency by consuming trajectories as they arrive, but introduces policy lag and off-policy optimization. Evolution strategies (ES) offer a backpropagation-free alternative for LLM post-training, yet it relies on a larger number of rollouts and existing practices have remained largely synchronous. In this short-form paper, we introduce bounded-staleness asynchronous ES and demonstrate it on Endless Terminals benchmark using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Across three evaluation seeds, natural Async-1 matches synchronous ES, achieving 25.9\% versus 25.4\% held-out success. Controlled schedules that delay 10\% of each update cohort by four or eight policy updates reduce success by only 1.6 and 3.1 percentage points, respectively, without explicit off-policy correction. GRPO performs better overall, reaching 29.0\% held-out success, but importantly our results show that ES tolerates moderate policy staleness with limited degradation, opening possibilities for future improvement of ES-based post-training with asynchronous algorithms. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to demonstrate the effectiveness of sync and async ES on a multi-turn terminal style agentic coding task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出有限陈旧度的异步进化策略（ES），在终端式多轮智能体编码任务上验证其可行性与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: LLM长时程智能体后训练受限于rollout生成效率：轨迹长、完成时间差异大、同步更新屏障导致快worker等待慢worker。异步RL虽缓解该问题，却引入策略滞后与离策略优化；ES作为无反向传播的替代方案需要更多rollout，且现有实践多为同步。
AI.method: 提出bounded-staleness异步ES，在Endless Terminals基准上用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct进行实验；设置自然异步Async-1，并设计受控调度，将每个更新队列中10%的样本延迟4或8个策略更新。
AI.result: 三个评估种子下，自然Async-1（25.9%）与同步ES（25.4%）持平；延迟4和8个更新的受控调度仅分别降低1.6和3.1个百分点，且无需显式离策略校正。GRPO整体更优，达29.0%。
AI.conclusion: ES能容忍中等程度的策略陈旧度且性能退化有限，为未来基于ES的异步后训练算法改进提供了可能；这是首次在终端式多轮智能体编码任务上验证同步与异步ES的有效性。

title: TrustmeWatcher: An Application for Workplace Micro-Sensing and Explainable Well-Being Feedback
comment: 4 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at XAI for U 2026, the 3rd International Workshop on Explainable AI for Ubiquitous, Pervasive and Wearable Computing, co-located with UbiComp/ISWC 2026
summary: Workplace sensing studies combine long-running behaviour traces with self-reports, yet the tools that collect those data often sit apart from the interface that returns results. We present TrustmeWatcher, the application built for the TRUST-ME project to connect this work. TrustmeWatcher reuses ActivityWatch's OS-level watchers for computer-activity collection and adds its own application layer. It turns the collected traces into an interactive screen-time dashboard, synchronizes responses from short questionnaires completed on the StreamDeck, and presents questionnaires alongside video highlights. Activity records and self-reports are aligned into labelled records for model development. The scope of this paper is limited to ActivityWatch data as model input. Artificial intelligence (AI) uses these activity records to predict six normalized state scores and an overall well-being score. The trained model runs locally, and the dashboard presents its predictions in semantic bands. Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) helps users understand how recorded activity contributed to a prediction. Privacy Control lets users pause or resume the camera and eye tracker used by the study. We describe the workflow, its user-device and sensing-setup boundaries, and its use with records from 17 participants. The result is a deployed application and study workflow that integrates activity review, study data collection, privacy control, local prediction, and a participant-facing interface for XAI evaluation.

AI.tldr: TrustmeWatcher 是一个为 TRUST-ME 项目构建的部署应用，将计算机活动采集、问卷同步、本地AI预测与可解释性界面整合到统一工作流中。
AI.motivation: 职场感知研究虽同时使用长期行为轨迹与自报告数据，但采集工具与结果反馈界面往往相互分离，缺乏整合。
AI.method: 复用 ActivityWatch 的 OS 级监视器采集计算机活动，并叠加自有应用层：生成交互式屏幕时间仪表板，同步 StreamDeck 短问卷回答，结合视频高亮展示问卷；将活动记录与自报告对齐为带标签记录，训练本地AI模型预测六项归一化状态分数与整体健康分数，并以语义区间和XAI呈现预测，另提供隐私控制（暂停/恢复摄像头与眼动仪）。
AI.result: 实现了可部署的应用与研究流程，整合活动回顾、数据采集、隐私控制、本地预测与面向参与者的XAI评估界面，并在17名参与者的数据上进行了使用。
AI.conclusion: 本文范围限于 ActivityWatch 数据作为模型输入，重点描述该工作流及其用户-设备与感知设置边界，为职场感知研究提供一体化的采集与反馈平台。

title: Sharp Convergence and Sample Complexity of Policy Mirror Descent for Average-Reward MDPs
summary: Policy mirror descent (PMD) has a mature finite-time theory in discounted Markov decision processes (MDPs), but less is known in the average-reward setting, a more natural objective for many control applications. We give a finite-time, finite-sample analysis of PMD in ergodic average-reward MDPs built around a single master recursion that governs convergence for any critic, without external regularization. Its specializations yield linear rates for exact, inexact-tabular, and linear function approximation (LFA) updates, with a superlinear regime for exact PMD. We complement these convergence results with end-to-end sample complexities of order $t_{\mathrm{mix}}^3/\varepsilon^2$ in both tabular ($|S||A|$-dependent) and LFA ($d$-dependent) settings. Our LFA sample complexity sharpens the prior best $t_{\mathrm{mix}}^5$ mixing dependence to $t_{\mathrm{mix}}^3$, and matching information-theoretic lower bounds establish that the critic's $t_{\mathrm{mix}}^3/\varepsilon^2$ sample complexity is unimprovable in both settings.

AI.tldr: 本文为遍历平均奖励MDP中的策略镜像下降(PMD)提供了有限时间、有限样本分析，基于单一主递归刻画收敛性，得到线性与超线性速率及$t_{\mathrm{mix}}^3/\varepsilon^2$的样本复杂度。
AI.motivation: PMD在折扣MDP已有成熟有限时间理论，但在平均奖励这一更贴合控制的设定下了解较少，本文旨在填补该空白并改进已有混合时间依赖。
AI.method: 通过一个适用于任意critic、无需外部正则化的单一主递归来统一分析PMD的收敛性，并将其特化到精确、非精确表格及LFA更新。
AI.result: 得到精确情形线性与超线性速率，表格与LFA端到端样本复杂度均为$t_{\mathrm{mix}}^3/\varepsilon^2$；LFA部分将此前$t_{\mathrm{mix}}^5$改进为$t_{\mathrm{mix}}^3$，且匹配下界证明critic样本复杂度不可改进。
AI.conclusion: 该分析统一了平均奖励PMD的收敛理论，并在LFA样本复杂度上达到信息论最优的混合时间依赖。

title: ALoDLM: Adaptively Looped Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) enable fast generation by predicting multiple tokens in parallel, but their practical adoption remains limited by a persistent quality gap relative to comparably sized autoregressive (AR) models. We attribute this gap to a computation-difficulty mismatch: within a partially observed sequence, some unknown tokens are easy to predict, while others require substantially more computation. Existing DLMs nevertheless apply uniform computational depth to all unknown positions at each denoising step. We introduce ALoDLM, which replaces uniform computation with token-adaptive latent recurrence. At each denoising step, ALoDLM iteratively refines latent representations and allocates computation according to token difficulty. Tokens ready to commit are fed back as discrete context, while unresolved tokens retain and further refine their latent states through additional recurrent passes. To learn token prediction and computation allocation jointly, we formulate token-wise computation schedules as latent variables and derive a conditional negative evidence lower bound (NELBO). We train ALoDLM at 1.7B and 8B parameter scales. Across eleven benchmarks, ALoDLM outperforms all evaluated DLMs and the corresponding AR baselines in average benchmark score at both scales. ALoDLM also retains fast parallel decoding, yielding a strong quality-efficiency trade-off among evaluated autoregressive and diffusion models under optimized inference engines.

AI.tldr: 提出ALoDLM，用token自适应的潜在循环计算替代扩散语言模型中的均匀计算，在1.7B和8B规模上超越同类DLM与AR基线。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLM）能并行预测多个token实现快速生成，但与同规模自回归（AR）模型相比存在持续的质量差距，限制了其实际应用。作者将这一差距归因于"计算-难度不匹配"：在部分观测的序列中，部分未知token容易预测，另一些则需要显著更多计算，而现有DLM在每个去噪步骤对所有未知位置施加均匀的计算深度。
AI.method: 提出ALoDLM，用token自适应的潜在循环（latent recurrence）替代均匀计算。在每个去噪步骤中，迭代细化潜在表示并按token难度分配计算量：准备确定的token作为离散上下文反馈，未解决的token保留并通过额外的循环遍次进一步细化其潜在状态。为联合学习token预测与计算分配，将token级计算调度建模为潜在变量，并推导出条件负证据下界（NELBO）作为训练目标。
AI.result: 在1.7B和8B两个参数规模上训练ALoDLM。在十一个基准测试中，两个规模下的平均基准得分均超过所有被评估的DLM以及相应的AR基线。同时保留了快速并行解码能力，在优化推理引擎下，于被评估的自回归与扩散模型中取得了良好的质量-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: token自适应计算分配有效弥合了扩散语言模型相对AR模型的质量差距，同时保持并行解码的效率优势，实现了质量与效率的更优平衡。

title: Dynamic Harness Search: Building Multi-Agent Systems Per-Query via Prediction
summary: Agent harnesses specify the roles, instructions, tools, and communication structure used to solve a task, and the right harness depends on the query. Because the value of each design choice is observable only through execution, tailoring a harness to each query has required either executing alternatives at inference time or costly manual design. We introduce SHIFT, which moves execution out of the per-query search loop. A local LLM architect learns a policy over harness-building actions from search, and a value function that predicts, from measured executions, a utility balancing accuracy against execution cost. For each query, Monte Carlo tree search uses these predictions to construct a harness. Across 9,193 tasks in six benchmarks, from math to document and general-assistant tasks, with a Gemini 3.5 Flash executor, SHIFT attains the highest mean accuracy, about 80%, outperforming 17 baselines that span prompting, prompt optimization, and workflow search, and exceeding the strongest baseline by 7.2 percentage points. A cheaper mode of SHIFT also attains a higher mean accuracy than every baseline while using 32% fewer execution tokens than the strongest baseline. We further show that choosing structure, instructions, and tools jointly beats choosing only instructions or only tools by up to 9.1 percentage points, and that learned value selection identifies more accurate harnesses with lower execution cost from candidate pools.

AI.tldr: SHIFT 将执行从逐查询的搜索循环中移除，通过本地 LLM 架构师从搜索中学习 harness 构建策略与价值函数，并用蒙特卡洛树搜索为每个查询构造 harness。
AI.motivation: 不同查询需要不同的 agent harness（角色、指令、工具、通信结构），而各设计选择的价值只能通过执行观察。现有方法要么在推理时执行备选方案，要么依赖昂贵的人工设计，成本高。
AI.method: 本地 LLM 架构师从搜索中学习一个关于 harness 构建动作的策略，并学习一个价值函数，从实测执行中预测兼顾准确率与执行成本的效用。对每个查询，用蒙特卡洛树搜索基于这些预测来构造 harness。
AI.result: 在六个基准、9,193 个任务（数学、文档、通用助手）上，使用 Gemini 3.5 Flash 执行器，SHIFT 取得最高平均准确率约 80%，超过 17 个涵盖提示、提示优化与工作流搜索的基线，比最强基线高 7.2 个百分点。SHIFT 的低成本模式准确率仍高于所有基线，且执行 token 比最强基线少 32%。联合选择结构、指令与工具比仅选指令或仅选工具最高提升 9.1 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: SHIFT 通过在离线搜索中学习策略与价值函数、在推理时用 MCTS 直接构造 harness，避免逐查询执行搜索，在准确率与执行成本上均优于现有方法，且联合优化结构、指令与工具带来显著收益。

title: Fine-Tuning VLM for Enhancing AI's Spatial Intelligence: Understanding 3D and 2D Rotations
summary: Spatial intelligence is a fundamental skill in multiple domains, such as Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM), Medicine, Architecture, and Construction. Recent studies indicate that Vision-Language Models (VLMs) still face limitations in spatial reasoning, which inhibits artificial intelligence (AI) from performing practical spatial tasks. Using multiple object-rotation datasets developed for training and evaluation, our experiments demonstrated promising improvements in both 2D and 3D rotation detection. Fine-tuned Google DeepMind-built Gemma-4 mixture-of-experts (MoE) models significantly outperformed fine-tuned Gemma-4 generalist models in predicting rotations defined by both their axes and angles. Fine-tuning also substantially improved angle estimation for 2D representation without requiring an explicit coordinate system. Furthermore, identifiable objects did not improve angle-detection accuracy; instead, objects with prominent linear features showed improved performance.

AI.tldr: 通过微调Gemma-4 MoE模型，在2D和3D旋转检测任务上取得明显提升，MoE优于通用模型。
AI.motivation: 空间智能是STEM、医学、建筑等领域的基础能力，但现有视觉语言模型在空间推理上仍存在局限，难以完成实际空间任务，因此需要研究如何提升其旋转检测能力。
AI.method: 使用多个面向训练与评估的目标旋转数据集进行实验，对Google DeepMind的Gemma-4混合专家（MoE）模型和Gemma-4通用模型进行微调，考察其在2D与3D旋转检测（轴与角度预测）上的表现，并分析物体可识别性与线性特征对角度检测的影响。
AI.result: 微调后的Gemma-4 MoE模型在轴与角度旋转预测上显著优于微调后的通用模型；微调也大幅提升了2D表示下的角度估计，且无需显式坐标系；可识别物体并未提升角度检测精度，而具有显著线性特征的物体表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 微调特别是MoE架构能有效增强视觉语言模型的空间旋转推理能力，且角度检测更依赖于物体的线性几何特征而非语义可识别性。

title: Dual-Scale Relational Graph Transformers for Ecosystem-Aware Fraud Detection
comment: This paper has been accepted at the Geometric Distributional Deep Learning (GDDL) workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Account takeover (ATO) fraud is a growing threat to digital banking, requiring effective detection while minimizing friction for legitimate customers. Production systems predominantly rely on tabular models that score sessions in isolation, discarding the relational structure of the underlying interaction network. Although graph-based models exploit relationships among sessions and network entities, they primarily reason over local neighborhoods and therefore capture only part of the problem: fraud risk depends jointly on the local relational structure surrounding a session and the evolving global state of the fraud ecosystem. We present HERMES (HEterogeneous Relational Micro--macro graph transformer Encoder for high-risk Sessions), a dual-scale architecture that jointly models these complementary scales of information. Micro-GT captures local heterogeneous graph structure through structured, relation-aware attention over a temporally safe session neighborhood. Complementing this local representation, Macro-GT models ecosystem-level context using non-anticipative climate tokens that summarize fraud dynamics, platform shifts, and infrastructure reuse, together with adaptive class prototypes that track representative fraud and benign session patterns over time. Evaluated on more than 130 million high-risk transaction sessions from a leading U.S. financial institution, HERMES consistently outperforms production and strong graph-based baselines, achieving a 44.44% relative reduction in customer friction and a 24.66% relative improvement in fraud recall over the production system. Ablation and temporal-stability analyses further demonstrate complementary gains from local relational modeling and global ecosystem context across changing fraud regimes.

AI.tldr: HERMES 是一个双尺度异构图 Transformer 编码器，联合建模会话局部关系结构与欺诈生态全局状态，在 1.3 亿+ 高风险交易会话上显著优于生产系统与图基线。
AI.motivation: 数字银行中的账户接管（ATO）欺诈日益严重，检测需在降低合法客户摩擦的同时保持有效性。生产系统多依赖孤立打分会话的表格模型，丢弃了交互网络的关系结构；现有图模型虽利用关系，但主要局限于局部邻域推理，仅能刻画部分问题——欺诈风险同时取决于会话的局部关系结构与欺诈生态的演化全局状态。
AI.method: 提出 HERMES（HEterogeneous Relational Micro–macro graph transformer Encoder for high-risk Sessions）双尺度架构：Micro-GT 通过结构化、关系感知的注意力机制，在时间安全的会话邻域上捕获局部异构图结构；Macro-GT 建模生态级上下文，使用非前瞻性的 climate tokens 汇总欺诈动态、平台切换与基础设施复用，并结合自适应类别原型随时间跟踪代表性欺诈与正常会话模式。
AI.result: 在来自美国某领先金融机构的 1.3 亿+ 高风险交易会话上评估，HERMES 持续优于生产系统与强图基线，相较生产系统实现客户摩擦相对降低 44.44%，欺诈召回相对提升 24.66%。消融与时间稳定性分析进一步表明局部关系建模与全局生态上下文在不同欺诈形态变化下具有互补增益。
AI.conclusion: 联合建模微观局部关系结构与宏观生态上下文，可有效提升 ATO 欺诈检测的性能与鲁棒性，同时显著减少对合法客户的干扰，并在欺诈模式演变下保持时间稳定性。

title: TCMClinicalReason-Bench: Can Language Models Reason from Pathogenesis to Prescription over Real-World Clinical Cases?
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate clinical narratives that are insufficiently grounded in patient-specific evidence. In traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), errors can propagate from etiology and pathogenesis through syndrome diagnosis and treatment principles to prescription generation. We developed TCMClinicalReason-Bench using 2,000 multicenter electronic health record cases to distinguish case-grounded responses from fluent but unsupported diagnostic and therapeutic conclusions. Five general-purpose and two TCM-specific LLMs were evaluated in zero-shot settings. An evidence-constrained rubric assessed seven diagnostic and therapeutic components and three cross-block relations, allowing case-supported alternatives. Qwen3.7-Plus with TCM retrieval served as the automated judge, alongside parallel blinded ratings by five senior TCM clinicians on a 600-case subset. Structural completeness was nearly saturated (99.3-100.0%), but normalized content scores ranged from 40.7% to 54.1%. The five general-purpose models averaged 50.0%, versus 41.3% for the two smaller TCM-specific models. Cross-block logic consistency ranged from 60.8% to 66.8% and correlated moderately with content across cases (Pearson's r = 0.515-0.656). Deficits were greatest in prescription generation, prescription analysis, and symptom-guided modification. In judge stress testing on 100 independent cases, perturbation detection rates across the three relations were 57%, 56%, and 31%, with contradictions detected more reliably than omissions. Separating component quality from cross-block consistency localizes failures missed by endpoint and completeness metrics and identifies where clinician oversight remains necessary.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了TCMClinicalReason-Bench基准（基于2000例多中心电子病历），用于评估大语言模型在中医临床推理中的"病例循证性"，并发现结构化完整性接近饱和但内容质量与跨模块逻辑一致性仍存在明显不足。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型生成的临床叙述常缺乏患者特异性证据支撑。在中医场景下，错误会沿"病因病机—证候诊断—治则—处方"链条逐级传播，而传统评估指标难以区分"有病例依据的回答"与"流畅但无依据的结论"。
AI.method: 基于2000例多中心电子病历构建TCMClinicalReason-Bench；在零样本设置下评估5个通用模型与2个中医专用模型；采用证据约束评分表评估7个诊断治疗组件与3类跨模块关系，允许病例支持的替代答案；以Qwen3.7-Plus结合中医检索作为自动评判，并由5位资深中医临床医师对600例子集进行平行盲评。
AI.result: 结构完整性近乎饱和（99.3%–100.0%），但归一化内容得分为40.7%–54.1%；5个通用模型平均50.0%，2个较小中医专用模型为41.3%；跨模块逻辑一致性为60.8%–66.8%，与内容得分中度相关（Pearson r=0.515–0.656）。缺陷最集中于处方生成、处方分析与症状导向加减。在100例独立案例的评判压力测试中，三类关系的扰动检出率分别为57%、56%、31%，矛盾比遗漏更易检出。
AI.conclusion: 将组件质量与跨模块一致性分离评估，可定位端点和完整性指标所遗漏的失败环节，并识别仍需要临床医生监督的关键位置。

title: ExpertMuon-Compass: Alignment-Guided Step Sizes for Mixture-of-Experts Training
summary: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models send each token to a few experts, so each expert is trained on a different part of the data, and this part changes during training. With a shared learning rate, Muon applies updates of roughly the same size to expert matrices of the same shape, even when an expert's update is poorly aligned with its current gradient. We here propose ExpertMuon-Compass (Compass), which multiplies the Muon step of each expert by two factors. A family factor compares the cosine between the expert's orthogonalized update and its gradient with the same cosine for the other experts in its layer. A scalar radius aggregates the alignment between corresponding rows of the update and gradient into one step-length multiplier. Compass keeps the update direction and the momentum buffer of Muon. In pretraining on FineWeb-Edu, Compass with Nesterov momentum on all matrices performs as well as or better than Muon, NorMuon, and other optimizers, with weight decay matched to NorMuon in the longer runs. Adding its factors to NorMuon gives the same or a lower loss than NorMuon. Compass is the most effective when the data seen by each expert varies during training, for example, as when the languages of a multilingual corpus arrive in separate blocks. With Compass, the expert load stays balanced, and the router assigns tokens to experts more decisively. We also prove a perturbation bound for the two factors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ExpertMuon-Compass（Compass），为 MoE 中每个专家的 Muon 更新乘以两个因子（family factor 与 scalar radius），在保持 Muon 更新方向与动量缓冲的前提下，使预训练性能优于或持平 Muon、NorMuon 等优化器，并在专家数据分布变化时效果最佳。
AI.motivation: MoE 语言模型将每个 token 发送给少数专家，因此每个专家在不同数据子集上训练，且该子集在训练过程中不断变化。在共享学习率下，Muon 会对相同形状的专家矩阵施加大小大致相同的更新，即使某个专家的更新与其当前梯度对齐很差，这造成了更新尺度与对齐程度不匹配的问题。
AI.method: 提出 ExpertMuon-Compass（Compass）：将每个专家的 Muon 步长乘以两个因子。其一是 family factor，比较该专家正交化更新与梯度的余弦相似度，以及同层其他专家的相同余弦；其二是 scalar radius，将更新与梯度对应行之间的对齐程度聚合成一个步长乘数。方法保留 Muon 的更新方向和动量缓冲。
AI.result: 在 FineWeb-Edu 预训练中，对所有矩阵使用 Nesterov 动量的 Compass 表现与 Muon、NorMuon 及其他优化器相当或更好，较长训练中权重衰减与 NorMuon 匹配；将因子加入 NorMuon 可得到相同或更低的损失。当每个专家所见数据在训练中变化时（如多语种语料按块到达）Compass 最有效，专家负载保持均衡，路由器对专家的分配更果断。此外作者证明了两个因子的扰动界。
AI.conclusion: Compass 通过引入 family factor 和 scalar radius 两个因子，自适应地调整各专家的更新步长，在保持 Muon 原有优点的同时提升了 MoE 语言模型预训练效果，尤其在专家数据分布动态变化场景下表现突出，并具备理论上的扰动界保证。

title: On the Steering Dimensionality of Refusal in Language Models
summary: Existing activation steering methods often assume that a high-level concept can be mediated by a single steering direction. To support this, two complementary interventions should be achieved: additive steering should induce the target behavior, while directional ablation should suppress it. Yet behaviors may occupy richer activation geometries beyond a single direction, and semantically similar behaviors may be represented by distinct directions. In this work, we study how many directions can reliably control two different types of refusal behaviors: refusal triggered by the safety alignment and refusal in general contexts. Given the limited expressive capability of a single steering vector, we study the general setting of steering subspaces and introduce the notion of steering dimensionality as the minimum subspace dimensionality required to reliably control a behavior. We characterize sufficient steering subspaces that cover the full extent of the target behavior through both the (monotonic) improvement before the sufficient dimensionality, and the saturation beyond it. Empirically, we find that refusal triggered by safety alignment is 1-dim steerable, while multiple distinct steering directions can achieve comparable control. In contrast, refusal in general contexts exhibits substantially richer activation geometry where even 5-dim steering subspaces fail to reliably capture its full steerable variation. Our results reveal that the activation geometry underlying refusal is highly context-dependent and can be substantially more complex than a single linear steering direction.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"拒绝行为"需要多少个方向才能被可靠控制，提出"引导维度"概念，发现安全对齐触发的拒绝是1维可引导的，而一般语境下的拒绝需要超过5维的子空间。
AI.motivation: 现有激活引导方法通常假设高层概念可由单一引导方向介导，但行为可能占据更丰富的激活几何结构，语义相似的行为也可能由不同方向表示。
AI.method: 研究引导子空间的一般设定，提出"引导维度"（可靠控制某行为所需的最小子空间维度），通过充分维度前的单调提升与之后的饱和来刻画充分引导子空间，并对两类拒绝行为进行实证分析。
AI.result: 安全对齐触发的拒绝是1维可引导的，且多个不同方向均可实现相当的控制效果；而一般语境下的拒绝激活几何更丰富，即使5维引导子空间也无法可靠捕捉其全部可引导变化。
AI.conclusion: 拒绝行为背后的激活几何高度依赖语境，可能比单一线性引导方向复杂得多。

title: Ideal Paths for Approximating Logistic Gradient Descent Trajectories at Large Initialization
summary: Modern training on a new task often starts from a previously trained model rather than from scratch, raising the question of how this initialization affects the subsequent training trajectory. Classical implicit-bias results characterize the direction selected by prolonged training, but this direction alone does not provide information regarding the intermediate behavior. We address this question through a geometric approximation of full-batch logistic gradient descent (GD) trajectories on strictly linearly separable data, with large initialization of scale $R$ motivated by prior training. From any limiting normalized initial position, we use minimum-norm projection rules to construct a unique continuous ideal path consisting of finitely many linear segments. The path has two stages: negative-margin correction followed by minimum-margin growth. We prove that, after an explicit two-stage time reparameterization, the fixed-step GD trajectory divided by $R$ converges uniformly to this path on every fixed parameter interval as $R\to\infty$. Further, our quantitative error bounds account for initialization perturbations and the transition between stages. This approximation provides asymptotic formulas for peak evaluation loss and cumulative training loss. In particular, peak evaluation loss can grow linearly in $R$ even when both endpoint losses tend to zero. The cumulative losses in the correction and margin-growth stages, normalized by $R^2$ and $R$, respectively, converge to explicit limits. Experiments on controlled geometries and fixed image features complement our theoretical results.

AI.tldr: 本文研究从预训练模型初始化后全批量逻辑回归梯度下降的训练轨迹,通过几何近似给出大初始化尺度下GD轨迹的极限理想路径,并推导峰值评估损失与累积训练损失的渐近公式。
AI.motivation: 现代训练常从已训练模型而非从头开始,初始化会影响后续训练轨迹。经典隐式偏置结果只刻画长时间训练选定的方向,无法说明中间过程的行为,因此需要刻画初始化尺度较大时的完整训练轨迹。
AI.method: 针对严格线性可分数据上的全批量逻辑回归梯度下降,考虑初始化尺度为R的情形。利用最小范数投影规则,从任意归一化初始位置构造由有限条线段组成的唯一连续理想路径,该路径分为负间隔修正与最小间隔增长两个阶段。证明经过显式两阶段时间重参数化后,GD轨迹除以R在每个固定参数区间上一致收敛到该路径。
AI.result: 证明了R趋于无穷时固定步长GD轨迹除以R一致收敛到理想路径,并给出考虑初始化扰动与阶段转换的定量误差界。由此得到峰值评估损失与累积训练损失的渐近公式:即使两端损失都趋于零,峰值评估损失仍可随R线性增长;修正阶段与间隔增长阶段的累积损失分别以R^2和R归一化后收敛到显式极限。控制几何与固定图像特征上的实验验证了理论。
AI.conclusion: 大初始化下逻辑回归GD训练轨迹可由两阶段线性分段理想路径精确近似,该框架揭示了峰值评估损失随初始化尺度线性增长的机制,并量化了各阶段累积损失,为理解预训练初始化对训练动态的影响提供了理论工具。

title: Spec2Game: Can LLMs Generate Complete Playable Games from Detailed Specifications?
summary: Generating an executable program does not necessarily mean that it correctly implements the behavioral requirements specified in natural language. To evaluate large language models' ability to realize detailed specifications as complete interactive programs, we introduce Spec2Game, a benchmark that requires models to generate complete Pygame projects from detailed natural-language game specifications. Spec2Game comprises 15 game families and 150 task instances, with one canonical task and nine controlled rule variants per family, spanning three levels of implementation complexity. Using source-code, runtime, and visual evidence, we evaluate generated projects along four dimensions---Executability, Specification Realization, Code Quality, and User-Facing Quality. Across 14 LLMs and 3,330 generated projects, we find that high executability does not imply faithful specification realization. Component-level analysis further shows that models perform substantially better on Game Element Modeling than on Rule and Mechanism Modeling or Goal and Termination Modeling, indicating that faithfully implementing game rules and termination logic remains a major challenge.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Spec2Game基准，用150个任务评估14个LLM从自然语言游戏规格生成完整Pygame程序的能力，发现可执行性高并不代表规格实现忠实。
AI.motivation: 生成可执行程序不等于正确实现自然语言描述的行为需求，需要系统评估大模型将详细规格转化为完整交互程序的能力。
AI.method: 构建Spec2Game基准，含15个游戏族、150个任务实例（每族1个标准任务+9个受控规则变体），覆盖三个实现复杂度层级；基于源码、运行时与视觉证据，从可执行性、规格实现、代码质量、用户面向质量四个维度评估。
AI.result: 评估14个LLM、共3330个生成项目，发现高可执行性并不意味着忠实的规格实现；组件级分析显示游戏元素建模表现显著优于规则与机制建模、目标与终止建模。
AI.conclusion: 忠实实现游戏规则与终止逻辑仍是主要挑战，Spec2Game为评估LLM规格实现能力提供了多维度基准。

title: Consideration Circuits: Depth Separation and Universality Beyond a Single Softmax
summary: Most feature-based choice models, classical and deep, score items and apply a single softmax. We introduce consideration circuits (CC), feature-based models of multi-stage choice defined by directed acyclic graphs of multinomial logit (MNL) units. Source units assign probabilities to menu items, and internal units combine predecessor distributions using MNL weights computed from their probability-weighted feature summaries. On a three-item compromise task with fixed non-collinear features, menu-independent random-utility models (RUM), including a single MNL unit, suffer an error bounded away from zero. For CC, in contrast, we establish a sharp depth--norm separation: increasing depth from $2$ to $3$ reduces the optimal maximum taste-vector norm for error $ε$ from $Θ(\log(1/ε)/ε)$ to $Θ(\log(1/ε))$. The depth-$2$ lower bound holds for arbitrary width and menu-independent routing biases, while a five-node depth-$3$ circuit with zero routing biases attains the logarithmic rate. More generally, we characterize two geometric conditions that are necessary and sufficient for approximating arbitrary deterministic choice tables on finite menu families. Under these conditions, depth $3$ suffices, while depth $4$ achieves optimal logarithmic norm scaling whenever the family contains a non-singleton menu. In experiments, standalone tree circuits with fewer than $600$ parameters attain the lowest mean test negative log-likelihood (NLL) among the evaluated models on four fixed-pool benchmarks and the Expedia temporal split. As output heads, CC generalize the linear MNL readout and lower mean test NLL for every tested encoder on Expedia and Trivago.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"考虑电路"(CC)，一种基于MNL单元有向无环图的多阶段特征选择模型，并证明了深度3即可实现对数级范数缩放、优于单层MNL的表达能力，实验显示其参数少且测试NLL最低。
AI.motivation: 经典与深度特征选择模型通常对物品打分后使用单一softmax，难以刻画多阶段选择过程。论文希望在固定特征的三物品"妥协"任务上，突破菜单无关随机效用模型（含单MNL单元）所存在的误差下界，探索更深层结构对表达能力的提升。
AI.method: 将选择模型定义为MNL单元组成的有向无环图：源单元为菜单项分配概率，内部单元基于概率加权特征摘要计算MNL权重来组合前驱分布。据此分析深度与范数之间的权衡，并刻画在有限菜单族上逼近任意确定性选择表的两个充要几何条件。
AI.result: 在三物品妥协任务上证明尖锐的深度—范数分离：深度从2增至3，误差ε所需最优最大味觉向量范数由Θ(log(1/ε)/ε)降至Θ(log(1/ε))。深度2下界对任意宽度和菜单无关路由偏置成立，而一个零路由偏置的五节点深度3电路即可达到对数速率。几何条件满足时深度3足够，深度4在含非单元素菜单时达到最优对数范数缩放。实验上，少于600参数的树状电路在四个固定池基准与Expedia时间划分上取得最低平均测试NLL；作为输出头时可泛化线性MNL读出，并在Expedia、Trivago上降低各编码器的平均测试NLL。
AI.conclusion: 考虑电路通过深度分层有效扩展了特征选择模型的表达能力，以极小参数量实现更优拟合，并可作为通用输出头替代线性MNL读出。

title: CADForge: Agentic Single-View CAD Reconstruction with Explicit Geometry Reasoning
summary: Reconstructing editable parametric CAD models from a single-view image is of great practical value for modern manufacturing, yet remains challenging due to incomplete geometric observations and complex inter-part relationships. To address it, we propose CADForge, an agentic framework that progressively converts a single image into CadQuery programs. CADForge decomposes an object into CAD-meaningful components and performs explicit geometric reasoning for each component, a process that first identifies CAD-relevant constraints and then translates them into precise modeling parameters through mathematical code. The inferred parameters then drive component-wise synthesis of executable CadQuery programs, with a review agent evaluating the resulting geometry and providing targeted feedback for iterative refinement. To further improve robustness and efficiency, CADForge incorporates a failure-guided toolkit construction mechanism to distill accumulated experience into tools, and maintains a compact parametric CAD memory for retrieving modeling context on demand. Experiments on diverse single- and multi-part objects show that CADForge consistently outperforms existing baselines in reconstruction fidelity and perceptual quality, demonstrating an effective approach to accurate single-view CAD reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出CADForge智能体框架，从单视图图像渐进式重建可编辑参数化CAD模型，性能优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 从单视图图像重建可编辑的参数化CAD模型对现代制造有重要价值，但因几何观测不完整、部件间关系复杂而极具挑战。
AI.method: CADForge将物体分解为CAD有意义的部件，对每个部件进行显式几何推理：先识别CAD相关约束，再通过数学代码转化为精确建模参数；参数驱动逐部件合成可执行的CadQuery程序，并由审查智能体评估几何结果并给出针对性反馈以迭代优化。此外引入失败引导的工具构建机制，将经验蒸馏为工具，并维护紧凑的参数化CAD记忆以按需检索建模上下文。
AI.result: 在多种单部件与多部件物体上，CADForge在重建保真度和感知质量上均持续优于现有基线。
AI.conclusion: CADForge展示了一种实现精确单视图CAD重建的有效途径。

title: You May Be Running the Wrong Inception Crop
summary: A decade after its inception, Inception crop has become the standard crop-based data augmentation method for training deep vision models. Not only is its practice of uniformly sampling crop scale and aspect ratio widely adopted, but also its lower and upper bounds, with the scale lower bound being the sole exception that is sometimes tuned. It is therefore surprising that the standard implementation in the TensorFlow / JAX ecosystem samples crop scale with probability density function $f(A) \propto \frac{1}{\sqrt{A}}$ unlike the PyTorch counterpart, which follows the original description. Motivated by this discovery, we train 522 ViT-S/16 models on the ImageNet-1k dataset with various training budgets and crop scale distributions. We reach $78.78\pm0.09$ top-1 val. accuracy with 90 epochs of training budget and find that 1. Higher training budget requires stronger augmentation; 2. Lower tail of the distribution of the crop scale determines the augmentation strength of Inception crop; 3. Models trained with higher training budget exhibit sparser saliency, regardless of the crop scale distribution or weight decay. Based on 2. we revisit the performance of Beta crop, whose softer cutoff allows it to optimize model performance across training budgets with less compromise. We replicate 1. and 3. with Scion optimizer in addition to AdamW, suggesting that the results may be general.

AI.tldr: 本文发现TensorFlow/JAX中Inception crop的实现与原始描述及PyTorch不一致（尺度采样服从 f(A)∝1/√A），通过大规模实验揭示了裁剪尺度分布下尾对增强强度的影响，并据此重新评估Beta crop。
AI.motivation: Inception crop已成为视觉模型训练的标准数据增强方法，但其在TensorFlow/JAX生态中的实现却与PyTorch及原始描述有所不同，这一差异此前未被系统研究。作者希望探究不同裁剪尺度分布对训练的影响，并据此改进增强策略。
AI.method: 在ImageNet-1k上使用多种训练预算与裁剪尺度分布训练522个ViT-S/16模型，并额外使用Scion优化器复现关键结论（与AdamW对比）。
