AI.result: 在90 epoch预算下达到78.78±0.09 top-1验证准确率；发现：(1)更高训练预算需要更强增强；(2)裁剪尺度分布的下尾决定Inception crop的增强强度；(3)无论裁剪尺度分布或权重衰减如何，更高预算下模型显著性更稀疏。基于结论(2)重新评估了Beta crop的表现。
AI.conclusion: 裁剪尺度分布的下尾是控制增强强度的关键，Beta crop因其更柔和的截断可在不同训练预算下更少妥协地优化性能；相关结论在Scion优化器下亦成立，说明可能具有普遍性。

title: Dense Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning in a Unified Geometry State
summary: Geometry reasoning is naturally stateful: solving a problem repeatedly alternates between structural proposals and exact deductions. We formulate this process as dense neural-symbolic coupling, in which neural guidance and symbolic execution share a typed state and communicate through executable actions at every search step. Neural proposals contribute theorem instances, constructions, and algebraic bridges; the symbolic runtime applies registered rules, propagates exact constraints, and records provenance. A nested controller allocates computation first between neural and symbolic proposal sources and then among admitted actions. We instantiate the framework in OmniGeo, a single solver for plane, analytic, and solid geometry. With Claude Sonnet 4.6, OmniGeo reaches 94.2%, 88.5%, and 89.8% on FormalGeo7K, Conic10K, and SolidFGeo, respectively (90.8% macro average), and solves 21/30 IMO-AG-30 problems.

AI.tldr: 提出密集神经-符号耦合框架,并在 OmniGeo 求解器中实例化,统一处理平面、解析与立体几何,取得优异基准成绩。
AI.motivation: 几何推理本质上是有状态的:求解过程在结构提议与精确演绎之间交替。作者希望用神经-符号紧耦合的方式刻画这一过程,弥合神经引导与符号执行之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 将求解形式化为密集神经-符号耦合:神经引导与符号执行共享带类型的状态,并在每步搜索中通过可执行动作通信。神经提议提供定理实例、构造和代数桥;符号运行时应用注册规则、传播精确约束并记录来源。嵌套控制器先分配神经与符号提议源之间的计算,再在可用动作间分配。
AI.result: 在 OmniGeo(面向平面、解析、立体几何的单一求解器)中实例化,配合 Claude Sonnet 4.6,在 FormalGeo7K、Conic10K、SolidFGeo 上分别达到 94.2%、88.5%、89.8%(宏平均 90.8%),并解决 IMO-AG-30 中的 21/30 题。
AI.conclusion: 密集神经-符号耦合为有状态几何推理提供了有效范式,OmniGeo 验证其可统一多种几何类型并取得强性能。

title: How RL Reshapes LLM Reasoning: Transferability, Coverage, and Scaling Laws
summary: Recent studies on reinforcement learning (RL) report seemingly conflicting evidence about large language model (LLM) reasoning. Training on mathematics can improve performance in other domains, yet gains in Pass@1 can coincide with lower Pass@$N$ than the base model. This raises a fundamental question: does RL expand an LLM's reasoning boundary, or merely reweight its existing reasoning space? We revisit these phenomena across Qwen and Gemma model families, showing both cross-domain gains and forgetting, while coverage at large sampling budgets increases on some tasks and decreases on others. Detailed analysis of solution traces before and after RL indicates a shift in the reasoning strategies the model employs, motivating a two-stage autoregressive policy model that separates \emph{strategy selection} from problem-specific execution. Within this framework, we prove how RL's implicit bias reshapes strategy preferences, allowing gains on some tasks while suppressing strategies required by others. This mechanism can also broaden or narrow coverage at a given sampling budget even without expanding strategy support. We further provide theoretical justifications for log-sigmoid and log-linear scaling laws in RL compute, and evaluate their predictive power. Together, these results connect changes in strategy selection to cross-domain transfer, reasoning coverage, and compute scaling.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨强化学习是否扩展大语言模型的推理边界，还是仅重新加权已有推理空间，并提出两阶段自回归策略模型解释其中的策略选择机制。
AI.motivation: 近期强化学习研究对LLM推理给出了看似矛盾的证据：数学训练可提升其他领域表现，但Pass@1提升可能伴随Pass@N下降，因此需要厘清RL究竟是扩展推理边界还是仅重新加权已有推理空间。
AI.method: 在Qwen和Gemma模型族上重访相关现象，分析RL前后解题轨迹；提出将策略选择与问题特定执行分离的两阶段自回归策略模型，并理论推导RL隐式偏置对策略偏好的重塑，以及log-sigmoid和log-linear计算缩放规律。
AI.result: 观察到跨域增益与遗忘并存，大采样预算下的覆盖率在不同任务上有的上升有的下降；轨迹分析显示RL改变了模型使用的推理策略；理论证明RL隐式偏置可在不扩展策略支持的情况下改变策略偏好，从而同时导致部分任务增益、其他任务被抑制，以及覆盖率的扩大或缩小。
AI.conclusion: 策略选择的变化可连接跨域迁移、推理覆盖率与计算缩放规律，为理解RL对LLM推理的作用提供统一解释。

title: VIGIL: Verifier-Informed Gated Improvement Loop for Spreadsheet Question Answering
summary: Enterprise agents should improve from delayed feedback without allowing every correction to rewrite system behavior. We study continual harness learning for corpus-level spreadsheet question answering. Building on FiCo (Find-then-Compute), a static retrieval-and-execution backbone, we introduce VIGIL (Verifier-Informed Gated Improvement Loop). Within a question, VIGIL verifies and repairs diversely prompted Structured Query Language (SQL) candidates. Across episodes, delayed labels update only a contract calibrator and query/result-column selector. The base model, prompts, retriever, and recorded candidate pool remain fixed in the continual-learning protocol. With the gold workbook and expected type supplied, the ungated and dual-gated full-replay variants reach 82.4% and 82.0% forward accuracy over 79 documents, from a 75.8% static baseline. The dual gate has the larger retrospective gain (2.7 versus 2.3 points), and its 6.3-point forward gain has a 95% t-interval of 5.6-6.9. In a separate stricter split that excludes 16 documents and 380 questions from fitting and online promotion, the accuracy-only gate raises mean held-out accuracy across ten final harnesses from 80.3% to 86.7%. Calibrator-only adaptation gains 5.9 points, close to the combined 6.4-point gain. Yet three of 26 gate-approved updates reduce held-out accuracy relative to their incumbents, so replay-buffer non-regression does not imply held-out non-regression. MiMoTable and external-task case studies test within-task verification and reuse the same promote-or-retain discipline. Overall, the results support bounded, auditable harness adaptation while revealing where finite replay gates fail to generalize beyond their promotion buffers.

AI.tldr: 提出VIGIL（验证器告知的门控改进循环），在保持基座模型、提示、检索器等固定的前提下，通过延迟反馈仅更新契约校准器与查询/结果列选择器，实现语料级电子表格问答的持续harness学习，在79篇文档上把前向准确率从75.8%提升到约82%。
AI.motivation: 企业智能体希望利用延迟反馈自我改进，但又不能让每一次纠错都任意改写系统行为。论文因此研究"持续harness学习"：在冻结主干的前提下实现有界、可审计的适配，避免反馈导致系统行为整体漂移。
AI.method: 基于静态的FiCo（先检索后计算）检索-执行骨架，提出VIGIL。问题内：对多样提示生成的SQL候选进行验证与修复；跨回合：延迟标签只更新一个契约校准器（contract calibrator）和查询/结果列选择器，基座模型、提示、检索器与已记录的候选池保持固定。设置无门控与双门控的全回放变体，并采用"晋升或保留"（promote-or-retain）纪律与回放缓冲非回归门槛。
AI.result: 在提供金标工作簿与期望类型时，无门控与双门控全回放变体在79篇文档上达到82.4%与82.0%的前向准确率，静态基线为75.8%。双门控回溯增益更大（2.7 vs 2.3点），其6.3点前向增益的95% t区间为5.6–6.9。在排除16篇文档、380个问题的更严格划分中，仅准确率门控把十个最终harness的平均留出准确率从80.3%提升到86.7%；仅校准器适配增益5.9点，接近合并的6.4点。但26次获批更新中有3次反而降低了相对原版本的留出准确率，说明回放缓冲的非回归并不蕴含留出集上的非回归。MiMoTable与外部任务案例研究测试了任务内验证并复用同一晋升或保留纪律。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持有界、可审计的harness适配，同时揭示了有限回放门控在推广到其晋升缓冲之外时可能失效的问题——缓冲内非回归不等于留出集非回归，提示门控设计需警惕泛化差距。

title: Principled Top-$k$ Selection for Language Models with Hybrid Gradients
summary: Selecting the best $k$ items out of $m$ candidates is a critical component of modern large language model systems, such as document selection in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and expert routing in Mixture-of-Experts (MoEs). However, training these selection modules remains challenging due to weak gradient signals and suboptimal exploration-exploitation tradeoffs. Furthermore, prior works often rely on heuristics, lacking principled objectives and approaches that explicitly model and solve the top-$k$ selection problem. In this work, we propose a principled objective for training selection modules, whose gradient naturally provides richer training signals in a hybrid form---containing a supervised-gradient component and a policy-gradient component. We show that the selection problem becomes harder as $m$ increases, and our algorithm converges at rate $O(1/\sqrt{T})$, with the optimal upper bound achieved by balancing between bias and variance. Practically, we apply our method to a set of tasks involving top-$k$ selection, including synthetic regression problems, RAG, and MoE systems, showing that our method outperforms the baselines in next-token prediction perplexity and QA accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文为top-k选择模块提出了一种有原则的训练目标，其梯度以监督梯度与策略梯度混合的形式提供更丰富的训练信号，并在合成回归、RAG与MoE任务上优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现代大语言模型系统（如RAG中的文档选择、MoE中的专家路由）需要从m个候选中选出最优的k个，但训练这类选择模块面临梯度信号弱、探索-利用权衡次优的问题，且已有工作多依赖启发式方法，缺乏对top-k选择问题显式建模与求解的原则性目标与方法。
AI.method: 作者为选择模块提出一个有原则的训练目标，其梯度天然以混合形式提供更丰富的训练信号，包含监督梯度分量与策略梯度分量；并从理论上分析选择问题随m增大而变难，证明算法以O(1/√T)速率收敛，且通过偏置-方差平衡达到最优上界。
AI.result: 在合成回归问题、RAG和MoE系统等一系列涉及top-k选择的任务上，本方法在下一token预测困惑度和问答准确率方面均优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为top-k选择模块提供了原则性目标与理论保证，其混合梯度机制有效改善了训练信号，并在多个实际任务中取得优于基线的表现。

title: LMBuild: Evaluating LLM Agents for Generating Buildable and Functional Structures
summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly capable of generating complex 3D structures, with the potential to reshape how objects are designed and realized in the physical world. Yet, producing elegant geometry is fundamentally different from producing objects that can be built and perform their intended functions. Existing evaluations largely focus on geometric quality while overlooking physical realizability. We introduce LMBuild, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on generating buildable and functional structures. LMBuild represents generated objects as assembled structures comprising part decompositions, joints, materials, and sequences. To support reproducible evaluation, we provide a unified framework consisting of: (1) an interactive environment in which agents can use tools to retrieve, create, and place components to construct objects; (2) a curated benchmark that repurposes established CAD datasets and augments them with knowledge from Wikipedia; and (3) a evaluation framework covering structural soundness, functional affordance, design quality, and physical realization. Evaluations across 30 systems reveal several intriguing findings: (a) Soundness and alignment are no longer the primary bottlenecks for frontier closed-source models, while functional affordance and physical operability remain substantially more challenging; (b) stronger models more effectively create new components, whereas weaker models tend to rely on retrieval; and (c) providing functional specifications substantially improves part completeness, kinematics, and physical operability. These results show that generating real-world structures requires deeper reasoning about functional affordances, mechanics, and designing and creating novel components. We expect LMBuild to provide a foundation for measuring progress and incentivizing research toward agents that generate buildable and functional structures.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出LMBuild，一个评估LLM智能体生成可建造且具功能性结构的基准，包含交互式环境、增强数据集和四维评估框架，通过对30个系统的评测揭示了功能性设计与物理可操作性的关键挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有对LLM智能体生成三维结构的评估主要关注几何质量，而忽视了物理可建造性与功能实现。生成优雅几何与生成能真正被建造并发挥预期功能的对象本质不同，因此需要新的评估基准。
AI.method: 将生成对象表示为包含部件分解、关节、材料和装配序列的组装结构；提供统一框架：(1)智能体可检索、创建和放置组件构建对象的交互式环境；(2)基于现有CAD数据集并用维基百科知识增强的精选基准；(3)涵盖结构稳固性、功能可供性、设计质量和物理实现的评估框架。
AI.result: 对30个系统的评测发现：(a)稳固性和对齐已不再是前沿闭源模型的主要瓶颈，而功能可供性和物理可操作性仍具挑战；(b)更强模型更善于创建新组件，较弱模型倾向依赖检索；(c)提供功能规格可显著提升部件完整性、运动学和物理可操作性。
AI.conclusion: 生成真实世界结构需要对功能可供性、力学以及设计与创造新组件进行更深层推理。LMBuild有望为衡量进展并激励智能体生成可建造、具功能性结构的研究提供基础。

title: Clean: Second-order LLM Training at Linear Memory Cost via Nyström Sketching
summary: Training large language models (LLMs) entails a fundamental trade-off: memory-efficient optimizers such as Adam discard cross-parameter curvature, whereas full-curvature methods such as SOAP can accelerate convergence at prohibitive memory costs. We introduce Clean, a memory-efficient and full-curvature optimizer designed to resolve this bottleneck. Clean leverages the randomized Nystrom method to accurately approximate the left and right preconditioners in SOAP, and to reduce the optimizer's memory complexity from quadratic to linear in terms of model dimensions. We subsequently reintegrate the off-subspace components to capture curvature information beyond the low-rank approximation, preserving rich curvature at minimal memory cost. We further propose Q-Clean, a low-precision variant that aggressively compresses optimizer states. Q-Clean reduces optimizer memory consumption by \textbf{over 50\%} compared to Muon when pre-training a LLaMA-1.3B architecture, all while maintaining strong and competitive predictive performance. Notably, Clean operates with a smaller optimizer-state footprint than standard AdamW while reaching AdamW's final performance \textbf{26\% faster} in wall-clock time. Furthermore, our methods uniquely enable the pre-training of a 13B-parameter model on a single 80GB GPU, providing a scalable, efficient, and accessible approach to large-scale model optimization.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Clean与Q-Clean两种优化器，利用随机Nyström方法将SOAP的全曲率预条件内存从二次降到线性，并保持曲率信息，实现更省内存、更快的LLM预训练。
AI.motivation: 大模型训练存在内存与收敛速度的根本权衡：Adam类优化器内存高效但丢弃跨参数曲率；SOAP等全曲率方法收敛快但内存开销巨大。作者希望同时获得内存高效与全曲率加速。
AI.method: Clean使用随机Nyström方法近似SOAP中的左右预条件器，将优化器内存复杂度从关于模型维度的二次降为线性；随后重新整合非子空间分量以捕捉低秩近似之外的曲率信息。进一步提出Q-Clean低精度变体，激进压缩优化器状态。
AI.result: 在LLaMA-1.3B预训练中，Q-Clean相比Muon减少超过50%的优化器内存，且预测性能仍有竞争力；Clean的优化器状态占用小于标准AdamW，却在墙钟时间上快26%达到AdamW的最终性能；方法还首次支持在单张80GB GPU上预训练13B参数模型。
AI.conclusion: Clean系列方法在保持甚至提升收敛性能的同时显著降低优化器内存，为大规模模型优化提供了可扩展、高效且易获取的方案。

title: Language-Conditioned Token and Reasoning Efficiency in Large Language Models: A Paired Cross-Lingual Study Protocol
comment: 32 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Prospective paired study protocol; no confirmatory model outcomes are reported
summary: Large language models incur language-dependent representation and inference costs, but existing comparisons often conflate input language, assigned observable-trace language, and answer realization. We specify a prospective paired study that separates these interfaces while holding the semantic item, checkpoint, and answer oracle fixed. The initial design instantiates 240 exactly scored items rendered from templates in English and seven non-English languages, three distinct-lineage open-weight checkpoints, three trace-token budgets, 22 input- and trace-language conditions, a fixed answer reserve, and a separately counted delimiter: 47,520 initial core runs before prospective sample-size selection. RQ1-RQ3 estimate input and trace effects by intention-to-treat with failure-inclusive terminal accounting and test answer realization by cloning a sealed prefix and runtime-native KV state into eight crossed branches. Pre-freeze independent language review, fixed-form ASCII selectors, and code/surface/solver agreement constrain the realization test. H1-H5 share one Holm family and a global simultaneous component band. A secondary randomized experiment compares one-long-attempt and complete K-short-attempt policies at equal trace allowance under frozen seeds and oracle-blind aggregation; it is a full-policy contrast because answer capacity differs. Outcomes include exact token spans, correctness, latency, runtime-exposed memory, and qualified same-host operating-system-reported energy over prespecified hardware rails. The protocol separates tokenizer expansion, observable-trace cost, and answer-realization cost without treating visible traces as internal cognition or operating-system estimates as physical cross-device energy. No confirmatory model outcome is reported; result fields remain disabled until the frozen evidence ledger passes independent verification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一项前瞻性配对研究方案，旨在分离大语言模型中"输入语言""可观测轨迹语言"与"答案实现"三类接口的语言依赖成本，并给出预注册的实验设计与分析计划。
AI.motivation: 现有关于大语言模型语言依赖表征与推理成本的比较，往往混淆了输入语言、被指定的可观测轨迹语言以及答案实现方式，导致无法区分成本究竟来自分词器扩展、可观测轨迹开销还是答案实现本身。因此需要一个能够分离这些接口、同时控制语义条目、检查点与答案判定的严格实验协议。
AI.method: 设计一项前瞻性配对研究：初始设计包含240个精确评分条目（由模板生成英文及七种非英语语言版本）、3个不同谱系的开源权重检查点、3种轨迹token预算、22种输入与轨迹语言条件、固定答案预留，以及单独计数的分隔符，共47,520次初始核心运行（尚待前瞻性样本量选择）。RQ1–RQ3采用意向性治疗分析（含失败在内的终态计账）估计输入与轨迹效应，并通过将密封前缀与运行时原生KV状态克隆到八个交叉分支来检验答案实现。通过预冻结的独立语言审查、固定形式ASCII选择器以及代码/表面/求解器一致性来约束实现检验。H1–H5共享一个Holm族与全局同时成分带。次要随机实验在相同轨迹额度、冻结种子与盲于判定器的聚合下，比较"一次长尝试"与"完整K次短尝试"策略。结果指标包括精确token跨度、正确性、延迟、运行时暴露内存，以及预设硬件轨道上经限定的同主机操作系统报告能耗。
AI.result: 本文为协议性研究，不报告任何确证性模型结果；结果字段在冻结的证据账本通过独立验证之前保持禁用状态。
AI.conclusion: 该协议能够分离分词器扩展、可观测轨迹成本与答案实现成本，同时避免将可见轨迹等同于内部认知、将操作系统估计等同于跨设备物理能耗。整体属于预注册、待验证的研究设计。

title: FTD-GNO: Memory-Efficient Graph Neural Operators through Functional Tensor Decomposition of the Kernel
summary: Graph Neural Operators (GNOs) provide flexible surrogate models for learning solution operators of partial differential equations (PDEs). However, standard GNOs typically parameterize the integral kernel with a monolithic neural network and evaluate kernel interactions over graph edges, leading to substantial computational and memory overhead at high resolutions or with large neighborhoods. To address these limitations, we propose Functional Tensor Decomposition Graph Neural Operator (FTD-GNO), a memory-efficient GNO framework that decouples the high-dimensional continuous integral kernel into low-dimensional mode-wise functions. By instantiating the kernel with classical tensor decomposition formats, including CP, Tensor-Train, and Tucker decompositions, FTD-GNO enables algebraic reconstruction of the integral operator without explicitly materializing full edge-wise kernel tensors. This factorized formulation reduces the memory footprint of kernel evaluation and aggregation while retaining the continuous operator-learning structure of GNOs. Theoretical complexity analysis shows that FTD-GNO substantially lowers parameter and activation-memory costs associated with high-dimensional kernel construction. Experiments show lower peak memory than the corresponding unfactorized graph-integral baselines, with shorter recorded training times. Fourier-graph experiments further demonstrate that FTD can improve the efficiency of a graph-integral layer within a hybrid operator and has good scalability.

AI.tldr: 提出FTD-GNO，将图神经算子的积分核用CP/TT/Tucker张量分解解耦为低维模态函数，避免显式构造全边核张量，显著降低内存与训练时间。
AI.motivation: 标准图神经算子(GNO)用单一神经网络参数化积分核并在图边上做核交互，在高分辨率或大邻域时计算与内存开销巨大，需要一种内存高效的算子学习框架。
AI.method: 提出功能张量分解图神经算子(FTD-GNO)：将高维连续积分核解耦为低维模态函数，用经典张量分解格式(CP、Tensor-Train、Tucker)实例化核，实现积分算子的代数重构，无需显式物化完整的逐边核张量；并给出理论复杂度分析。
AI.result: 理论复杂度分析表明FTD-GNO大幅降低高维核构建相关的参数与激活内存开销；实验显示峰值内存低于对应的未分解图积分基线，训练时间更短；Fourier-graph实验表明FTD能提升混合算子中图积分层的效率且可扩展性良好。
AI.conclusion: 因子化张量分解为GNO提供了内存高效且保留连续算子学习结构的方案，在降低内存与时间成本的同时具备良好可扩展性，适合高分辨率与大邻域场景。

title: EnvDreamer: Large-Scale Multimodal-to-Environment Generation for Embodied AI
summary: Large datasets and high capacity models have accelerated progress in vision and language. This work introduces a platform aimed at bringing comparable gains to embodied learning, world models, and robotics. We present EnvDreamer, a framework that uses large language and vision language models to generate Unreal Engine 5 environments for embodied AI and robot training. EnvDreamer enables sampling of large, diverse, interactive, customizable, and validator passed virtual environments for training and evaluation across navigation, interaction, and manipulation. We illustrate the platform with a large set of generated scenes and simple baselines. Policies trained on EnvDreamer generated environments, without explicit mapping or human task supervision, achieve competitive results on multiple embodied benchmarks spanning navigation, rearrangement, and manipulation. EnvDreamer also supports image-conditioned reconstruction for real-to-sim studies. Finally, we release EnvDreamer-20k, a dataset of 20,000 validator passed environments with task programs, scene graphs, trajectories, and metadata to support reproducible benchmarking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EnvDreamer，一个利用大语言与视觉语言模型生成 Unreal Engine 5 虚拟环境的平台，用于具身 AI 与机器人训练，并发布包含 2 万个环境的 EnvDreamer-20k 数据集。
AI.motivation: 大数据与高容量模型推动了视觉和语言领域的进展，但具身学习、世界模型与机器人领域尚未获得同等收益，缺乏大规模、多样、可交互且可验证的训练环境。
AI.method: 使用大语言模型和视觉语言模型自动生成 Unreal Engine 5 环境，支持采样大规模、多样、可交互、可定制且通过验证器的虚拟场景，覆盖导航、交互与操作任务；同时支持基于图像条件的真实到仿真重建。
AI.result: 在无显式建图与人工任务监督下，基于 EnvDreamer 生成环境训练的策略在导航、重排与操作等多个具身基准上取得有竞争力的结果；并发布含任务程序、场景图、轨迹与元数据的 EnvDreamer-20k 数据集。
AI.conclusion: EnvDreamer 为具身 AI 与机器人领域提供了可扩展的环境生成平台与可复现的基准数据集，推动该领域获得类似视觉与语言领域的规模化收益。

title: PaLoRA: Paced Low-Rank Adaptation for Continual Learning
summary: LoRA-based continual learning methods mitigate catastrophic forgetting through various mechanisms, yet nearly all complement these with small learning rates as a heuristic to restrict gradient scaling magnitude. Such fixed heuristics lack theoretical guidance on how the strength of this restriction should evolve as tasks accumulate. We reveal that even under directional constraints such as nullspace projection, finite-precision updates inevitably leak into the subspace of accumulated prior knowledge along multiple directions. While small learning rates attenuate such leakage, they cannot prevent the accumulated forgetting from intensifying as the effective rank of historical knowledge grows. We show that the optimal magnitude restriction should adaptively increase with this effective rank to balance stability and plasticity, i.e., preservation of previous knowledge and acquisition of new task information. Under an anisotropic leakage model, we derive a pacing law $s^*=\sqrt{R/c}$ that characterizes the optimal scaling of gradient steps, i.e., the magnitude restriction itself, where $R$ is the effective rank of past updates. Based on this insight, we propose PaLoRA, which compresses historical knowledge via adaptive SVD truncation, projects gradients onto the nullspace of prior tasks, and applies rank-aware adaptive pacing. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over prior methods, with particularly strong performance in long-horizon settings, achieving substantial gains of 4% accuracy on challenging 50-task ImageNet-A and ImageNet-R benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PaLoRA，通过理论推导出梯度步长最优约束应随历史知识有效秩自适应增长，将历史知识SVD压缩、零空间投影与秩感知自适应节奏相结合，在长时程持续学习任务上显著优于先前方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LoRA的持续学习方法普遍依赖固定的小学习率作为限制梯度缩放幅度的启发式手段，缺乏关于该限制强度应如何随任务累积而演化的理论指导，且无法阻止遗忘随历史知识有效秩增长而加剧。
AI.method: 作者揭示即使存在零空间投影等方向约束，有限精度更新仍会沿多个方向泄漏到历史知识的子空间。在各项异性泄漏模型下推导出最优缩放节奏律 s*=√(R/c)，其中 R 为历史更新的有效秩，据此提出PaLoRA：通过自适应SVD截断压缩历史知识、将梯度投影到先前任务的零空间，并施加秩感知的自适应节奏控制。
AI.result: 实验显示PaLoRA持续优于先前方法，在长时程场景中表现尤为突出，在具有挑战性的50任务ImageNet-A和ImageNet-R基准上取得约4%的准确率提升。
AI.conclusion: 最优梯度幅度限制应随历史知识有效秩自适应增大，以平衡稳定性与可塑性；PaLoRA验证了这一理论洞察的有效性。

title: MOIRA: Mass-Oriented Indexing with Ragged Attention for Long-Context Decoding
summary: Long-context decoding is limited by memory bandwidth, because every output token reads the KV cache of every layer. Sparse decoding reduces this cost by reading only part of the KV cache. We observe that the number of pages a query needs varies widely across KV heads, layers and steps. Fixed budgets are simple, but they are sized for demanding cases and tuned per workload; adaptive budgets follow this variation more flexibly, but existing designs pay for it with extra selection cost or training. At the kernel level, FlashAttention-3 (FA3) and FlashInfer are designed for rows of similar length: with page lists whose length differs per KV head, they either pad the lists (forfeiting much of the sparse saving), leave thread blocks unbalanced, or rely on a host-side plan that runs outside the CUDA graph. We propose MOIRA, a training-free sparse decode path in vLLM whose budget adapts per KV head and per layer. For every request, layer, KV head and step, a coverage rule keeps the smallest set of pages whose estimated attention mass reaches a fraction $γ$. A new kernel, self-planning attention, lets each thread block derive its own share of the work from the list lengths, so the whole decode step stays inside the CUDA graph. On an H200, at RULER's 128k context, MOIRA with $γ=0.99$ matches dense accuracy while reading about 30% of the pages and reduces the time per output token (TPOT) by 2.2-2.5$\times$ relative to dense FA3; with $γ=0.98$ it reduces TPOT by 2.7$\times$ and stays within the noise of dense. Under high serving load it raises throughput by up to 51%. These results suggest that a budget adapted per head and layer, paired with a kernel that keeps such budgets inside the CUDA graph, makes sparse decoding both flexible and fast.

AI.tldr: MOIRA提出一种免训练的稀疏解码路径，按KV头和层自适应预算，配合自规划注意力内核，在保持精度的同时大幅降低TPOT并提升吞吐。
AI.motivation: 长上下文解码受内存带宽限制，因为每个输出token都要读取所有层的KV缓存。稀疏解码可降低成本，但查询所需页数在不同KV头、层和步骤间差异很大：固定预算简单但需按负载调优，自适应预算更灵活却带来额外选择开销或训练成本。同时FA3和FlashInfer针对行长相近的场景设计，面对各KV头页列表长度不一的情况会出现填充浪费、线程块不平衡或依赖CUDA图之外的host端计划。
AI.method: 提出MOIRA，vLLM中的免训练稀疏解码路径，预算按KV头和层自适应。对每个请求、层、KV头和步骤，用覆盖规则保留估计注意力质量达到比例γ的最小页集合。设计新内核"自规划注意力"(self-planning attention)，让每个线程块根据列表长度自行推导其工作量份额，从而整个解码步骤保持在CUDA图内。
AI.result: 在H200上，RULER 128k上下文下，γ=0.99的MOIRA读取约30%的页即可匹配稠密精度，TPOT相比稠密FA3降低2.2-2.5倍；γ=0.98时TPOT降低2.7倍且处于稠密噪声范围内。高服务负载下吞吐提升最高51%。
AI.conclusion: 按头和层自适应预算，并配以能将此类预算保持在CUDA图内的内核，可使稀疏解码既灵活又快速。

title: Stochastic Adaptive Fourier Decomposition for Operator Learning
summary: Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs) offer an efficient paradigm for solving partial differential equations (PDEs). However, FNOs rely on a fixed Fourier basis and hard frequency truncation, which inherently limit their ability to model non-periodic, localized, and fine-scale solution structures. We propose the Stochastic Adaptive Fourier Decomposition Neural Operator (SAFDNO), a spectral neural operator that replaces predefined Fourier modes with an adaptive Takenaka-Malmquist (TM) orthonormal system derived from the theory of Stochastic Adaptive Fourier Decomposition (SAFD). Instead of performing an expensive greedy pole search in classical SAFD, SAFDNO amortizes stochastic pole selection through a neural pole predictor and constructs the adaptive TM system directly from latent features. The resulting operator performs learned filtering on coefficients of analytic branches in the Hardy space with respect to the input-adaptive TM system, preserving the global receptive field of spectral operators while providing a more flexible representation than using fixed spectral bases. Across nine PDE benchmark problems, SAFDNO achieves the best performance on all six regular-grid problems among strong neural operator baselines, with especially notable gains on Darcy, Burgers, and Navier-Stokes, where fixed Fourier modes are often less effective at modeling localized oscillations, sharp transitions, and multiscale structures. SAFDNO also exhibits stronger zero-shot super-resolution performance and shows less performance degradation when deployed on finer discretizations. These results suggest that the input-adaptive TM system provides a promising alternative to fixed spectral representations for neural operator learning.

AI.tldr: 提出 SAFDNO，用输入自适应的 Takenaka-Malmquist 正交系统替代固定傅里叶基，在多个 PDE 基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: FNO 依赖固定傅里叶基与硬频率截断，难以建模非周期、局部化和细尺度解结构。
AI.method: 用来自随机自适应傅里叶分解的 TM 正交系统替换预设傅里叶模态；以神经极点预测器摊销随机极点选择，避免经典 SAFD 的昂贵贪心搜索；从潜在特征直接构造自适应 TM 系统，并在 Hardy 空间解析分支系数上做学习式滤波。
AI.result: 在九个 PDE 基准中的六个规则网格问题上性能最优，Darcy、Burgers、Navier-Stokes 上提升尤为明显；零样本超分辨率更强，更细离散下性能退化更小。
AI.conclusion: 输入自适应的 TM 系统是替代固定谱表示用于神经算子学习的可行方向。

title: From Latent Space to Jacobian Space: Measuring, Evading, and Training Against Safety-Content Accessibility
summary: Output-only safety monitoring sees only the end of a model's computation, yet the model computes its answer before emitting it: what it is internally poised to say is safety-critical. Jacobian-space (J-space) readouts, linear maps from hidden states to the output vocabulary via the model's input-output Jacobian, have been proposed as a window on behaviorally accessible internal content, and a first safety protocol (JADR) showed that danger recognition is readable there. What remains unknown is how this accessible content relates to the latent-space safety geometry studied by representation engineering, and how safety training shapes it. We introduce two quantitative bridges: (i) a transport-amplification profile $A_\ell$, measuring how strongly a latent safety direction is carried toward output space by each layer's Jacobian, and (ii) a paired base-vs-tuned protocol that attributes accessibility to training provenance. Across four small model pairs (135M to 1.5B, three lens-fit seeds), tuned checkpoints concentrate recognition in upper-middle layers, and at 0.5B DPO installs refusal while J-space recognition drops to chance: training can widen the accessibility gap exactly where behavioral safety looks best. A deployment audit closes the loop: monitor-aware GCG-style suffixes suppress the prompt-side monitor at zero behavioral cost at every scale; only a learned monitor rung resists its own adaptive re-attack; the training-time defense fails its re-attack at every penalty weight; steering shows the amplification profile is descriptive, not causal; and continuous-prefix optimization fails where discrete search succeeds. Safety monitoring, training, and evaluation must operate on accessibility itself, not on outputs alone.

AI.tldr: 本文通过引入"传输放大剖面"A_ℓ与基座-微调配对协议，将仅输出安全监测读出的J空间内容与表征工程研究的潜空间安全几何联系起来，发现安全训练可能在行为安全最佳处扩大可及性缺口，且部署审计显示监测器可被低成本规避。
AI.motivation: 仅输出型安全监测只能看到模型计算的末端，而模型在输出前已内部计算出答案，其内部"准备说"的内容对安全至关重要。J空间读出（经输入-输出雅可比将隐状态映射到输出词表的线性映射）已被提议作为观察行为可及内部内容的窗口，且首个协议JADR证明危险识别在此可读。但尚不清楚这种可及内容与表征工程所研究的潜空间安全几何有何关系，以及安全训练如何塑造它。
AI.method: 提出两个定量桥梁：(i) 传输放大剖面A_ℓ，度量每一层雅可比将潜空间安全方向携带至输出空间的强度；(ii) 基座-微调配对协议，用于将可及性归因于训练来源。在四个小模型对（135M至1.5B，三个透镜拟合种子）上进行实验，并进行部署审计，包括监测器感知的GCG式后缀、学习型监测器阶梯、训练时防御的重攻击、引导实验以及连续前缀优化与离散搜索的对比。
AI.result: 在四个模型对上，微调检查点将识别集中于中上层；0.5B的DPO在安装拒绝行为的同时使J空间识别降至随机水平：训练恰在行为安全看起来最好处扩大了可及性缺口。部署审计显示，监测器感知的GCG式后缀在所有规模上以零行为代价抑制提示侧监测器；只有学习型监测器阶梯能抵抗其自适应重攻击；训练时防御在所有惩罚权重下重攻击均失败；引导表明放大剖面是描述性的而非因果性的；连续前缀优化失败而离散搜索成功。
AI.conclusion: 安全监测、训练与评估必须作用于可及性本身，而非仅作用于输出。安全训练可能在不提升（甚至削弱）内部可及识别的情况下改善行为安全，而现有监测防御易被自适应攻击规避，凸显了以可及性为中心的安全范式的必要性。

title: Optimizer Geometry Sets the Pace: Spectral Learning Dynamics in Matrix Factorization
summary: Recent successes of matrix- and curvature-based optimizers have renewed interest in how update geometry shapes learning. These methods normalize or precondition updates, changing how different components progress during training. In deep matrix factorization, the geometry that slows gradient descent (GD) favors low-rank solutions by delaying the emergence of small singular modes. This raises the question of what remains of that spectral bias when normalization or curvature correction weakens or removes the slowdown. We study how optimizer geometry and depth jointly govern this behavior through a common framework for singular mode dynamics. Under explicit balance and alignment assumptions, we derive birth, saturation, and decay laws for Euclidean GD, coordinate-wise updates of SignGD and an instantaneous Adam approximation, spectral updates of Muon and cumulative Shampoo, and a block curvature model of K-FAC. The resulting picture is not a simple ordering from stronger to weaker low-rank bias. To highlight, SignGD and ideal Muon eliminate the divergent birth barrier and drive unsupported modes to zero in finite time. Cumulative Shampoo initially retains GD's depth-dependent barrier, then accumulated gradients produce a catch-up phase while making previously active modes increasingly persistent. Undamped K-FAC cancels the factorization-induced slowdown while preserving the ordering of the target singular values, whereas positive damping introduces a spectral threshold below which the slow GD phase laws reappear. These results give normalization, accumulated state, damping, and depth a direct interpretation as controls determining when modes emerge, persist, and disappear during training.

AI.tldr: 本文通过统一的奇异模动力学框架，研究了优化器几何与深度如何共同决定深度矩阵分解中的谱偏置行为。
AI.motivation: 矩阵与曲率类优化器（如 SignGD、Adam、Muon、Shampoo、K-FAC）通过归一化或预条件改变更新几何，从而影响训练中不同分量的进度。在深度矩阵分解中，减缓梯度下降的几何会延迟小奇异模的出现，从而偏好低秩解。作者想探究当归一化或曲率校正削弱/消除这种减缓时，谱偏置还剩下什么。
AI.method: 在显式的平衡与对齐假设下，建立一个统一的奇异模动力学框架，推导各优化器的诞生、饱和与衰减规律。覆盖对象包括欧氏 GD、SignGD 与瞬时 Adam 近似的坐标式更新、Muon 与累积 Shampoo 的谱更新，以及 K-FAC 的块曲率模型。
AI.result: 结果并非从强到弱的简单低秩偏置排序。SignGD 与理想 Muon 消除了发散的诞生壁垒，并在有限时间内将无支撑模驱动至零；累积 Shampoo 最初保留 GD 的深度相关壁垒，随后累积梯度产生追及阶段，使先前活跃的模越来越持久；无阻尼 K-FAC 取消了分解诱导的减缓但保留目标奇异值的排序，而正阻尼引入谱阈值，低于该阈值时缓慢的 GD 阶段规律重新出现。
AI.conclusion: 归一化、累积状态、阻尼与深度可被直接解释为控制模在训练中何时出现、持续与消失的调节量。

title: Bidirectional Preference Synthesis: Learning Prompt-Conditioned Preferences from Boundary Failures
summary: Correction-based offline preference pipelines commonly treat model failures only as rejected responses under the original prompt. This supervision is incomplete for boundary failures: responses that violate the given instruction yet coherently satisfy a nearby intent or constraint setting. We introduce Bidirectional Preference Synthesis (BPS), a data-construction method for standard Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) that makes this missing prompt dependence explicit. For each validated boundary failure, BPS keeps the conventional forward pair under the original prompt and adds a reverse pair under a synthesized achieved prompt, so the same response is rejected where it is wrong and chosen where it is right, without changing the DPO objective, training a reward model, or requiring online sampling. On Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, BPS preserves original-side pairwise ranking while raising achieved-side ranking accuracy from 6.8% to 62.3% on held-out crossed anchors, with a similar shift under a Kimi-K2.6 cross-teacher probe. A blind human audit supports the intended reverse preference direction, and downstream evaluations show the clearest separation from Forward-DPO in multilingual multi-turn instruction following, with consistent capability-retention patterns on agentic, tool-use, and code checks.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出双向偏好合成（BPS），一种面向标准 DPO 的数据构建方法，通过为边界失败案例同时保留原始提示下的前向偏好对并新增合成达成提示下的反向偏好对，使同一回答在其错误处被拒绝、在其正确处被选择，从而显式刻画缺失的提示依赖性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于纠正的离线偏好流程通常只把模型失败当作原始提示下的被拒回答，这种监督对"边界失败"并不完整——即那些违反给定指令却连贯地满足了相近意图或约束设定的回答。作者希望在不改变 DPO 目标、不训练奖励模型、也不需要在线采样的前提下，补上这部分缺失的提示依赖监督。
AI.method: BPS 针对每一个经验证的边界失败，保留原始提示下的常规前向偏好对，同时新增一个在合成"达成提示"下的反向偏好对，使同一回答在被违反的语境中被拒、在契合的语境中被选。该方法作为数据构建方法，直接适用于标准 DPO，无需改动目标函数、不训练奖励模型、不做在线采样。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 上，BPS 保持了原始侧的成对排序能力，同时将留存的交叉锚点上的达成侧排序准确率从 6.8% 提升到 62.3%；在 Kimi-K2.6 跨教师探针下也出现类似变化。盲人人工审核支持了预期的反向偏好方向；下游评测中，在多语言多轮指令遵循任务上其与 Forward-DPO 的区分最为明显，并在智能体、工具使用和代码检查上呈现一致的能力保留模式。
AI.conclusion: BPS 通过同时编码同一回答在原始提示与合成达成提示下的相反偏好，显式补全了边界失败所缺失的提示依赖监督，在保持原有排序能力的同时显著提升达成侧排序准确率，并在多项下游任务上展现出与 Forward-DPO 的清晰区分及稳定的能力保留。

title: A Hand-Checkable Proof That Two Hidden ReLU Layers Compute the Maximum of Six Numbers
summary: Exactly computing the maximum function is a standard test case for studying depth in ReLU networks. Two hidden layers are known to suffice for up to twelve inputs through computer-assisted constructions. For six real inputs, we give an explicit hexagon identity whose local structure yields a self-contained analytical proof of this depth bound. The identity was found by computer-assisted search; we prove it through explicit cancellations that can be checked entirely by hand, without executing a verification program. The identity also yields an explicit network with hidden widths $17$ and $41$, zero biases, and rational weights.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对六个实数输入的max函数，给出显式的"六边形恒等式"，用纯手工可验证的解析证明说明两层隐藏层足以精确计算max函数，并构造出宽度为17和41、无偏置、有理权重的显式神经网络。
AI.motivation: 精确计算max函数是研究ReLU网络深度的标准测试任务。此前已知对最多十二个输入，两层隐藏层足够，但这些结论依赖计算机辅助构造与验证程序，缺乏可手工核验的解析证明。论文希望在六个实数输入这一情形下，给出自包含、可完全手算验证的解析证明。
AI.method: 通过计算机辅助搜索发现一个"六边形恒等式"，并利用显式抵消（cancellation）给出解析证明，证明过程完全可手工检查、无需运行验证程序；该恒等式的局部结构直接导出对深度界的两层证明，并据此构造出显式网络。
AI.result: 证明了对六个实数输入，两层隐藏层即可精确计算max函数；该恒等式给出了隐藏层宽度分别为17和41、偏置为零、权重为有理数的显式网络。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为max函数的深度下界提供了首个可完全手工验证的解析证明（六输入情形），并将计算机辅助发现与可人工核验的证明相结合，给出了具体的显式网络参数。

title: Suppressing Pressure, Amplifying Evidence: Self-Guided Attention Steering to Mitigate Sycophancy and Stubbornness
summary: Reliable language models should resist unsupported user pressure while effectively using objective contextual information. However, models may exhibit sycophancy by yielding to unsupported user pressure or contextual stubbornness by failing to update their answers when relevant contextual information warrants revision. Evaluating interventions for these failures separately can obscure whether mitigating one failure exacerbates the other. To assess this trade-off, we introduce CoPE-Bench with six conditions per question: a neutral baseline, correct or incorrect user pressure, contextual information consistent with or conflicting with the neutral answer, and a joint condition combining incorrect claims with conflicting contextual information. To regulate the influence of user pressure and contextual information, we propose SPAE (Suppressing Pressure, Amplifying Evidence), a training-free framework that uses the model's own judgments to identify relevant tokens, suppressing user pressure and amplifying contextual information through token-level attention steering. On average across five backbones, SPAE reduces pressure following by 18.8 percentage points and increases joint-condition updating by 5.5 percentage points relative to the strongest baseline in the main comparison. In two-turn dialogue, it improves joint-condition updating by an average of 13.2 percentage points over the strongest prompting baseline. The source data and codes can be found at https://github.com/03Grant/sycophancy-and-stubbornness.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CoPE-Bench 基准与免训练框架 SPAE，通过 token 级注意力调控同时缓解模型的迎合性与语境固执。
AI.motivation: 语言模型应能抵抗无依据的用户压力，同时有效利用客观语境信息。但模型可能表现出迎合性（屈服于无依据的用户压力）或语境固执性（在相关语境信息要求修正时仍不更新答案）。单独评估这两种失败的干预措施会掩盖一个失败被缓解是否加剧另一失败的问题。
AI.method: 提出 CoPE-Bench，每道题含六种条件：中性基线、正确或错误的用户压力、与中性答案一致或冲突的语境信息、以及结合错误主张与冲突语境的联合条件。提出 SPAE（Suppressing Pressure, Amplifying Evidence）免训练框架，利用模型自身判断识别相关 token，通过 token 级注意力调控抑制用户压力并放大语境信息。
AI.result: 在五个主干模型上平均而言，相比主对比中最强基线，SPAE 将顺从压力降低 18.8 个百分点，将联合条件更新提高 5.5 个百分点。在两轮对话中，相比最强提示基线，联合条件更新平均提高 13.2 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: SPAE 能在不加剧迎合性与语境固执性权衡的前提下，同时缓解两类失败，且无需训练即可泛化到多个主干模型。数据与代码已开源。

title: Cross-Trait Transfer in Subliminal Learning
comment: 38 pages, including references and appendices. Code: https://github.com/PeterXingyuZhao/cross-trait-transfer
summary: Subliminal learning is a phenomenon where a student language model acquires a teacher model's behavioral traits by training on semantically unrelated outputs. It is a subtle statistical phenomenon as trait transmission relies on weak statistical patterns in the generated data. To understand trait transmission between teacher-student pairs, we study cross-trait transfer: how data generated under one teacher trait changes the student's preferences of other traits. To this end, we introduce a directed trait-transfer matrix that quantifies these effects using log-probability gains for student answers. We find that the trait-transfer matrix reveals clusters of related traits, with students sometimes developing preferences for traits similar, but not identical, to the teacher's trait. Such cross-trait structure can be partially captured by output distribution metrics and representation-based metrics. Further, we analyze trait development and interaction: learning dynamics shows a progression from broad shared shifts toward more trait-specific transfer, and multi-trait experiments suggest that opposed traits can enhance such differentiation. Together, our findings reveal salient statistical structures over trait transfer and competition, thus providing a broader view of how hidden preferences are transmitted in subliminal learning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究潜意识学习中的跨特质迁移现象，提出有向特质迁移矩阵来量化学生模型在教师某一特质数据训练下对其他特质的偏好变化，揭示迁移矩阵中的特质聚类结构、学习动态及多特质竞争效应。
AI.motivation: 潜意识学习中学生模型能通过语义无关的输出习得教师的行为特质，但这种特质传递依赖微弱统计模式，机制尚不清晰，尤其缺乏对"跨特质迁移"（某一教师特质如何影响学生对其他特质的偏好）的系统理解。
AI.method: 引入有向特质迁移矩阵，用学生回答的对数概率增益量化特质间传递效应；并结合输出分布度量和基于表征的度量对跨特质结构进行刻画；同时分析学习动态与多特质交互实验。
AI.result: 迁移矩阵呈现相关特质的聚类结构，学生有时会发展出与教师特质相似但不完全相同的偏好；跨特质结构可被输出分布度量与表征度量部分捕捉；学习动态显示从广泛共享偏移逐步过渡到特质特异性迁移；对立特质的多特质实验可增强这种分化。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了特质迁移与竞争中的显著统计结构，为理解潜意识学习中隐藏偏好的传递提供了更全面的视角。

title: ShadowMiner v1 - An Experience Report on Implementing and Measuring a Problem-and-Hypothesis Discovery Engine
summary: ShadowMiner v1 is a system that automatically discovers research problems and generates hypotheses from AI papers. It is a nine-stage pipeline. It structures documents into a knowledge graph and finds graph gaps in it - structural blind spots in research. These graph gaps are included in the LLM generation prompt. Each generated hypothesis is then verified by checking whether it is already covered by existing research, scoring its quality, and checking that the facts it relies on are accurately drawn from its sources. This report does not propose a new generation or evaluation technique. It describes our experience of implementing and applying ideas from prior work, and measuring whether each one actually contributed.

AI.tldr: ShadowMiner v1 是一个从 AI 论文中自动发现研究问题并生成假设的系统，采用九阶段流水线，将文档组织为知识图谱并识别其中的"图谱缺口"，再通过 LLM 生成假设并加以验证。
AI.motivation: 从大量 AI 论文中自动发现值得研究的问题并生成假设，帮助研究者找到研究中的结构性盲点。
AI.method: 九阶段流水线：将文档结构化为知识图谱，在图中寻找"图谱缺口"（研究中的结构性盲点），将缺口作为提示输入 LLM 以生成假设；随后对每个假设进行验证，包括检查是否已被现有研究覆盖、评估其质量、核实其依赖事实是否准确来源于原始文献。
AI.result: 报告并未提出新的生成或评估技术，而是记录了对既有工作进行实现与应用的经验，并衡量各环节是否真正产生了贡献。
AI.conclusion: 该工作属于经验性复现与效果度量研究，重点在于验证 ShadowMiner v1 各阶段组件的实际贡献，而非提出新方法。

title: Adaptive Bregman Alternating Projections for Feasible Gromov-Wasserstein Learning
summary: The Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) problem compares structured distributions without requiring a shared feature space or known correspondences, but its nonconvex objective and coupled marginal constraints make computation challenging. Bregman alternating projected gradient (BAPG) uses inexpensive alternating row and column updates, yet its fixed-penalty relaxation leaves a persistent feasibility gap. We propose Adaptive KL-BAPG (A-KL-BAPG), which combines a finite fixed-penalty burn-in with a guarded increasing-penalty phase. At each tail iteration, the method reuses BAPG's alternating updates and backtracks a delayed-power step until a Sinkhorn-inspired projective-diameter safeguard is satisfied. We prove finite termination of the backtracking at each iteration and show that the feasibility gap vanishes asymptotically. We further establish a best-iterate $O(1/\log N)$ bound for the weighted squared corrected residual and, under a support regularity condition, the existence of a stationary accumulation point for the original GW problem. This distinguishes A-KL-BAPG from fixed-penalty BAPG, whose stationarity guarantees are given for the relaxed problem. Experiments show that A-KL-BAPG achieves a favorable balance of accuracy, objective value, feasibility, and stationarity relative to BAPG variants, projection-based methods, and task-specific baselines. For synthetic and real graph alignment problems, it closely matches the accuracy and objective value of fixed-penalty KL-BAPG while reducing the marginal feasibility gap by 62-99% and the projected stationarity residual by 28-98%. Heterogeneous domain adaptation experiments show a similar pattern: A-KL-BAPG maintains comparable target accuracy and objective values while achieving better feasibility and stationarity than fixed-penalty KL-BAPG.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应KL-BAPG（A-KL-BAPG）算法，通过有限固定惩罚预热加带保护的增长惩罚阶段，解决Gromov-Wasserstein问题的可行性差距，并给出理论保证与实验验证。
AI.motivation: Gromov-Wasserstein问题用于比较结构化分布，无需共享特征空间或已知对应关系，但其非凸目标和耦合边际约束使计算困难。Bregman交替投影梯度（BAPG）虽更新廉价，但固定惩罚松弛导致持续存在的可行性差距。
AI.method: A-KL-BAPG结合有限固定惩罚预热阶段与带保护的增长惩罚阶段。尾部迭代中复用BAPG交替更新，并回溯延迟幂步长，直到满足受Sinkhorn启发的投影直径保护条件。证明了每次迭代回溯的有限终止性，并证明可行性差距渐近消失。
AI.result: 建立了加权平方校正残差的最佳迭代O(1/log N)界，并在支撑正则条件下证明原GW问题存在平稳聚点，使A-KL-BAPG区别于仅对松弛问题给出平稳性保证的固定惩罚BAPG。实验中，A-KL-BAPG在准确性、目标值、可行性和平稳性之间取得良好平衡；在图对齐任务中匹配固定惩罚KL-BAPG的精度与目标值，同时将边际可行性差距降低62-99%、投影平稳残差降低28-98%；异构域适应实验呈现类似模式。
AI.conclusion: A-KL-BAPG通过自适应增长惩罚与投影保护机制，有效消除固定惩罚方法的可行性差距，并为原GW问题提供平稳性理论保证，在多种任务上优于BAPG变体、投影类方法及特定任务基线。

title: Functionally Equivalent or Not? Graph-Grounded Differential Surrogate Execution for Code Equivalence
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables, accepted by NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Verifiable Coding
summary: Determining whether two programs are functionally equivalent is central to code modernization, patch validation, refactoring, and code-generation evaluation. Yet the usual signals are incomplete: tests cover only finite inputs, textual similarity confuses implementation with behavior, and unconstrained LLM judgments are difficult to audit. Direct execution is often impossible when a program depends on an obsolete, licensed, unavailable, or unsafe environment. We introduce FEAgent, a selective equivalence assessor agent that combines typed program-graph evidence with differential surrogate execution. FEAgent first aligns public interfaces and behaviorally relevant graph anchors, then issues bounded queries over call-flow, control-flow, data-flow, type, import, and effect relations. Next, a branch-aware generator agent proposes discriminating inputs, and two blinded LLM surrogates independently predict source and target observables. Every claim and predicted divergence is recorded in an evidence ledger. A deterministic reconciler then returns EQUIVALENT, INEQUIVALENT, or UNCLEAR rather than forcing a verdict when paths are uncovered or evidence conflicts. We evaluate FEAgent on function-level equivalence and repository-level bug patches, where the existing oracle is a benchmark label or a passing test suite. Every disagreement with that oracle is adjudicated by direct execution, revealing errors in benchmark labels and behavioral divergences missed by unit-test-only scoring. On EquiBench, execution confirms FEAgent's disagreements with published labels on 216 of 1,200 evaluated pairs (18.0%); on SWE-bench Verified, 94 of 331 test-passing agent patches (28.4%) diverge from the reference patch. FEAgent thus serves as an audit layer between testing and formal verification, keeping its evidence reviewable and its uncertainty explicit without claiming a proof of equivalence.

AI.tldr: FEAgent是一个"选择性等价评估智能体"，结合类型化程序图证据与差分代理执行，输出EQUIVALENT/INEQUIVALENT/UNCLEAR三种判定，并保留可审计的证据账本，用于代码现代化与补丁验证中的程序功能等价判断。
AI.motivation: 判断两个程序是否功能等价对代码现代化、补丁验证、重构和代码生成评估至关重要。但现有信号不完整：测试只能覆盖有限输入，文本相似度混淆实现与行为，无约束的LLM判断难以审计；而当程序依赖过时、受限、不可得或不安全的环境时，直接执行往往不可行。
AI.method: FEAgent先对齐公共接口和行为相关的图锚点，再针对调用流、控制流、数据流、类型、导入和效应关系发出有界查询；由分支感知的生成器智能体提出有区分力的输入，两个盲化的LLM代理独立预测源与目标的观测量；所有论断与预测分歧记入证据账本；最后由确定性协调器返回EQUIVALENT、INEQUIVALENT或UNCLEAR，在路径未覆盖或证据冲突时不强行给出结论。
AI.result: 在函数级等价与仓库级缺陷补丁上评估：EquiBench中，直接执行确认FEAgent与已发表标签的分歧在1200对中有216对（18.0%）；SWE-bench Verified中，331个通过测试的智能体补丁中有94个（28.4%）与参考补丁存在行为分歧，揭示了基准标签错误与仅靠单元测试评分所遗漏的行为差异。
AI.conclusion: FEAgent可作为测试与形式化验证之间的审计层，其证据可复核、不确定性显式表达，且不宣称证明了等价性。

title: Self-Reflection Fine-Tuning: Enhancing Agent Security against Prompt Injection Attacks from Failure Experience
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in tool-augmented environments, but their reliance on external inputs makes them highly vulnerable to prompt injection attacks that can hijack task objectives. Existing safety alignment methods rely on static expert trajectories or preference optimization, limiting their ability to generalize to adaptive attack patterns. In this work, we propose Self-Reflection Fine-Tuning (SRFT), a training framework that enables agents to improve robustness by learning from their own failure experiences under adversarial conditions. Instead of passively imitating expert behaviors, SRFT exposes the agent to compromised trajectories constructed via injected attacks, and leverages an expert model to generate structured self-reflection reasoning that contrasts unsafe and optimal actions. This reflective supervision teaches the agent to identify malicious instructions, reason about their consequences, and maintain alignment with the original user intent. We instantiate this framework in SR-Agent, built on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B, and evaluate it on both static and adaptive prompt injection benchmarks. Experimental results show that SRFT substantially reduces attack success rates while preserving task performance, and demonstrates strong generalization under adaptive attacks. These findings suggest that learning from failure via self-reflection is a promising direction for building robust and secure LLM agents. Our code is released at https://github.com/Eden-Wang1710/srft-repo.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自反思微调（SRFT）框架，让LLM智能体从自身在对抗攻击下的失败经验中学习，从而提升对提示注入攻击的鲁棒性，并实例化为SR-Agent，在静态与自适应攻击基准上显著降低攻击成功率且保持任务性能。
AI.motivation: 工具增强环境中的LLM智能体因依赖外部输入而极易遭受提示注入攻击，攻击者可通过注入恶意指令劫持任务目标。现有安全对齐方法依赖静态专家轨迹或偏好优化，难以泛化到自适应攻击模式，因此需要一种能从失败经验中持续学习的鲁棒性提升方法。
AI.method: 提出自反思微调（SRFT）训练框架：不再被动模仿专家行为，而是让智能体暴露于通过注入攻击构造的被污染轨迹中；利用专家模型生成结构化自反思推理，对比不安全动作与最优动作，从而教会智能体识别恶意指令、推理其后果并保持与原始用户意图对齐。基于Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct和Qwen3-8B实例化为SR-Agent。
AI.result: 在静态与自适应提示注入基准上评估，SRFT大幅降低攻击成功率，同时保持任务性能，并在自适应攻击下展现出强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过自反思从失败中学习，是构建鲁棒且安全的LLM智能体的一个有前景的方向。代码已开源于 https://github.com/Eden-Wang1710/srft-repo。

title: Do Tool Calls Execute as Intended? Measuring and Repairing Intent-Execution Correspondence in LLM Agents
summary:
Agents built on large language models (LLMs) build and run software through tool calls. A call reaches its program through several hops, and any hop can change the call without notice. When the changed call fails, the agent retries a correct call, which costs users time and money. Benchmarks and failure analyses do not see the change, because they read the call and its result but not what a hop received. We define intent-execution correspondence (IEC) as the property that the executed action matches the action the emitted call denotes under the tool contract. Our protocol observes what each hop received without executing the call, and names the first hop that changed it by the receiver's own parser. IntAct then delivers the call in a form that this hop cannot alter, or refuses the call. We build IEC-Bench from the changes observed in real-world use, with chains of dependent calls under the execution paths of 4 widely-used harnesses.
  In 47,828 shell calls within production sessions, Claude Code's Bash tool changes 12.0% of the calls that carry code, escape sequences, or long text. For 80.7% of the calls whose backslashes are changed, the wrong action runs without any reported error. All 10 measured harnesses change a call. Trajectory-based judgment attributes 95.1% of the production failures to the LLM, although the path caused more than half of them. On IEC-Bench, the path raises the token cost per passed task 2.4 times (up to 12.3 times). A hop that changes a call also hides the changes after it, so 55.1% of the failures on one path appear only after its first hop is repaired. IntAct, deployed in a commercial product, recovers 79.2% of the failures with a changed call. Harnesses should therefore be designed and tested hop-by-hop to ensure a correct call executes as intended or is refused.

AI.tldr: 论文定义了"意图-执行对应"（IEC）属性，揭示LLM智能体工具调用在传输链路中会被中间环节静默篡改，提出IntAct协议与IEC-Bench基准来检测并修复此类故障。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的智能体通过工具调用构建和运行软件，调用会经过多个"跳"（hop）到达程序，任何一跳都可能无声地改变调用内容。当被改变的调用失败时，智能体会重试正确调用，浪费用户时间和金钱。现有基准和失败分析只读取调用及其结果，而不看各跳实际收到了什么，因此无法发现这种改变。
AI.method: 定义"意图-执行对应"（IEC）：在工具契约下，被执行的动作需与发出的调用所表示的动作一致。提出协议：在不执行调用的前提下观测每一跳收到了什么，并由接收方自己的解析器命名第一个改变调用的跳。IntAct则要么以该跳无法篡改的形式投递调用，要么拒绝该调用。同时基于真实使用中观测到的改变构建IEC-Bench，包含在4种广泛使用harness执行路径下的依赖调用链。
AI.result: 在生产会话的47,828次shell调用中，Claude Code的Bash工具改变了12.0%携带代码、转义序列或长文本的调用；对反斜杠被改变的调用，80.7%会在无任何报错的情况下执行错误动作。全部10种被测harness都会改变调用。基于轨迹的判断将95.1%的生产故障归因于LLM，但其中超过一半实为路径所致。在IEC-Bench上，路径使每个通过任务的token成本上升2.4倍（最高12.3倍）。改变调用的跳还会掩盖其后的改变，因此某路径上55.1%的故障只有在修复第一跳后才显现。IntAct在商业产品中部署，可恢复79.2%的被改变调用故障。
AI.conclusion: harness应当按跳（hop-by-hop）进行设计与测试，以确保正确的调用按意图执行或被拒绝。

title: Rethinking Self-Distillation for Multi-Teacher Capability Merging
summary: Combining capabilities of multiple expert models trained starting from the same base checkpoint has become increasingly common in frontier language-model post-training. Recent trends suggest that multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) outperforms conventional off-policy methods. However, despite the higher inference and environment interaction costs incurred by MOPD, we find that much of its reported accuracy gain is due to certain training design choices and hyperparameter optimization, rather than the algorithm itself. We conduct a controlled self-distillation study across two multi-teacher settings, four models, and eleven benchmarks, comparing off-policy methods, namely supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and soft-label distillation, to hybrid teacher-prefix distillation and MOPD. We found that all four methods achieve \textit{nearly identical} accuracy. However, MOPD uses $14.8$--$23.1\times$ SFT's training GPU-hours. We also revisit four recently published comparisons between on-policy and off-policy distillation and find that the reported on-policy gains shrink substantially when SFT baselines are trained on rejection-sampled teacher trajectories and use independently tuned hyperparameters. As a training-free alternative, we also find that simple weight-merging methods can recover expert capabilities with minutes of CPU merging time, although their accuracy degrades as model size decreases and task interference increases. Overall, our results question recent gains reported due to MOPD and suggest careful tuning of more efficient off-policy baselines as a viable alternative.

AI.tldr: 多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）报告的精度优势主要来自训练设计与超参调优，而非算法本身。控制实验显示其与离策略方法精度几乎相同，但训练GPU耗时高出14.8–23.1倍。
AI.motivation: 在前沿语言模型后训练中，整合多个专家模型能力日益常见，且近期趋势认为多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）优于传统离策略方法。然而MOPD推理与环境交互成本更高，作者因此质疑其精度收益是否真正源于算法。
AI.method: 开展受控自蒸馏研究，覆盖两种多教师设置、四个模型、十一个基准，对比四种方法：离策略的监督微调（SFT）与软标签蒸馏，以及混合教师前缀蒸馏与MOPD。同时复现四篇已发表的在线/离策略蒸馏对比，并将SFT基线改用拒采样的教师轨迹与独立调优的超参。另测试免训练的权重合并作为替代方案。
AI.result: 四种方法精度几乎相同，但MOPD训练GPU耗时是SFT的14.8–23.1倍。复现实验发现，当SFT基线使用拒采样教师轨迹并独立调参后，所报告的在线策略增益大幅缩小。权重合并可在数分钟CPU时间内恢复专家能力，但随模型规模减小与任务干扰增加，精度会下降。
AI.conclusion: 结果质疑近期MOPD报告的增益，表明通过精心调优更高效的离策略基线是可行的替代方案。

title: AgentPersonaBench: Benchmarking Persona-Driven User Simulation
summary: We introduce AgentPersonaBench (APB), a benchmark evaluating whether persona conditioning faithfully steers downstream agent behavior. While language models are increasingly deployed for persona-driven user simulation, existing benchmarks primarily evaluate conversational styling or self-reports rather than authentic behavioral fidelity. APB evaluates latent persona adherence one trait at a time, embedding each target trait within a complete synthetic profile without explicitly naming the trait or disclosing the test. Ground-truth adherence is verified strictly from observable actions across four interaction surfaces of increasing realism: survey, chat, web (interactive web environments), and app (desktop software environments). APB comprises 2,460 tasks spanning 867 traits, verified through automated audits and expert review. Our evaluation of 20 frontier model arms demonstrates that high-fidelity user simulation is already attainable: leading models achieve up to 84.7% full-pass adherence under unprompted conditions. At the same time, APB identifies clear behavioral boundaries: adherence drops across interaction modalities (only 37.9-64.3% pass all four surfaces), multi-attribute demands degrade retention, and competing model families exhibit pronounced behavioral divergence.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 AgentPersonaBench (APB) 基准，用于评估人格条件是否能忠实驱动智能体的下游行为。基准包含 2,460 个任务、867 种特质，覆盖问卷、聊天、网页和桌面应用四类交互场景。评估 20 个前沿模型显示，领先模型在无提示条件下可达 84.7% 完全通过率，但跨交互模态时下降至 37.9-64.3%，多属性需求会降低保持度，不同模型家族表现出显著行为差异。
AI.motivation: 现有基准主要评估对话风格或自我报告，而非真实的行为保真度，无法判断人格条件是否真正驱动下游智能体行为。
AI.method: APB 一次评估一种潜在人格特质，将其嵌入完整合成画像中而不显式命名该特质或透露测试内容；通过四类递进真实度的交互界面（问卷、聊天、网页、应用）的可观察动作严格验证真值依从性；任务经自动审计与专家复核。
AI.result: 评估 20 个前沿模型组件，领先模型在无提示条件下完全通过依从率最高达 84.7%；跨四种交互界面全部通过率仅 37.9-64.3%；多属性需求会削弱特质保持；不同模型家族间行为差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 高保真用户模拟已可实现，但 APB 揭示了明确的行为边界：跨模态依从性下降、多属性场景保持退化、模型家族行为分化，说明人格条件驱动下游行为仍存在系统性局限。

title: Integrated Imputation-Classification for Supervised Learning with Missing Data
summary: We study supervised classification problems with missing feature values. Existing approaches often decouple imputation from classification, producing imputations that may be plausible but uninformative for prediction. Instead, we propose the Integrated Imputation and Classification Network (IICN), which jointly trains an imputer and an ${(n{+}1)}$-classdiscriminator adversarially with a single class supervised classification objective, where the discriminator learns to distinguish among the $n$ true classes and an additional ``imputed" class. We prove that at the global optimum, the imputer and discriminator together implement marginalization over missing coordinates and yield a Bayes-optimal classifier. We evaluate IICN on FashionMNIST, CIFAR-10, and tabular datasets with naturally occurring missingness. IICN outperforms classical impute-then-classify pipelines and recent generative baselines, showing strong robustness and accuracy in challenging settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IICN，将缺失值填补与分类联合训练，并通过对抗式判别器实现贝叶斯最优分类。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常将缺失值填补与分类解耦，导致填补结果虽然合理但对预测未必有信息量，影响分类性能。
AI.method: 提出Integrated Imputation and Classification Network（IICN），联合训练填补器和一个(n+1)类判别器，以单一类别监督分类目标进行对抗训练，判别器需区分n个真实类别和一个附加的“填补”类别。
AI.result: 作者证明在全局最优时，填补器与判别器共同实现缺失坐标边缘化，并得到贝叶斯最优分类器；在FashionMNIST、CIFAR-10及自然缺失的表格数据集上，IICN优于经典“先填补后分类”流程和近期生成式基线，表现出较强的鲁棒性和准确率。
AI.conclusion: IICN通过联合建模填补与分类，并在理论上达到贝叶斯最优，在多个含缺失数据任务上取得优于现有方法的性能，说明面向预测的联合填补策略更有效。

title: TrustMed-RL: Long-Horizon Reinforcement Learning for Evidence-Grounded Clinical Diagnosis
summary: Medical language models can produce correct diagnoses despite incomplete investigations and unsupported reasoning. To support long-horizon, evidence-grounded diagnosis, we introduce \textbf{TrustMed-RL}. Built from PubMed rare-disease cases and over 24,000 manually annotated image panels, it integrates interviews, examinations, testing, specialist consultation, and literature search through state-dependent actions. Our 8B vision--language policy, trained with clinically adapted GiGPO and coverage-adjusted diagnostic rewards, achieves 37.1\% diagnostic accuracy on 2,500 evaluation cases, outperforming all evaluated open-weight baselines and improving over supervised fine-tuning by 12.4 percentage points.. When success additionally requires acquiring at least 50\% of supporting test evidence, TrustMed-RL achieves 32.5\%, exceeding GPT-4o by 6.8 percentage points. Furthermore, it surpasses all evaluated baselines on MTMedDialog and multiple larger 27--32B models on AgentClinic. In physician review of 200 diagnostically accepted test-set trajectories, 83.0\% receive evidential-grounding scores of 4--5 out of 5. Physicians' assessments suggest that these diagnostic trajectories are trustworthy and aligned with human diagnostic reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 TrustMed-RL，一个基于 PubMed 罕见病病例和超 2.4 万张人工标注图像面板构建的循证长程诊断系统，通过状态依赖动作整合问诊、检查、检验、专家会诊与文献检索，在 2500 例评估中达到 37.1% 诊断准确率，并在多项基准上超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 医学语言模型即使调查不完整、推理缺乏依据，也可能给出正确诊断；为支持长程、循证诊断，需要引入证据落地机制。
AI.method: 基于 PubMed 罕见病病例与 24,000+ 人工标注图像面板构建 TrustMed-RL；通过状态依赖动作整合问诊、体格检查、检验、专科会诊和文献检索；训练 8B 视觉-语言策略，采用临床适配的 GiGPO 与覆盖率调整的诊断奖励。
AI.result: 在 2500 例评估中诊断准确率 37.1%，超越所有评估的开源权重基线，较监督微调提升 12.4 个百分点；在需获取至少 50% 支持性检验证据时达 32.5%，超 GPT-4o 6.8 个百分点；在 MTMedDialog 及 AgentClinic 上超越所有评估基线及多个 27–32B 模型；200 例医生评审中 83.0% 的轨迹获得 4–5/5 的证据落地评分。
AI.conclusion: 医生评估表明该系统的诊断轨迹可信，并与人类诊断推理相一致。

title: Do RUL explanations hold up? Faithfulness and stability of attributions on C-MAPSS
summary: Deep remaining-useful-life (RUL) models on NASA C-MAPSS are now routine, and so are heatmaps that colour sensors and timesteps. A heatmap that looks mechanical is not the same as an explanation an engineer can act on. We train three standard architectures - a 1D CNN, an LSTM, and a small Transformer encoder - on the official FD001 and FD003 splits with the piecewise RUL cap of 125 cycles and the official PHM08 asymmetric score. We then attach three attribution maps (Integrated Gradients, occlusion, last-layer attention) and evaluate them with the checks the XAI-for-PdM literature still under-reports: deletion/insertion faithfulness, Spearman stability under sensor-scale noise, agreement across training seeds, and cosine consistency inside RUL bins. Prediction error is a prerequisite, not the claim. The headline is which explanation method moves the RUL output when its top cells are removed, and which map survives a 5% input perturbation. Integrated Gradients and occlusion are similarly faithful on the LSTM; Transformer attention is cheap and temporally smooth but weakly faithful. All three maps are almost unchanged under 5% input noise, yet IG/occlusion agree only moderately across two LSTM seeds - stability to sensor jitter is not the same as stability to retraining. A secondary tabular check on the AI4I 2020 failure dataset shows the same deletion pattern for tree importances. We recommend occlusion or IG for any C-MAPSS-style report that will be read by a maintenance engineer, and we treat raw attention weights as a visualisation only.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统比较了1D CNN、LSTM与小型Transformer在C-MAPSS上的RUL预测，并用忠实性、噪声稳定性、跨种子一致性与区间内一致性四类检验评估Integrated Gradients、occlusion与注意力三种归因图，指出occlusion/IG更适合工程报告，原始注意力仅作可视化。
AI.motivation: 深度RUL模型与其传感器-时间步热力图已成常规做法，但"看起来机械"的热力图并不等于工程师可据以行动的可靠解释；XAI-for-PdM文献对删除/插入忠实性、传感器尺度噪声稳定性、跨训练种子一致性等检验仍报告不足。
AI.method: 在官方FD001与FD003划分上按分段RUL上限125循环与PHM08非对称评分训练1D CNN、LSTM与小型Transformer编码器；接入Integrated Gradients、occlusion与末层注意力三种归因图；实施删除/插入忠实性、5%传感器尺度噪声下的Spearman稳定性、跨训练种子一致性及RUL分箱内余弦一致性检验；并在AI4I 2020失效数据集上以树模型重要性做表格验证。
AI.result: 预测误差仅为前提而非结论。LSTM上IG与occlusion忠实性相近；Transformer注意力计算廉价且时间上平滑，但忠实性弱。三种归因图在5%输入噪声下几乎不变，而IG/occlusion在两个LSTM种子间仅中等一致——对传感器抖动的稳定性不等于对重训练的稳定性。AI4I 2020上的树重要性呈现相同的删除模式。
AI.conclusion: 对面向维护工程师的C-MAPSS类报告，推荐使用occlusion或IG；原始注意力权重应仅视为可视化手段，不宜作为解释依据。

title: TimeNet: An Extensible Unified Data Infrastructure for Next-Generation Temporal Foundation Models
summary: Temporal Foundation Models (TFMs) aim to generalize across domains, datasets, and tasks. Yet, their development remains constrained by fragmented, task-specific data formats, annotations, and processing pipelines. We introduce TimeNet, an open-source data standard and scalable infrastructure that decouples temporal data from task definitions and represents signals, metadata, annotations, and supervision in a shared, extensible data model. TimeNet supports multimodal signals with regular, irregular, or ordinal time axes and expresses different task families (including classification, forecasting, temporal localization, question answering, generation, and editing) as reusable views over the same recordings. This shared representation enables heterogeneous time-series datasets to be combined for large-scale model training across domains, modalities, and tasks. We demonstrate TimeNet by transcoding datasets with 1.5M task instances spanning diverse domains, modalities, temporal scales, and forms of supervision, while retaining practical I/O performance relative to native formats. TimeNet enables an existing TFN training pipeline to support joint training on a configurable number of heterogeneous datasets through configuration changes alone. We show this capability by training TFM across multiple datasets and tasks, obtaining a 14% F1 score improvement compared with models trained on individual datasets. These results show that TimeNet provides the data and systems foundation needed to move beyond task- and dataset-specific TFMs toward models that can learn jointly across heterogeneous domains, modalities, temporal scales, and forms of supervision from a common data model.

AI.tldr: TimeNet是一个开源时序数据标准与可扩展基础设施，通过统一数据模型解耦时序数据与任务定义，实现跨域、跨模态、跨任务的大规模基础模型训练。
AI.motivation: 时序基础模型（TFMs）的发展受限于碎片化的、任务特定的数据格式、标注和处理流程，难以跨域、跨数据集、跨任务泛化。
AI.method: 提出TimeNet，将信号、元数据、标注和监督用共享可扩展的数据模型表示；支持规则、非规则或顺序时间轴的多模态信号；将分类、预测、时序定位、问答、生成、编辑等任务族表达为同一记录的复用视图。
AI.result: 对150万个任务实例的数据集进行转码，覆盖多种域、模态、时间尺度和监督形式，并保持接近原生格式的I/O性能；通过仅修改配置即可使现有TFN训练流程支持多异构数据集的联合训练，相比单数据集训练，F1提升14%。
AI.conclusion: TimeNet为时序基础模型提供了所需的数据与系统基础，推动其从任务/数据集特定模型迈向能在异构域、模态、时间尺度和监督形式间联合学习的通用模型。

title: First-Order Steering: Translating Weight Adaptation into Activation Steering
summary: Activation steering exploits interpretable directions in the residual stream to enable inference-time manipulation of model behavior. Composing steering vectors to apply multiple target behaviors simultaneously is important in various fields-including AI alignment and safety-but remains a challenge for existing activation steering methods. In contrast, prior work in model merging shows that target behaviors represented by learned weight adaptations can be combined with high accuracy. A method that translates weight adaptations into activation steering vectors could therefore extend prior work in model merging to generate composable steering vectors that better enable simultaneous inference-time behavioral control. For this, we introduce First-Order Steering, a formulation of activation steering as a first-order approximation of weight update matrices parameterized by a vector of steering strengths, and establish theoretical bounds on the approximation error of first-order steering. We then develop a novel model merging procedure, HeRD-Merging, which minimizes the first-order approximation error terms to enable higher first-order steering accuracy. Together, our method produces steering vectors that control both individual and composed behaviors more accurately than existing activation steering methods. Furthermore, HeRD-Merging matches the performance of conventional model-merging baselines, while producing weight adaptations that admit more accurate first-order steering vectors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 First-Order Steering，将激活引导（activation steering）形式化为权重更新矩阵的一阶近似，并据此设计 HeRD-Merging 模型合并方法以提升可组合引导向量的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有激活引导方法难以同时组合多个目标行为，而模型合并中学习到的权重更新能较精确地组合目标行为。作者希望将权重更新转化为激活引导向量，从而借助模型合并实现可组合、可同时控制的推理时行为调控。
AI.method: 提出 First-Order Steering：用由引导强度向量参数化的权重更新矩阵的一阶近似来表示激活引导，并对近似误差建立理论界；进一步提出 HeRD-Merging 模型合并流程，通过最小化一阶近似误差项来提高一阶引导精度。
AI.result: 该方法生成的引导向量在控制单一行为和组合行为时均比现有激活引导方法更准确；同时 HeRD-Merging 在性能上匹配常规模型合并基线，并产生能支持更精确一阶引导向量的权重更新。
AI.conclusion: First-Order Steering 与 HeRD-Merging 结合，将模型合并与激活引导联系起来，实现了更精确的单行为和组合行为推理时控制，同时保持与常规合并基线相当的合并性能。

title: CORE-RL: Confidence-Oriented Reliability Evaluation of Black-Box Reinforcement Learning Policies
summary: The deployment of Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents in critical domains must be preceded with a pipeline to evaluate the alignment of the RL agent with complex multi-objective specifications and robustness under real-world environmental drift. However, to protect intellectual property, the RL agent may be delivered for evaluation as opaque executable or remote API, which makes traditional evaluation techniques based on the internals of the policies infeasible. To address this gap, CORE-RL: Confidence-Oriented Reliability Evaluation of black box RL policy is proposed in this paper. The CORE-RL pipeline introduces a Unified Reliability Metric that formally integrates early task termination and safety constraint violations, preventing unsafe policies from masking failures through premature episode halts. By subjecting the policy to a noise certification envelope of perceptual noise, actuation noise and change in environment dynamics, the pipeline computes the finite-sample Clopper-Pearson bounds on unified reliability metric and Hoeffdings' lower bound on reward and safety cost. The pipeline then defines safe operational design domain to report high-confidence certificates for safety and expected performance. Experiments on continuous control tasks demonstrate the CORE-RL pipeline's ability to automatically reject non-compliant policies and map the safe Operational Design Domain (ODD) of safety-aware policies. Thus CORE-RL provides an evaluation framework towards a quantitative, transparent and reproducible, statistical rationale necessary to safely evaluate, compare, and deploy black box RL solutions.

AI.tldr: 提出 CORE-RL 黑盒强化学习策略可靠性评估框架，通过统一可靠性指标与噪声认证包络，为黑盒 RL 策略提供安全性与性能的统计证书及安全运行设计域。
AI.motivation: 关键领域部署 RL 智能体前需评估其与复杂多目标规范的对齐性及环境漂移下的鲁棒性。但出于知识产权保护，RL 策略常以不透明可执行文件或远程 API 形式交付，导致依赖策略内部信息的传统评估方法不可行，因此需要面向黑盒策略的评估方案。
AI.method: 提出 CORE-RL 流程：引入统一可靠性指标，形式化整合早期任务终止与安全约束违反，防止不安全策略以提前终止掩盖失败；在包含感知噪声、执行噪声和环境动态变化的噪声认证包络下评估策略，计算统一可靠性指标的有限样本 Clopper-Pearson 置信界，以及奖励与安全成本的 Hoeffding 下界；据此定义安全运行设计域，报告安全与期望性能的高置信度证书。
AI.result: 在连续控制任务上的实验表明，CORE-RL 能自动拒绝不合规策略，并刻画安全感知策略的安全运行设计域（ODD）。
AI.conclusion: CORE-RL 提供了面向黑盒 RL 解决方案的评估框架，给出定量、透明、可复现的统计依据，以支持安全地评估、比较与部署黑盒强化学习方案。

title: Questioning the Questions: Sustaining Self-Evolution in Reasoning Models
summary: Self-evolving reasoning models learn from their own generated questions, yet repeated self-training can lead to performance collapse. In this paper, we investigate why performance deteriorates over successive rounds and how to sustain self-evolution. Our analysis identifies two recurring quality problems in self-generated questions: invalid questions and repeated variants of the same mathematical questions. First, invalid questions become more prevalent across rounds, and answer-consistency filtering further increases their proportion in training data. Second, existing question diversity controls based on lexical similarity can miss mathematically equivalent questions expressed in different ways, which leads to question diversity collapse in later training rounds. Building on these findings, we introduce R-Quest, which uses question validity and novelty feedback to guide self-evolution. We first train the solver to recognize and reject invalid questions, then use its judgments to guide questioner rewards and filter solver training data. To avoid question repetition, we use a frozen base model to compare sampled question pairs and provide novelty feedback. Empirically, our method consistently achieves the highest average performance on 12 benchmarks in mathematical reasoning, general-domain reasoning, and code generation across two model families. Additionally, R-Quest maintains stable performance gains over ten rounds of self-evolution, peaking in the final round and outperforming R-Zero by 17.32 points.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自进化推理模型在反复自训练中的性能崩溃原因，提出R-Quest方法，通过问题有效性与新颖性反馈引导自进化，在12个基准上取得最佳平均表现并在十轮迭代中保持稳定增益。
AI.motivation: 自进化推理模型从自身生成的问题中学习，但反复自训练会导致性能崩溃。作者希望探究性能为何随轮次恶化，以及如何维持自进化。
AI.method: 分析发现两类问题：无效问题和同一数学问题的重复变体。无效问题随轮次增多，且答案一致性过滤会进一步提高其比例；基于词汇相似度的多样性控制会遗漏数学等价但表述不同的问题，导致后续轮次多样性崩溃。基于此提出R-Quest：先训练求解器识别并拒绝无效问题，再用其判断引导提问者奖励并过滤求解器训练数据；同时用冻结基模型比较采样问题对以提供新颖性反馈，避免重复。
AI.result: 在两个模型家族的数学推理、通用领域推理和代码生成共12个基准上，方法持续取得最高平均性能；在十轮自进化中保持稳定增益，最后一轮达到峰值，比R-Zero高出17.32分。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入问题有效性与新颖性反馈，可缓解自进化中的性能崩溃，实现持续稳定的自我提升。

title: Asking Earns Nothing: Scoring the Decision to Act in BFCL Multi-Turn
summary: An agent that lacks the information it needs should ask rather than act, and the task definitions of agent leaderboards say so. BFCL multi-turn builds two of its four categories around a turn on which the model is supposed to ask, and its scorer never looks at that turn: the gold trajectory there is empty, the checker skips it, and the scripted user cannot answer, so asking earns nothing, guessing costs nothing on that turn, and asking twice loses the item. The benchmark also contains the control experiment for that decision. A should-ask item is a base item with one piece of information removed from one turn, so the same request appears twice at the same turn index, once complete and once not: on the first the model should make the call that changes the world, on the second it should ask. We score one decision per pair, whether the model attempted a world-changing call on that turn, read off the stored trajectories with no LLM judge; acting always and asking always both score 50. On the 223 pairs that pose this decision, gpt-5.4 attempts the call on 83.4% of the complete turns and holds back on 78.0% of the incomplete ones, the best decision accuracy of seven models at 80.7%; on the same items the official score ranks it sixth and puts first a model that lands in the middle here. One added line telling gpt-5.4 not to ask pushes it toward acting on both sides of the pair, so its decision accuracy shows no detectable change, while its official score rises by 13.5 to 23.5 points on the two should-ask categories and on the base twins; the opposite line, telling gemma-4-31B-it to ask first, improves its decision by 4.5 points and gains no official score. The score moves with the push toward action, not with the decision. We release the pairs, a turn-level scorer that runs on any BFCL output directory without an API key, and 31 manually verified bad items.

AI.tldr: BFCL多轮基准的"应询问"类别评分存在缺陷：该轮的金标轨迹为空、检查器跳过、脚本用户无法回答，导致询问无收益、猜测无代价；作者构建了223对"应询问"对照项，用无LLM评判的回合级评分器测量模型"行动还是询问"的决策，发现官方分数与真实决策能力脱钩。
AI.motivation: 智能体在信息不足时应先询问而非直接行动，BFCL多轮基准的任务定义也如此宣称——其四个类别中有两个围绕"模型应提问"的回合构建。然而该基准的评分器根本不检查这一回合：金标轨迹为空、检查器跳过、脚本化用户无法作答，于是询问得不到奖励、猜测在该轮没有代价、连问两次反而丢分。基准本身还包含了检验这一决定的对照实验，为验证官方分数是否真正衡量了"询问还是行动"这一决策提供了条件。
AI.method: 作者利用BFCL自带的对照设计：一个"应询问"项是基础项在某回合被移除一条信息，因此同一请求在同一回合索引出现两次——一次完整、一次不完整；完整时应发出改变世界的调用，不完整时应询问。每对只评一个决策，即模型在该回合是否尝试了改变世界的调用，直接从存储的轨迹中读取，不使用LLM评判；"总是行动"和"总是询问"的基线得分均为50。作者构建了223对这类决策项，在七个模型上评估最优决策准确率，并与官方分数对比，同时通过注入"不要询问"或"先询问"的指令做因果扰动实验。
AI.result: 在223对决策项上，gpt-5.4在完整回合尝试调用的比例为83.4%，在不完整回合克制行动的比例为78.0%，决策准确率80.7%，为七个模型中最优；但在同样的项目上，其官方分数仅排名第六，而排名第一的模型在该决策上表现居中。给gpt-5.4加一句"不要询问"的提示，使其在配对两侧都倾向行动，决策准确率无可检测变化，但官方分数在"应询问"两个类别及基础孪生项上上升13.5至23.5分；相反的提示（让gemma-4-31B-it先询问）使其决策提升4.5分，官方分数却毫无提高。结果表明官方分数随"倾向行动"的推动而变动，与决策质量无关。
AI.conclusion: 官方分数衡量的是向行动倾斜的程度，而非"该问则问、该做则做"的决策能力，因此它把决策能力中等但更爱行动的模型排在首位。作者发布了这些对照配对、一个可在任意BFCL输出目录上运行、无需API密钥的回合级评分器，以及31个经人工核验的问题项。

title: What to Preserve in Recursive Computation: A Local Predictive Sufficiency Principle
summary: Recursive computation repeatedly compresses or reuses intermediate states, creating a simple tension: information that must remain useful across longer recursive paths is also exposed to more opportunities for loss before reaching the final prediction. Existing reconstruction or local-prediction objectives provide tractable supervision, but do not ensure that the retained information remains sufficient for subsequent recursive computation. We identify local predictive sufficiency with recursive predictive closure: controlling local predictive deficiencies at individual interfaces controls the resulting discrepancy at the root. We then turn this principle into a tractable training procedure. Starting from a variational characterization, we derive finite predictive tests and an empirical predictive deficiency that measures predictive value retained across compression. Its predictive sensitivities define margin-relaxed half-space constraints on parameter updates, and we project the host optimizer's proposed update onto their intersection only when predictive preservation would otherwise be violated. Across temporal graphs, language memory, vision-language-action control, and recursive self-improvement, the method matches or improves the corresponding host models under matched compression budgets, with larger gains under heavier recursive or memory demands, while better preserving predictive information across successive transformations. Crucially, the same task-agnostic predictive-preservation principle is instantiated across all four settings through host-compatible interventions while keeping the endpoint task, backbone, and evaluation protocol fixed. These results establish predictive preservation at recursive interfaces as a general training principle for recursive compression.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"递归预测闭包"原则：通过控制各递归接口处的局部预测缺陷，即可控制根节点处的预测偏差；并据此设计一种可训练方法，在预测保持将被破坏时，将优化器更新投影到由预测敏感度定义的松弛半空间约束交集上。
AI.motivation: 递归计算会反复压缩或复用中间状态，形成一种矛盾：需要在较长递归路径上保持有用的信息，同时也暴露于更多丢失机会。现有的重构或局部预测目标虽提供了可处理的监督，但无法保证保留下来的信息对后续递归计算仍然充分。
AI.method: 将局部预测充分性刻画为"递归预测闭包"；从变分刻画出发，推导有限预测检验与经验预测缺陷，衡量压缩过程中保留的预测价值；其预测敏感度定义参数更新的margin松弛半空间约束；仅当预测保持会被破坏时，把宿主优化器提出的更新投影到这些约束的交集上。该方法与宿主模型兼容，保持终点任务、骨干与评估协议不变。
AI.result: 在时间图、语言记忆、视觉-语言-动作控制以及递归自我改进四类场景中，在相同压缩预算下，该方法达到或优于对应宿主模型；在递归或记忆需求更重时增益更大，同时更好地在连续变换间保持预测信息。
AI.conclusion: 递归接口处的预测保持可作为递归压缩的通用训练原则。

title: Modeling Deletion Requests in Machine Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning is seen as a promising approach to enable users to exercise the "right to erasure" in the context of AI models. We ask how users might influence the behavior of models when exercising this right. We define two types of behaviors that users might adopt when requesting the deletion of their data: adaptivity and collectivity. Drawing connections between the goals of users in this context and results in stochastic optimization, we demonstrate theoretical gaps between the potential effects of groups of users who do and do not display these behaviors. We then show how techniques from data valuation might be used to design deletion requesters that can significantly alter model behavior in realistic settings. In experiments on computer vision tasks, we demonstrate the differential effects of different models of user behavior and attempt to isolate the impacts of adaptivity and collectivity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究用户行使"删除权"时如何影响模型行为，定义"适应性"与"集体性"两类用户行为，理论揭示有/无这些行为的用户群体影响存在差距，并提出用数据估值技术设计删除请求者以显著改变模型行为。
AI.motivation: 机器遗忘被视为在AI模型中实现用户"删除权"的途径，但现有研究多关注技术可行性，未充分探讨用户自身行为方式对模型行为的影响，本文关注用户行为差异带来的后果。
AI.method: 定义用户请求删除数据时的两类行为：适应性（adaptivity）与集体性（collectivity）；将用户目标与随机优化结果建立联系进行理论分析；利用数据估值技术设计能够显著改变模型行为的删除请求者；在计算机视觉任务上开展实验，隔离两类行为的影响。
AI.result: 理论上证明了表现与不表现上述行为的用户群体，其潜在影响之间存在差距；实验中验证了不同用户行为模式对模型的差异化影响，并尝试分离适应性与集体性各自的作用。
AI.conclusion: 用户行为（适应性与集体性）会显著影响机器遗忘的效果，结合数据估值可设计出有效改变模型行为的删除请求策略，凸显了用户行为在"删除权"实践中的重要性。

title: What Does a Harness Buy? Tokens, Mostly
summary: A coding agent is a language model wrapped in a harness: the system prompt, the tool set, and the context management that turn a chat model into something that can work inside a repository. Production harnesses ship releases daily, vendors advertise pass-rate gains from harness changes, and leaderboards mix harnesses freely. What is rarely measured is how much the harness itself moves the score when the model is held fixed. We run five models through three production harnesses, Claude Code, mini-SWE-agent, and OpenCode, on SWE-bench Verified, and rerun the same configurations to calibrate how much a score moves when nothing changes but the run. On 447 tasks and the two models we ran there, Claude Code and mini-SWE-agent, the heaviest and the lightest harness, are equivalent within five points. On a 45-task hard subset and five models, swapping the harness flips as many tasks as rerunning the same harness, 13% in both cases, and the tasks a harness wins in one run are not the tasks it wins in the next. The one harness effect that clears the noise is a loss, not a gain: OpenCode trails by up to 9 points on the large pool, and on one model half of that gap sits in runs its output cap cut short. What the harness does decide is the bill. With the same model, the same tasks, and one price list, cost per task differs by up to 3x across harnesses. The gap is set at the first call, by the preamble of system prompt and tool schemas each harness sends with every step, and scaled by the number of steps; per-step growth and per-call tool output differ far less. The provider's price for cached input scales the bill and does not reorder it. The rerun data also give the resolution a harness comparison needs: at the discordance we observe, 45 tasks catch a 13-point gap only half the time and no gap with 80% power, and 447 tasks resolve 5 points, still coarser than the gains many harness changes claim.

AI.tldr: 在SWE-bench Verified上固定模型、只更换生产级coding agent框架(Claude Code、mini-SWE-agent、OpenCode),发现框架对得分的真实影响主要由噪声和一次框架劣势(OpenCode最多落后9分)构成,而框架最确定的影响其实是成本——同模型同任务下每任务花费最高相差3倍。
AI.motivation: 业界普遍关注模型能力,框架(harness)本身的贡献很少被单独测量:各厂商每日发布新框架版本、宣传通过率提升,排行榜又随意混用不同框架,导致"框架究竟把分数移动了多少"这一问题缺乏干净、可控的实证。作者希望在同一模型固定、仅更换框架的设置下,量化框架的真实影响及其统计可分辨性。
AI.method: 在SWE-bench Verified上,用5个模型跑3个生产级框架(Claude Code、mini-SWE-agent、OpenCode),并重复运行相同配置以标定"什么都不变时分数自身的波动"。分别在447任务大池(2个模型)和45任务困难子集(5个模型)上对比。同时用统一价目表比较每任务成本,并拆解成本来源(系统提示+工具schema的固定前导、每步增长、每次调用工具输出),还做了统计功效分析。
AI.result: 在最重与最轻的框架(Claude Code与mini-SWE-agent)之间,447任务、2模型上差距在5分以内,属等价。在45任务困难子集、5模型上,换框架翻转的任务比例与重跑同一框架相同,均为13%,且某框架一次运行赢的任务在下次并不稳定。唯一超出噪声的框架效应是负向的:OpenCode在大池上最多落后9分,其中一个模型上该差距的一半来自其输出上限截断的运行。成本方面,同模型同任务、同一价目表下,每任务成本跨框架最高相差3倍,差距由每个step发送的系统提示与工具schema前导在首次调用即决定,并按步数放大;每步增长和每次调用工具输出差异较小;缓存输入价格会缩放账单但不改变排序。
AI.conclusion: 框架对通过率的影响大多落在运行噪声之内,唯一稳定的效应是OpenCode的劣势,而非宣称的增益;要可靠比较框架需要足够的样本量——按观测到的不一致率,45任务只有约一半概率捕捉到13分差距、80%功效下捕捉不到任何差距,447任务可分辨5分,仍比许多框架改动所宣称的提升更粗。框架真正稳定的影响是成本,可相差3倍,主要源于固定前导提示与步数。
