In contrast, dropout improves extrapolation when its placement within the architecture is reconsidered. In that regard, we show that the standard placement of dropout before layer normalization introduces a systematic distributional mismatch, and that applying dropout just before the linear projection resolves this issue. For example, a modified SmolLM3 with sliding window attention, continually pre-trained with dropout, can extrapolate perfectly to 64$\times$ on Needle-in-a-Haystack and far beyond the pre-training context size on RULER and HELMET. Mamba2 also benefits from dropout, suggesting an architecture-agnostic nature of the problem. We further propose Variance-Preserving Affine Dropout (VPAD), a new dropout strategy that substantially reduces the resulting pre-activation variance mismatch, leading to further extrapolation improvements in transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文发现长度泛化不仅取决于架构设计（如位置编码、注意力机制），还与训练过程本身相关。研究表明，权重衰减会损害外推能力，而重新考虑 dropout 的放置位置则能改善外推。标准做法将 dropout 置于层归一化之前会引入系统性分布失配，将其改置于线性投影之前可解决该问题。基于此，作者提出保持方差的仿射 Dropout（VPAD），进一步降低激活前方差失配，从而提升 Transformer 的外推性能。在 SmolLM3、Mamba2 等模型上验证了该方法的架构无关性。
AI.motivation: 长度泛化通常被归因于架构选择（如位置编码和注意力机制），但本文希望探究训练过程本身（尤其是正则化方法）对长度泛化的影响，以揭示此前被忽视的因素。
AI.method: 研究正则化对长度泛化的影响：分析权重衰减与 dropout 的作用；重新设计 dropout 在架构中的放置位置，将 dropout 从层归一化之前移至线性投影之前，以消除系统性分布失配；并提出保持方差的仿射 Dropout（VPAD），进一步减少激活前方差失配。
AI.result: 权重衰减会阻碍外推；重新放置的 dropout 能改善外推。修改后的 SmolLM3（滑动窗口注意力）结合 dropout 持续预训练，可在 Needle-in-a-Haystack 上完美外推到 64×，并在 RULER 和 HELMET 上远超预训练上下文长度。Mamba2 同样受益于 dropout。VPAD 显著降低激活前方差失配，进一步提升 Transformer 的外推能力。
AI.conclusion: 长度泛化与训练过程密切相关，尤其受正则化策略及 dropout 放置位置的影响。通过重新设计 dropout 位置并引入 VPAD，可有效改善外推性能，且该问题具有架构无关性。这为提升序列模型长度泛化提供了新思路。

title: Bounds, Decompositions and Null Behaviour of KRATOS: A Mathematical Specification of a Recognition-Comparability Diagnostic
summary: KRATOS is a group-structured bibliometric diagnostic that compares the distribution of documents (participation) with the distribution of citation weight (recognition) over a fixed, finite universe of analytical groups. This note gives its complete mathematical specification and derives the properties that govern its interpretation. Beyond bounds and equality conditions for each component, we show that the recognition-alignment score depends on citation data only through ratios of group mean citation rates to the corpus mean; that the composition ceiling of the participation--recognition factor is an affine function of the total variation distance to the uniform reference; and that the factor itself satisfies Fréchet-type bounds in terms of this ceiling and a participation-weighted recognition score. We establish an exact logarithmic decomposition of the composite index, an ordering between the primary and a reciprocal-symmetric recognition score, invariance properties, and closed-form first and second moments of the recognition ratios under global and stratified permutation nulls. These results explain why composite orderings can be sensitive to small groups, heavy-tailed citation distributions and metadata reassignment. All results are verified numerically with an accompanying script. The specification concerns measurement structure only; it does not define a measure of epistemic change or justice.

AI.tldr: 本笔记给出 KRATOS 这一群体结构型文献计量诊断工具的完整数学规范，并推导其解释性质的若干理论结果。
AI.motivation: KRATOS 比较固定有限分析组上文档分布（参与度）与引用权重分布（认可度），但此前缺乏完整数学规范与解释性性质，需要系统刻画其测量结构。
AI.method: 通过数学推导建立各分量的界与等号条件、认可对齐分数对引用数据的依赖形式、参与—认可因子的构成上限（与到均匀参考的总变差距离成仿射关系）、Fréchet 型界、复合指数的精确对数分解、与原分数和互反对称分数的排序关系、不变性，以及全局与分层置换零假设下认可比的一阶矩与二阶矩闭式解；并用配套脚本进行数值验证。
AI.result: 认可对齐分数仅通过组平均引用率与语料均值的比值依赖引用数据；构成上限是到均匀参考的总变差距离的仿射函数；因子满足基于该上限与参与加权认可分数的 Fréchet 型界；得到对数分解、排序关系、不变性与置换零假设下的矩闭式解；解释复合排序对小群体、重尾引用分布和元数据重分配的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 该规范仅涉及测量结构，不定义认知变化或正义的度量；结果有助于理解复合排序的敏感性来源。

title: Proximal Causal Learning under Unmeasured Confounding
summary: Estimating treatment effects from observational data typically relies on the No Unmeasured Confounding Assumption (NUCA), which rarely holds in practice. Proximal causal learning (PCL) addresses unmeasured confounding via proxy variables, yet existing methods require the proxy variables to be pre-specified. Thus, we propose PCL-U, a framework that learns proxy variables directly from observed covariates. PCL-U uses neural encoders to decompose covariates into treatment-inducing, outcome-inducing, and shared proxies, guided by minimax mutual information objectives, and obtains causal estimates through a practical moment-based risk function. Experiments on benchmarks show that PCL-U matches or outperforms existing baselines. Besides, there are two types of synthetic datasets with varying dimensions and confounding strengths that illustrate that our method maintains stable estimation accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出PCL-U框架，从观测协变量中自动学习代理变量，解决近端因果学习中代理变量需预先设定的限制。
AI.motivation: 从观测数据估计处理效应通常依赖无未测量混杂假设（NUCA），但该假设在实践中很少成立。近端因果学习（PCL）通过代理变量处理未测量混杂，但现有方法要求代理变量必须预先指定，限制其应用。
AI.method: PCL-U使用神经编码器将协变量分解为处理诱导型、结果诱导型和共享代理三类，并由极小极大互信息目标进行引导；随后通过一个实用的基于矩的风险函数获得因果估计。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上，PCL-U达到或超过现有基线方法；在两类不同维度和混杂强度的合成数据集上，方法保持稳定的估计精度。
AI.conclusion: PCL-U实现了代理变量的自动学习，缓解了PCL对预指定代理的依赖，并在多个实验设置下展现出与基线相当或更优且稳定的因果效应估计性能。

title: LatentIndex: Cross-Layer Sharing with Layer-Specific Selection for Sparse Attention
summary: Sparse attention reduces core-attention computation, but its indexers still incur repeated selection work and per-layer key-cache storage. Reusing selected indices across layers reduces this overhead but constrains multiple layers to the same token set. We introduce LatentIndex, which extends the latent-sharing principle of Multi-head Latent Attention across indexer layers. Each layer group constructs a shared latent cache from its first layer's hidden states, while layer-specific scoring enables independent token selection. Absorbing key decoders into queries enables direct scoring of the shared cache without reconstructing historical per-layer keys. We develop training-free calibration and investigate a training-aware instantiation of this principle. To balance quality and computation, a hierarchical selection (HS) variant lets followers independently refine a shared candidate set proposed by the anchor. With four-layer sharing, LatentIndex reduces logical indexer-cache storage by 61.1% on DeepSeek-V3.2. Across DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5, training-free LatentIndex improves head-wise attention-mass recall over IndexCache by up to 3.28 percentage points while maintaining RULER and LongBench performance close to native DSA. HS further achieves 2.30-2.72 times decode indexer speedups over DSA across 8K-128K contexts, retaining most of LatentIndex's recall. LatentIndex offers a new perspective on cross-layer indexing: sharing continuous representations rather than discrete selections enables efficient reuse while preserving layer-specific token selection.

AI.tldr: 提出LatentIndex，将MLA的潜变量共享思想跨索引层扩展，通过共享潜缓存+层特定打分实现高效跨层索引复用，在保持性能的同时显著降低存储并加速解码。
AI.motivation: 稀疏注意力虽减少了核心注意力计算，但其索引器仍存在重复的选择工作和逐层的键缓存存储开销。跨层复用已选索引可降低开销，却会强制多层使用相同的token集合，限制灵活性。
AI.method: 将多头潜注意力（MLA）的潜变量共享原理扩展到索引器各层。每个层组基于首层隐状态构建共享潜缓存，同时保留层特定的打分以支持独立token选择；将键解码器吸收进查询中，从而无需重建历史逐层键即可直接对共享缓存打分。提出免训练校准方法并探索训练感知实现；进一步提出分层选择（HS）变体，让跟随层独立细化由锚层提出的共享候选集，以平衡质量与计算。
AI.result: 四层共享下，LatentIndex在DeepSeek-V3.2上减少逻辑索引器缓存存储61.1%。在DeepSeek-V3.2和GLM-5上，免训练LatentIndex相较IndexCache的head-wise注意力质量召回率最高提升3.28个百分点，同时RULER和LongBench性能接近原生DSA。HS在8K-128K上下文中实现相对DSA 2.30-2.72倍的解码索引器加速，并保留LatentIndex大部分召回率。
AI.conclusion: LatentIndex为跨层索引提供了新视角：共享连续表示而非离散选择，既能实现高效复用，又能保留层特定的token选择。

title: Weight Decay and Neuron Condensation: A Three-Stage Analysis of Two-Layer ReLU Networks
summary: Weight decay is widely used as a regularization technique in neural network training, yet its role in neuron condensation (parameter direction alignment) remains unclear. Starting from a parameter initialization in the neural tangent kernel regime, we characterize training dynamics under weight decay through three stages: rapid fitting, amplitude compression, and neuron condensation. Using a two-layer ReLU network, we analyze a residual correlation field that governs both neuron amplitudes and directions. During rapid fitting, the residual approaches a quasi-static equilibrium maintained by weight decay while the tangent kernel remains nearly unchanged. In the early stage of amplitude compression, kernel decay amplifies the residual correlation field, whose isolated attracting extrema provide candidates for condensation directions. As neuron amplitudes stabilize, we bound the drift of attracting extrema and demonstrate contraction of neuron directions around them, leading to neuron condensation. This staged analysis provides a dynamical understanding of how weight decay promotes a condensed representation, beyond reducing parameter norms.

AI.tldr: 本文从NTK初始化出发，将带权重衰减的训练动力学划分为三个阶段：快速拟合、幅度压缩和神经元凝聚，用两层ReLU网络分析控制神经元幅度与方向的残差相关场，揭示了权重衰减促进凝聚表征的动力学机制。
AI.motivation: 权重衰减是神经网络训练中广泛使用的正则化技术，但其在神经元凝聚（参数方向对齐）中的作用尚不清晰，已有认识多停留在减小参数范数层面，缺乏对训练动力学的完整刻画。
AI.method: 以神经切线核（NTK）区域的参数初始化为起点，采用两层ReLU网络，定义并分析一个同时控制神经元幅度和方向的残差相关场，分三阶段刻画训练动力学：快速拟合、幅度压缩、神经元凝聚。
AI.result: 在快速拟合阶段，残差趋于由权重衰减维持的准静态平衡，而切线核几乎不变；在幅度压缩早期，核衰减放大了残差相关场，其孤立吸引极值给出了凝聚方向的候选；当神经元幅度稳定后，论文界定了吸引极值的漂移，并证明神经元方向向其收缩，从而产生神经元凝聚。
AI.conclusion: 该分阶段分析从动力学角度解释了权重衰减如何促进凝聚表征的形成，超越了"仅减小参数范数"的传统理解，为理解权重衰减的表示学习效应提供了新视角。

title: SEIS: Self-Evolving Inference Systems
summary: Inference systems determine how fast and how cheaply language models can be served, so making them faster has direct practical value. However, prior work focuses mostly on optimizing certain parts such as kernels or memory within the large system. In this work, we take a holistic approach and apply agentic self-evolution to optimize the whole system end-to-end. Our SEIS (Self-Evolving Inference Systems) autonomously optimizes the entire mini-sglang engine without human intervention through iterative sessions with inherited experiences and code changes. Serving Qwen3-0.6B on H100, the resulting engine reaches 3.27X the throughput of the original mini-sglang implementation and beats SOTA engines like vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, and SGLang in the single-request workload. The correctness of the optimized inference engine by SEIS is tested in terms of numerical difference and downstream accuracy on math and long-context retrieval tasks. The code and session histories show that the speedup comes from redesigning the whole engine and that building on earlier sessions beats independent attempts. These results suggest that agentic self-evolution can optimize a complex system end-to-end. The evaluation also has to evolve with the engine, and letting agents evolve it is a natural next step.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SEIS（自进化推理系统），采用智能体自进化方法对推理引擎进行端到端整体优化，在H100上服务Qwen3-0.6B时吞吐量达原始mini-sglang的3.27倍，并超越vLLM、TensorRT-LLM和SGLang等SOTA引擎。
AI.motivation: 推理系统决定了语言模型服务速度与成本，具有直接实用价值。但以往工作多聚焦于系统内局部组件（如算子或内存）的优化，缺乏对整个系统的端到端整体优化视角。作者希望验证智能体自进化能否优化复杂系统。
AI.method: 提出SEIS（Self-Evolving Inference Systems），通过多轮迭代会话、继承历史经验与代码修改，在无人工干预下自主优化整个mini-sglang引擎，实现端到端的系统级优化。
AI.result: 在H100上服务Qwen3-0.6B，所得引擎吞吐量达原mini-sglang的3.27倍，在单请求负载下超越vLLM、TensorRT-LLM、SGLang等SOTA引擎；数值差异与数学、长上下文检索任务的下游准确率测试验证了正确性。加速源于对整个引擎的重新设计，且基于早期会话的迭代优于独立尝试。
AI.conclusion: 智能体自进化能够端到端优化复杂系统。评估方法也需随引擎共同进化，让智能体自动演化评估是自然的下一步。

title: PhaseGate: Phase-Aware CPU Retrieval Scheduling for On-Device LLMs on Unified Memory
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on On-Device Intelligence: Foundation Models under Real-World Constraints
summary: On-device assistants run GPU-based LLM inference alongside CPU retrieval on unified-memory systems. Under a saturated local-retrieval workload, four concurrent retrieval workers raise 95th-percentile (p95) decode latency by 60-61% on two M4 systems, whereas prefill latency rises by only 5.7-6.9%. We study LLM phase as an admission signal for independent CPU retrieval under controlled LLM workloads. PHASEGATE calibrates separate concurrency limits for prefill and decode, selecting four and one on our base-M4 configuration. Under a backlogged queue, it achieves 2.0 times the aggregate retrieval throughput of the best tested feasible fixed policy, with both p95 LLM latency metrics within 1.25 times their no-retrieval baselines in all seven held-out runs. A phase-blind control, TimeGate, uses the same two limits on a calibration-derived schedule without observing LLM phase. It achieves similar retrieval throughput but violates the output-token latency limit in every run. M2 and M2 Pro Mac minis reproduce the policy ordering, while output-length sweeps show that the advantage narrows as decode occupies more of each request.

AI.tldr: PHASEGATE 利用 LLM 阶段（prefill/decode）作为 CPU 检索任务的准入信号，为两阶段分别设定并发上限，从而在保证 LLM 延迟的前提下大幅提升检索吞吐。
AI.motivation: 在统一内存系统上，设备端助手需要同时运行 GPU 的 LLM 推理与 CPU 检索。饱和的本地检索负载会显著抬高 decode 阶段的 p95 延迟（60-61%），而 prefill 仅上升 5.7-6.9%，说明两阶段对 CPU 资源竞争敏感度不同，需要差异化的并发控制。
AI.method: 提出 PHASEGATE，将 LLM 阶段作为独立 CPU 检索的准入信号，为 prefill 和 decode 分别校准并发上限（基座 M4 上分别为 4 和 1）。同时设计阶段盲的对照方案 TimeGate，使用相同的两个上限与校准得到的调度，但不观测 LLM 阶段。
AI.result: 在积压队列下，PHASEGATE 达到最佳可行固定策略检索吞吐的 2.0 倍，且在全部 7 次留出运行中两项 p95 LLM 延迟指标均控制在无检索基线的 1.25 倍以内。TimeGate 吞吐相近但在每次运行中都违反输出 token 延迟上限。M2 与 M2 Pro Mac mini 复现了策略排序；输出长度扫描显示，随着 decode 占比增大，优势缩小。
AI.conclusion: 以 LLM 阶段作为检索准入信号，可在不牺牲 LLM 延迟目标的前提下显著提升 CPU 检索吞吐，且该策略优势在多种硬件上可复现，但会随 decode 占比增加而减弱。

title: PermVLA: Factorization Order as a Regularizer for VLA Learning
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies commonly learn action chunks through a fixed left-to-right (LTR) factorization, although the same expert trajectory distribution admits many valid chain-rule factorizations. We identify factorization order as an overlooked regularization choice and introduce causally anchored permutation (CAP), which samples action reveal orders with a tunable chronological prefix. Its auxiliary objective trains one shared policy to predict actions from different known subsets of the same expert chunk, while deployment retains deterministic LTR control. We call this conditional-set augmentation: it creates multiple conditional prediction problems from one expert chunk without adding demonstrations. This discourages reliance on the single chronological prefix used by ordinary teacher forcing. Controlled experiments show that CAP consistently outperforms standard LTR training on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, with the same advantage appearing in cross-dataset CALVIN evaluation. A diagnostic that measures the expected squared difference between a chunk's joint log likelihood under two reveal orders verifies that CAP training internalizes agreement across reveal orders. These findings position sampled subset-conditioned auxiliary objectives as a general recipe for constructing VLA regularizers, illustrated by an extension to diffusion action generators.

AI.tldr: 本文将动作块的因子分解顺序视为被忽视的正则化选择，提出因果锚定排列（CAP），通过从同一专家动作块的不同已知子集进行预测来训练共享策略，在不增加演示的情况下提升VLA策略性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通常以固定的从左到右（LTR）因子分解学习动作块，但同一专家轨迹分布可支持多种合法的链式法则分解。作者识别出因子分解顺序是一个被忽视的正则化选择，并希望避免模型过度依赖普通教师强制中使用的单一时间前缀。
AI.method: 提出因果锚定排列（CAP），以可调的时间前缀采样动作揭示顺序。其辅助目标训练一个共享策略，从同一专家动作块的不同已知子集预测动作，而部署时仍保留确定性的LTR控制。作者将这种机制称为条件集增强：在不增加演示的情况下，从单个专家动作块生成多个条件预测问题。此外还将该方法扩展到扩散动作生成器。
AI.result: 在LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus上，CAP持续优于标准LTR训练，在跨数据集CALVIN评估中也表现出相同优势。一项诊断通过测量同一动作块在两种揭示顺序下联合对数似然之间的期望平方差，验证了CAP训练确实使模型内化了跨揭示顺序的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 采样式子集条件辅助目标可作为构建VLA正则化器的一种通用方法，CAP是其在动作块因子分解顺序上的具体实现，并可推广到扩散动作生成器等生成式动作建模框架。

title: TMAML: Temporal Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning for Cold-Start Time Series Forecasting
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, Accepted at Neurips 2026 TS-LIMITS Workshop
summary: Cold-start forecasting, the task of forecasting a time series with little to no historical data, is a common challenge. Addressing it requires approaches that learn quickly from few datapoints and leverage information from related series, typically through static covariates, to generalize well to unseen series. While some global forecasting models can generate cold-start predictions by leveraging information shared across multiple series, they are not optimized for out-of-train-set generalization or adaptation from short histories. In this work, we formulate cold-start forecasting as a few-window learning problem and introduce Temporal Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (TMAML), which tailors the model-agnostic meta-learning algorithm, originally developed for few-shot adaptation of neural networks, to deep time series forecasting. TMAML constructs meta-tasks as temporally consistent support-query windows and pairs them with a temporal meta-training and meta-testing procedure, yielding forecasting models that are explicitly optimized for cold-start forecasting. We instantiate TMAML on the Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) and present an initial empirical analysis of forecast accuracy and calibration across three cold-start scenarios: TMAML consistently outperforms or matches a standard ERM-trained TFT, yields better-calibrated forecasts than naive on two of the three scenarios, but does not consistently outperform naive on probabilistic forecast accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文将冷启动预测形式化为少窗口学习问题，提出时间模型无关元学习（TMAML），在TFT上实例化并在三种冷启动场景下验证。
AI.motivation: 冷启动预测（历史数据极少）是常见难题，需要能快速从少量数据学习并借助相关序列信息泛化的方法。现有全局预测模型虽可利用跨序列共享信息生成冷启动预测，但未针对训练集外泛化或短历史自适应进行优化。
AI.method: 将冷启动预测形式化为few-window learning问题；提出TMAML，将原本用于神经网络少样本适应的模型无关元学习（MAML）改造用于深度时间序列预测。TMAML构建时间一致的支持-查询窗口作为元任务，配合时间元训练与元测试流程，显式优化冷启动预测能力。在Temporal Fusion Transformer（TFT）上实例化TMAML。
AI.result: 在三种冷启动场景下进行初步实证分析：TMAML在预测精度上一致优于或持平于标准ERM训练的TFT；在三种场景中的两种上比naive方法校准更好；但在概率预测精度上未持续优于naive方法。
AI.conclusion: TMAML为冷启动预测提供了显式优化框架，在点预测精度上有效，校准性部分改善，但概率预测精度仍有提升空间。

title: Efficient Neural Surrogates for Linear Radiation Transport on the Lattice and Hohlraum benchmarks
summary: Linear radiation transport equations (RTEs) form the simulation foundations underpinning design and analysis tasks in nuclear engineering, inertial confinement fusion, medical imaging, and astrophysics, but resolving the high-dimensional phase space at engineering fidelity remains expensive enough that outer-loop workflows, such as design optimization, uncertainty quantification, and parameter sweeps, are routinely budget-bound on traditional solvers. Neural surrogates promise to relax this bottleneck by amortizing simulation cost across thousands of downstream queries, but the architectural choices and engineered inductive biases that make a surrogate accurate on one transport problem do not transfer straightforwardly across model families. We benchmark two parameter-matched neural surrogate architectures, the physics-attention Transolver and the multi-scale graph network Bi-Stride Multi-Scale MeshGraphNet (BSMS-MGN), as end-to-end approximations of the final-time particle concentration for the two-dimensional linear RTE on the canonical Lattice and Hohlraum benchmarks. An ablation across Fourier features and region-weighted training loss exposes strongly architecture-dependent inductive-bias preferences, indicating that design choices common to physics-informed surrogate workflows must be revisited per architecture rather than imported across model families, and that downstream utility depends on per-QoI sensitivity rather than a single field-level score. The model training recipe, training data, and evaluation pipeline are released alongside this paper to support reproduction, transfer to related transport problems, and evaluation as amortized forward-model components in larger outer-loop simulation workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文基准比较了两种参数匹配的神经代理架构（Transolver 与 BSMS-MGN）在二维线性辐射输运方程上的端到端近似能力，发现归纳偏置偏好强烈依赖架构，不能跨模型家族直接移植。
AI.motivation: 线性辐射输运方程在核工程、惯性约束聚变、医学成像和天体物理中至关重要，但高维相空间求解成本高昂，导致设计优化、不确定性量化、参数扫描等外层工作流受算力预算限制。神经代理有望通过摊销仿真成本缓解瓶颈，但使代理准确的架构选择与工程化归纳偏置难以在不同模型家族间迁移。
AI.method: 在典型 Lattice 和 Hohlraum 基准上，针对二维线性 RTE 的最终时刻粒子浓度，基准测试两种参数匹配的神经代理架构：物理注意力模型 Transolver 与多尺度图网络 Bi-Stride Multi-Scale MeshGraphNet（BSMS-MGN）。通过傅里叶特征与区域加权训练损失的消融实验，分析归纳偏置偏好。
AI.result: 消融实验显示，傅里叶特征和区域加权训练损失的偏好强烈依赖架构，说明物理信息代理工作流中常见的设计选择必须按架构重新审视，而非跨模型家族直接套用；下游效用取决于各关注量（QoI）的敏感度，而非单一字段级评分。
AI.conclusion: 论文发布了模型训练配方、训练数据与评估流程，以支持复现、迁移至相关输运问题，以及在更大规模外层仿真工作流中作为摊销前向模型组件进行评估。

title: Coupling Noisy Pairwise Knowledge to the DAG Posterior for Causal Discovery
summary: External causal reports can improve structure learning from limited observations, but their reliability varies across sources and variable pairs. We introduce HB-NoisyKG, a Bayesian framework that combines observational data with repeated causal reports from sources such as large language models. Each report is a noisy observation of a direct pair state implied by one DAG. A feature-conditioned Beta prior pools information about pair reliability, and a shared error matrix captures systematic mistakes. Alternating inference uses the graph posterior to refine reliability estimates, which determine how reports influence subsequent graph updates. The report likelihood uses only graph pair-state marginals, so the same observation layer supports discrete and continuous likelihoods in graph-only and joint inference. Against an 80-restart no-KG baseline, HB uses at most 80 total restarts and lowers mean SHD from 22.39 to 16.06 on five discrete benchmarks. On a physical light tunnel with random variable IDs and retained descriptions, HB lowers SHD from 39.00 for no-KG to 27.30. On continuous Sachs, graph-only BGe raises AUROC by 0.121 over no-KG Top-K. In a controlled synthetic study, continued updating also reduces mean reliability estimation error and held-out report log loss compared with one-time estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HB-NoisyKG，一个将观测数据与来自大语言模型等来源的重复因果报告相结合的贝叶斯框架，可在有限观测下提升结构学习效果。
AI.motivation: 外部因果报告能改善有限观测下的结构学习，但其可靠性因来源和变量对而异，需要一种能建模并利用这种不确定性的方法。
AI.method: 每个报告被建模为一个DAG隐含的直接变量对状态的噪声观测；采用特征条件Beta先验汇总变量对可靠性信息，并用共享误差矩阵捕捉系统性错误；通过交替推断，用图后验修正可靠性估计，再由可靠性决定报告对后续图更新的影响；报告似然仅依赖图的变量对状态边缘分布，从而支持离散与连续似然以及纯图与联合推断。
AI.result: 相比80次重启的无KG基线，HB最多使用80次总重启，在五个离散基准上将平均SHD从22.39降至16.06；在随机变量ID并保留描述的物理光隧道任务上，SHD从39.00降至27.30；在连续Sachs数据上，纯图BGe相比无KG Top-K将AUROC提升0.121；在受控合成研究中，持续更新相比一次性估计降低了平均可靠性估计误差和留出报告对数损失。
AI.conclusion: HB-NoisyKG通过显式建模报告可靠性并交替更新图与可靠性，有效利用不可靠的外部因果报告，在离散、连续及真实物理场景中均一致提升结构学习性能。

title: A Tropical Geometry View of Forgetting: A Per-Unit Projector for Knowledge-Preserving Fine-Tuning
summary: Fine-tuning a language model on new text degrades what it already does. Replay-free projectors such as Adam-NSCL and GPM forbid one shared subspace of a layer's inputs in every row of the update. The tropical geometry of a ReLU layer shows why this is too coarse. In data space, the units' walls are tropical hypersurfaces whose cells are dual to the upper vertices of a zonotope; in weight space, each old token is a hyperplane, and the tokens cut out a polyhedron, the closure of the weights that keep every token on its side. An exact identity joins the two pictures: the squared change of the layer's output under any weight change splits into in-cell, open-to-closed and closed-to-open terms, and the first two live on the tokens each unit fires on. The identity names a gate-aware per-unit projector, and a budget-separation theorem prices exact protection: it costs a unit the rank of its own open tokens, while a shared subspace pays at least the rank of their union in every row. On OPT-1.3b, where 96% of (token, unit) pairs are closed, the projector forgets less than Adam-NSCL at all six matched budgets from 9 to 60 constrained directions per row, the gap widening from $1.1\times$ to $4.3\times$; with 1/5.5 of the directions it halves the forgetting of Adam-NSCL at GPM's energy threshold. On OPT-6.7b, it matches Adam-NSCL's forgetting at matched budget while learning more. As the theory predicts, the open/closed partition is the operative variable: open tokens beat random, sign-blind and anti-gate token sets on 18 of 18 seed-pairs. In pruning repair, every derivative-based local model of the output error at the dense weights is blind to pairs that open: the minimisers of the gate-weighted objective can leave the polyhedron, the objective's closed-form solution is 1.94 nats worse than no repair on OPT-1.3b, and a convex one-sided penalty bounds the escape.

AI.tldr: 本文用热带几何刻画ReLU层的门控结构，指出共享子空间投影器过于粗糙，提出门感知的逐单元投影器，并证明精确保护的成本恰为该单元开放token的秩。
AI.motivation: 无回放的持续微调会使语言模型遗忘已有能力。已有方法（Adam-NSCL、GPM）在每行更新中禁止一个共享输入子空间，但这种做法忽略了ReLU单元的激活门控差异，粒度过粗，导致保护不足或过度约束。
AI.method: 在数据空间中，单元边界为热带超曲面，其胞腔与zonotope上顶点对偶；在权重空间中，每个旧token是一个超平面，切出保持token符号的多面体。作者建立恒等式：层输出平方变化可分解为胞内、开到闭、闭到开三项，前两项只依赖各单元实际激活的token。由此构造门感知的逐单元投影器，并用预算分离定理给出成本下界。
AI.result: 在OPT-1.3b上96%的(token, unit)对处于闭合状态，该投影器在每行9至60个约束方向的六个预算下遗忘均少于Adam-NSCL，差距从1.1倍扩大到4.3倍；仅用1/5.5的方向即在GPM能量阈值下将遗忘减半。OPT-6.7b上同等预算下遗忘持平但学得更多。开放token集合在18/18种子对上优于随机、符号盲与反门控集合。剪枝修复中，基于密集权重处输出误差的局部模型对会打开的配对全部失明，门加权目标的闭式解比不修复差1.94 nats，凸单边惩罚可限制逃逸。
AI.conclusion: 开放/闭合划分是持续微调保护的真正操作变量；门感知的逐单元投影以更小预算实现更低遗忘，且揭示了修剪修复中现有局部近似方法的根本盲区。

title: Only Project Once: Projection-Adaptive Loss for Exact Constraint Satisfaction
summary: Precise constraint satisfaction is a prerequisite to deploying learned models in many areas, motivating methods that repair raw neural predictions with a repair procedure. Current methods unroll multiple repair steps in training and softly penalize constraint violations that remain after the unroll. This is compute- and memory-intensive, lacks robustness when the repair fails to converge, and surrenders most of the constraint satisfaction work to the repair. Our central finding is that, contrary to common practice, a single detached projection step suffices in training. We accomplish this with a Projection-Adaptive Loss (PAL), which uses the constraint residual after this single step to adaptively weigh constraint penalties on the raw prediction. In experiments, PAL is the only method that retains virtually perfect feasibility on extremely nonlinear constraints, and matches or outperforms current methods on synthetic and engineering benchmarks. Because it only requires a single detached projection step, PAL trains 2.5x faster than the canonical repair-based method (DC3) on its own ACOPF benchmark. PAL can also be trained when constraints are expensive to evaluate (e.g., via neural surrogates), a setting where current unrolled methods are memory-intractable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Projection-Adaptive Loss (PAL)，发现训练中只需一步分离(detached)的投影即可满足约束，无需多次展开修复步骤。PAL 用单步投影后的约束残差自适应加权原始预测的约束惩罚。
AI.motivation: 将学习模型部署到许多领域需要精确满足约束，因此需要修复(repair)程序来修正神经网络的原始预测。现有方法在训练中展开多个修复步骤，并对展开后仍存在的约束违反进行软惩罚，这带来三个问题：计算和内存开销大；当修复不收敛时缺乏鲁棒性；并且把大部分约束满足工作都交给了修复过程。
AI.method: 核心发现是与常规做法相反，训练中只需一步分离(detached)的投影即可。基于此提出 Projection-Adaptive Loss (PAL)，利用单步投影后的约束残差自适应地加权对原始预测的约束惩罚。由于只需一步分离投影，PAL 也可在约束评估昂贵时（如通过神经代理模型）进行训练。
AI.result: 在实验中，PAL 是唯一在高度非线性约束上保持几乎完美可行性的方法，并在合成和工程基准上达到或超过现有方法。在其自有的 ACOPF 基准上，PAL 训练速度比经典的基于修复的方法（DC3）快 2.5 倍。PAL 还可在约束评估昂贵（如神经代理模型）的场景下训练，而现有展开方法在此场景下内存不可承受。
AI.conclusion: 训练中只需一步分离投影即可满足约束，无需多步展开修复。PAL 通过自适应加权约束惩罚，在保持可行性、性能、训练效率和内存可扩展性方面均优于现有展开式修复方法。

title: MASBench: Benchmarking LLM-based Multi-Agent Collaboration under Partial Observability
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have progressively evolved into the core of autonomous agents. Building on this progress, LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) coordinate multiple agents into a synergistic team to accomplish complex tasks that exceed the capabilities of individual agents. The effectiveness of such systems depends not only on the agents themselves, but also on how collaboration mechanisms are designed and organized. Note that real-world collaboration is typically partially observable, where each agent can only access partial information about the environment due to physical or privacy-related constraints. However, many existing multi-agent benchmarks assume global observability, and leave limited support for systematically evaluating collaboration mechanisms. To bridge this gap, we introduce MASBench, a multi-agent collaboration benchmark designed under partially observable constraints. It is organized into three progressive task categories: Reasoning, Scheduling, and Game. Through this structure, we progressively evaluate three representative collaboration mechanisms: Protocol, Memory, and Routing. MASBench further provides deterministic evaluation metrics, including performance score, communication cost, and cost effectiveness, to characterize both collaboration outcomes and communication overhead. Experiments across diverse LLM backbones and mechanism configurations offer empirical guidance for effective MAS design. Code is available at: https://github.com/BUPT-GAMMA/MASBench

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MASBench，一个面向部分可观测约束的多智能体协作基准，通过Reasoning、Scheduling、Game三类渐进任务评估Protocol、Memory、Routing三种协作机制，并提供确定性指标衡量协作效果与通信开销。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的多智能体系统通过协作完成超越单智能体能力的复杂任务，其效果不仅取决于智能体本身，还取决于协作机制的设计。但现实协作通常是部分可观测的（受物理或隐私约束），而现有多智能体基准多假设全局可观测，缺乏对协作机制的系统评估支持。因此需要填补这一空白。
AI.method: 提出MASBench基准，在部分可观测约束下设计，分为Reasoning、Scheduling、Game三个渐进式任务类别，对应评估Protocol、Memory、Routing三种代表性协作机制；提供确定性评价指标：performance score、communication cost和cost effectiveness。
AI.result: 在不同LLM骨干模型和多种机制配置下进行了实验，为有效的MAS设计提供了经验性指导；代码已开源于https://github.com/BUPT-GAMMA/MASBench。
AI.conclusion: MASBench弥补了现有基准在部分可观测条件下协作机制评估的不足，通过渐进任务结构与多维确定性指标，为多智能体协作机制的设计与比较提供了系统化评估框架与实证依据。

title: DiffGate: Difficulty-Gated Teacher Guidance for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as a widely used paradigm for post-training large language models, reducing the train--test mismatch of conventional distillation by supervising the student on its own generated trajectories. However, existing OPD objectives remain largely token-local and outcome-agnostic, optimizing teacher--student agreement at each prefix despite reasoning quality being determined at the trajectory level. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), particularly Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), provides complementary outcome-level supervision but suffers from sparse rewards and coarse credit assignment. We show that OPD and RLVR exhibit complementary blind spots: teacher signals provide dense local guidance but are weakly aligned with rollout correctness, whereas group-relative rewards capture task success but provide coarse token-level credit and vanish on all-failure groups. We introduce DiffGate, an outcome-gated objective that combines GRPO with selective, bounded teacher guidance. Teacher supervision is applied only to failed trajectories, scaled by group difficulty, and smoothly bounded to prevent extreme teacher--student discrepancies from dominating optimization. The verifier therefore determines \emph{which trajectories} receive teacher guidance, while the teacher provides dense token-level update directions within those trajectories. Across Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B students, DiffGate improves code avg@8 over matched GRPO by $+1.7$ and $+1.8$ points and pass@8 by $+1.6$ and $+5.7$ points, respectively. On mathematics, avg@8 remains within $0.5$ points of GRPO while pass@8 improves by $+1.1$ and $+3.9$ points. Overall, DiffGate improves pass@8 across all four model--domain settings, demonstrating improved solution coverage under our evaluation protocol.

AI.tldr: DiffGate 提出一种结果门控的蒸馏目标，将 GRPO 与选择性、有界的教师指导相结合，在失败轨迹上按组难度施加教师监督，提升大语言模型的推理覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 现有 on-policy distillation（OPD）目标多为 token 局部且与结果无关，而 RLVR/GRPO 提供结果级监督却面临奖励稀疏与信用分配粗糙的问题。作者指出 OPD 与 RLVR 存在互补盲区：教师信号密集但弱对齐 rollout 正确性，组相对奖励捕捉任务成功但 token 级信用粗糙且在全失败组中消失。
AI.method: 提出 DiffGate，一种结果门控目标：将 GRPO 与选择性、有界的教师指导结合。教师监督仅施加于失败轨迹，并按组难度缩放，同时平滑有界以防极端师生差异主导优化。由验证器决定哪些轨迹接受教师指导，教师在轨迹内提供密集的 token 级更新方向。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-0.6B 与 Qwen3-1.7B 学生模型上：代码任务中 avg@8 相比匹配的 GRPO 分别提升 +1.7 与 +1.8 分，pass@8 提升 +1.6 与 +5.7 分；数学任务中 avg@8 与 GRPO 差距在 0.5 分内，pass@8 提升 +1.1 与 +3.9 分。
AI.conclusion: DiffGate 在全部四个模型—领域设置中均提升了 pass@8，表明在评测协议下改进了解决方案覆盖率。

title: When Debate Helps: Proposal Supply and Verification-Aware Readout in Multi-Agent Reasoning
summary: Multi-agent debate can improve reasoning, yet often fails to beat simple majority voting. We argue that successful debate requires two distinct mechanisms: proposal supply must surface a correct answer, and readout must identify that answer when voting misses it. We formalize the first requirement through recoverable headroom, which measures cases where a correct proposal is available but the majority answer is wrong. For the second, we develop Latent Verification Debate (LVD), an accounting model in which candidate proposals receive answer-specific verification evidence before final generation. Controlled fixed-proposal interventions estimate this latent effect in equivalent peer-support units and show that correct evidence changes answer probabilities and generated decisions while proposal supply remains fixed. To improve proposal supply, we construct societies from neural-thicket agents using labeled and label-free coverage objectives. Across two backbones and matched-budget reasoning benchmarks, coverage-selected societies increase complementary proposal supply and improve aggregate accuracy in repeated stochastic evaluations. Round-level controls further show that interaction provides gains beyond applying the same finalizer directly to the initial proposals. These results identify proposal coverage and truth-sensitive evidence use as complementary conditions for debate to outperform voting. Code is available at https://github.com/Wang-ML-Lab/when-debate-helps.

AI.tldr: 本文将多智能体辩论超越多数投票的条件分解为两个机制：提案供给需覆盖正确答案，读出机制需识别正确答案，并通过可恢复余量与潜在验证辩论（LVD）进行形式化与实验验证。
AI.motivation: 多智能体辩论常被用于提升推理能力，但往往无法优于简单的多数投票。作者认为成功的辩论需要两个独立机制共同作用：一是提案供给必须能够浮现正确答案，二是读出（voting/readout）机制必须在投票失效时识别出正确答案。现有工作未清晰区分这两者，因此难以解释辩论何时有效。
AI.method: 1）用"可恢复余量（recoverable headroom）"形式化第一项要求，衡量存在正确提案但多数答案为错的情形；2）提出潜在验证辩论（LVD），一种记账模型，使候选提案在最终生成前获得答案特定的验证证据，并通过受控固定提案干预估计该潜在效应；3）为改进提案供给，利用神经丛（neural-thicket）智能体，基于有标签与无标签覆盖目标构建社会群体；4）在两个骨干模型与匹配预算推理基准上进行重复随机评估，并开展轮级对照实验。
AI.result: 固定提案干预表明，正确的验证证据会改变答案概率与生成决策，而提案供给保持不变；在两个骨干与匹配预算推理基准上，覆盖度筛选的社会群体提升了互补提案供给并改善了聚合准确率；轮级对照显示，交互带来的增益超过将同一终结器直接应用于初始提案的效果。
AI.conclusion: 提案覆盖与真值敏感的证据使用是辩论超越投票的两个互补条件。该框架为理解并设计有效的多智能体辩论提供了理论与实证依据。

title: Asymptotically Optimal Best Arm Identification with Fixed-Budget under Differential Privacy
summary: Best arm identification under differential privacy is a pure-exploration problem in which both statistical efficiency and privacy protection must be achieved simultaneously. We study fixed-budget best arm identification for bandits under pure $ε$-differential privacy, where the learner must recommend an arm after a prescribed sampling budget while protecting the full transcript. We prove that the optimal exponential decay rate of the error probability is upper bounded by an instance-dependent privacy-aware transportation exponent that differs from the analogous quantity used to characterize the stopping time in fixed-confidence analysis by Jourdan and Azize [2025]. Guided by this exponent, we propose AO-Pri-BAI, an adaptive algorithm that maintains private running estimates through Laplace-tree mechanisms and learns a sampling design through a min--max interaction between hard alternatives and arm allocations. We prove that AO-Pri-BAI satisfies pure $ε$-differential privacy. We also establish that the exponent of the failure probability of AO-Pri-BAI matches the privacy-aware benchmark. Numerical studies show that even in the non-asymptotic setting, AO-Pri-BAI outperforms benchmark algorithms on various instances, complementing the theoretical analyses.

AI.tldr: 本文研究纯ε-差分隐私下的固定预算最佳臂识别问题，证明了误差概率最优指数衰减率的上界为一种隐私感知传输指数，并提出达到该基准的自适应算法AO-Pri-BAI。
AI.motivation: 最佳臂识别在差分隐私下需要同时兼顾统计效率与隐私保护。固定预算场景中，学习者在给定采样预算后推荐一个臂并保护完整交互记录，其误差概率的最优指数衰减率此前尚不明确，需要刻画隐私约束下的理论极限并设计匹配算法。
AI.method: 论文首先证明误差概率最优指数衰减率的上界为一个实例相关的隐私感知传输指数，该指数不同于Jourdan和Azize [2025]用于刻画固定置信度分析中停止时间的对应量。基于该指数，提出自适应算法AO-Pri-BAI，通过Laplace树机制维护私有运行估计，并在困难备择与臂分配之间进行min-max交互来学习采样设计。
AI.result: 理论证明AO-Pri-BAI满足纯ε-差分隐私，且其失败概率的指数与隐私感知基准相匹配。数值研究显示，即使在非渐近设置下，AO-Pri-BAI在多种实例上均优于基准算法。
AI.conclusion: 论文刻画了纯ε-差分隐私下固定预算最佳臂识别的理论极限，并给出达到该极限的自适应算法，理论与实验相互印证，为隐私约束下的纯探索问题提供了新的分析框架。

title: RAGStress: A controlled benchmark for evaluating retrieval-augmented generation under knowledge-base degradation
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is typically evaluated under the implicit assumption that the underlying knowledge base (KB) is clean, leaving the behaviour of RAG systems under realistic KB degradation poorly characterised. We introduce RAGStress, a controlled evaluation benchmark for stress-testing RAG systems under systematic KB corruption. The benchmark pairs four naturalistic corruption types (factual corruption, numeric typo, relevance poisoning, and contradiction injection) with three severity levels (subtle, moderate, and obvious) over a single-KB, metadata-filtered experimental design built from 57 MMLU subjects and 182,546 documents. Across 52,500 model-question-condition evaluations, RAGStress reveals that clean retrieval can mask robustness differences, semantic-fidelity corruptions are substantially more harmful than signal-utility perturbations, no-retrieval accuracy does not predict corrupted-retrieval robustness, and mixed-KB accuracy should not be treated as worst-case robustness. We document the benchmark's intended use, supported claims, and limitations, and provide an artifact bundle including generation scripts, corruption prompts, metadata schema, and evaluation code. RAGStress is intended as a controlled stress test for RAG robustness under KB corruption, not as a general model leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAGStress基准，用于系统评估知识库损坏条件下RAG系统的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG评估通常隐含假设知识库是干净的，对现实知识库退化情境下RAG行为刻画不足。
AI.method: 构建受控评测基准，包含四类自然损坏（事实损坏、数字笔误、相关性投毒、矛盾注入）与三个严重程度（轻微、中等、明显），基于57个MMLU科目、182,546篇文档的单知识库、元数据过滤设计。
AI.result: 在52,500次模型-问题-条件评估中发现：干净检索会掩盖鲁棒性差异；语义保真类损坏比信号效用扰动危害更大；无检索准确率无法预测损坏检索下的鲁棒性；混合知识库准确率不应视为最坏情况鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: RAGStress是用于知识库损坏下RAG鲁棒性的受控压力测试基准，而非通用模型排行榜，并提供生成脚本、损坏提示、元数据模式与评估代码等工件。

title: Anticipating the Consequences of Curriculum Decisions with Large Language Models
summary: Automatic curriculum learning can improve the effectiveness of reinforcement learning by selecting the training experiences presented to the agent over time. Predicting the consequences of such decisions can, however, be difficult. We analyze automatic curriculum learning as a sequential decision-making problem, highlighting a gap between the quantities that determine the value of curriculum decisions and the information captured by local learning signals commonly used to guide them. We then investigate whether Large Language Models (LLMs) can exploit richer information about the learning problem to better anticipate the consequences of curriculum decisions. We introduce a method that combines online learning-progress estimates with LLM-informed estimates of (i) the potential downstream benefits of learning on each task and (ii) whether direct training on a task is currently likely to produce progress. We evaluate the approach on a custom benchmark of 256 textual goals in Craftax under different curriculum objectives. We observe the strongest gains when optimizing for individual target tasks. When optimizing across the full task set, the benefits vary across learners with different mechanisms for cross-task transfer, ranging from modest improvements in learning speed to larger gains that persist through the end of training.

AI.tldr: 该论文将自动课程学习视为序贯决策问题，指出常用局部学习信号与课程决策价值之间的信息差距，并提出结合在线学习进度估计与LLM先验估计的方法，在Craftax的256个文本目标基准上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 自动课程学习能通过选择呈现给智能体的训练经验来提升强化学习效果，但预测这些课程决策的后果很困难。作者注意到，决定课程决策价值的量（如下游收益、当前是否适合训练）与通常用来指导课程学习的局部学习信号之间存在信息鸿沟，因此希望利用LLM更丰富的问题信息来更好地预判课程决策的后果。
AI.method: 作者将自动课程学习形式化为序贯决策问题，并提出一种方法，将在线学习进度估计与LLM提供的两类估计相结合：(i) 每个任务学习的潜在下游收益估计；(ii) 当前直接训练某任务是否可能产生进度的估计。在Craftax上构建包含256个文本目标的自定义基准，并在不同课程目标下进行评估。
AI.result: 在针对单个目标任务优化时，方法取得了最强收益；在针对整个任务集优化时，收益因学习者跨任务迁移机制不同而变化，表现为从学习速度的适度提升到持续到训练结束的较大收益不等。
AI.conclusion: LLM捕获的额外信息可以弥补局部学习信号的不足，帮助更准确预判课程决策的后果；该方法在个体目标任务上增益显著，在整体任务集上效果依赖于学习者的跨任务迁移机制，说明LLM引导的课程学习具有潜力但需结合具体迁移机制加以应用。

title: Penumbra: Sample-Efficient Adversarial Search for Regulatory Obligations
comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Self-Evolving Diversity-Driven Search for Robust AI Systems (EvoRobust) at NeurIPS 2026. Workshop papers are non-archival. 12 pages (4 content pages plus references and appendices)
summary: Agents are entering finance, healthcare and law, sectors where a violation leaves no lexical signature and carries real penalties. Whether an omission is material, or a disclosure sufficient, depends on what the response left out. Probing such an obligation means finding responses one minimal edit from flipping compliance, and every probe costs a generation and two adjudications, so the binding constraint on regulatory red-teaming is sample efficiency, not volume. We introduce Penumbra, an adversarial search that walks from a verified anchor under an expanding edit budget until a two-evaluator committee changes its verdict, and emits the two adjacent responses that straddle the change. Allocation is adaptive, and the objective is coverage of the defeat surface: distinct (obligation x defeat mode) cells resolved per candidate. At matched budget, adaptive allocation reaches uniform allocation's full-budget coverage on 59% of the candidates; at equal records it covers 1.43x the defeat modes of naive enumeration, and the gain is confined to the axis it targets. On 60 screened obligations of a financial advisory constitution, Penumbra returns 144 pairs, each a compliant and a violating response that the committee places on opposite sides of the boundary, differing by a handful of words where a model asked for both directly produces texts sharing almost nothing. A second constitution, for clinical triage, reproduces this on 18 obligations: 49 pairs at the same tightness, with the same modes hardest. Pairs like these show where an obligation's own terms stop deciding, which is what an agent deployed under it must be tested against, and the search finds them at a cost that scales with the boundary, not the text.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Penumbra，一种面向监管红队的对抗搜索方法，通过自适应分配编辑预算，在合规边界的"半影区"寻找最小编辑即可翻转合规判定的响应对，以较低样本成本揭示义务条款失效的边界。
AI.motivation: 金融、医疗、法律等领域的智能体违规往往不存在明显的词汇特征，且伴随实际惩罚。判断遗漏是否重大、披露是否充分，取决于响应"漏掉了什么"，这类义务难以通过常规文本检测发现。探测此类义务需要找到距离翻转合规判定仅一步之遥的响应，而每次探测都要消耗一次生成与两次裁定，因此监管红队的真正瓶颈是样本效率而非数据规模。
AI.method: Penumbra 采用对抗搜索：从已验证的合规定锚点出发，在逐步扩大的编辑预算下搜索，直到由两个评估者组成的委员会改变裁决，并输出跨过判定边界的两条相邻响应。搜索过程中的资源分配是自适应的，优化目标为"击败面"的覆盖率，即每个候选样本所解决的（义务 × 击败模式）不重复单元数量。
AI.result: 在相同预算下，自适应分配在 59% 的候选上达到均匀分配全预算的覆盖率；在相同记录数下，其覆盖的击败模式是朴素枚举的 1.43 倍，且增益局限于其针对的目标维度。在金融咨询章程的 60 条筛选义务上，Penumbra 返回 144 对样本，每对为委员会判为边界两侧的合规与违规响应，仅相差几个词，而直接要求模型同时生成两类文本则几乎无共享内容。在临床分诊章程的 18 条义务上复现同样结果：49 对样本，紧致度相同，且最难的击败模式一致。
AI.conclusion: 这类成对样本揭示了义务条款自身措辞停止起决定作用的区域，正是部署于该义务下的智能体必须被测试的地方；该搜索的发现成本随边界规模而非文本规模增长，从而以更高样本效率支撑监管红队工作。

title: Backward-Consistent Diffusion Sampling for Sparsely Observed PDE Inverse Problems
summary: Recovering Partial Differential Equation (PDE) coefficient fields from extremely sparse observations is a severely ill-posed inverse problem for which generative machine learning methods (e.g., diffusion models) have become a leading way to encode the prior. Recent state-of-the-art diffusion solvers lift these priors to function spaces, finding a physics-consistent reconstruction in the output space of the diffusion denoiser. We prove that, in a discontinuous PDE setting, output space methods can result in failure to appropriately minimize the unobserved error with the correct coefficient field. Consequently, we propose Function space Backward-Consistent Sampling (FunBCS), an input space optimization approach for solving PDE problems which aims to find the best input such that the denoiser reconstruction is physics-consistent. We then prove that FunBCS appropriately minimizes the unobserved error, unlike output space optimization methods. Per our theoretical analysis, we also provide insights on how to dynamically allocate the number of input space optimization steps used throughout the sampling process. Our evaluations, across four PDE inverse problems (including the discontinuous Darcy flow), demonstrate that FunBCS reduces the reconstruction error by $27$-$64\%$ while running $1.4$-$2.1\times$ faster when compared to the current state-of-the-art.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FunBCS（函数空间反向一致采样），一种输入空间优化方法，用于从极稀疏观测中恢复 PDE 系数场，理论证明其能正确最小化未观测误差，并在四个反问题中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 从极稀疏观测恢复 PDE 系数场是严重病态的逆问题，需依赖生成式先验（如扩散模型）。当前最新扩散求解器在去噪器的输出空间寻找物理一致的解，但在不连续的 PDE 情形下，输出空间方法可能无法正确最小化未观测误差，导致重建失败。
AI.method: 作者首先证明在不连续 PDE 设置下，输出空间方法可能无法用正确的系数场最小化未观测误差。为此提出 FunBCS：一种输入空间优化方法，寻找最优输入使去噪器重建满足物理一致性。随后证明 FunBCS 能正确最小化未观测误差。基于理论分析，还给出在采样过程中动态分配输入空间优化步数的策略。
AI.result: 在四个 PDE 反问题（包括不连续 Darcy 流）上的评估显示，与当前最先进方法相比，FunBCS 将重建误差降低 27%–64%，同时运行速度快 1.4–2.1 倍。
AI.conclusion: 输入空间优化在理论上优于输出空间优化，能正确最小化未观测误差，并在实际 PDE 逆问题中同时实现更高的精度与更高的效率。

title: Not Self-Decidable: LLMs Cannot Draw the Boundary of What an Agent Verifier Can Check
comment: Accepted at the Who Verifies the Agents? Workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Workshop papers are non-archival. 21 pages (9 content pages plus references and appendices)
summary: A verifier for an agent faces rules of two kinds: the ones a fixed check can settle and the ones that require a judge. A team that derives its own checks fixes that split up front. Where the requirements come from outside, as in finance, healthcare and law, the agent enforces rules it did not write, so the split falls to runtime, recurring for every predicate of every rule on every action at a rate no reviewer can audit. Every escalation scheme assumes a model can make that decision itself, that it is self-decidable. Across six corpora, including the EU AI Act, FINRA guidance and a deployed credit agent, we collect roughly 22,000 labels from four models built by three labs. They agree almost perfectly where the answer is obvious and collapse on regulatory text; their errors run in opposite directions, so no model can be trusted as the conservative choice; and on the deployed agent's own rule-set they err together, over-claiming that a fixed check will do, the direction that never gets escalated. We introduce CoVer (corroborate-then-verify), which treats unanimity as a nomination, admitting a predicate only when the check synthesized for it survives intervention, reading fields the agent cannot write and holding under deterministic rewording. That gate rejects most of what corroboration wrongly admits, at a cost in coverage we report rather than tune away. The obvious alternative, agreement with a reference judge, certifies nothing: it climbs from 30% to 77% across calibration bands while the genuinely decidable share does not move, because a judge drawn from the population under indictment ratifies the blind spot it shares. Self-decidability is not a capability to elicit from a model but a boundary the verifier must construct.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CoVer（corroborate-then-verify）框架，通过"先取证、后验证"的门控机制，将"自可判定性"从模型能力问题重构为验证器必须构建的边界，从而可靠地区分可由固定检查裁决的规则与需要裁判的规则。
AI.motivation: 面对来自外部（金融、医疗、法律）的规则，代理必须执行并非自己编写的规则，因此"哪些谓词可由固定检查裁决、哪些需要裁判"的划分只能落在运行时，且需对每条规则、每个动作、每个谓词反复判断，规模远超人工审查能力。现有升级（escalation）方案假设模型能自行做出该判断（即"自可判定性"），但这一假设未被验证。
AI.method: 在六个语料库（含欧盟 AI 法案、FINRA 指南及一个已部署的信贷代理）上，从三个实验室的四个模型收集约 22,000 条标注，检验模型对"可否由固定检查裁决"的判断一致性。提出 CoVer：将一致性视为"提名"，仅当针对该谓词合成的检查能通过干预测试、读取代理无法写入的字段、并在确定性改写下保持稳定时，才接纳该谓词。同时对比"与参考裁判一致"这一替代方案。
AI.result: 模型在答案明显处几乎完全一致，但在监管文本上崩溃；错误方向相反，故无模型可作为保守选择；在已部署代理的规则集上，模型错误方向一致，过度声称"固定检查即可"，而这一方向恰是永不被升级的方向。CoVer 的门控拒绝了大部分一致性错误接纳的谓词，代价是覆盖率的下降（论文如实报告而非调参掩盖）。与参考裁判一致的方案则毫无认证力：随校准带宽提升从 30% 升至 77%，而真正可判定的比例纹丝不动，因为裁判来自被质疑的群体，会认可其共享的盲区。
AI.conclusion: 自可判定性并非可从模型中引出的能力，而是验证器必须主动构建的边界；CoVer 通过干预、写入隔离与改写稳定性等验证手段实现了这一构建。

title: The Numerical Linear Algebra of Large Language Models
summary:
Numerical Linear Algebra (NLA) has consistently played a vital role in advancing science by providing tools to solve fundamental problems encountered in scientific and engineering applications. Over the decades, it has continually evolved to meet the demands driven by successive waves of scientific discovery. For instance, during the 1950s and 1960s, substantial efforts were devoted to developing methods for solving eigenvalue problems that emerged from the rapidly growing field of aerodynamics. This led to the discovery of the LR and QR algorithms. Later the attention turned to the solution of sparse linear systems that were common in applications like computational aerodynamics. Today we are experiencing yet another wave of major scientific advancement and NLA is once more at the heart of its development. This Machine Learning (ML) wave is proving to be utterly disruptive in science and engineering. Many tools in ML particularly Large Language Models (LLMs) are grounded in matrix and tensor methods. As we are approaching Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), it is clear that matrix methods will be called to play an even more significant role. For the numerical linear practitioner the speed of the current change makes it particularly challenging to adapt.
  This is a survey article that centers on machine learning techniques, with a particular focus on large language models. It has two main objectives. The first is to clarify the core concepts behind Large Language Models in a manner accessible to specialists in numerical methods. The second is to examine the key Numerical Linear Algebra concepts employed by LLM techniques, while also highlighting several significant recent contributions of NLA to the field.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇综述文章，聚焦机器学习技术（尤其是大语言模型），旨在向数值方法专家阐明大语言模型的核心概念，并审视大语言模型所依赖的关键数值线性代数概念，梳理数值线性代数领域对该领域的近期重要贡献。
AI.motivation: 数值线性代数（NLA）长期为科学与工程应用提供解决问题的工具，并随科学发现的浪潮不断演进（如20世纪五六十年代因空气动力学需求催生了LR与QR算法，随后转向稀疏线性系统）。当前机器学习浪潮具有颠覆性，其中许多工具（尤其大语言模型）建立在矩阵与张量方法之上。随着迈向AGI，矩阵方法的作用将更为重要。但当前变化速度极快，使数值线性代数从业者难以适应，因此需要一篇连接NLA与ML/LLM的综述。
AI.method: 本文为综述文章，采用调研与梳理的方式，围绕机器学习技术展开，重点聚焦大语言模型。
AI.result: 文章围绕两个主要目标展开：一是以数值方法专家易于理解的方式阐明大语言模型背后的核心概念；二是审视大语言模型技术所采用的关键数值线性代数概念，并着重介绍NLA对该领域的若干近期重要贡献。
AI.conclusion: 随着以机器学习、大语言模型为代表的新一轮科学变革推进，矩阵与张量方法将发挥愈发重要的作用；数值线性代数与大语言模型正形成深度融合，本篇综述为NLA研究者理解并参与这一变革提供了桥梁。

title: Learning to Clarify Underspecified Intents Under Limited Interaction
summary: AI assistants receive requests that leave out information needed for a good outcome, for example about users' preferences or goals. They must then either speculate or ask for more information before proceeding. We reconceptualize this as a value-of-information problem: the assistant should acquire information whose absence causes the greatest avoidable loss in user utility. This is rarely known ex ante; rather, assistants must predict it in order to optimally allocate limited user interactions. We instantiate this problem in image generation and derive a reinforcement learning framework using multi-turn simulated users to maximize utility recovery under uncertainty. In a preregistered study with 456 interactive sessions across 76 human participants, this helped users significantly better match reference images with significantly fewer questions, less total interaction time, and lower cost. This points toward a simple and scalable framework for training language model assistants to better disambiguate user intent by asking more informative questions.

AI.tldr: 该论文将"助手需在信息不全时决定是否追问"重构为信息价值(Value-of-Information)问题，并在图像生成任务中用强化学习框架训练助手，通过多轮模拟用户最大化效用恢复；在456次交互、76名被试的预注册实验中，显著提升匹配度并减少提问次数、时间与成本。
AI.motivation: AI助手的用户请求常缺失偏好或目标等关键信息，助手此时要么猜测、要么追问。如何最优地分配有限的用户交互来获取最有价值的信息，缺乏明确的问题建模与训练方法。
AI.method: 将信息获取重构为信息价值问题：助手应获取那些"缺失会导致最大可避免效用损失"的信息；由于该价值事前未知，助手需进行预测。作者在图像生成任务中实例化该问题，构建基于强化学习的框架，使用多轮模拟用户，在不确定性下最大化效用恢复。随后开展预注册人类研究（76名参与者，456次交互会话）进行验证。
AI.result: 相比基线，该方法帮助用户显著更好地匹配参考图像，同时提问次数显著更少、总交互时间更短、成本更低。
AI.conclusion: 这指向一种简单且可扩展的框架，用于训练语言模型助手通过提出更具信息量的提问来更好地澄清用户意图。

title: Policy as Data: Replay-Based Policy Dual Averaging via Advantage Regression
summary: Actor-critic methods reuse past experience to improve sample efficiency. However, historical data are typically regarded as off-policy samples for the current policy-improvement update. This work introduces Regularized Dual Averaging Actor Critic (RDA2C), which assigns a distinct role to replay. In regularized dual averaging, the subsequent policy is determined by accumulated policy-improvement feedback, so historical advantage estimates contribute directly to the actor objective rather than solely to the most recent update. RDA2C stores state-action samples with critic-estimated advantage labels, fits a dual score model $Z_θ$ to the aggregated dataset, and derives the current policy from the accumulated score model using the entropy mirror map. In this way, replay defines an empirical dual objective from which the policy is computed. To analyze RDA2C, we establish a finite-time value-gap decomposition, separating the regularized dual-averaging term from errors due to stale-replay supervised fitting, critic bias, finite-buffer variance, and replay coverage, and stating the assumptions under which each error is bounded. RDA2C accepts advantage labels from any critic. With GAE labels, RDA2C outperforms PPO on six of eight MuJoCo tasks and eight of twelve Atari games. RDA2C also outperforms AAPDA, the closest dual-averaging baseline, on six of eight MuJoCo tasks. With twin-$Q$ labels, RDA2C matches SAC at matched batch size and update frequency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RDA2C，将经验回放从"离策略样本"重新定位为定义经验对偶目标的聚合数据集，通过对偶评分模型与熵镜像映射从累积优势反馈中直接导出策略，并给出有限时间价值间隙分解。
AI.motivation: 传统actor-critic方法虽通过复用历史经验提升样本效率，但将历史数据仅视为当前策略改进更新的离策略样本，历史优势估计只作用于最近一次更新，未能充分发挥回放数据的作用。
AI.method: 提出Regularized Dual Averaging Actor Critic（RDA2C）。在正则化对偶平均框架下，后续策略由累积的策略改进反馈决定，历史优势估计直接进入actor目标。具体地，存储带critic估计优势标签的状态-动作样本，用聚合数据集拟合对偶评分模型Z_θ，再通过熵镜像映射从累积评分模型导出当前策略，使回放定义了一个用于计算策略的经验对偶目标。
AI.result: 建立有限时间价值间隙分解，将正则化对偶平均项与陈旧回放监督拟合误差、critic偏差、有限缓冲方差、回放覆盖误差分离，并给出各误差有界的假设。RDA2C可接受任意critic的优势标签：使用GAE标签时在8个MuJoCo任务中的6个和12个Atari游戏中的8个上优于PPO；在8个MuJoCo任务中的6个上优于最接近的对偶平均基线AAPDA；使用twin-Q标签时在匹配批大小与更新频率下与SAC持平。
AI.conclusion: RDA2C通过将回放重新解释为经验对偶目标的定义者，使历史优势反馈持续作用于策略计算，并具备理论误差分解与跨任务、跨标签来源的经验验证，为actor-critic中的回放利用提供了新视角。

title: PyINE: A Framework for Scalable Elicitation and Oversight via Code Execution
summary: Reasoning models can remain capable of solving a task while still defaulting to cheaper but misleading shortcuts. This creates a central oversight problem: when a model gives an answer with plausible but incomplete reasoning, can an overseer determine whether that output should be trusted? To study this problem, we introduce PyINE, a framework for scalable elicitation and oversight using instrumented Python programs as a verifiable execution substrate. In PyINE, programs define task environments, execution traces provide authoritative labels for outcomes and intermediate facts, and task variants can be generated mechanically rather than through static human annotation. We instantiate the framework in PyINE-v1, a first release built from nearly one million deterministic execution traces and over 500,000 matched LLM-generated code variants used for counterfactual evaluation. Using standard RL with verifiable rewards on cue-varied tasks, we train a shortcut-following model that improves substantially at predicting execution outcomes while still making systematic errors when misleading human-facing cues conflict with the program's realized behavior. We then evaluate activation probes, trained text classifiers, prompted judges, and a lightweight debate protocol as overseers of this model. We find that performance pooled at the dataset level can hide weak coverage of the failures that matter most: cheap learned overseers often miss rare shortcut-driven errors, while stronger model-based checks are more balanced but substantially costlier and harder to turn into reliable thresholded decisions. PyINE-v1 turns this failure-mode coverage problem into a reusable experimental setting for developing oversight methods that are verifiable, failure-mode-aware, and cost-sensitive.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 PyINE 框架及其首个实例 PyINE-v1，利用可插桩的 Python 程序作为可验证执行基底，研究推理模型中"捷径驱动错误"的监督难题，并系统评估了多种监督方法在故障模式覆盖与成本上的权衡。
AI.motivation: 推理模型可能表面上能完成任务，却默认采用更省力但有误导性的捷径。当模型给出看似合理但推理不完整的答案时，监督者难以判断该输出是否可信。现有评估往往缺乏可验证的、可机械生成的任务变体与权威标签，因此需要一个新的实验框架来系统研究这一监督问题。
AI.method: 作者提出 PyINE 框架，用可插桩的 Python 程序定义任务环境，通过执行轨迹提供结果与中间事实的权威标签，并机械生成任务变体。基于近百万条确定性执行轨迹和超过 50 万条匹配的 LLM 生成代码变体，构建了 PyINE-v1。采用带可验证奖励的标准 RL 在提示线索变化任务上训练一个"遵循捷径"的模型，再以激活探针、训练文本分类器、提示式评判器和轻量级辩论协议作为监督者进行评估。
AI.result: 训练出的捷径遵循模型在预测执行结果上有显著提升，但当误导性的人类面向线索与程序实际行为冲突时，仍会犯系统性错误。评估发现，数据集层面的聚合性能会掩盖对关键失败模式的弱覆盖：廉价的学习型监督者常漏掉罕见的捷径驱动错误，而更强的基于模型的检查虽更均衡，但成本显著更高且难以转化为可靠的阈值化决策。
AI.conclusion: PyINE-v1 将"失败模式覆盖"问题转化为可复用的实验环境，为开发可验证、故障模式感知且成本敏感的监督方法提供了基础。

title: Revisiting the Generalization of Neural Graph Edit Distance Models
summary: Neural approaches to Graph Edit Distance (GED) have achieved strong results under standard within-dataset evaluation, but much less is known about how well these models transfer across graph collections. We conduct a systematic study of this problem using exact GED supervision across diverse graph datasets and a broad set of representative learning-based methods. Our results reveal a pronounced gap between within-collection performance and cross-collection transfer. Models that perform well on their training collections often lose this advantage when evaluated on structurally different data. Training on multiple source collections substantially improves zero-shot transfer and provides a better starting point when limited supervision is available for a new target collection. Further analysis shows that transfer behavior varies with the source--target direction and the structural characteristics of the collections involved. These findings suggest that conventional within-collection evaluation provides only a partial view of the generalization behavior of neural GED models and motivate broader evaluation across heterogeneous graph collections.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了神经图编辑距离(GED)模型的跨图集合迁移问题，发现数据集内性能与跨集合迁移能力存在明显差距，多源训练可显著提升零样本迁移效果。
AI.motivation: 现有神经GED方法在标准的数据集内评估中表现优异，但其跨图集合的迁移能力尚不清楚。传统评估方式只能提供对模型泛化行为的部分认识，因此需要更广泛的异构图集合评估。
AI.method: 使用精确GED监督，在多种图数据集上对一系列代表性学习方法进行系统性研究；考察数据集内性能与跨集合迁移的差异，并测试多源集合训练对零样本迁移及有限监督场景下新目标集合的影响，同时分析源-目标方向和图集合结构特征对迁移行为的作用。
AI.result: 数据集内性能与跨集合迁移之间存在显著差距；在训练集合上表现良好的模型在结构不同的数据上常失去优势；多源训练大幅改善零样本迁移，并为有限监督下的新目标集合提供更好的起点；迁移行为随源-目标方向及集合结构特征而变化。
AI.conclusion: 传统的数据集内评估仅能部分反映神经GED模型的泛化行为，应推动在异构图集合上进行更广泛的评估。

title: Toward a Locally Deployable Agentic Co-Scientist: Small-Model Planning for Early-Stage Drug Discovery
comment: 22 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at the AI for Drug Discovery Workshop, NeurIPS 2026
summary: Early-stage computational drug discovery requires coordinating heterogeneous scientific tools across multi-step workflows. We present a lightweight, tool-augmented framework in which a locally deployable compact language model plans calls to 18 modular tools. A Unified Molecular Schema maintains shared molecular records, while a plug-in interface supports tool replacement and extension. We construct 1,263 manually refined query-plan pairs through workflow-graph path coverage and apply LoRA fine-tuning to three compact model families. Under the query-level split, all fine-tuned models generate fully parseable and schema-compliant plans on 47 held-out cross-group queries. Llama 3.2-3B achieves a tool-selection F1 of 0.998, sequence exact match of 0.979, and argument F1 of 0.960. Under the stricter workflow-grouped split, which excludes identical ordered tool sequences across partitions, sequence exact match reaches 0.452 to 0.548, highlighting the remaining difficulty for compact models in generating complete workflow paths unseen during training. These results demonstrate the feasibility of compact, locally deployable planning while identifying compositional generalization as an important direction for further improvement.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个轻量、工具增强的早期药物发现规划框架：本地可部署的小型语言模型通过18个模块化工具进行规划调用，结合统一分子Schema与插件接口，并用1,263条精炼查询-计划对进行LoRA微调。结果显示微调模型能生成可解析且符合Schema的计划，但在更严格的workflow-grouped划分下序列完全匹配率大幅下降，说明组合泛化仍是难点。
AI.motivation: 早期计算药物发现需要在多步工作流中协调多种异构科学工具，现有方案可能依赖大型模型或云端部署，难以本地化、轻量化地完成规划任务，因此需要探索小型可部署模型的可行性。
AI.method: 构建工具增强框架，由本地可部署的小型语言模型规划对18个模块化工具的调用；使用统一分子Schema维护共享分子记录，并通过插件接口支持工具替换与扩展；基于工作流图路径覆盖构建1,263条人工精炼的查询-计划对，对三个小型模型系列进行LoRA微调。
AI.result: 在query-level划分下，所有微调模型在47条跨组保留查询上均能生成完全可解析且符合Schema的计划；Llama 3.2-3B达到工具选择F1 0.998、序列完全匹配0.979、参数F1 0.960。在更严格的workflow-grouped划分下（排除分区之间相同的有序工具序列），序列完全匹配降至0.452至0.548。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了紧凑、本地可部署规划的可行性，同时指出组合泛化是小模型生成训练中未见完整工作流路径时的重要改进方向。

title: Gated Target Propagation for Compositional Generalization in Continual Learning
summary: Continual learning is typically framed as acquiring new knowledge without catastrophically forgetting previous tasks. However, a flexible continual learner should also be able to reuse and recombine previously acquired knowledge to rapidly solve novel task compositions. We introduce Gated Target Propagation (GaTaP), a continual learning algorithm in which task-specific gating variables---learned through a closed-form inner loop update---selectively suppress or enhance network modules. Network parameters are learned in a slower timescale outer loop, using the same local difference target propagation error signal as is used for adapting gating variables. We provide tractable experiments on class-incremental learning scenarios for both multilayer perceptron and convolutional network architectures. We show strong performance retention on previously learned tasks, as well as compositional generalization to unseen tasks, achieved through few-shot gain adaptation at inference. We analyze learned gating patterns and find that related tasks exhibit similar gating patterns, suggesting that inferred gates capture meaningful, reusable task structure. Overall, GaTaP provides a powerful framework for jointly ameliorating catastrophic forgetting and enabling few-shot compositional generalization in neural network models.

AI.tldr: GaTaP 通过任务特定门控变量（闭式内循环）与慢速外循环参数学习，结合目标传播误差信号，在类增量学习中同时缓解灾难性遗忘并实现小样本组合泛化。
AI.motivation: 持续学习通常只关注「学新不忘旧」，但灵活的持续学习器还应能复用、重组已有知识以快速解决新任务组合。论文希望同时解决灾难性遗忘与组合泛化两个问题。
AI.method: 提出 Gated Target Propagation (GaTaP)：任务特定门控变量通过闭式内循环更新，选择性地抑制或增强网络模块；网络参数在较慢时间尺度的外循环中学习，两者使用相同的局部差分目标传播（difference target propagation）误差信号。在 MLP 与 CNN 上做类增量学习实验。
AI.result: 在先前任务上保持较强性能，且通过对门控进行推理时的小样本增益自适应，实现对未见任务的组合泛化；分析学习到的门控模式发现相关任务呈现相似门控，说明推断出的门控捕捉到可复用的任务结构。
AI.conclusion: GaTaP 为联合缓解灾难性遗忘并实现小样本组合泛化提供了有力框架。

title: Formalizing the Moral Evaluation of Speech Acts: Truthfulness, Lies and Ethical Dilemmas
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 27th International Conference on Principles and Practice of Multi-Agent Systems (PRIMA 2026). Kumamoto, Japan
summary: In life-or-death situations, a benevolent lie may appear more moral than telling the truth. Yet such lies can backfire, producing unintended and sometimes fatal consequences. This tension, famously disputed by Kant and Constant in 1797, applies not only to lying but to assertive speech acts in general, raising the question of which utterance should be chosen when moral stakes are high. We present a logical framework for the ethical evaluation of speech-act utterances based on agents' beliefs. Implemented in Answer Set Programming (ASP), the framework assesses utterances under deontologism, consequentialism, and principialism, and is illustrated on Sartre's The Wall (1939), a reworking of that controversy in which lying leads alternately to rescue and to death. Our setting is general by design: as two variants show, accommodating a new moral situation amounts to adjusting parameters, not rules.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于智能体信念的言语行为伦理评估逻辑框架，并用回答集编程（ASP）实现，在道义论、后果论和原则主义下评估言语行为，以萨特《墙》为例展示其通用性。
AI.motivation: 在生死攸关的情境中，善意的谎言可能比真话显得更道德，但也可能事与愿违、造成致命后果。这一康德与贡斯当在1797年争论的张力不仅适用于说谎，也适用于一般断言性言语行为，从而引出在高道德风险下应选择何种话语的问题。作者希望建立一个能够对此进行伦理评估的通用框架。
AI.method: 作者提出一个基于智能体信念的言语行为伦理评估逻辑框架，并使用回答集编程（ASP）实现。该框架在道义论、后果论和原则主义三种伦理理论下对言语行为进行评估，并以萨特1939年《墙》为案例进行说明——《墙》是对该争论的改写，其中说谎交替导致救援与死亡。框架被设计为通用的：如两个变体所示，容纳新的道德情境只需调整参数而非规则。
AI.result: 框架在ASP中实现，并在《墙》这一案例上成功展示了在道义论、后果论和原则主义下的言语行为评估。两个变体进一步表明，适应新的道德情境只需调整参数而无需修改规则，验证了框架的通用性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一个通用的、基于信念的逻辑框架，用于对言语行为进行伦理评估，可跨不同伦理理论运作，并能通过参数调整灵活适应新道德情境，为言语行为的伦理分析提供了形式化工具。

title: Pareto-Improving Adversarial Attacks with Primal-Dual Regularization
summary: Transferable adversarial attacks are arguably the most practical black-box threat model. Under the same perturbation budget, stronger transfer attacks attain higher attack success rate (ASR), yet their imperceptibility also tends to degrade. Under such a fixed-budget protocol, transferability and imperceptibility therefore appear to trade off against each other. We argue that this conflict is an artifact of fixed-budget evaluation, not an intrinsic trade-off. When attacks are compared on the ASR--imperceptibility Pareto frontier obtained by sweeping $ε$, stronger transfer attacks already attain better imperceptibility at matched ASR than weaker ones. To exploit this latent advantage, we introduce the stealthy transfer attack ST, a plug-in primal-dual wrapper that adds an $L_\infty$ saturation regularizer to the standard constrained objective and resolves it through a two-step primal-dual update: a projected primal step on the perturbation coupled with an $L_1$-ball projection on a dual variable that absorbs the regularizer through Fenchel duality, requiring no auxiliary models or handcrafted perceptual priors. Empirically, ST extends the Pareto frontier across different base attacks and additional surrogate architectures. At $ε{=}16/255$, average imperceptibility gains over each base attack are $17\%$ on LPIPS and $14\%$ on NIQE while ASR is preserved or improved. At matched high-ASR levels, the strongest ST variants further Pareto-dominate dedicated stealth-oriented transfer attacks, confirming that the latent imperceptibility advantage of strong transfer attacks can be unlocked by a primal-dual optimization wrapper without sacrificing transferability. Code will be made available at \url{https://github.com/AndssY/ST}.

AI.tldr: 本文将"迁移性与不可感知性的权衡"归因于固定预算评估的假象，提出即插即用的原始-对偶框架ST，在保持或提升攻击成功率的同时显著增强迁移攻击的隐蔽性。
AI.motivation: 在相同扰动预算下，迁移性更强的对抗攻击其不可感知性往往更差，以往认为二者存在固有矛盾。本文认为这是固定预算评估造成的假象：若在通过扫描ε得到的ASR-不可感知性帕累托前沿上比较，强迁移攻击在同ASR下其实已具备更好的不可感知性。
AI.method: 提出ST（stealthy transfer attack），一种即插即用的原始-对偶包装器：在标准约束目标中加入L∞饱和正则项，通过两步原始-对偶更新求解——对扰动做投影原始步，对偶变量做L1球投影并经Fenchel对偶吸收正则项，无需辅助模型或手工感知先验。
AI.result: ST在不同基攻击与额外替代架构上扩展了帕累托前沿；在ε=16/255时，相对各基攻击LPIPS平均提升17%、NIQEE提升14%，ASR保持或提升；在同等高ASR水平下，最强的ST变体进一步帕累托支配专门的隐蔽导向迁移攻击。
AI.conclusion: 强迁移攻击潜在的不可感知性优势可通过原始-对偶优化包装器被释放，而无需牺牲迁移性，说明迁移性与不可感知性之间并非固有冲突。

title: Agentic discovery of blood biomarker from distilled private health records
summary: Routine complete blood counts (CBCs) could yield new biomarkers, but the private records needed to evaluate candidates cannot be shared with frontier language model agents that excel at discovery. We distilled the evidence held in the Clalit Health Services panel of over 5.4 million patients into a released scoring tool: for each of 13 immune-mediated diseases, a graph attention network was trained inside the data boundary to predict the case-control AUC of candidate CBC expressions, and only the trained weights were released. The tool grounds an agent's propose-score-refine loop in real-world data without exposing any patient data. In external validation, agent-discovered expressions improved on their literature-seeded starting points by a median of 4.18 AUC percentage points, and across three independent cohorts, reranking the candidates of three frontier research tools improved on their first choices in most comparisons, with gains that varied by cohort. The released scorer supports privacy-preserving biomarker hypothesis generation.

AI.tldr: 该研究将Clalit健康服务540万患者私有数据"蒸馏"为一个可发布的评分工具：在数据边界内为13种免疫介导疾病训练图注意力网络，预测候选全血细胞计数（CBC）表达式的病例对照AUC，仅发布训练权重。该工具使语言模型智能体能在不接触患者数据的前提下进行"提议—评分—精炼"循环。外部验证中，智能体发现的表达式较文献起点中位提升4.18个AUC百分点，并在三个独立队列中多数情况下改进了三个前沿研究工具的首选结果。发布的评分器支持隐私保护的生物标志物假设生成。
AI.motivation: 常规全血细胞计数（CBC）有潜力提供新的生物标志物，但评估候选指标所需的私有病历无法与擅长发现的前沿语言模型智能体共享，隐私限制与智能体发现能力之间存在矛盾。
AI.method: 将Clalit健康服务超过540万患者面板中的证据蒸馏为一个可发布的评分工具：针对13种免疫介导疾病，在数据边界内部训练图注意力网络，用于预测候选CBC表达式的病例对照AUC，仅释放训练后的权重；该工具为智能体的"提议—评分—精炼"循环提供真实世界数据支撑，而不暴露任何患者数据。
AI.result: 在外部验证中，智能体发现的表达式较其文献启发的起点中位提升4.18个AUC百分点；在三个独立队列中，对三个前沿研究工具的候选进行重排序，在多数比较中优于其首选结果，且增益因队列而异。
AI.conclusion: 所发布的评分器支持隐私保护的生物标志物假设生成。

title: Path Laplacian Encodings for Directed Graphs
summary: Directed graphs naturally model many real-world systems in which interactions are asymmetric, such as citation networks, web graphs, and information-flow networks. However, graph learning methods commonly rely on message passing with symmetrized graph representations or positional encodings that only partially exploit edge directionality. We introduce PathLapPE, a novel spectral positional encoding (PE) derived from the path Laplacian on directed graphs. PathLapPE provides node- and edge-level features that encode directional higher-order structure and can be incorporated into standard graph learning architectures. Empirical results on node- and graph-level benchmark tasks show that PathLapPE yields consistent improvements across several architectures, especially when combined with direction-aware message passing. Compared with magnetic Laplacian positional encodings, a widely studied spectral positional encoding for directed graphs, PathLapPE does not require additional fine-tuning of directionality hyperparameters while offering competitive runtime and performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 PathLapPE，一种基于有向图路径拉普拉斯算子的谱位置编码，能编码方向性高阶结构，在节点级和图级任务上带来稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 现实系统中有向图的边具有非对称性（如引文网络、网页图、信息流网络），但常见图学习方法依赖对称化图表示的消息传递，或使用仅部分利用边方向性的位置编码，未能充分挖掘方向信息。
AI.method: 从有向图上的路径拉普拉斯算子出发，设计新的谱位置编码 PathLapPE，提供节点级与边级特征，可编码有向高阶结构，并能直接嵌入标准图学习架构中。
AI.result: 在节点级与图级基准任务上，PathLapPE 在多种架构中均带来一致提升，与方向感知消息传递结合时效果尤为明显；相比磁拉普拉斯位置编码，无需额外微调方向性超参数，且运行时间和性能具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: PathLapPE 为有向图提供了一种有效且易用的谱位置编码方案，弥补了现有方法对方向性利用不足的问题，兼具性能与效率优势。

title: Dynamic Routing as a New Dimension for Test-time Versatility of LLMs
summary: Beyond scaling their parameters and data, large language models currently gain versatility on new problems along a single axis: the tokens they spend on chain-of-thought (CoT). We investigate whether dynamic routing programs, which execute a subset of the model's layers or iterate some of them, can open a second axis of test-time adaptation, complementary to CoT and free of any gradient update. Prior work showed that such programs exist and bring accuracy and efficiency gains on problems similar to those they were trained on; we ask whether they can also be identified rapidly, from a handful of demonstrations (3 or 10), by a strategy that transfers across models and tasks without training. First, we find that strategies that select programs by the probability they assign to the demonstrations' labels, arbitrated by the model's own confidence, bring consistent gains: on average over the 49 tasks of MMLU and substantially on four of seven models, and most of all on far out-of-distribution tasks such as ARC-AGI, where programs double the accuracy of a 7B model whose CoT fails. Second, on MMLU across the seven post-trained models, routing complements CoT in practice: the two succeed on different queries, and their composition exceeds CoT alone. Despite these gains, our analyses show that confidence-based selection leaves much of the potential untapped, in two places in particular: (1) in surfacing the routing potential that is already present early in pre-training but becomes harder to select after post-training, and (2) in making models robust to the refinements routing introduces, since unsuccessful routes tend to drive the residual stream out of the distribution that the following layers expect. Together, our results point to dynamic routing as a paradigm for extending the plasticity of existing and future LLMs in rapid test-time adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究动态路由程序（执行模型部分层或迭代某些层）是否能作为思维链（CoT）之外的第二条测试时适应轴，发现基于示例标签概率并用模型自身置信度仲裁的选择策略可在无需梯度更新、跨模型跨任务迁移的情况下带来稳定增益。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型目前提升新问题适应性的唯一途径是增加CoT所消耗的token。作者希望探索是否存在第二条测试时适应轴——动态路由程序，且该路由能在仅用少量示例（3或10个）、无需训练、可跨模型跨任务迁移的条件下被快速识别。
AI.method: 提出基于概率的选择策略：按路由程序对示例标签赋予的概率来挑选程序，并用模型自身的置信度进行仲裁；在MMLU的49个任务以及7个模型上进行评估，并测试在ARC-AGI等分布外任务上的表现，同时分析路由与CoT的互补性以及失败路由对残差流的影响。
AI.result: 该策略在MMLU上平均带来一致增益，在7个模型中的4个上表现显著；在ARC-AGI等分布外任务上，程序使CoT失败的7B模型准确率翻倍。在MMLU的7个后训练模型上，路由与CoT在实践中互补：二者在不同查询上成功，组合效果超过单独使用CoT。分析显示置信度选择仍有两处未充分挖掘的潜力：早期预训练中已存在的路由潜力在后训练后更难被选出，以及模型对路由引入的细化不够鲁棒，失败路由会使残差流偏离后续层期望的分布。
AI.conclusion: 动态路由可作为一种范式，用于在快速测试时适应中扩展现有及未来大语言模型的可塑性。

title: Low-Fidelity FDM Spectral Guidance for Neural Eigenvalue Solvers
summary: Operator eigenvalue problems appear throughout science. Classical methods usually discretize the operator into a matrix and then solve the resulting matrix eigenvalue problem. This works well in low dimensions, but fine grids quickly become expensive in both memory and computation as the dimension grows. Neural network based solvers avoid storing these large grids, but recent state of the art neural methods can require hundreds of thousands of training steps and may struggle to find the desired eigenvalues. We show that the two approaches can help each other. A coarse finite difference method (FDM) calculation acts as a cheap numerical model of the operator spectrum. We use the approximate eigenvalues as fixed shifts during the training of the neural solver, as they only need to locate the relevant part of the spectrum. We also introduce Stabilized Inverse Power Method Neural Network (SIPMNN), a more stable training procedure for higher-dimensional problems. Across five test problems at $d=10$, the combined approach is more accurate overall than the tested fully neural alternatives while using eight to ten times fewer iterations.

AI.tldr: 提出将粗网格有限差分与神经网络求解器结合的方法：用FDM近似特征值作为固定位移指导神经网络训练，并提出更稳定的SIPMNN训练流程，在10维问题上以更少迭代获得更高精度。
AI.motivation: 算子特征值问题广泛存在于科学中。经典矩阵离散化方法在高维时内存与计算开销急剧增大，而纯神经网络方法虽避免了存储大网格，却常需数十万次训练迭代且难以找到目标特征值。作者希望让两种方法互补。
AI.method: 粗网格有限差分（FDM）计算作为算子谱的廉价数值模型，将其近似特征值作为固定位移（shift）用于神经网络求解器训练，只需定位谱的相关部分；同时提出稳定化逆幂法神经网络（SIPMNN），一种对高维问题更稳定的训练流程。
AI.result: 在d=10的五个测试问题上，该组合方法整体精度优于所测试的纯神经网络替代方案，且迭代次数减少8至10倍。
AI.conclusion: 经典数值离散与神经网络求解器可以相互促进；廉价FDM位移结合更稳定的SIPMNN训练，能在高维算子特征值问题上实现更高精度与更高效率。

title: When Is Enough Enough in Self-Evolving LLM Systems?
summary: Self-evolving large language model (LLM) systems repeatedly propose, evaluate, and incorporate updates to prompts, skills, or other persistent artifacts. Despite their growing effectiveness, these systems typically operate under a predetermined iteration or compute budget, without a principled criterion to determine when further evolution is no longer worthwhile. This can lead to two undesirable consequences: unnecessary computation after performance has saturated and the risk of returning late updates that overfit or exploit the evaluation signal. These issues motivate us to study two fundamental questions: when should a self-evolving system stop, and what should it output once it stops? We address the first by formulating an online sequential testing problem and constructing an anytime-valid restart detector using the per-item paired evaluation outcomes already produced by self-evolving LLM systems. We address the second by formulating a change-point estimation problem and using the estimated transition to select an earlier artifact for output. The resulting procedure is plug-and-play and requires no modification of the underlying self-evolving algorithms. Across two self-evolving frameworks, three LLM model families, and five benchmarks, our method substantially reduces computation costs while maintaining comparable unseen-test performance. For example, on SearchQA with SkillOpt and DeepSeek V4 Flash, our method stops at round 4 rather than the full budget of 40, reducing token usage by 91.6% while achieving 82.43% unseen-test accuracy versus 82.00% under the full-budget run.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究自演化LLM系统何时停止以及停止后应输出什么的问题，提出基于在线序贯检验的随时有效重启检测器与变点估计方法来选择早期artifact，在不修改底层算法的前提下显著降低计算成本并保持性能。
AI.motivation: 现有自演化LLM系统通常在预设的迭代或计算预算下运行，缺乏判断继续演化是否还有价值的原则性标准，导致性能饱和后的不必要计算，以及返回过拟合或利用评估信号的后期更新风险。
AI.method: 将"何时停止"建模为在线序贯检验问题，利用自演化系统已产生的逐项配对评估结果构建随时有效的重启检测器；将"输出什么"建模为变点估计问题，利用估计的转变点选择较早的artifact进行输出。整个流程即插即用，无需修改底层自演化算法。
AI.result: 在两个自演化框架、三个LLM模型系列和五个基准上，方法大幅降低计算成本同时保持可比的未见测试性能。例如在SearchQA上使用SkillOpt与DeepSeek V4 Flash，方法在第4轮停止而非完整40轮预算，token使用减少91.6%，未见测试准确率82.43%对比全预算的82.00%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为自演化LLM系统提供了原则性的停止判据与输出选择机制，可即插即用地减少计算浪费并规避后期更新过拟合风险，同时保持性能。

title: Score-Calibrated Flow for Sampling from Unnormalized Densities with Applications to Generative Online Reinforcement Learning
summary: Diffusion and flow models provide expressive policy classes for online reinforcement learning (RL), enabling multimodal behaviors and improved performance. However, training these policies remains challenging: the critic specifies the desired policy as an unnormalized Boltzmann density but does not provide direct samples from it. Many existing methods rely on importance sampling to construct training signals, which can suffer from high variance, increasing computational cost and destabilizing training. We propose Score-Calibrated Flow (SCF), a simple and efficient algorithm for training generative models to sample from unnormalized densities without importance sampling or backpropagation through the sampling trajectory. We learn the desired flow by enforcing self-consistency, bypassing target posterior mean estimation. By jointly exploiting the prescribed target score and the structure of flow matching, we establish these self-consistency requirements as score-calibrated optimality conditions, first for the terminal density and then for the trainable velocity field. We prove that their unique solutions are, respectively, the target density and the ideal flow model that conditional flow matching (CFM) would recover if target samples were available. We formulate the velocity condition as a fixed-point equation and exploit its conditional-expectation structure to construct a stop-gradient objective for enforcing it. The resulting training procedure retains the scalable sample-interpolate-regress structure of CFM despite the absence of target samples, using endpoints generated by the current flow. For online RL, the critic gradient supplies the target score at the generated actions, yielding a direct approach to actor training. Experiments on RL benchmarks demonstrate that SCF matches or improves upon state-of-the-art generative-policy baselines, while substantially reducing training time.

AI.tldr: 提出 Score-Calibrated Flow (SCF)，无需重要性采样或对采样轨迹反向传播，即可训练生成式策略从非归一化密度中采样，用于在线强化学习。
AI.motivation: 扩散与流模型能为在线 RL 提供表达力强的策略类，支持多模态行为并提升性能。但训练困难：critic 仅以未归一化 Boltzmann 密度形式指定目标策略，不直接给出样本。现有方法多依赖重要性采样构造训练信号，方差大、计算成本高且训练不稳定。
AI.method: 通过自一致性学习目标流，绕过目标后验均值估计。联合利用指定目标得分与流匹配结构，建立"得分校准最优性条件"：先针对终端密度，再针对可训练速度场。证明其唯一解分别就是目标密度，以及若有目标样本时 CFM 会恢复的理想流模型。将速度条件写成不动点方程，利用其条件期望结构构造带 stop-gradient 的目标。训练流程保持 CFM 可扩展的 sample-interpolate-regress 结构，用当前流生成的端点替代真实目标样本。在在线 RL 中，critic 梯度在生成动作处提供目标得分，直接用于 actor 训练。
AI.result: 在 RL 基准上，SCF 匹配或超越当前最优生成式策略基线，同时显著缩短训练时间。
AI.conclusion: SCF 为从非归一化密度训练生成模型提供了简单高效的方法，无需重要性采样与轨迹反向传播，直接适用于在线 RL 的 actor 训练。

title: Not All Answers Are Contextually Persuadable: Inference Dynamics in Large Language Models under Contextual Influence
comment: Published in the Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: At the core of modern prompting techniques is contextual sensitivity, the ability of large language models to adapt their predictions based on inference-time context. Despite its central role, inference behavior under strong contextual influence remains poorly understood, particularly at the level of internal inference dynamics. We introduce a theoretical framework for analyzing contextual influence through inference dynamics, enabling quantitative characterization of inference behavior beyond output-level answer changes. Our analysis shows that inference dynamics do not exhibit unbounded drift under repeated contextual assertions.
