summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model on self-generated trajectories, but transmitting dense teacher distributions across long reasoning traces creates prohibitive communication and memory bottlenecks. Practical systems therefore rely on sparse teacher interfaces, typically transmitting either the sampled-token score or a small Top-$k$ distribution. However, this sparse setting faces a fundamental dilemma: sampled-token estimators are unbiased but suffer from severe gradient variance, whereas directly optimizing Top-$k$ objectives introduces systematic bias. To improve this trade-off, we propose ResOPD (On-Policy Distillation with Tail Residualization), which provides unbiased full-vocabulary reverse KL gradient estimation under on-policy sampling, with substantial variance reduction under the same sparse payload in the evaluated settings. ResOPD aggregates the unobserved vocabulary into an observable coarse tail event, computes its exact aggregate gradient, and samples only the fine-grained within-tail residual, which requires no additional teacher queries or forward passes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ResOPD substantially reduces gradient variance, stabilizes online training dynamics, and improves downstream performance across the evaluated settings. These results establish ResOPD as an efficient, plug-and-play variance reduction primitive for sparse on-policy distillation.

AI.tldr: ResOPD通过将未观测词表聚合为可观测的粗粒度尾部事件并精确计算其梯度，仅采样尾部内残差，在同等稀疏传输条件下实现了无偏且低方差的on-policy蒸馏梯度估计。
AI.motivation: on-policy蒸馏在学生自生成轨迹上训练，但跨长推理链传输稠密教师分布会造成通信与内存瓶颈，因此实际系统依赖稀疏教师接口（采样token分数或Top-k分布）。然而稀疏设定存在两难：采样token估计无偏但梯度方差极大，直接优化Top-k目标则引入系统性偏差。
AI.method: 提出ResOPD（带尾部残差化的on-policy蒸馏）：将未观测词表聚合为一个可观测的粗粒度尾部事件，精确计算其聚合梯度，仅对尾部内部残差进行采样；无需额外教师查询或前向计算。
AI.result: 在所评估设定下，ResOPD在相同稀疏载荷下提供无偏的全词表反向KL梯度估计并显著降低方差；大幅减少梯度方差、稳定在线训练动态，并提升下游性能。
AI.conclusion: ResOPD是一种高效、即插即用的方差缩减原语，适用于稀疏on-policy蒸馏。

title: Runtime Authorization of Self-Generated Subgoals in Long-Horizon Tool-Using AI Agents
summary:
Long-horizon tool-using AI agents create subgoals, replan, delegate work, and compose sibling results. Per-tool permission checks cannot establish that a changing goal graph remains within the principal-approved task. We address this authorization gap in a finite structured domain with one principal and one authorization root. Each proposed goal-graph mutation carries a version-bound witness that its continuation traces, resources, obligations, invariants, and closing condition refine the active root contract; every protected effect is rechecked at an atomic commit boundary. Free-form goal text supplies no authority.
  We prove trace-policy and modeled forbidden-state preservation under explicit mediation, abstraction, freshness, and atomicity assumptions, plus conditional root-success preservation, a separation result for memoryless allowlists, exact finite-domain decidability, and universal-safety monotonicity under sound abstraction refinement. An executable model explores 340 states and 419 transitions. Across 96 matched cases covering 25 structural schemas, the complete mechanism commits zero forbidden states in 48 drifted cases and completes all 48 benign counterparts. Two public upstream runtime paths execute 258 native dispatches across 32 cases, with every case-level decision and receipt chain matching. A frozen host-local study covers 129 synthetic one-factor-at-a-time cells, all matching fixed decisions and reasons. A history-aware continuation comparator blocks every modeled bad trace prefix but commits all operations in 11 cases whose violations lie in typed resources, freshness, or explicit-join evidence outside its trace projection. Within the registered structured domains, runtime authorization preserves useful replanning while preventing self-generated subgoals from becoming a source of new authority.

AI.tldr: 提出面向长时程工具智能体的目标图授权机制：每次目标图变更需携带版本绑定的见证，证明其细化当前根契约，所有受保护效果在原子提交边界重检，自由文本目标不提供任何权威。理论证明与可执行模型/多项实验验证了授权有效且保留有用重规划。
AI.motivation: 长时程工具智能体通过创建子目标、重规划、委派与组合兄弟结果来工作，但逐工具权限检查无法保证动态变化的目标图仍处于主体已批准的任务范围内，形成授权缺口。论文在有限结构化域（单主体、单授权根）中解决该缺口。
AI.method: 为每个目标图变更附加版本绑定的见证，证明其延续轨迹、资源、义务、不变量与闭合条件细化当前激活的根契约；在原子提交边界重检受保护效果；自由形式目标文本不携带权威。在显式中介、抽象、新鲜性与原子性假设下进行形式化证明，并构建可执行模型（340 状态、419 转移）进行实验。
AI.result: 证明轨迹策略与建模禁止状态保持、条件性根成功保持、无记忆许可分离结果、有限域精确可判定性及可靠抽象细化下的普遍安全单调性。96 个匹配案例（25 种结构模式）中完整机制在 48 个漂移案例中零禁止状态提交并完成全部 48 个良性对应案例；两条公开上游运行时路径 32 案例 258 次原生分发逐案决策与收据链一致；冻结主机本地研究 129 个合成单因子单元全部匹配固定决策；历史感知比较器阻断所有建模坏轨迹前缀，但对其轨迹投影外的类型化资源、新鲜性或显式连接证据违规的 11 个案例全部提交。
AI.conclusion: 在注册的结构化域内，运行时授权既能保留有用的重规划，又能阻止智能体自生成的子目标成为新权威来源，验证了该机制在授权缺口上的有效性与安全性。

title: SFlexRCA: Lightweight, Scalable, and Flexible Root Cause Analysis for IIoT Edge Systems
summary: Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) systems generate high-dimensional sensor telemetry from interconnected components, where faults can propagate across the system. To address these challenges, we propose SFlexRCA (Scalable and Flexible Root Cause Analysis), a topology-free RCA framework designed for resource-constrained IIoT environments. SFlexRCA transforms multivariate telemetry into compact orthogonal representations and applies shared lightweight linear modeling, avoiding explicit graph construction, message passing, and per-variable or lag-specific parameter growth. We evaluate SFlexRCA on three publicly available IIoT datasets, BATADAL, SWaT, and WADI, spanning different numbers of monitored variables, temporal characteristics, and training-data regimes. SFlexRCA is compared with 10 statistical, causal, and non-causal baselines in terms of RCA accuracy, training efficiency, inference latency, and memory consumption. In addition, inference efficiency and memory consumption are evaluated on Raspberry Pi 3 and Raspberry Pi 5, while energy consumption is additionally measured on Raspberry Pi 5. We further investigate temporalcontext sensitivity, architectural and loss components, and alternative representations. Notably, SFlexRCA maintains strong localization performance on BATADAL despite its limited normal-operation training data, while its compact shared architecture avoids the parameter growth associated with causal and graph-based approaches. Its lightweight shared architecture further enables efficient deployment on resource-constrained IIoT edge devices. The SFlexRCA code is available at https://github.com/theamrzaki/RootCause- Analysis-Correlation-Attentive-Modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出SFlexRCA：一种面向资源受限IIoT的无拓扑根因分析框架，通过正交化紧凑表征与共享轻量线性建模实现高效故障定位。
AI.motivation: IIoT系统产生高维传感器遥测数据，组件相互关联导致故障跨系统传播，根因定位困难；且边缘设备资源受限，传统因果/图方法存在显式图构建、消息传递及随变量或时滞参数增长的高开销问题。
AI.method: SFlexRCA将多变量遥测转化为紧凑正交表示，并采用共享的轻量线性建模，避免显式图构建、消息传递以及按变量或时滞的参数增长，属于无拓扑（topology-free）框架。
AI.result: 在BATADAL、SWaT、WADI三个公开IIoT数据集上，与10种统计、因果及非因果基线比较RCA准确率、训练效率、推理延迟与内存消耗；并在Raspberry Pi 3/5上评估推理效率与内存，在Pi 5上测量能耗；BATADAL在正常训练数据有限的条件下仍保持强定位性能；紧凑共享架构避免了因果与图方法的参数增长。
AI.conclusion: SFlexRCA以轻量共享架构在资源受限的IIoT边缘设备上实现高效部署，兼顾根因定位性能与计算、内存、能耗效率，代码已开源。

title: Do LLMs Understand Sequential Structure? A Controlled Study of Inference and Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as interactive agents and simulators, yet it remains unclear whether they can recover latent sequential structure beyond surface action frequencies. This distinction is critical for behavioral simulation, where actions are often shaped by prior context rather than marginal frequencies alone. We study this question using controlled two-player Rock--Paper--Scissors interactions and a one-player stochastic n-gram continuation task. Across these experiments, we test whether LLMs can identify latent strategies, follow simple Markov rules, and sustain higher-order conditional dependencies. Our framework separates distribution matching from conditional rule following. Results show that longer context does not improve identification, correct recognition does not ensure faithful simulation, and higher-order dependencies substantially degrade rule recovery. Apparent behavioral fidelity can therefore mask incorrect generative mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 研究用受控实验检验大语言模型能否恢复潜在的序列结构，而非仅匹配表面行为频率，发现长上下文、正确识别和高阶依赖各有局限。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型日益被用作交互智能体与行为模拟器，但尚不清楚它们能否超越表面动作频率去恢复潜在的序列结构。这一点对行为模拟至关重要，因为行为往往由先前情境决定，而非仅由边际频率决定。因此需区分"分布匹配"与"条件规则遵循"两种能力。
AI.method: 采用受控的双人石头剪刀布交互，以及单人的随机n-gram续接任务。在这些实验中，检验大语言模型能否识别潜在策略、遵循简单马尔可夫规则、维持更高阶的条件依赖。框架将分布匹配与条件规则遵循分离考察。
AI.result: 更长的上下文并未提升识别效果；正确识别并不能保证忠实的模拟；更高阶依赖显著削弱了规则恢复能力。表面上看似行为逼真，可能掩盖了错误的生成机制。
AI.conclusion: 表征行为逼真性并不等同于正确的生成机制，评估大语言模型作为行为模拟器时需区分分布匹配与条件规则遵循，警惕表面保真性掩盖机制性错误。

title: ScopeSAE: Model-Scope Feature Discovery with Interpretable Layer Selection
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are a central tool in mechanistic interpretability. However, existing SAEs are primarily trained per layer. The modeling subspace is therefore fixed by layer identity, independent of which token-layer states actually drive each prediction. We argue that this constraint contributes to several limitations observed in layer-wise SAEs, including low feature utilization, high dictionary redundancy, and features that lack direct behavioral grounding. In this paper, we propose ScopeSAE, which selects the modeling subspace per token by attributing each prediction to its most influential token-layer state via normalized gradient-based attribution, and learns features over the resulting prediction-relevant subspace. Empirically, ScopeSAE yields an effect we term reconstruction-better-than-original. Written-back reconstructions of the SAE produce lower next-token cross-entropy than the original activations, an outcome that, to our knowledge, has not previously been reported for SAEs. Through interventional analyses and a KL fine-tuning counter-experiment, we show that this effect is attributable to ScopeSAE's prediction-relevant subspace itself rather than to architectural changes. ScopeSAE further improves effective feature count, interpretability, utilization, and dictionary redundancy over existing layer-based baselines, suggesting that choosing the SAE modeling subspace by predictive relevance leads to more useful and behaviorally meaningful features.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ScopeSAE，通过基于归一化梯度归因按 token 选择与预测最相关的 token-层状态子空间来训练稀疏自编码器，缓解逐层 SAE 的局限，并首次报告了“重建优于原始”的现象。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏自编码器（SAE）主要按层训练，建模子空间被层身份固定，与真正驱动每次预测的 token-层状态无关。作者认为该约束导致了逐层 SAE 的诸多局限，如特征利用率低、字典冗余高、特征缺乏直接的行为支撑。
AI.method: 提出 ScopeSAE：通过归一化梯度归因，将每个预测归因到最具影响力的 token-层状态，从而为每个 token 选择建模子空间，并在该“预测相关子空间”上学习特征。
AI.result: ScopeSAE 产生了“重建优于原始”（reconstruction-better-than-original）的效果，即写回重建的下一 token 交叉熵低于原始激活，据作者所知此前未见报道。通过干预分析和 KL 微调对照实验，证明该效果源于预测相关子空间本身而非架构改变。相比逐层基线，ScopeSAE 在有效特征数量、可解释性、利用率和字典冗余方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 按预测相关性选择 SAE 建模子空间可产生更有用且更具行为意义的特征，表明子空间选择方式是提升 SAE 质量的关键因素。

title: CIPO: Counterfactual Imagination Policy Optimization for Adaptive Tool Granularity Selection
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents solve complex tasks through multi-step interactions with external tools. These interactions often contain recurring local tool sequences. Treating such sequences as composite "Skills" can shorten tool-use trajectories and reduce repeated low-level decisions. However, when atomic tools and composite skills coexist, skill use becomes a policy problem: the agent must decide whether the current state requires atomic fine control or skill-level abstraction. In this paper, we argue that effective skill use should be studied as adaptive tool granularity selection. The most direct training signal for this problem is to compare the consequences of atomic and skill choices available from the same state. Based on this view, we propose CIPO, a Counterfactual Imagination Policy Optimization framework for adaptive tool granularity. CIPO constructs executable skills through budget-constrained mining of successful tool-use trajectories and trains granularity decisions with counterfactual branch rollouts. For each base rollout, CIPO branches at the first eligible granularity decision and replaces the chosen action with a feasible atomic or skill alternative. The paired outcome difference serves as a supplementary reward for policy optimization. Experiments across multiple benchmarks and model backbones show that CIPO improves task success and decision efficiency over baselines. Further analyses show that CIPO learns effective skill use by improving the choice between atomic tools and composite skills based on the current state, without simply increasing skill frequency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CIPO，一个面向 LLM 智能体自适应工具粒度选择的策略优化框架，通过反事实分支训练智能体在原子工具与复合技能间做选择，提升任务成功率与决策效率。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体通过多步工具交互完成任务时，常出现重复的局部工具序列，可将其视为复合"技能"以缩短轨迹、减少低层重复决策。但当原子工具与复合技能共存时，智能体面临策略问题：当前状态该用原子级精细控制还是技能级抽象。作者认为应把技能使用研究为"自适应工具粒度选择"问题。
AI.method: 从同一状态比较原子与技能两种选择后果这一最直接的训练信号出发，提出 CIPO 框架：1）通过预算受限的方式从成功工具使用轨迹中挖掘可执行技能；2）用反事实分支 rollout 训练粒度决策——对每个基础 rollout，在首个可用的粒度决策点分支，将所选动作替换为可行的原子或技能替代方案；3）将配对结果差异作为策略优化的补充奖励。
AI.result: 在多个基准和多种模型骨干上的实验表明，CIPO 相比基线提升了任务成功率和决策效率。进一步分析显示，CIPO 是通过改善基于当前状态在原子工具与复合技能之间的选择来学会有效使用技能，而非单纯增加技能使用频率。
AI.conclusion: 有效技能使用应被建模为自适应工具粒度选择问题，利用同一状态下的反事实分支对比作为训练信号是可行且有效的，CIPO 在提升任务表现的同时实现了更优的粒度决策，而非盲目增加技能调用。

title: Why Subliminal Learning Needs So Much Data: A Noisy Inverse View through Steering Vector Recovery
summary: Subliminal learning lets a student inherit a teacher's behavioral trait from semantically unrelated data, yet published demonstrations typically require tens of thousands of carrier examples. We ask where this data requirement comes from. Our testbed is subliminal steering: the teacher trait is a known residual-stream vector $Δ_T$, so transfer can be measured directly as parameter recovery. On identical carrier prefixes, we compare token-level (hard) NLL supervision with full-distribution (soft) KL supervision. At initialization the two objectives give nearly collinear gradients, and both align poorly with $Δ_T$. Under iterative optimization, however, they diverge: soft supervision recovers $Δ_T$ almost exactly from a few hundred carriers, while hard supervision stays well below it even with tens of thousands. We explain this gap by casting steering-vector distillation as a noisy linear inverse problem. Locally, the carrier task maps the trait through its Fisher matrix $F$, so gradients point toward $FΔ_T$ rather than $Δ_T$. Gradient descent then acts as a progressively less-damped inverse of $F$. With soft targets, this inverse restores low-curvature directions. With hard labels, it also amplifies the sampling noise in those same directions. The result is an optimal inversion depth that grows with the number of independent carriers. Experiments on Qwen2.5-7B and Gemma-2-9B confirm four predictions: the Fisher distortion of the initial gradient, recovery ordered from steep to flat directions, an optimal depth that shifts with data scale, and the finding that resampling completions from a fixed prompt pool works as well as adding new prompts. In this setting, large carrier datasets are needed less to reveal the trait than to suppress label noise amplified by Fisher inversion. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/luoyuchenmlcv/subliminal-data}.

AI.tldr: 本文将"阈下引导"任务建模为含噪线性逆问题，揭示软监督（KL）能在数百条载体上近乎精确恢复教师特质向量，而硬监督（NLL）需数万条，差异源于Fisher矩阵逆变换对采样噪声的放大。
AI.motivation: 既往"阈下学习"演示通常需要数万条载体样本才能传递教师的行为特质，本文追问这一数据需求从何而来，以厘清软监督与硬监督在特质传递效率上的本质差异。
AI.method: 构建"阈下引导"测试台，将教师特质设为已知残差流向量Δ_T，以参数恢复程度直接度量传递。在相同载体前缀下对比token级（硬）NLL监督与全分布（软）KL监督，并用含噪线性逆问题框架分析：载体任务通过Fisher矩阵F映射特质，梯度指向FΔ_T，梯度下降逐步充当F的逆。
AI.result: 初始时两种目标的梯度近乎共线且与Δ_T对齐不佳，但迭代后分化：软监督从几百条载体近乎精确恢复Δ_T，硬监督即便数万条仍远低于此。在Qwen2.5-7B与Gemma-2-9B上验证四项预测：初始梯度的Fisher畸变、恢复按陡峭到平坦方向排序、最优迭代深度随数据规模移动、固定提示池重采样完井与添加新提示效果相当。
AI.conclusion: 大数据集的作用并非揭示特质，而是抑制被Fisher逆变换放大的标签噪声；软监督通过逆变换恢复低曲率方向而不放大噪声，从而显著降低数据需求。

title: EmoRSS: Mitigating Emotion-Induced Over-Refusal in Large Language Models
summary: Emotional expression can influence the safety decisions of large language models (LLMs), offering a potential avenue for improving safety alignment. Existing studies have mainly focused on how emotional expressions facilitate attacks under harmful requests, while overlooking their effects on benign requests. We find that emotional expression can also systematically increase refusal tendencies on benign requests, leading to unnecessary over-refusal. Based on this observation, we propose emotion-guided refusal subspace steering (EmoRSS), an activation-steering method that mitigates emotion-induced over-refusal while preserving refusal behaviour on harmful requests. Specifically, we first identify a refusal-sensitive layer using layer-wise linear probes and construct a refusal subspace from sparse autoencoder (SAE) features aligned with the probe direction. Next, we use paired regular and emotional requests with the same queries to estimate the mean activation shift in the features defining the refusal subspace. Finally, we decode this shift into an activation intervention vector and apply it in the reverse refusal direction during inference, without updating the backbone parameters. Experiments on two LLMs show that, when requests contain emotional expressions, our method achieves a more favourable trade-off between refusing harmful requests and answering benign ones than prior over-refusal mitigation baselines, while better preserving general task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文发现情绪表达会系统性地使大模型对良性请求产生过度拒绝，并提出EmoRSS激活引导方法，在保持对有害请求拒绝的同时缓解情绪诱发的过度拒绝。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注情绪表达如何助长有害请求下的攻击，而忽视了其对良性请求的影响。作者发现情绪表达会系统性地提高对良性请求的拒绝倾向，导致不必要的过度拒绝，因此需要一种方法来缓解这一问题。
AI.method: 提出情绪引导拒绝子空间引导方法（EmoRSS）。首先用逐层线性探针识别拒绝敏感层，并基于与探针方向对齐的稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征构建拒绝子空间；然后用相同查询的常规与情绪化请求对，估计拒绝子空间特征的平均激活偏移；最后将该偏移解码为激活干预向量，在推理时沿反向拒绝方向施加，且不更新骨干参数。
AI.result: 在两个大模型上的实验表明，当请求包含情绪表达时，该方法在拒绝有害请求与回答良性请求之间的权衡优于现有的过度拒绝缓解基线，同时更好地保持了通用任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 情绪表达会诱发大模型的过度拒绝，EmoRSS通过拒绝子空间激活引导有效缓解该问题，并在安全性与可用性之间取得更优平衡。

title: Residual Visual Credit Optimization: Conserved Evidence Routing for Multimodal Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards scales multimodal reasoning, but an outcome reward says how much a trajectory is worth, not how that value should be spread over the decisions that produced it. We introduce Residual Visual Credit Optimization (RVCO), which treats token credit as a conserved routing problem. A controlled visual intervention yields a per-token evidence response; robust within-trajectory coordinates remove incidental scale; and a budgeted entropic router distributes a fixed amount of sequence utility according to perceptual dependence. A residual support path guarantees positive credit at every valid position, and an analytic correction restores the prescribed credit mass exactly. The resulting field is selective, bounded, full-support, and invariant to response-local score shifts, and recovers hard token selection as a limiting case. Across four model families and seven reasoning benchmarks, RVCO improves accuracy over strong RLVR baselines while maintaining late-stage optimization stability, corruption robustness, and competitive training cost. Rewards, rollouts, and the group-relative advantage estimator are unchanged; only the geometry of token-level credit differs.

AI.tldr: 本文将令牌级信用分配视为守恒路由问题，提出残差视觉信用优化（RVCO），在不改变奖励与优势估计的前提下重塑令牌信用几何，提升多模态推理性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态推理中，可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的结果奖励只给出轨迹整体价值，无法说明该价值应如何分配到产生它的各个决策（令牌）上，缺乏合理的令牌级信用分配。
AI.method: 提出RVCO：通过受控视觉干预得到每令牌的证据响应；用稳健的轨迹内坐标去除偶然尺度影响；用预算化熵路由器按感知依赖程度分配固定序列效用；残差支撑路径保证每个有效位置获得正信用；解析校正精确恢复规定的信用总量。
AI.result: 所得信用场具有选择性、有界、全支撑、对响应局部分数偏移不变，并可退化为硬令牌选择。在四个模型族和七个推理基准上，RVCO优于强RLVR基线，同时保持后期优化稳定性、损坏鲁棒性与有竞争力的训练成本。
AI.conclusion: 奖励、rollout和群组相对优势估计器均不变，仅改变令牌级信用的几何结构，即可实现更优的多模态推理。

title: How corner is a corner case? Percentile control for highway scenario generation
comment: 30 pages, 13 figures, 8 tables. Project page with videos: https://hhjj233.github.io/CornerPercentile/ Code: https://github.com/hhjj233/P-control-SG
summary:
Generating corner-case scenarios with appropriate adversity in a simulation environment is critical for testing an autonomous vehicle (AV) software stack's safety performance before deployment. Existing autonomous-driving scenario generators can enforce specific behavior, adversity, or feasibility conditions, but they provide limited control over how extreme a generated scenario is relative to plausible futures in the same traffic context. This study represents the adversity of a generated scenario as its percentile in the conditional distribution of future risk given the observed history. This view supports calibrated answers to two questions: how "corner" a generated corner-case scenario is and how its "cornerness" can be fine-tuned.
  To this end, we formulate history-conditioned risk-percentile requests and learn a reference risk distribution that maps each requested percentile to a physical risk target. We then use a percentile-conditioned joint diffusion model with sampling-time risk guidance to generate multi-agent futures, together with a reference-based criterion for evaluating percentile realization.
  Experiments use the minimum post-encroachment time (PET) between the ego and its surrounding vehicles as the risk surrogate on highD. On the primary evaluation set, our method realizes 1,422 of 1,440 requests within a 0.05 percentile tolerance (98.75%), with mean percentile error 0.00673 and PET-target error 0.00991 seconds. The resulting interface connects context-relative risk specification, physical realization, and evaluation through a common risk scale. Project website and videos of generated scenarios are available at https://hhj233.github.io/CornerPercentile/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出以“条件风险分布的百分位”来量化自动驾驶测试场景的极端程度，实现可控、可标定的corner-case生成。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶场景生成器虽能施加特定行为、逆境或可行性约束，但难以控制生成场景相对于同一交通情境下合理未来的极端程度，即缺乏对“corner-ness”的精确标定。
AI.method: 将场景逆境度定义为在观测历史条件下未来风险条件分布中的百分位；据此构建历史条件化风险百分位请求，学习将请求百分位映射到物理风险目标的参考风险分布，并采用带采样时风险引导的百分位条件联合扩散模型生成多智能体未来轨迹，同时提出基于参考的百分位实现评估准则。以最小PET作为风险代理指标，在highD数据集上实验。
AI.result: 在主评测集上，1,440个请求中有1,422个在0.05百分位容差内实现（98.75%），平均百分位误差0.00673，PET目标误差0.00991秒。
AI.conclusion: 该接口通过统一的“风险尺度”将情境相对的风险指定、物理实现与评估连接起来，支持对生成corner-case场景极端程度的标定与微调。

title: TSAE: Structured Sparse Autoencoders for Interpreting Time-Series Forecasting Models
summary: Time-series forecasting informs critical decisions in energy dispatch, industrial operations, and environmental monitoring; understanding the patterns models rely on is essential for assessing reliability and identifying failures. Input attribution identifies important variables and time segments but offers limited insight into internal features, while standard sparse autoencoder (SAE) objectives do not directly constrain cross-variable structure or temporal continuity. We introduce TSAE, a structured sparse autoencoder for forecasting representations that decomposes hidden states into individually inspectable features. TSAE organizes cross-variable structure through shared and variable-routed private dictionaries, separates feature detection from magnitude estimation with gated encoding, and constrains neighboring sparse-code changes according to raw-segment similarity. These mechanisms support analysis of variable context, activation strength, and temporal evolution. Forecast-consistency fine-tuning further improves preservation of the frozen forecaster's outputs. The accompanying TSEVAL protocol separately audits fidelity, feature coherence, and physical calibration to ground feature interpretation. In three-seed experiments with frozen PatchTST on ETTh1, ETTh2, and ETTm1, TSAE achieves the lowest hidden-state reconstruction error, normalized forecast-reconstruction error (NFRE), and feature transition rate among five SAEs at comparable per-token activity. NFRE decreases by 4.3-26.4% relative to the next-best mean. Dataset-dependent tradeoffs in selectivity, physical correlation, and calibration show that fidelity and temporal-stability gains require independent semantic validation to support feature interpretation.

AI.tldr: 提出结构化稀疏自编码器TSAE，将预测模型隐藏状态分解为可检验特征，并配套TSEVAL评估协议，在多个ETT数据集上取得最低重构误差与特征转移率。
AI.motivation: 时间序列预测在能源调度、工业运营和环境监测中至关重要，需理解模型依赖的模式以评估可靠性。输入归因只能识别重要变量和时间段，无法揭示内部特征；标准稀疏自编码器（SAE）目标也未直接约束跨变量结构或时间连续性。
AI.method: TSAE通过共享字典与变量路由私有字典组织跨变量结构，用门控编码分离特征检测与幅度估计，并按原始片段相似度约束相邻稀疏码变化。此外采用预测一致性微调以保留冻结预测器的输出，并提出TSEVAL协议分别审计保真度、特征一致性与物理校准。
AI.result: 在冻结PatchTST上对ETTh1、ETTh2、ETTm1进行三种子实验，TSAE在五种SAE中取得最低隐藏状态重构误差、归一化预测重构误差（NFRE）和特征转移率；NFRE相比次优均值下降4.3%-26.4%。选择性、物理相关性与校准方面存在数据集依赖的权衡。
AI.conclusion: TSAE在保真度与时间稳定性上优于现有SAE，但这些增益需通过独立语义验证来支撑特征解释，不能仅凭重构指标断定特征语义有效。

title: EVISKILL: Grounding Skill Evolution in Replayable Evidence
summary: Continual skill evolution enables LLM agents to accumulate and refine reusable procedural knowledge from interaction experience without updating model parameters. Its effectiveness depends on determining not only what to change, but also why a change is justified and when it should become persistent guidance. However, existing experience-driven methods can lose the behavioral evidence and task contexts supporting edits. Moreover, a global validation outcome provides an incomplete judgment of its constituent changes: locally supported corrections may be discarded with a rejected revision, while evidence may require further experience to inform useful updates. To this end, we introduce EVISKILL, an evidence-driven framework that organizes execution observations into Replayable Evidence Cards and synthesizes edits with explicit links to their supporting contexts. Targeted replay verifies these edits through re-execution and provides feedback for correction. Across epochs, EVISKILL preserves evidence and provisionally retains supported edits for further refinement, while global validation governs their incorporation into the final skill. Experiments on three interactive benchmarks across six LLM backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach.

AI.tldr: EVISKILL：一种证据驱动的LLM智能体技能持续演化框架，通过可回放证据卡支持编辑、定向回放验证与跨轮次保留，提升可复用程序性知识的积累与精炼效果。
AI.motivation: 现有经验驱动方法在修改智能体技能时，容易丢失支持编辑的行为证据与任务上下文；且仅依赖全局验证结果会低估局部有效的修正，可能把有支持证据的改动随被拒版本一并丢弃，某些证据还需更多经验才能形成有效更新。
AI.method: 提出EVISKILL框架：将执行观察组织为可回放证据卡（Replayable Evidence Cards），合成技能编辑时显式关联其支持上下文；通过定向回放（targeted replay）重新执行来验证编辑并提供纠正反馈；跨epoch保留证据，并临时保留有支持的编辑以供进一步精炼，最终由全局验证决定是否纳入最终技能。
AI.result: 在三个交互式基准、六种LLM主干模型上的实验表明该方法有效。
AI.conclusion: 将证据、上下文与局部/全局验证分层结合，可更可靠地实现LLM智能体技能的无参数持续演化。

title: Prompt Dominance and Asymmetric Verifier Costs: Empirical Ablations of GRPO at 1B Scale on GSM8K
comment: 12 pages, 8 figures. Code, run records, and figure scripts: https://github.com/Helios-YQH/llm-from-scratch
summary: This paper studies GRPO at 1B scale from both directions: what estimator choices do to the learning signal, and what a degraded reward signal does to what is learned. We train OLMo-2-0425-1B on GSM8K with a from-scratch implementation and measure both sides in controlled sweeps, including a verifier-quality experiment that degrades the training reward and the test-time selector identically. Four results stand out. The prompt is the first-order decision: the zero-shot prompt leaves the base model at 0.08% (its outputs are degenerate continuations, not wrong answers), so almost no group carries a gradient, and training succeeds because the 3-shot prompt reaches 18.3%. At this scale the estimator variants sit within seed noise, with Dr. GRPO ahead on both seeds. In the off-policy regime, clipping is the whole story: training on data without a clipped ratio loses 4-6 points relative to the on-policy reference, while GRPO-style clipping and GSPO recover the loss entirely. Finally, the same weak verifier is far cheaper in RL than in test-time selection: a 10%-flip verifier leaves RL's attainable gain intact (91% and 106% retained across two seeds) where selection retains 57%, and a format-only verifier leaves RL with 16-30% of its gain and selection with essentially nothing. Flip noise acts as an affine transform on the expected reward, and the group-normalized advantage with Adam's rescaling removes it exactly; the residual is a second-order variance effect that the matched-step comparison at a 30% flip rate tests.

AI.tldr: 本文从估计器选择与奖励信号退化两个方向研究1B规模的GRPO：提示词（3-shot vs zero-shot）是首要决策，估计器变体差异在种子噪声内，off-policy下裁剪是关键，弱验证器对RL的损害远小于测试时选择。
AI.motivation: 探究GRPO在1B小规模下，估计器选择如何影响学习信号，以及退化的奖励信号如何影响所学内容，并对比弱验证器在RL训练与测试时选择中的不同代价。
AI.method: 从零实现并在OLMo-2-0425-1B上于GSM8K训练，进行受控扫描；开展验证器质量实验，同等退化训练奖励与测试时选择器；比较多种估计器变体、on/off-policy裁剪方式及不同翻转率的验证器。
AI.result: zero-shot提示下基座模型仅0.08%（输出为退化续写），几乎无组携带梯度；3-shot提示达18.3%使训练成功。估计器变体差异在种子噪声内，Dr. GRPO在两个种子上均领先。off-policy下裁剪是全部关键：无裁剪比率训练损失4-6分，GRPO式裁剪与GSPO完全恢复。10%翻转验证器下RL保留91%和106%增益，而选择仅57%；纯格式验证器下RL保留16-30%增益，选择几乎为零。
AI.conclusion: 在1B规模，提示词是最主要的决策因素；估计器变体影响有限；off-policy中裁剪至关重要；弱验证器对RL训练的代价远低于测试时选择，翻转噪声表现为期望奖励的仿射变换，被组归一化优势与Adam缩放精确消除，残余为二阶方差效应。

title: CI-JEPA: A Counterfactual Analysis of Latent Representations in Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures for Self-Supervised Learning
comment: This article has been accepted for the International Symposium on Smart Systems, Algorithms & Applications 2026 (IS3A3 2026), Tezpur Central University, India
summary: Self-supervised visual representation learning learns useful features without manual annotations during representation training. The image-based joint-embedding predictive architecture (I-JEPA) predicts latent representations of masked image regions, but its objective does not explicitly model responses to specified visual interventions. We introduce CI-JEPA, a counterfactual intervention-aware extension that learns to predict the representation change $ΔZ = Z_{\mathrm{CF}} - Z$ between an original image and a modified counterpart. We assess representation robustness through selective sensitivity: stronger responses to task-relevant semantic changes than to nuisance changes. Experiments on Flowers102 use flower-center occlusion as a candidate semantic intervention and background blur and tint as candidate nuisance interventions. With frozen-encoder linear probing, CI-JEPA achieves a best validation accuracy of 78.14\%, compared with 77.55\% for both the pretrained ViT-B/16 and the I-JEPA baseline, a gain of 0.59 percentage points. The reported mean $L_2$ representation changes are 4.42 for center occlusion, 3.48 for background tint, and 2.83 for background blur. This ordering is consistent with relative semantic selectivity for the evaluated interventions, rather than complete nuisance invariance. The accuracy comparison is complementary and does not establish improved robustness over the baselines. These controlled image modifications provide a framework for studying intervention-induced changes in JEPA representations; they do not establish causal feature discovery or robustness to all visual changes.

AI.tldr: 提出 CI-JEPA，在 I-JEPA 基础上学习预测图像干预引起的表示变化 ΔZ，在 Flowers102 上线性探测准确率 78.14%，略高于基线 77.55%。
AI.motivation: I-JEPA 预测被遮挡区域的潜在表示，但目标函数未显式建模对特定视觉干预的响应，缺乏对语义变化与无关变化的选择性敏感度评估。
AI.method: CI-JEPA 作为反事实干预感知的扩展，学习预测原图与修改图之间的表示变化 ΔZ = Z_CF − Z；以选择性敏感度衡量鲁棒性。实验在 Flowers102 上，用花朵中心遮挡作为语义干预候选，背景模糊与色调作为无关干预候选。
AI.result: 冻结编码器线性探测下，CI-JEPA 最佳验证准确率 78.14%，而预训练 ViT-B/16 与 I-JEPA 基线均为 77.55%，提升 0.59 个百分点。平均 L2 表示变化：中心遮挡 4.42、背景色调 3.48、背景模糊 2.83，排序体现语义选择性而非完全无关不变性。
AI.conclusion: 准确率比较仅为补充性证据，不能确立相对基线的鲁棒性提升；该受控图像修改框架用于研究干预引起的 JEPA 表示变化，不构成因果特征发现或对所有视觉变化的鲁棒性证明。

title: Billion-Scale Thumbnail Optimization for Uncurated Short-Form Videos via Multi-Armed Bandits
summary: This paper introduces a real-time thumbnail optimization system deployed at a global $O(B)$ scale on a major short-form video platform. Unlike traditional long-form content, where custom thumbnails are heavily curated by creators, a considerable fraction of short-form videos are published without human-selected artwork. To address this uncurated corpus, we present a fully automated, end-to-end framework that replaces static default frames with dynamic, data-driven selections across billions of videos. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first published work demonstrating an online Multi-Armed Bandit framework successfully deployed at an $O(B)$ scale for uncurated short-form video discovery. Our solution pairs a multi-stage candidate generation pipeline with a low-latency serving infrastructure. By initializing the exploration framework with image-specific priors derived from a deep visual quality model, the system minimizes exploration costs and dynamically serves optimal thumbnails at serving time. Global deployment demonstrates statistically significant improvements in core user discovery and engagement metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并部署了一个面向全球十亿级规模短视频平台的实时缩略图优化系统，用在线多臂老虎机框架为未人工策划的短视频自动选择动态缩略图。
AI.motivation: 短视频与长视频不同，大量视频发布时没有创作者精选的封面，默认静态帧效果差，缺乏人工策划导致缩略图选择成为自动化难题。
AI.method: 采用多阶段候选生成流程配合低延迟服务基础设施；将基于深度视觉质量模型得到的图像先验用于初始化探索框架，以降低探索成本，并在服务时动态提供最优缩略图。
AI.result: 据作者所述，这是首个在十亿级规模上成功部署、用于未策划短视频发现的在线多臂老虎机框架；全球部署在核心用户发现与互动指标上取得统计显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 该系统能够以自动化、数据驱动的方式替代静态默认帧，在超大规模短视频场景中有效优化缩略图并提升用户体验。

title: Why, Where, How: Taxonomy-guided Error Grounding for Code Repair in NL2SQL
summary: SQL queries that large language models write from natural language questions can execute successfully yet produce incorrect results, so execution alone does not reveal what to fix. An error taxonomy says why the query is wrong, but not where to look or how to change it. Existing methods can guide SQL correction through feedback, error reports, or generated plans alongside an unmasked query. We introduce TEG(Taxonomy-guided Error Grounding), which turns a supplied diagnosis into a structured correction input for natural language-to-SQL (NL2SQL) correction. Type-specific rules map each error type to construct classes to reconsider and an edit operation to request. TEG masks the selected constructs in the query when applicable and states that operation in an edit instruction. TEG generates candidate corrections from this input, uses execution feedback to guide candidate selection, and repeats the process one annotation at a time for queries with several errors. On NL2SQL-BUGs, TEG reaches 47.3 single-error execution accuracy and 37.0 overall with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Across the model sizes and thinking modes evaluated in the main comparison, TEG outperforms all evaluated baselines on single-error queries, even when the baselines receive the same error-type annotations. With predicted types, TEG stays above direct LLM correction and ErrorLLM on single-error queries.

AI.tldr: TEG将错误类型诊断转为结构化修正输入，通过掩码相关SQL构造并给出编辑指令，结合执行反馈迭代修正，在NL2SQL-BUGs上取得优于基线的单错误执行准确率。
AI.motivation: LLM生成的SQL虽能执行但结果错误，单靠执行无法定位问题；错误分类只说明错误原因，不指示修改位置与方式；现有方法（反馈、错误报告、生成计划）指导不足。目标是让诊断信息落地为可操作的修正输入，明确"看哪里、怎么改"。
AI.method: TEG（Taxonomy-guided Error Grounding）：1）用类型专属规则把每种错误类型映射到需重新考虑的构造类别和请求的编辑操作；2）在适用时掩码查询中被选中的构造，并在编辑指令中陈述该操作；3）基于该输入生成候选修正，用执行反馈引导候选选择；4）对含多个错误的查询，按一次一个标注迭代重复。
AI.result: 在NL2SQL-BUGs上，使用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct达到47.3的单错误执行准确率和37.0的整体准确率。在主要比较中评估的各类模型规模和思考模式下，TEG在单错误查询上优于所有评估基线，即使基线接收相同的错误类型标注。使用预测类型时，TEG在单错误查询上仍高于直接LLM修正和ErrorLLM。
AI.conclusion: 将错误分类诊断结构化为"掩码位置+编辑操作"的接地输入，并配合执行反馈迭代选择，能有效提升NL2SQL修正效果，且优势不依赖于完美错误类型标注。

title: Learning under Localized Minority Imbalance
summary: Class-imbalance methods implicitly assume that the minority class is uniformly undersampled relative to the majority class. However, in many real-world settings, minority instances may be disproportionately under-observed in certain regions of the feature space. For example, small businesses that go bankrupt may disappear from records, while those that survive remain visible, making bankruptcy appear less common among small firms than it actually is. This gives rise to localized minority imbalance (LMI), a challenge that is often overlooked and extends beyond general class-count imbalance. We show that under LMI, existing imbalance mitigation techniques can fit observation-induced biases in the training data and generalize poorly to under-observed regions of the true minority distribution. To address this, we propose a tree-based stratified approach that recursively partitions the feature space with the goal of reducing within-stratum LMI distortion. For each resulting stratum, we pair its majority instances with the full observed minority set and train a base classifier to create an ensemble. Extensive experiments over benchmark tabular datasets simulated with LMI show that our stratified ensembling approach outperforms popular and state-of-the-art imbalance mitigation techniques. We also introduce a gold-standard evaluation protocol that uses unbiased test sets, and demonstrate that conventional hold-out evaluation from the same LMI-biased data can substantially mislead performance. Overall, our results highlight that the cause of imbalance is as important as the correction method.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"局部化少数类不平衡"(LMI)问题，并设计基于树的层叠策略集成方法来缓解该问题，同时提出无偏测试评估协议。
AI.motivation: 现有类不平衡方法隐含假设少数类相对于多数类是均匀欠采样的，但现实中少数样本在某些特征区域可能被不成比例地少观测到（如破产小企业从记录中消失），导致局部化少数类不平衡(LMI)。这种LMI常被忽视，且现有方法会拟合观测偏置，在欠观测区域泛化很差。
AI.method: 提出基于树的层叠(stratified)方法：递归划分特征空间以减小层内LMI失真；对每个划分出的层，将其多数类实例与全部观测到的少数类集合配对，训练基分类器形成集成。
AI.result: 在模拟LMI的基准表格数据集上，该层叠集成方法优于流行及最先进的类不平衡缓解技术；并引入使用无偏测试集的gold-standard评估协议，证明基于同一LMI偏置数据的常规留出评估会严重误导性能判断。
AI.conclusion: 不平衡的成因与纠正方法同样重要，处理LMI需同时关注观测偏置的机制与缓解技术。

title: SharpDraft: Accelerating Long-Context Speculative Decoding with Cardinality-Aware Query Scaling
summary: Long-form reasoning makes inference expensive, and speculative decoding mitigates this cost by verifying multiple draft tokens in parallel. Its speedup, however, can fade as context grows and draft acceptance declines. We focus on attention-mass dilution: as softmax normalizes over more visible Keys, the mass concentrated on the highest-scoring Keys can decrease. We introduce SharpDraft, a training-free method that counteracts this effect through cardinality-aware Query scaling, without the computational overhead of online adaptation. Under explicit assumptions, we derive an exact top-$k$ mass correction and deploy a closed-form fixed-slope approximation. Across AIME-26, GPQA-Diamond, and LongGenBench Diary, SharpDraft achieves $2.59$-$3.19\times$ geometric-mean end-to-end speedups over target-only autoregressive decoding when applied to DFlash, PARD, and EAGLE 3.1. With DFlash, it improves decoding speed and outperforms full-parameter and LoRA-based online adaptation in end-to-end speedup, while matching the unmodified drafter's reported peak allocated GPU memory.

AI.tldr: SharpDraft是一种免训练方法，通过基数感知的Query缩放缓解注意力质量稀释，在不增加在线适应开销的情况下提升推测解码的加速效果。
AI.motivation: 长文本推理成本高昂，推测解码通过并行验证多个草稿token来降低开销，但其加速效果在上下文增长、草稿接受率下降时会减弱。作者关注"注意力质量稀释"现象：随着softmax在更多可见Key上归一化，集中在最高分Key上的质量可能下降。
AI.method: 提出SharpDraft，一种免训练方法，通过基数感知的Query缩放来抵消注意力质量稀释，避免在线适应的计算开销。在明确假设下推导出精确的top-k质量修正，并采用闭式固定斜率近似进行部署。
AI.result: 在AIME-26、GPQA-Diamond和LongGenBench Diary上，将SharpDraft应用于DFlash、PARD和EAGLE 3.1时，相对仅目标自回归解码取得2.59–3.19倍的几何平均端到端加速。使用DFlash时，它提升了解码速度，在端到端加速上优于全参数和基于LoRA的在线适应方法，同时匹配未修改草稿器报告的峰值分配GPU内存。
AI.conclusion: SharpDraft通过无训练、无在线开销的Query缩放有效缓解注意力质量稀释，在多种模型和基准上实现了显著且高效的推测解码加速。

title: D-DOIT: Training-free Adaptation of Discrete Diffusion via Doob's h-Transform
summary: We propose D-DOIT (Discrete Doob-Oriented Inference-time Transformation), a training-free and efficient adaptation method for discrete diffusion models with generic rewards. D-DOIT formulates adaptation as sampling from a reward-tilted target distribution and realizes this transport through Doob's h-transform of the discrete diffusion reverse kernel, using only reward values rather than reward gradients. Unlike continuous diffusion, masked discrete diffusion samples categorical token-reveal transitions rather than continuous state updates. D-DOIT derives the corresponding discrete Doob's h-transform, which guides sampling by reweighting reverse transition probabilities instead of adding a drift correction. To make this transformation practical, D-DOIT avoids expensive future rollouts. At each guided step, D-DOIT samples candidate next states, uses the model prediction head to complete each candidate into a clean sequence, evaluates each completion with the reward oracle, and resamples the next state with probabilities proportional to the rewards. An optional late-stage best-of-K refinement further improves sample quality by branching trajectories only near the end of denoising, avoiding the $K$-fold cost over the full trajectory. Empirically, across regulatory DNA design and protein inverse folding benchmarks, D-DOIT outperforms training-free guidance baselines. It improves enhancer activity and cell-type specificity while preserving sequence naturalness, and achieves the highest success rate in protein inverse folding.

AI.tldr: 提出 D-DOIT，一种无需训练、高效的离散扩散模型适应方法，通过离散 Doob h-变换重加权反向转移概率实现通用奖励引导，并取得优于基线的效果。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散模型（如掩码扩散）在通用奖励引导下的适应存在困难：不同于连续扩散的状态加噪，它进行的是类别型 token 揭示转移，无法直接套用连续扩散中加漂移项的引导方式；同时需避免昂贵的未来 rollout。
AI.method: 将适应建模为从奖励倾斜目标分布采样，用离散 Doob h-变换重加权反向转移概率（仅需奖励值而非梯度）。每步采样候选下一状态，用预测头补全为干净序列，经奖励 oracle 评估后按奖励比例重采样。另设可选的后期 best-of-K 精化，仅在去噪末期分支，避免全程 K 倍开销。
AI.result: 在调控 DNA 设计和蛋白质逆折叠基准上，D-DOIT 优于免训练引导基线：提升增强子活性和细胞类型特异性同时保持序列自然度，并在蛋白质逆折叠中取得最高成功率。
AI.conclusion: D-DOIT 提供了一种无需训练、无梯度的离散扩散奖励引导框架，借助离散 Doob h-变换与高效的候选重采样策略，在生物序列设计任务上验证了其有效性。

title: LexiHorizon: Stabilizing Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Deep Search
summary: Deep search agents tackle complex knowledge tasks through iterative retrieval, multi-hop reasoning, and evidence synthesis across multiple sources. Existing approaches typically assume relatively stable retrieval systems and operate over short-horizon tool interaction. However, when retrieval is sensitive to query formulation, even a semantically appropriate query may fail to surface critical evidence because of mismatched entity names, aliases, or keyword combinations. Recovering from such failures requires repeated query reformulation and longer interaction trajectories. This setting poses a distinct training challenge, as the policy must sustain long-horizon query exploration while managing an expanding volume of retrieved content. We propose LexiHorizon, a framework for training search agents over long horizons that expands the trajectory context budget, manages accumulated retrieval content using a window over recent tool observations while preserving the reasoning history, and introduces an outcome-gated search-effort reward that provides a bounded bonus for tool invocations to trajectories with nonzero answer reward. Experiments on XBench, WebWalkerQA, and BrowseComp-ZH show that the resulting 9B model consistently outperforms both its base model and MiroThinker-1.7-mini, with maximum absolute gains of 8.7 and 23.8 percentage points, respectively. These results suggest that combining an extended context budget with reasoning-preserving context management benefits long-horizon deep search agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LexiHorizon 框架，通过扩展轨迹上下文预算、保留推理历史的检索内容窗口管理，以及"结果门控"的搜索努力奖励，训练长时程深度搜索智能体，在多个基准上显著优于基线模型。
AI.motivation: 现有深度搜索智能体通常假设检索系统相对稳定、工具交互时程较短。但检索对查询表述敏感，语义合适的查询也可能因实体名、别名或关键词组合不匹配而无法召回关键证据。此类失败需要反复重写查询并延长交互轨迹，从而带来训练挑战：策略须在长时程查询探索的同时管理不断膨胀的检索内容。
AI.method: LexiHorizon 框架包含三部分：(1) 扩展轨迹上下文预算；(2) 用近期工具观测窗口管理累积的检索内容，同时保留推理历史；(3) 引入结果门控的搜索努力奖励——仅对答案奖励非零的轨迹，给予工具调用以有界加成奖励。
AI.result: 在 XBench、WebWalkerQA 和 BrowseComp-ZH 上，所得 9B 模型持续优于其基座模型与 MiroThinker-1.7-mini，最大绝对增益分别为 8.7 和 23.8 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将扩展上下文预算与"保留推理"的上下文管理相结合，有利于长时程深度搜索智能体。

title: A Graph-Based Inspection and Intervention Tool for Assessing Mechanistic Learning in PINNs
comment: This is a developmental work which was submitted to NeurIPS workshops. Useful feedback was obtained and an improved version is being developed
summary: We ask whether physically meaningful correspondences discovered inside a trained scientific model remain meaningful outside the conditions under which they were discovered. We introduce GIIT (Graph-based Inspection and Intervention Tool), which represents governing physics as a computational physics dependency graph, maps graph nodes to internal network components via sensitivity- and trend-based discovery, and tests the resulting mapping under targeted intervention. Evaluating on temporal extrapolation out-of-distribution (OOD) regimes of increasing severity, we find that temporal extrapolation is associated with layer-wise correspondence drift and reduced functional correspondence. Specifically, while the model achieves low physics residual in-distribution (1.915 x 10-4 on full ID and 1.01 x 10-4 on an ID sub-window t in [0.5, 0.8]), the functional mapping changes even before leaving the training domain, and the shift continues as the evaluation window extends beyond the training domain: residual error increases from 2.81 x 10-2 on the boundary-crossing window (t in [0.5, 1.5]) to 3.30 x 10-1 on severe OOD (t in [1, 2]), accompanied by a systematic leftward shift of internal layer mappings, where the average winner layer index drops from 5.71 (ID) to 3.00 (ID sub-window) down to 2.29 (severe OOD). Only 2 of 7 physical nodes maintain stable layer assignments across the boundary-crossing window, and only 1 of 7 under severe extrapolation, revealing potential internal functional correspondence changes before severe degradation in conventional output metrics. Additional results for linear oscillatory systems are further detailed in the appendix.

AI.tldr: 提出GIIT工具，用计算物理依赖图映射神经网络内部组件，发现在时间外推OOD下模型与物理的对应关系会漂移并减弱。
AI.motivation: 探究科学模型在训练条件之外是否仍保持已学到的物理对应关系，即物理意义的对应能否外推。
AI.method: 构建GIIT（Graph-based Inspection and Intervention Tool）：将支配物理表示为计算物理依赖图，通过敏感性与趋势发现把图节点映射到网络内部组件，并在定向干预下检验映射。
AI.result: 在逐步加剧的时间外推OOD中，出现层级对应漂移与功能对应减弱：ID残差约1.915e-4（子窗口1.01e-4），边界窗口残差升至2.81e-2，严重OOD达3.30e-1；获胜层索引均值从5.71（ID）降至3.00（子窗口）再到2.29（严重OOD）；跨边界仅2/7物理节点保持稳定层分配，严重外推仅1/7。
AI.conclusion: 内部功能对应关系在常规输出指标严重退化之前就已改变，说明模型内发现的物理对应未必在训练条件之外保持有意义。

title: Memory Canonicalization: A Framework and Benchmark for Cross-Model Drift in Persistent LLM Memory
summary: Persistent memory for Large Language Models (LLMs) has matured rapidly: systems such as MemGPT/Letta, Mem0, and Zep now provide agents with tiered, temporally-aware, model-agnostic external storage, while the Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes access to memory servers. A less addressed problem is that an identical stored memory object, retrieved by two different LLMs under otherwise identical conditions, may not be interpreted the same way, factually or emotionally. This paper proposes memory canonicalization: a write-time pipeline that detects ambiguity, conditional structure, and emotional loading in a raw memory object and rewrites it into an explicit, structurally disambiguated canonical form, with emotional valence represented as a separate field rather than inferred from tone. We formalize the pipeline, define a companion Cross-Model Semantic Drift / Emotional Consistency Score benchmark (CMSC-E), and report results from a three-arm pilot using 176 synthetic memory objects and three downstream model families. We find an uncorrected improvement in cross-model emotional consistency for fully canonicalized memory relative to raw memory (+0.050, 95% bootstrap CI [0.013, 0.086], paired t-test p = 0.010), but this result does not survive Bonferroni, Holm, or Benjamini-Hochberg correction across the six comparisons tested. None of the factual-drift (CMSD) comparisons reach significance at any correction level. We report these results as exploratory rather than confirmatory and outline needed follow-up work, including larger samples, independent judge models, human-validated rendering, and preregistration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"记忆规范化"（memory canonicalization）：在写入时检测原始记忆对象中的歧义、条件结构与情感负载，将其改写为显式、结构上消歧的规范形式，并把情感效价作为独立字段而非从语气推断。作者定义了配套的跨模型语义漂移/情感一致性基准 CMSC-E，并用176个合成记忆对象、三个下游模型族开展三臂试点。结果显示完全规范化记忆在跨模型情感一致性上有未校正提升（+0.050，95% bootstrap CI [0.013, 0.086]，配对t检验 p=0.010），但该结果无法通过Bonferroni、Holm或Benjamini-Hochberg校正；事实漂移（CMSD）各项比较在任何校正水平下均不显著。作者将结果定位为探索性而非验证性。
AI.motivation: LLM持久记忆系统（MemGPT/Letta、Mem0、Zep）及MCP标准化已日趋成熟，但一个被忽视的问题是：同一存储记忆对象在相同条件下被不同LLM检索时，事实与情感解读可能不一致，即存在跨模型语义漂移与情感解读差异，因此需要一种在写入端统一表征的方法。
AI.method: 提出记忆规范化写时流水线：检测原始记忆对象中的歧义、条件结构与情感负载，并改写为显式、结构上消歧的规范形式，情感效价以独立字段表示而非由语气推断。形式化该流水线，并定义配套基准CMSC-E（跨模型语义漂移/情感一致性评分）。开展三臂试点，使用176个合成记忆对象与三个下游模型族。
AI.result: 完全规范化记忆相对原始记忆在跨模型情感一致性上呈现未校正提升（+0.050，95% bootstrap CI [0.013, 0.086]，配对t检验 p = 0.010）；但该结果无法通过 Bonferroni、Holm 或 Benjamini-Hochberg 在六项比较上的多重校正。事实漂移（CMSD）的所有比较在任何校正水平下均未达到显著。
AI.conclusion: 结果仅作为探索性而非验证性结论报告，尚不能确认规范化对跨模型一致性有稳健效果。后续需扩大样本量、采用独立评判模型、进行人工验证的渲染评估，并开展预注册研究。

title: Software World Models: From Consequence Prediction to Decision Value
summary: A coding agent may safely modify one repository while silently breaking downstream services, libraries, or datastores that depend on it. Exhaustively running integration tests after every agent action is impractical, so the agent must predict these failures before executing them. Existing software world models predict the agent's own observations, while static change-impact analysis only identifies where a change may propagate. We instead introduce the Software World Model (SWM), which models the broader system affected by a code change and predicts its blast set: the components that the change will break. SWM follows three stages: explore, learn, and act. Explore executes candidate changes from restored system states, prioritizing regions where observed failures contradict the dependency graph. Learn fine-tunes a language model on these execution outcomes to predict downstream breakage. Act converts sampled predictions into per-consumer break probabilities for change ranking, proactive migration, and deciding when another execution is worth its cost. On held-out synthetic systems, SWM improves blast-set F1 from 0.431 for static reachability to $0.571\pm0.037$, more than halves ranking regret, and improves migration return at all nine evaluation checkpoints. The two methods are complementary: reachability is stronger on dependencies represented in the graph, while SWM recovers failures caused by couplings the graph misses. Experiments on held-out real libraries further show that predicting structured failure outcomes, rather than only scalar risk, is important for downstream decision quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出软件世界模型（SWM），通过探索-学习-行动三阶段预测代码变更会破坏的下游组件集合（blast set），在合成与真实库上优于静态可达性分析。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体修改某仓库时可能悄悄破坏依赖它的下游服务、库或数据存储；每次行动后都穷尽运行集成测试不现实，因此智能体需在执行前预测这些失败。现有软件世界模型仅预测智能体自身观测，静态变更影响分析只能指出变更可能传播的位置，无法预测实际破坏。
AI.method: SWM分三阶段：探索（explore）——从恢复的系统状态执行候选变更，优先探索观测失败与依赖图相矛盾的区域；学习（learn）——在这些执行结果上微调语言模型以预测下游破坏；行动（act）——将采样预测转化为每个消费者的破坏概率，用于变更排序、主动迁移及判断是否值得再执行一次。
AI.result: 在留出合成系统上，blast-set F1从静态可达性的0.431提升至0.571±0.037，排序后悔减半以上，并在全部九个评估检查点上改善迁移收益。两种方法互补：可达性在图中已表示的依赖上更强，而SWM能恢复图遗漏耦合导致的失败。真实库实验进一步表明，预测结构化失败结果而非仅标量风险对下游决策质量很重要。
AI.conclusion: 通过建模变更所影响的更广系统并预测其blast set，SWM优于静态分析，且与可达性分析互补；预测结构化失败结果对提升下游决策质量至关重要。

title: AutoSciBench: Autonomous Benchmark Generation for Evaluating Scientific Agents
summary: As agents rapidly evolve, existing benchmarks can become saturated, limiting their ability to distinguish capabilities and reveal remaining failure modes. Particularly in scientific domains, constructing and updating benchmarks requires substantial time, labor, and domain expertise, making it difficult to keep evaluation aligned with advances in agent capabilities. We address this challenge by investigating whether scientific-agent benchmarks can be automatically generated and iteratively adapted as agent capabilities evolve. We introduce AutoSciBench, a framework that represents each task as a high-level concept specifying the scientific domain, data modality, and required reasoning approach, together with a low-level recipe specifying how the question, environment, and ground-truth answer are constructed and verified. Agents attempt to solve each task, producing solver trajectories and corresponding judge feedback which AutoSciBench uses to revise the recipe or concept, closing observed shortcuts and shifting tasks toward raw-data re-examination, interpretation of intermediate results, and evidence integration. Experience distilled from completed refinement trajectories further guides new concept generation, allowing lessons from earlier task refinement to inform subsequent benchmark construction. Starting from existing benchmarks, we evaluate AutoSciBench across computational biology, materials science, and clinical imaging. Generated benchmarks reduce average solver accuracy by 22.4 and 25.5 percentage points relative to the human-curated benchmarks in computational biology and materials science, respectively, while generated tasks receive higher average quality ratings across all three domains, suggesting that scientific-agent evaluation can adapt as agent capabilities advance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AutoSciBench，一个可自动生成并随智能体能力演化而迭代适应科学智能体基准的框架，通过概念-配方双层结构结合求解者轨迹与评判反馈进行迭代改进，在计算生物学、材料科学和临床影像三大领域生成了更难且质量更高的基准。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准容易饱和，难以区分能力与揭示剩余失效模式；而在科学领域，构建和更新基准需要大量时间、人力和领域专业知识，难以与智能体能力的进步保持同步。
AI.method: 将每个任务表示为高层概念（科学领域、数据模态、所需推理方式）与低层配方（问题、环境、真值答案的构建与验证方式）。智能体尝试解题产生求解轨迹与评判反馈，AutoSciBench 据此修订配方或概念，堵塞被发现的捷径，使任务转向原始数据再检验、中间结果解读与证据整合；从已完成精化轨迹中提炼经验，指导新概念生成。
AI.result: 在计算生物学、材料科学和临床影像领域进行评估：相比人工编排基准，生成基准使求解者平均准确率分别下降22.4和25.5个百分点（计算生物学与材料科学），且在三个领域生成任务的平均质量评分均更高。
AI.conclusion: 科学智能体评估可以随智能体能力进步而自适应演化，基准可被自动生成并迭代精化以实现这一目标。

title: TempoBridge: Source-Conditioned Flow Matching with Optimal Transport Couplings for Single-Cell Population Transitions
summary: Destructive single-cell measurements provide unpaired population snapshots rather than observations of the same cells across conditions. Local cell states and transition requests may also be insufficient to distinguish responses across source populations. We introduce TempoBridge, a common source-conditioned transport formulation for temporal, genetic, and chemical population transitions. Source cells initialize latent transport and provide a fixed empirical population summary. The velocity field receives this summary alongside the evolving cell state, flow time, and a structured transition descriptor. Minibatch optimal transport (OT) supplies couplings only for conditional flow-matching training paths; inference requires neither target expression nor OT computation. On held-out donors, TempoBridge achieves an Energy distance of 0.129 versus 0.144 for scGen. Genetic mean-expression $L_2$ error is 2.261 versus 3.156 for scGPT-scratch under Seen 2/2. On held-out compounds, condition-averaged drug-effect correlation is 0.598 versus 0.561 for the CellFlow adapter. Temporal ablations show higher mean distributional error after removing source context, replacing optimal transport with random pairing, or replacing flow matching with static residual regression. Together, these results demonstrate the predictive utility of a common source-conditioned transport formulation across held-out donors, gene combinations, and compounds.

AI.tldr: TempoBridge：一种以源群体为条件的通用运输框架，统一处理时间、遗传与化学扰动下的单细胞群体迁移，推理时无需目标表达或最优传输计算。
AI.motivation: 破坏性单细胞测序只能得到未配对的群体快照，无法追踪同一细胞在不同条件下的状态；且局部细胞状态与迁移请求不足以区分不同源群体的响应。因此需要一个能利用源群体信息、跨时间/遗传/化学扰动进行预测的通用建模框架。
AI.method: 提出源条件化的运输表述：源细胞初始化潜在运输并给出固定的经验群体摘要，速度场同时接收该摘要、演化中的细胞状态、流动时间和结构化迁移描述符；用微批次最优传输（OT）仅为条件流匹配的训练路径提供耦合，推理阶段既不需要目标表达也不需要OT计算。
AI.result: 在留出供体上Energy distance为0.129，优于scGen的0.144；遗传平均表达L2误差2.261，优于scGPT-scratch的3.156（Seen 2/2）；在留出化合物上条件平均药效相关性0.598，优于CellFlow适配器的0.561。时间维度消融显示，移除源上下文、用随机配对替代OT、或用静态残差回归替代流匹配都会提高平均分布误差。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，源条件化的通用运输表述在留出供体、基因组合和化合物上均具有预测价值。

title: R1A-PC: Physics-Guided Electromagnetic Inversion of Three-Dimensional Human Point Clouds in Complex Static Environments
summary: Recovering three-dimensional human geometry from electromagnetic measure?ments in a complex static environment is difficult because strong multipath responses from walls, floors, and other objects obscure the weak target per?turbation. We propose R1A-PC, a physics-guided method that reconstructs a 2048-point human cloud from paired complex fields measured with and without the target. Complex background subtraction emphasizes target-induced ampli?tude and phase changes, while the background field remains available as an environmental condition. A frequency-balanced discrete Born adjoint produces a three-dimensional spatial knowledge map. At each of two bounded deformation stages, the decoder combines complex measurement features, background fea?tures, and multiscale physical features queried at the current point coordinates; the second stage queries again after the first coordinate update. We analyze the residual of paired subtraction, the weighted normal-operator structure of the raw adjoint, and the feasible set of the predicted cloud. In a held-out background generated by full-wave simulation under a fixed acquisition geometry, R1A-PC obtains a squared Chamfer distance of 0.001434 m2 and an F-score of 0.963080 at 0.05 m. Compared with TopNet, the Chamfer distance decreases by 70.28%. Removing physical guidance or background subtraction increases the Chamfer distance by 242.06% or 241.18%, respectively. Experiments across background layouts and poses support the complementary roles of paired subtraction and position-dependent adjoint features.

AI.tldr: 提出R1A-PC，一种物理引导方法，从有无目标的配对复数场测量中重建2048点人体点云，通过复数背景相减与频率平衡离散Born伴随生成三维空间知识图，并在两阶段有界变形解码器中融合测量、背景与多尺度物理特征。
AI.motivation: 在复杂静态环境中从电磁测量恢复三维人体几何很困难，因为墙壁、地板等物体的强多径响应会掩盖微弱的目标扰动。需要一种能利用环境信息并抑制背景干扰的物理引导重建方法。
AI.method: 提出R1A-PC：利用有无目标的配对复数场，进行复数背景相减以突出目标引起的幅度与相位变化，同时保留背景场作为环境条件；采用频率平衡离散Born伴随产生三维空间知识图；解码器在两个有界变形阶段中结合复数测量特征、背景特征以及在当前点坐标处查询的多尺度物理特征，第二阶段在第一次坐标更新后再次查询。分析包括配对相减残差、原始伴随的加权法算子结构及预测点云的可行集。
AI.result: 在固定采集几何下全波仿真生成的留出背景中，R1A-PC获得平方Chamfer距离0.001434 m²、0.05 m处F-score 0.963080；相比TopNet，Chamfer距离下降70.28%。去除物理引导或背景相减分别使Chamfer距离增加242.06%或241.18%。跨背景布局与姿态的实验支持配对相减与位置相关伴随特征的互补作用。
AI.conclusion: R1A-PC通过配对复数场相减与物理引导的伴随特征，在复杂静态背景下显著提升三维人体点云重建精度，且配对相减与位置相关伴随特征具有互补作用。

title: Bridging the EHR Divide: Asymmetric Contrastive Learning for Cross-National Medical Representation Transfer
summary: Cross-system transfer of longitudinal Electronic Health Record (EHR) representations is challenging because clinical coding, patient populations, and healthcare workflows differ substantially across institutions and countries. We introduce Asymmetric Supervised Contrastive Learning (Asymmetric SupCon), a task-specific pre-training objective motivated by the heterogeneity of negative clinical outcomes. The objective clusters patients sharing a target positive outcome without explicitly attracting negative trajectories toward one another. We pre-train temporal Transformer encoders on longitudinal records from 3.98 million patients in the Taiwanese National Health Insurance Research Database (NHIRD) and transfer them to two U.S. EHR datasets, MIMIC-IV and EHRSHOT. A hybrid semantic mapping pipeline combining direct mappings with embedding-based retrieval enables transfer across heterogeneous clinical vocabularies. On MIMIC-IV, NHIRD pre-training consistently improves over random initialization while substantially narrowing the performance gap to task-specific in-domain pre-training. On EHRSHOT, the transferred models show particularly strong few-shot performance for incident disease prediction. A controlled objective ablation shows that Asymmetric SupCon achieves the best AUPRC on three of four evaluated tasks and is 0.003 AUPRC below Standard SupCon on the fourth. These results support asymmetric contrastive pre-training as an effective approach for task-specific cross-national EHR representation transfer. Code is available at https://github.com/qingYzhang/Asymmetric_SupCon.

AI.tldr: 提出非对称监督对比学习(Asymmetric SupCon)预训练目标，在台湾NHIRD(398万患者)上预训练时序Transformer，迁移至美国MIMIC-IV与EHRSHOT，跨系统EHR表示迁移表现有效。
AI.motivation: 跨机构、跨国家的EHR表示迁移困难，因临床编码、患者人群与医疗流程差异大；同时负性临床结局具有异质性，标准对比学习将负样本相互吸引并不合适。
AI.method: 提出任务特定的Asymmetric SupCon预训练目标：聚合同属目标阳性结局的患者，但不显式将阴性轨迹相互拉近。在NHIRD纵向记录上预训练时序Transformer编码器，并用结合直接映射与嵌入检索的混合语义映射流程跨异构临床词表迁移至MIMIC-IV和EHRSHOT。
AI.result: MIMIC-IV上，NHIRD预训练稳定优于随机初始化并显著缩小与任务特定域内预训练的差距；EHRSHOT上迁移模型在突发疾病预测的少样本场景表现尤为突出；消融显示Asymmetric SupCon在四项任务中三项AUPRC最佳，第四项仅低于标准SupCon 0.003。
AI.conclusion: 非对称对比预训练是任务特定跨国家EHR表示迁移的有效方法。

title: Beyond Instruction Following: Learning Grounded Skill-Following with Skill Contracts
summary: Instruction following typically enforces discrete, response-level requirements, whereas an expert-authored skill prescribes procedural requirements spanning multiple phases and environment interactions. Given such a skill, we train the executor to execute all required phases instead of focusing solely on the final answer. We therefore introduce Grounded Skill-Following, which requires an agent to execute a fixed, expert-authored skill across its required phases by grounding decisions in environment observations. To achieve verifiable procedural execution, we formulate each skill as a skill contract combining visible skill instructions with an explicit contract runtime. The runtime specifies required phases, admissible actions, permitted transitions, and accepted termination. This structure provides a dense, verifiable training signal throughout execution. We leverage this by introducing Verified Progress Credit, which assigns rewards upon the initial completion of contract milestones and aggregates them into the trajectory return to guide policy optimization. During rollout, the contract runtime continuously tracks state transitions to provide Contract-State Feedback, which indicates whether the latest action is accepted and guides the agent toward valid next actions. To measure procedural compliance, we introduce the Protocol Completion Rate (PCR), defined as reaching accepted termination through all required phases, and decouple it from the final Task Outcome. Jointly trained with our framework, Qwen3.5-4B achieves Protocol Completion Rates of 99.27% on Math and 99.96% on Search, while slightly outperforming original baselines in Task Outcome (82.95% and 46.61%, respectively). Controlled studies examine how skill instructions, training signals, and contract-state feedback affect both metrics, while withholding interventions evaluate behavioral dependence on observation content.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Grounded Skill-Following 任务：智能体需依据专家编写的技能，在执行过程中结合环境观测按阶段完成任务。为此将技能形式化为 skill contract（含契约运行时），并引入 Verified Progress Credit 奖励与 Contract-State Feedback 反馈，最后用 Protocol Completion Rate（PCR）衡量流程合规性。Qwen3.5-4B 在 Math 与 Search 上分别达到 99.27% 和 99.96% 的 PCR，任务结果也略优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有指令跟随多只约束离散的、响应级要求，而专家技能往往规定跨多个阶段并与环境交互的流程性要求。若仅关注最终答案，模型可能跳过或省略必要阶段。作者希望让执行器完整执行技能的所有必备阶段，并让这种流程执行可验证、可训练。
AI.method: 1) 提出 Grounded Skill-Following 设定：在环境观测基础上执行固定的、专家撰写的技能，覆盖其全部必备阶段。2) 将每个技能表示为 skill contract：由可见的技能指令与显式的契约运行时组成，运行时规定必备阶段、可允许动作、允许的状态转移与可接受的终止。3) 引入 Verified Progress Credit：在契约里程碑首次完成时给予奖励，并聚合进轨迹回报以指导策略优化。4)  rollout 时契约运行时持续跟踪状态转移，提供 Contract-State Feedback，指示最新动作是否被接受并引导下一步有效动作。5) 提出 Protocol Completion Rate（PCR）衡量是否经由所有必备阶段达到可接受终止，并与最终任务结果解耦。
AI.result: 联合训练后，Qwen3.5-4B 在 Math 上 PCR 达 99.27%，在 Search 上达 99.96%；任务结果分别为 82.95% 和 46.61%，略优于原始基线。控制实验考察了技能指令、训练信号与契约状态反馈对两项指标的影响；withholding 干预实验评估了行为对观测内容的依赖。
AI.conclusion: 通过将技能契约化并配套可验证的稠密训练信号与运行时反馈，可以在不牺牲（甚至略微提升）最终任务表现的前提下，实现接近满分的流程合规执行。作者还通过消融与干预实验分析了各设计要素的作用及智能体对观测内容的依赖。

title: How Should Teachers Be Prepared? RL on Student-Induced States for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves the reasoning capabilities of small language models through token-level teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories. Yet can teachers that excel at solving problems independently also guide student reasoning effectively? Prior work shows that when student prefixes follow reasoning paths that differ from the teacher's own or contain errors, teachers can be less accurate when continuing from these prefixes than when solving problems independently. To this end, we propose Prep-OPD, which uses reinforcement learning (RL) before distillation to train the teacher to adapt to the student's existing reasoning state and correct course when errors arise. Training optimizes teacher continuations from fixed student prefixes using final-answer correctness as the reward. The prepared teacher then trains the student through trajectory guidance and token-level supervision. We evaluate Prep-OPD on eight mathematical reasoning benchmarks, using Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 as the teacher and Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B as students. With the 4B teacher and 1.7B student, Prep-OPD improves average accuracy over standard OPD and the strongest baseline, Relay-OPD, by 8.28 and 2.30 percentage points, respectively. Controlled experiments further show that teacher RL conditioned on student-generated prefixes yields higher student accuracy than problem-start teacher RL with and without handoff on Qwen3-1.7B. Reusing the same prepared teacher also improves Qwen3-0.6B.

AI.tldr: 提出Prep-OPD：在蒸馏前用强化学习训练教师适应学生的推理状态并纠错，从而提升小模型推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有on-policy distillation中，擅长独立解题的教师在接续学生生成的不同推理路径或含错前缀时，准确性会下降，因此需要让教师学会适应学生状态并纠错。
AI.method: Prep-OPD先用RL在固定的学生前缀上训练教师，以最终答案正确性为奖励，优化教师对后续推理的生成；随后用该教师通过轨迹引导和token级监督训练学生。
AI.result: 在8个数学推理基准上，教师Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507、学生Qwen3-1.7B时，平均准确率比标准OPD和最强基线Relay-OPD分别高8.28和2.30个百分点；基于学生前缀的教师RL优于问题起点教师RL；同一教师也可提升Qwen3-0.6B。
AI.conclusion: 让教师在蒸馏前通过RL适应学生前缀并纠错，可显著提升on-policy distillation的效果，且具备跨学生规模的复用性。

title: Memadapter: Counterfactual Adaptation Against Memory-induced Sycophancy
summary: Long-term memory enables LLM-based agents to retain and reuse information across tasks and sessions, supporting personalization and long-horizon interactions. However, persistent memories can also induce sycophancy, causing agents to over-align with users' historical beliefs even when they are inaccurate, outdated, or inconsistent with objective evidence. Existing mitigation methods assume that memory-induced sycophancy originates from biased or incorrect memories and attempt to reduce this risk by filtering such memories at different stages of the memory pipeline. However, in the real world, objective and correct memories can still induce sycophancy, and the same memory can warrant different influence across different contexts. To this end, we propose MemAdapter, a novel framework that adaptively integrates retrieved memories to support objective and reliable reasoning. Specifically, MemAdapter consists of three components: (i) Counterfactual Induction, which leverages counterfactual reasoning to uncover the potential risk of retrieved memories; (ii) Context-Aware Reflection, which calibrates the inferential influence of each retrieved memory in light of the current task via self-reflection; and (iii) Evidence-Based Reasoning, which grounds the final response in appropriate evidence while preserving the legitimate influence of memory. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate that MemAdapter consistently improves memory reliability across diverse scenarios. Our code is available at https://github.com/DEEP-JLU/MemAdapter.

AI.tldr: 提出MemAdapter框架，通过反事实归纳、上下文感知反思和证据推理三个组件，自适应整合检索到的记忆，缓解大模型智能体因长期记忆导致的谄媚问题，在三个基准上提升记忆可靠性。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆使LLM智能体能够跨任务保留和复用信息，但持久记忆也会诱发谄媚，使智能体过度迎合用户的历史信念，即使这些信念不准确、过时或与客观证据不一致。现有缓解方法假设记忆引发的谄媚源于有偏或错误记忆，故在记忆流水线各阶段过滤此类记忆，但现实中客观正确的记忆同样可引发谄媚，且同一记忆在不同情境下应有不同影响。
AI.method: MemAdapter包含三个组件：(i) 反事实归纳（Counterfactual Induction），利用反事实推理揭示检索记忆的潜在风险；(ii) 上下文感知反思（Context-Aware Reflection），通过自我反思根据当前任务校准每条检索记忆的推理影响；(iii) 证据推理（Evidence-Based Reasoning），在保留记忆合理影响的同时将最终回答建立在适当证据之上。
AI.result: 在三个基准上的大量实验表明，MemAdapter在多样场景下持续提升记忆可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 客观正确的记忆也可能引发谄媚，关键在于根据上下文自适应地校准记忆的影响，而非仅过滤有偏记忆；MemAdapter为此提供了有效方案，代码已开源。

title: EDISCO: Equivariant DIScrete Diffusion for Euclidean Combinatorial Optimization
comment: 45 pages, 8 figures, 18 tables, accepted to NeurIPS 2026
summary: Euclidean combinatorial optimization problems (ECOPs), such as the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) and Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP), possess inherent symmetries under the two-dimensional Euclidean group E(2), including rotations, reflections, and translations. Existing learning-based methods, including recent diffusion-based methods, rely on data augmentation or regularization to approximate E(2)-equivariance. This paper presents EDISCO, the first discrete diffusion model for ECOPs with exact E(2)-invariant generative distributions over node-index solutions. EDISCO introduces an E(2)-equivariant edge-score network coupled with a categorical continuous-time Markov chain over discrete edge variables, and exact posterior sampling provides efficient multi-step inference. This design gives EDISCO a local geometric inductive bias: edge neighborhoods with the same relative geometry and combinatorial context are represented consistently regardless of absolute position or orientation, making learning more efficient and inference more robust than non-equivariant methods. EDISCO outperforms previous learning-based state-of-the-art solvers on synthetic TSP from 100 to 10000 nodes and CVRP from 50 to 2000 customers, while using only 33-50% of the training instances. Trained only on uniform synthetic data, EDISCO also outperforms competing learning-based baselines under spatial distribution shift and CVRP constraint-tightness shift. Code is available at https://github.com/ValleyC/EDISCO.

AI.tldr: EDISCO是首个具有精确E(2)不变生成分布的欧氏组合优化离散扩散模型，在TSP和CVRP上超越现有学习型求解器且训练数据更少。
AI.motivation: 欧氏组合优化问题（如TSP、CVRP）在二维欧氏群E(2)下具有旋转、反射、平移的固有对称性，但现有学习型方法（包括扩散方法）仅通过数据增强或正则化近似E(2)等变性，未能精确利用这一对称性。
AI.method: 提出EDISCO：在节点索引解上具有精确E(2)不变生成分布的离散扩散模型。设计E(2)等变边评分网络，配合离散边变量上的分类连续时间马尔可夫链，并通过精确后验采样实现高效多步推理。
AI.result: 在100至10000节点的合成TSP和50至2000客户的CVRP上超越此前学习型SOTA求解器，仅用33-50%训练实例；仅在均匀合成数据上训练，在空间分布偏移和CVRP约束紧度偏移下仍优于竞争基线。
AI.conclusion: EDISCO赋予模型局部几何归纳偏置，使相同相对几何与组合上下文的边邻域表示一致，从而提升学习效率与推理鲁棒性。

title: A Safe Action Is Not Enough: Feasible-Future Decoding for Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary:
A safe action is not necessarily a viable one. Under a frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policy, an action can be likely and locally admissible yet leave no policy-supported route to safe task completion. We call this the feasibility-likelihood gap: likelihood ranks the current action, whereas feasibility depends on the futures that remain after it.
  We derive the exact next-block marginal of the history-conditioned policy-environment trajectory law restricted to safe task completion. The derivation exposes a candidate-dependent feasible-future mass with two roles: its support records whether safe completion remains possible under the frozen continuation process, and its magnitude measures how much weighted safe-completion mass is preserved. Exact evaluation is impractical online, so we develop a selective finite-candidate approximation, derive conditions for recovering the best retained viable candidate, and instantiate it as an alarm-triggered, training-free reranker.
  On Safety-CHORES, VICS-G lowers mean cumulative safety cost by 1.9%-57.5% across six settings while remaining within 2.5 percentage points of policy sampling in success and 0.82 steps in mean episode length. The resulting decoder is tied to an exact policy-relative safe-completion target, yet requires neither retraining of the base policy nor online trajectory rollouts.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"可行性-似然性差距"问题：冻结的VLA策略下，一个动作可能高概率且局部可行，却无法通向安全的任务完成；作者推导精确的安全完成下一块边缘分布，并提出免训练、报警触发的重排器VICS-G。
AI.motivation: 在冻结的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略下，动作的似然性高并不意味着该动作仍保留通往安全任务完成的可行路径。现有方法只用似然对当前动作排序，无法反映该动作之后是否还存在策略支持的、可安全完成任务的未来，从而产生"可行性-似然性差距"。论文旨在让解码直接对齐"策略相对的安全完成"目标，且无需重训基座策略或在线轨迹展开。
AI.method: 作者推导了受限在安全任务完成条件下的、以历史为条件的策略-环境轨迹律的精确"下一块"（next-block）边缘分布，暴露出一个依赖候选动作的可行未来质量：其支撑集表示在冻结续推过程中安全完成是否仍可能，其大小衡量保留下来的加权安全完成质量。由于精确在线评估不可行，作者提出一种选择性的有限候选近似，给出恢复"最佳保留可行候选"的条件，并将其实例化为报警触发、免训练的重排器VICS-G。
AI.result: 在Safety-CHORES上，VICS-G在六种设置下将平均累积安全代价降低1.9%–57.5%，同时成功率与策略采样差距在2.5个百分点以内，平均回合长度差距为0.82步。
AI.conclusion: 所得解码器与精确的"策略相对安全完成"目标相绑定，但既不需要重训基座策略，也不需要在线轨迹展开，表明在冻结VLA策略上以轻量、免训练的重排即可有效弥合可行性-似然性差距。

title: Trinity: One Differentiable Physics for Training, Refining and Scoring Generative Floorplanners
comment: Shih-Ying Yeh and Tzu-Sian Wang contributed equally. 85 pages, 65 figures, 67 tables. Project page: https://kohaku-lab.github.io/Trinity/ Code: https://github.com/Kohaku-Lab/Trinity Models: https://huggingface.co/KBlueLeaf/Trinity
summary: Floorplanning arranges the blocks of a chip and decides their shapes under objectives that press blocks together, short wirelength and a small outline, and constraints that hold them apart, non-overlap, clusters, MIB shapes and boundary blocks. Recent diffusion placers train on reference layouts alone and leave this coupled system to guidance, post-hoc loops and a legalizer, reporting only the endpoint, which hides what the generator contributes. We re-implement four of them under one recipe on FloorSet, score raw, refined and legalized layouts on one scale, and propose Trinity, a flow-matching floorplanner whose six differentiable functions for the constraints and objectives are its training loss term, the energy of a closed-form refiner after sampling and the base of a soft cost for every stage. The network thus learns the correction prior placers apply in their samplers, and sampling needs no guidance. Stage by stage, the training term lowers a plain transformer's raw soft cost by 26% and matters most at short budgets, the shared refiner decides more of the final cost than the generator and matches a ported placer's loop in 16 to 660 times fewer steps, Trinity's refined soft cost is 36% below the best ported pipeline, the soft cost ranks settings as the contest's hard cost does, and on the FloorSet val set the pipeline reaches a mean hard cost of 1.014 in 1.63 s per case.

AI.tldr: 论文重新实现四个扩散布局器并统一评估，提出流匹配的布局规划器 Trinity，将六个可微约束/目标函数作为训练损失、闭式精炼器能量与各阶段软代价基础，无需引导采样即可学习修正先验。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散布局器仅在参考布局上训练，将耦合系统交给引导、事后循环与合法化器处理，只报告最终结果，掩盖了生成器的实际贡献，缺乏对生成质量本身的分阶段评估。
AI.method: 在 FloorSet 上用统一配方复现四个扩散布局器；对原始、精炼、合法化布局在同一尺度评分；提出 Trinity 流匹配布局器，其六个可微约束与目标函数同时作为训练损失项、采样后闭式精炼器的能量以及各阶段软代价的基础。
AI.result: 训练项将普通 Transformer 的原始软代价降低 26%，在短预算下作用最大；共享精炼器决定最终代价的比重超过生成器，并在 16 至 660 倍更少步数下匹配移植布局器的循环；Trinity 精炼后软代价比最佳移植流程低 36%；软代价对设置的排序与竞赛硬代价一致；FloorSet 验证集上平均硬代价 1.014，每例 1.63 秒。
AI.conclusion: 将约束与目标统一为可微函数并贯穿训练、精炼与评估，可让网络直接学习修正先验，无需采样引导，且精炼器比生成器更主导最终质量，整体优于现有移植流程。

title: CreativeFlow: A One-to-Many Analogical Relation Transfer Method for 3D Asset Generation
comment: 3 pages. To appear in SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Posters (SA Posters '26), Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, December 2026
summary: Inspired by cognitive science, we present CREATIVEFLOW, an analogical generation framework that explicitly models analogical divergent thinking to mitigate creative homogenization in text-to-3D pipelines. Our method derives a series of meaningful yet relationally similar source-target asset pairs, each featuring distinct geometric configurations. Expert evaluations demonstrate that our framework substantially enhances creative novelty and visual fascination. This workflow and its resulting assets establish a foundational dataset and benchmark for future relation-aware 3D model training.

AI.tldr: 提出 CREATIVEFLOW——一个受认知科学启发的类比生成框架，通过显式建模类比发散思维来缓解文本到3D流程中的创意同质化问题。
AI.motivation: 文本到3D生成流程存在创意同质化问题，生成结果趋于雷同、缺乏新颖性。作者从认知科学中的类比思维获得启发，希望借助类比发散思维机制来提升生成的创造性。
AI.method: 构建 CREATIVEFLOW 类比生成框架，显式建模类比发散思维；通过推导一系列有意义但关系相似的"源资产—目标资产"配对，且每对具有不同的几何构型，实现关系感知的类比式3D资产生成。
AI.result: 专家评估表明，该框架显著提升了生成结果的创意新颖性与视觉吸引力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作流程及其生成的资产为未来关系感知的3D模型训练建立了基础数据集与基准，为缓解创意同质化提供了新思路。

title: MAGIC: Topology-Aware Analytic Graph Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Graph few-shot class-incremental learning (GFSCIL) requires a model to continually recognize emerging classes from only a few labeled nodes while preserving previously acquired knowledge. Beyond the catastrophic forgetting inherited from conventional graph continual learning, GFSCIL presents two distinctive challenges: extremely limited novel-class supervision causes severe overfitting, while cross-session edges---edges connecting newly arriving nodes with historical nodes---alter historical propagation neighborhoods and thereby induce representation drift. We propose MAGIC, a replay-free GFSCIL framework that combines a frozen graph representation backbone (e.g., an intrinsically parameter-free backbone such as SGC or a pretrained graph foundation model) with closed-form analytic continual learning. To alleviate novel-session overfitting, MAGIC learns a topological prior from the base graph that can characterize both homophilous and heterophilous relations, and injects this prior through Potts Markov random field inference to refine supervision for novel classes. To mitigate representation drift, MAGIC transfers previous predictions from the old representations of affected historical nodes to their updated representations through drift-aware analytic distillation. Experiments across five datasets and eight baselines demonstrate the effectiveness of MAGIC. Under the 5-shot setting, MAGIC improves Mean Accuracy and Final Accuracy by 5.48 percentage points and 9.33 percentage points on average, and reduces Performance Drop by 10.78 percentage points on average compared with the best baselines. MAGIC also shows clear advantages under the 1- and 3-shot settings, with larger gains as the number of supports increases. Moreover, MAGIC requires substantially less training time.

AI.tldr: MAGIC：一种免回放的图小样本类增量学习框架，结合冻结图表示骨干与闭式解析持续学习，通过拓扑先验注入和漂移感知蒸馏缓解过拟合与表示漂移。
AI.motivation: 图小样本类增量学习（GFSCIL）除传统图持续学习的灾难性遗忘外，还面临两个特有挑战：新类监督极少导致严重过拟合；跨会话边（新节点与历史节点相连）改变历史传播邻域，引发表示漂移。
AI.method: MAGIC 采用免回放框架，融合冻结的图表示骨干（如无参数的 SGC 或预训练图基础模型）与闭式解析持续学习。一是从基础图学习可刻画同质与异质关系的拓扑先验，经 Potts 马尔可夫随机场推断注入以精炼新类监督；二是通过漂移感知解析蒸馏，将受影响历史节点旧表示上的先前预测迁移到其更新表示上。
AI.result: 在五个数据集、八个基线上验证有效。5-shot 设置下，平均 Mean Accuracy 与 Final Accuracy 分别提升 5.48 与 9.33 个百分点，Performance Drop 平均降低 10.78 个百分点；1-shot 与 3-shot 下同样占优，且随支持样本数增加增益更大，训练时间也显著更少。
AI.conclusion: MAGIC 通过拓扑先验精炼监督与漂移感知蒸馏，在免回放前提下有效缓解新类过拟合与表示漂移，在准确率、抗遗忘和效率上均优于现有基线。

title: AECG: Asymmetric Experience Consolidation and Governance In Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems increasingly rely on memory to transform execution trajectories into reusable procedural knowledge. Yet repeated retrieval also makes memory errors persistent: memory pollution arises when outdated, weakly supported, or spuriously successful procedures become recurring components of future reasoning. Multi-agent execution introduces an additional structural risk. Scope collapse occurs when procedural knowledge escapes the coordination scope in which it was shown effective and is repeatedly reused at incompatible decision levels, allowing local errors to influence cascades of downstream decisions. Meanwhile, task-level failures provide ambiguous supervision because they rarely reveal which recalled knowledge was responsible. We introduce AECG, a framework for asymmetric experience consolidation and governance for multi-agent systems. AECG turns memory from static experience storage into a dynamic reliability-governance loop, preserving coordination scope and using multi-scale, confidence-aware reliability to detect degradation. It then combines degradation with downstream impact to prioritize high-risk knowledge under a bounded review budget, applies targeted interventions, and reactivates revised skills only after paired replay. Across three multi-agent frameworks and four benchmarks, AECG achieves the best score in 11 of 12 framework--benchmark settings and improves over the strongest competing memory method by as much as 10.23 percentage points; removing scope preservation reduces accuracy by up to 16.89 points. AECG thereby reframes multi-agent memory from passive accumulation into auditable reliability governance. Code is available at https://github.com/fenhg297/AECG

AI.tldr: 本文提出AECG框架，将多智能体系统中的记忆从静态存储转变为动态可靠性治理循环，通过保留协调范围、多尺度置信度检测退化、优先级干预与配对重放验证，有效缓解记忆污染与范围坍缩问题。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的多智能体系统依赖记忆将执行轨迹转化为可复用的程序性知识，但反复检索会使记忆错误持续存在。记忆污染指过时、支撑薄弱或虚假成功的程序成为未来推理的常驻组件；范围坍缩指程序性知识脱离其被验证有效的协调范围，在不兼容的决策层级被反复复用，导致局部错误向下游决策级联传播。同时，任务级失败提供的是模糊监督，难以揭示究竟是哪条被召回的知识导致了失败。
AI.method: AECG是一个面向多智能体系统的非对称经验巩固与治理框架。它把记忆从静态经验存储转为动态可靠性治理循环：保留协调范围；采用多尺度、置信度感知的可靠性来检测退化；将退化与下游影响结合，在有限审查预算下优先处理高风险知识；执行针对性干预；仅在配对重放通过后重新激活修订后的技能。
