AI.result: 在三个多智能体框架和四个基准上，AECG在12个"框架—基准"组合中的11个取得最佳成绩，相比最强的竞争记忆方法最多提升10.23个百分点；消融掉范围保留机制后，准确率最多下降16.89个百分点。
AI.conclusion: AECG将多智能体记忆从被动积累重新定义为可审计的可靠性治理，代码已开源。

title: One Token Can Be Enough: Bridging Prompting and Activation Steering with Prefix Steering
summary: Prompting guides language model behavior through the initial context, whereas activation steering often intervenes throughout generation. A natural question is whether steering can produce effects on subsequent computation similar to those of prompting. Under fixed-state attention assumptions, we establish sufficient conditions for single- and multi-token steering to match prompt-induced attention-head outputs, and characterize how changes in input representations affect this match and its approximation error. This attention-level connection leads us to ask whether, at the behavioral level, steering can also guide subsequent generation through a brief initial intervention. We study Prefix Steering, which applies existing steering directions and operators over a short span starting at the final prompt token, with no further direct intervention afterward. We examine how intervention duration and strength jointly shape the control-capability trade-off. Across four models and five tasks, intervention over a short span, even a single token, often retains much of full steering's behavioral control while better preserving general capabilities, offering a trade-off competitive with, and in some settings better than, prompting and alternative steering-strength policies. Prefix Steering also remains effective on final-answer formatting tasks after reasoning, suggesting that a brief initial intervention can influence behavior expressed well after steering ends. These findings challenge the common practice of steering every generated token and motivate a more dynamical view of activation steering, in which a brief intervention can alter the trajectory of subsequent generation without continued intervention.

AI.tldr: 本文研究激活引导（activation steering）能否像提示（prompting）一样，仅通过短暂初始干预影响后续生成，并提出 Prefix Steering 方法。
AI.motivation: 提示通过初始上下文引导模型行为，而激活引导通常在生成全程干预。作者想探究：引导能否仅在初始阶段产生与提示类似的效果，从而影响后续生成。
AI.method: 在固定状态注意力假设下，建立单 token 与多 token 引导匹配提示诱导的注意力头输出的充分条件，并刻画输入表示变化对匹配及近似误差的影响；进而提出 Prefix Steering，在从最终提示 token 开始的短区间内施加现有引导方向和算子，之后不再直接干预。
AI.result: 在四个模型和五个任务上，短区间（甚至单 token）干预常能保留大部分完全引导的行为控制能力，同时更好保持通用能力，其权衡优于或部分优于提示和替代引导强度策略；在推理后的最终答案格式任务上仍有效。
AI.conclusion: 短暂初始干预可以改变后续生成轨迹，无需持续干预，挑战了“对每个生成 token 都进行引导”的常见做法，支持对激活引导采取更动态的视角。

title: From Scientific Observations to Mechanisms: Benchmarking Hypothesis Generation by AI Scientists
summary: Data-driven mechanistic hypotheses are essential to scientific discovery because they explain how underlying processes produce observed phenomena. AI agents and AI scientists increasingly support scientific data analysis. However, their ability to turn empirical findings into mechanistic hypotheses remains insufficiently examined. To address this gap, we introduce MechHypoBench, the first benchmark for evaluating whether AI agents and AI scientists can generate such hypotheses from empirical data. It combines paper-derived mechanisms from 14 scientific fields with real-world datasets containing 17.98 million records. The construction retains the observational complexity of empirical data while providing a specified underlying mechanism. Agents analyze the observations and propose open-form hypotheses. We develop an evaluation framework that assesses open-form mechanistic hypotheses through their consequences under withheld conditions. Experiments with general agents and AI scientists reveal a substantial gap between generated hypotheses and the underlying mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MechHypoBench，首个评估 AI 智能体与 AI 科学家能否从经验数据中生成机制性假设的基准，结合 14 个科学领域的论文机制与含 1798 万条记录的真实数据集，并开发基于"在保留条件下假设后果"的评估框架；实验显示生成假设与真实机制之间存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动的机制性假设是科学发现的核心，因为它能解释潜在过程如何产生观测现象。AI 智能体与 AI 科学家日益支持科学数据分析，但其将经验发现转化为机制性假设的能力尚未被充分检验。
AI.method: 构建 MechHypoBench：融合来自 14 个科学领域的论文派生机制与包含 17.98 百万条记录的真实数据集，在保留经验数据观测复杂性的同时提供已知的底层机制；智能体分析观测并提出开放式假设。同时开发评估框架，通过假设在被保留（withheld）条件下的后果来评估开放式机制性假设。
AI.result: 对通用智能体与 AI 科学家的实验表明，生成的假设与底层真实机制之间存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: AI 智能体与 AI 科学家在从经验数据生成机制性假设方面仍能力不足，MechHypoBench 为该能力提供了首个系统性评测基准与评估方法。

title: Hamiltonian Metric Learning and Energy-Based Training: A Dissipative Geometric Framework for Optimization
summary: Optimization in machine learning is usually expressed through iterative rules that update model parameters using information from the loss landscape. In this work, we study an alternative viewpoint in which parameter optimization is treated as the evolution of a dissipative dynamical system. The model parameters are regarded as generalized coordinates, the loss acts as a potential energy, and a positive-definite metric defines the local kinetic geometry of parameter space. Starting from a variational formulation, we derive the corresponding Hamiltonian dynamics, the geometric force generated by a position-dependent metric, and a metric-compatible Rayleigh dissipation law. The resulting continuous system satisfies a monotonic energy-dissipation relation, while its discrete form allows the influence of curvature on the optimization trajectory to be studied directly. We illustrate the framework using a controlled CIFAR-10 image-reconstruction problem for which the optimum is known analytically. With the image Hessian used as the metric, the curvature dependence of the quadratic modal dynamics is removed. We then reparameterize the same image as a matrix product state, producing a genuinely position-dependent metric and a nonzero geometric force. Poincaré return maps provide a complementary phase-space view of the resulting contraction dynamics. These examples establish HAMLET as a geometric, energy-based framework for studying optimization as dissipative motion in parameter space. On a five-seed MNIST MLP benchmark, HAMLET attains the highest mean test accuracy (97.95\%) and the lowest mean test negative log-likelihood (0.0696) among the three evaluated optimizers.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出HAMLET框架，将参数优化视为耗散动力系统的演化，通过变分方法推导哈密顿动力学、几何力和Rayleigh耗散，并在图像重建与MNIST基准上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统机器学习优化通过迭代规则更新参数，仅利用损失景观信息，缺乏对参数空间几何结构及动力学演化的系统刻画，作者希望从耗散动力系统的新视角统一描述优化过程。
AI.method: 将模型参数视为广义坐标、损失视为势能、正定度量定义局部动能几何；从变分表述出发推导对应哈密顿动力学、由位置依赖度量产生的几何力以及与度量相容的Rayleigh耗散律，得到连续系统及其离散形式，并采用Hessian度量、矩阵乘积态重参数化及Poincaré返回映射进行分析。
AI.result: 连续系统满足单调能量耗散关系，离散形式可直接研究曲率对优化轨迹的影响。在已知解析最优解的CIFAR-10图像重建中，以图像Hessian为度量可消除二次模态动力学的曲率依赖；将同一图像重参数化为矩阵乘积态后得到真正位置依赖的度量与非零几何力，Poincaré返回映射提供了收缩动力学的相空间视角。在五种子MNIST MLP基准上，HAMLET取得最高平均测试准确率97.95%与最低平均测试负对数似然0.0696。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果确立了HAMLET作为几何、基于能量的框架，用于将优化研究为参数空间中的耗散运动，并在实际基准上展现出优于其他优化器的性能。

title: Image Synthesis as an Intermediate for Controllable Time Series Generation
summary: Semantic-driven time-series generation offers a promising way to improve downstream learning in few-shot forecasting, but directly generating numerical sequences from language often fails to preserve the intended temporal structure. We propose VisualBridge, which uses time-series plots as a visual intermediate to bridge high-level temporal semantics and numerical sequences. An MLLM first converts plotted series into structured semantic representations, enabling explicit control over temporal properties such as trend, seasonality, and volatility. We then learn a semantic editing policy with downstream forecasting rewards, allowing the generation process to favor temporal patterns that are beneficial for the target task. The resulting sequences are further modeled by a temporal VAE to produce consistent multivariate augmentations. Experiments on standard public forecasting benchmarks demonstrate that VisualBridge improves few-shot forecasting over conventional augmentation methods, with ablations validating the roles of visual semantic grounding, learned semantic control, and VAE-based generation.

AI.tldr: VisualBridge 用时间序列图形作为视觉中间桥梁，将高层时序语义与数值序列关联，结合语义编辑策略与时序 VAE，实现可控的时序数据增强，提升少样本预测效果。
AI.motivation: 语义驱动的时间序列生成有潜力改善少样本预测，但直接从语言生成数值序列往往难以保持预期的时序结构。
AI.method: 先由 MLLM 将绘制的时间序列转换为结构化语义表示，显式控制趋势、季节性和波动性；再用下游预测奖励学习语义编辑策略，使生成偏向对目标任务有益的时序模式；最后用时序 VAE 建模生成序列，产生一致的多变量增强数据。
AI.result: 在标准公开预测基准上，VisualBridge 相比传统增强方法提升了少样本预测性能；消融实验验证了视觉语义接地、学习式语义控制与 VAE 生成的作用。
AI.conclusion: 以时间序列图形为视觉中间表示，结合可学习语义控制与 VAE 生成，是提升少样本时序预测的一种有效数据增强思路。

title: Priced Guidance: Can Language Models Generate Future Research Ideas?
summary: We evaluate language models' capability to generate novel research ideas through the lens of compression. We aim to lower-bound the potentially tiny probability that a language model generates the essence of a future research idea without any hints. Rather than estimate this probability through expensive repeated sampling, our Priced Guidance framework measures the compression cost: how many additional bits of information are needed to guide the model to recover the target idea. We prove that if the model can recover the target idea with at most K bits of guidance in expectation, then it can generate the idea without any guidance with probability at least $2^{-K}$. In our framework, the language model, called the generator, can pose a sequence of multiple-choice questions and specify a probability distribution over possible answers. A guide, which is a language model with access to the target idea, selects answers. If a selected answer has prior probability p, the generator pays $-\log_2 p$ bits. The generator aims to produce an idea that matches the essence of the target idea with minimal cumulative cost. This cumulative cost equals, up to an additive constant, the number of bits of information sent by the guide. Using this methodology, we evaluate five generator LLMs (Opus 5, Fable 5.1, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 Sol, and GLM 5.3) on the core ideas in 87 recent high-quality deep learning papers and we use LLM as judge to determine whether the generated idea matches the target in terms of the central research object and defining mechanism. Fable 5.1 achieves the lowest median compression cost at 69.9 bits, substantially lower than gzip's median of 5,712 bits for losslessly compressing the summary of the target idea. A uniform ensemble of Fable 5.1, Opus 5, and Astra further reduces the median compression cost to 55.8 bits and improves the generation probability lower bound by 18,000 times.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Priced Guidance 框架，用压缩成本衡量语言模型生成未来研究想法的能力，并证明引导成本 K 比特对应无引导生成概率下界 2^{-K}。
AI.motivation: 直接通过反复采样估计语言模型"凭空"生成未来研究想法的概率成本极高、难以测量，因此需要一种更高效的下界估计方法。
AI.method: 让生成器模型提出一系列多选题并给出答案概率分布，由掌握目标想法的引导模型选择答案；若所选答案先验概率为 p，则记录成本 -log₂p 比特，累计成本即引导所传递的信息量上界（至多相差常数）。据此对五个生成器 LLM 在 87 篇近期高质量深度学习论文的核心想法上评测，并用 LLM 作为裁判判断生成想法是否在核心研究对象与关键机制上与目标一致。
AI.result: Fable 5.1 取得最低中位压缩成本 69.9 比特，远低于 gzip 无损压缩目标想法摘要的 5,712 比特中位数；Fable 5.1、Opus 5 与 Astra 的均匀集成进一步将中位成本降至 55.8 比特，并将生成概率下界提升约 18,000 倍。
AI.conclusion: 压缩成本可作为衡量语言模型生成新研究想法能力的有效代理指标，集成模型能显著降低引导成本并提升无引导生成的概率下界。

title: Safe Context Switching for Agents in the Wild: Mitigating Subspace Interference via Orthogonal Adaptation
summary: Most Large Language Models exhibit a fundamental tension between two sequential tasks, such as logical reasoning and safety alignment. The high-variance internal states required for sophisticated Chain-of-Thought (CoT) deduction can geometrically interfere with latent representations encoding safety constraints. We identify this phenomenon as Sequential Subspace Interference, showing that standard fine-tuning on logical tasks such as multi-step mathematics and code generation can result in a 23.3% interference penalty on alignment benchmarks, substantially weakening the model's safety priors. This Reasoning Drift is not adequately captured by current adaptation methods because gradients for logical tasks are rarely orthogonal to safety objectives. To address this issue, we propose AURA (Adaptive Unique Residual Allocation), a spectral regularization framework that enforces Spectral Independence between reasoning and safety. By explicitly estimating the null space of the alignment manifold and constraining reasoning updates to its orthogonal complement, AURA enables models to improve logical reasoning without compromising safety. Empirically, AURA recovers 23.0% of the lost performance while preserving greater than 0.98 cosine fidelity to the safe state, demonstrating that reasoning and alignment can be effectively decoupled through geometric regularization.

AI.tldr: 论文识别出"序列子空间干扰"现象，并提出谱正则化框架AURA，通过约束推理更新位于对齐流形零空间的补空间中，实现推理与安全性的解耦。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在逻辑推理与安全对齐两类序列任务间存在根本性张力：复杂思维链推理所需的高方差内部状态会在几何上干扰编码安全约束的潜在表示。标准微调在数学、代码等逻辑任务上会造成23.3%的对齐性能干扰惩罚，削弱安全先验，而现有适配方法无法充分刻画这种"推理漂移"，因为逻辑任务的梯度很少与安全目标正交。
AI.method: 提出AURA（自适应唯一残差分配），一个谱正则化框架，旨在强制推理与安全之间的"谱独立性"。具体做法是显式估计对齐流形的零空间，并将推理性更新约束到其正交补空间中。
AI.result: AURA恢复了23.0%的损失性能，同时对安全状态保持大于0.98的余弦保真度。
AI.conclusion: 推理与对齐可以通过几何正则化实现有效解耦，为兼顾逻辑能力与安全性提供了可行路径。

title: What Will Post-Training Fix? Per-Problem Gains Are Shared Across Independent RL Runs, and Existing Checkpoints Predict Them Better Than A Priori Signals
summary: Data selection, curricula and the evaluation of post-training recipes all assume that we can tell, before training, which problems a model will improve on. We test this assumption directly. For two base models, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B and Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, we evaluate eighteen post-training runs on up to 1532 competition math problems with many samples per problem, and compare signals available before training against a noise ceiling derived from the agreement between disjoint subsets of runs. Three findings hold on both base models. What post-training fixes is shared: independent runs agree on which rarely solved problems improve, with a noise ceiling of about 0.9, yet the two base models agree with each other only at rho=0.25 - the shared component belongs to the base model, not to the problem. A priori signals capture a minority of it: base pass rate, the likelihood of a correct solution, a larger model's pass rate and their combinations explain only 0.30 and 0.24 of the explainable variance in gains. Existing checkpoints are the better predictor: the per-problem gains of a single checkpoint from another family predict a new run better than every a priori signal, alone or combined (0.52 vs. 0.33 and 0.34 vs. 0.17 against the combined signals). The conclusions hold on problems from 2025-2026 competitions and when the baselines on the two sides of every comparison are estimated independently. We propose the noise ceiling as a standard companion to per-problem signals.

AI.tldr: 本文检验"训练前即可预测模型将在哪些问题上提升"这一假设，发现增益的可预测部分主要归属于基座模型而非问题本身，且现有检查点比任何先验信号更能预测新训练运行的逐题增益。
AI.motivation: 数据选择、课程设计与后训练配方评估都默认：训练前就能判断模型会在哪些问题上取得进步。作者直接检验这一假设，考察这种可预测性到底有多大、来自何处，以及哪些信号真正有效。
AI.method: 以 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 和 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B 为基座，对多达 1532 道竞赛数学题进行 18 次后训练运行，每题多次采样；将训练前的先验信号（基座通过率、正确解似然、更大模型的通过率及其组合）与由不同运行子集一致性推导出的噪声上限进行比较；并检验跨检查点、跨基座模型的预测能力，用 2025-2026 竞赛题和独立估计基线做稳健性验证。
AI.result: 两个基座上结论一致：(1) 后训练修复的是共享成分，独立运行对哪些"极少被解出"的问题会提升有一致判断，噪声上限约 0.9，但两个基座模型之间仅 rho=0.25，说明共享成分属于基座模型而非问题；(2) 先验信号只能解释可解释方差的少数，基座通过率、正确解似然、更大模型通过率及组合分别解释 0.30 和 0.24；(3) 现有检查点预测更优，来自另一家族的单个检查点的逐题增益可预测新运行，优于所有先验信号单独或组合（0.52 vs 0.33，0.34 vs 0.17）。
AI.conclusion: 训练前的先验信号不足以判断模型将在哪些问题上提升，其可解释部分主要来自基座模型而非问题属性；已有检查点的逐题增益是更强的预测源。作者建议将"噪声上限"作为逐题信号的标配伴随指标。

title: Look Before You Leap: Thermodynamic Arbitration of Parametric and Non-Parametric Knowledge in LLM Agents via Self-Regulating Memory Architectures
summary: The architecture of modern LLMs consists of a profound cognitive polarization. LLMs possess implicit intuition encoded in their parameters, yet rely on a disconnected, explicit mechanism to access the outside world. Agentic frameworks have not bridged this gap; instead, models are often compelled into pathological "induced amnesia." Under the prevailing "Retrieve-Always" paradigm, agents must distrust their internal knowledge, making every user interaction a "tabula rasa" event that must be checked externally. This creates reflexive dependence that can be thermodynamically wasteful, cognitively fragile, and susceptible to irrelevant context. We propose a return to first principles, operationalizing the biological maxim "Look Before You Leap." We introduce MARTA (Metacognitive Adaptive Retrieval and Thought Architecture), a neuro-symbolic framework that bridges parametric and non-parametric knowledge. Rather than treating retrieval as mandatory, MARTA models it as a cost, taking the leap only when perceived internal inadequacy warrants external information. By allowing the agent to gauge the entropy of its own thoughts before acting, MARTA enables deliberative retrieval and uncertainty-aware decision making. Our approach suggests that giving agents the capacity for introspection can restore a more efficient balance between internal knowledge and external information.

AI.tldr: MARTA 是一个神经符号框架，把检索当作有成本的决策，让智能体先评估内部知识是否充分，再决定是否外部检索，从而在内部参数化知识与外部信息之间取得更高效的平衡。
AI.motivation: 当前 LLM 存在"认知极化"：参数中隐含直觉知识，却依赖割裂的显式机制访问外部世界。主流"始终检索"范式迫使模型不信任内部知识，导致"诱导性失忆"，每次交互都成为"白板"事件，造成反思性依赖、热力学浪费、认知脆弱以及对无关上下文的敏感。
AI.method: 作者回归第一性原理，将生物学格言"三思而后行（Look Before You Leap）"操作化，提出 MARTA（Metacognitive Adaptive Retrieval and Thought Architecture），一个连接参数化与非参数化知识的神经符号框架。该框架不把检索视为强制步骤，而是建模为一种成本，仅在感知到内部知识不足时才"起跳"进行外部检索；通过让智能体在行动前度量自身思维的熵，实现审慎检索与不确定性感知的决策。
AI.result: MARTA 使智能体具备内省能力，在内部知识与外部信息之间恢复更高效的平衡，缓解了"始终检索"带来的浪费、脆弱与无关上下文干扰问题。
AI.conclusion: 赋予智能体内省能力，可以重建内部知识与外部信息之间更高效的平衡，为 LLM 智能体的检索决策提供一种以元认知为核心的新范式。

title: How Long, Not How Close: A Learned Temporal Metric for Planning in Latent World Models
summary: Latent world models plan by rolling a frozen predictor forward under candidate action sequences and ranking the candidates by the latent distance between their imagined end state and the goal. However, this ranking breaks down when the goal lies several plans away, because the latent distance measures how closely an end state resembles the goal rather than how far it remains from reaching it. To address this, we propose TEMPO, a temporal-distance planning objective that leaves the world model untouched, learns only from the demonstrations already used to train it, and adds negligible cost to the planner's search. TEMPO learns a small map of the frozen latent in which the distance between two states of an episode reflects the number of environment steps between them, and blends this distance into the planner's cost. It requires no rewards, policies or success labels and, being a cost rather than a model, applies to frozen world models with one latent vector per state that plan by a latent distance. We evaluate TEMPO on eleven simulated environments (e.g., maze navigation, tabletop pushing, robotic arm control and three-dimensional manipulation) with the LeWM and PLDM planners. With a small MLP that adds at most 0.3% to a plan's arithmetic, TEMPO improves both planners at every goal distance, including the one-plan setting of their evaluations, raises LeWM from 36% to 99% on TwoRoom three plans from the goal, and remains competitive on a broad range of 2D and 3D navigation, reaching and manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: TEMPO提出一种时间距离规划目标：在不动世界模型的前提下，学习一个仅反映状态间环境步数的潜在小映射，并将其融入规划器代价，解决了潜在距离在多步规划中失效的问题。
AI.motivation: 潜在世界模型通过将候选动作序列的想象终点与目标做潜在距离比较来选优，但该距离衡量的是“像不像目标”而非“离目标还有多远”，当目标需要多步计划时排序失效。
AI.method: TEMPO不修改冻结的世界模型，仅利用训练世界模型已有的示范数据，学习冻结潜在空间中的一个小映射，使两个状态间的距离对应其间的环境步数，再将此时间距离混合进规划器代价。该方法无需奖励、策略或成功标签，作为代价而非模型，适用于每个状态一个潜在向量、以潜在距离规划的冻结世界模型。
AI.result: 在11个仿真环境（迷宫导航、桌面推动、机械臂控制、三维操作等）上，配合LeWM与PLDM规划器评估。仅用一个小MLP、至多增加0.3%的规划计算量，TEMPO在所有目标距离上均提升两个规划器，包括其评测的单步设定；把LeWM在TwoRoom距目标三步时的成功率从36%提升到99%，并在广泛的2D/3D导航、到达与操作任务上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 用学会的时间距离替代原始潜在距离作为规划代价，是一种轻量、通用且有效的改进，可即插即用地提升冻结潜在世界模型的长程规划能力。

title: GFGE: Unifying Explainable AI Methods through an Interpretation Framework
summary: Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) encompasses methods that draw on different sources of information and address different explanatory needs. A common framework is needed to describe how this information becomes evidence and is communicated as an explanation for a particular recipient. We propose the General Framework for Generating Explanations (GFGE), grounded in interpretative frameworks and the complementary activities of \emph{sense-reading} and \emph{sense-giving}. Its conceptual foundation is the Interpret/Explain Schema (IES), which connects an analyst's interpretation of system evidence, the communication of a selected account, and the recipient's interpretation of that account. GFGE operationalises this schema through five roles: data interpretation, model interpretation, output interpretation, optional post-hoc analysis, and aggregation. A role-typed operation graph records method-specific dependencies, while evidence records retain the sources, assumptions, and limitations of explanatory claims. The explanatory question, audience, and context guide the procedure. We instantiate GFGE for attribution, surrogate, counterfactual, concept and prototype, intrinsic rule, argumentation, and language-model methods. These instantiations show how intrinsic, post-hoc, and hybrid workflows can be represented through the same roles while preserving their distinct evidential requirements. GFGE provides a common basis for analysing explanation workflows, tracing communicated claims to their evidence, and identifying unresolved explanatory dependencies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通用解释生成框架（GFGE），以"解读/给予意义"与解释/说明图式（IES）为基础，通过五种角色和角色类型化操作图，统一刻画归因、代理、反事实、概念与原型、内在规则、论证及语言模型等XAI方法的解释生成流程。
AI.motivation: 可解释人工智能（XAI）方法众多，依赖的信息来源与解释需求各异，缺乏共同框架来描述信息如何转化为证据并向特定接收者传达为解释。
AI.method: 提出GFGE框架，扎根于解释性框架及sense-reading与sense-giving的互补活动。其概念基础为IES图式，连接分析者对系统证据的解读、所选说明的传达及接收者对该说明的解读。GFGE通过五个角色实现：数据解释、模型解释、输出解释、可选的事后分析、聚合。使用角色类型化操作图记录方法特定依赖，证据记录保存解释性主张的来源、假设与局限。解释问题、受众与情境引导该过程。
AI.result: 将GFGE实例化应用于归因、代理、反事实、概念与原型、内在规则、论证及语言模型方法，表明内在、事后与混合工作流可在相同角色下表示，同时保留各自不同的证据要求。
AI.conclusion: GFGE为分析解释工作流、将传达的主张追溯至其证据、识别未解决的解释依赖提供了共同基础。

title: Pessimistic Minimax Learning for Public-Private Information Games under Unilateral Coverage
summary: We study offline learning in two-player zero-sum contextual games with public and private information, motivated by strategic settings such as auctions and negotiations with private valuations. We introduce unilateral prescriptive concentrability and show that asymmetric information can change offline coverage through its effect on equilibrium behavior. For finite state-action spaces, we develop a pessimistic algorithm with an $\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n})$ exploitability rate, matching the standard sample-size dependence for fully observed minimax games. We further develop a pessimistic policy mirror descent framework, PPA-PMD, for general function approximation and obtain a unified $\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n} + 1/\sqrt{T})$ exploitability rate with no-regret actor updates. Together, these results provide the first theoretical framework for offline equilibrium learning under public-private information constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文首次为具有公私信息约束的双人零和情境博弈建立了离线均衡学习的理论框架，提出单边规定性集中性概念，并给出悲观算法与PPA-PMD框架，达到与全观测极小极大博弈相当的样本效率。
AI.motivation: 研究动机来自拍卖、私下估值谈判等策略场景，这些场景兼具公开与私人信息，而现有离线学习理论主要针对完全观测博弈，缺乏对信息不对称如何影响离线覆盖与均衡学习的分析。
AI.method: 作者引入单边规定性集中性（unilateral prescriptive concentrability）量化不对称信息对离线覆盖的影响；针对有限状态-动作空间设计了悲观算法；进一步提出悲观策略镜像下降框架PPA-PMD以支持一般函数逼近，并结合无遗憾的actor更新。
AI.result: 有限空间下悲观算法达到\(\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n})\)的可利用度速率，与完全观测极小极大博弈的标准样本量依赖一致；PPA-PMD框架获得统一的\(\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n} + 1/\sqrt{T})\)可利用度速率，其中actor更新无遗憾。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次为公私信息约束下的离线均衡学习提供了理论框架，揭示不对称信息通过影响均衡行为改变离线覆盖，并证明可在信息受限条件下实现与全观测情形相当的样本效率。

title: Learning from imperfect teachers for low-resource acoustic generalization
summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) improves low-resource acoustic learning by enriching one-hot supervision with the softened predictive distribution of a fixed teacher network. However, a teacher trained with limited or imbalanced annotations may produce a biased distribution whose components are not uniformly reliable. Although this distribution can still encode useful knowledge, direct full-distribution matching may also transfer teacher-induced biases, thereby distorting the student's decision boundary and degrading its generalization performance. To address this limitation, we propose Boundary-Anchored Mass-Partitioned Distillation (BA-MPD), a logit-based distillation objective composed of Boundary-Anchored Correction (BAC) and Mass-Partitioned Distillation (MPD). BAC addresses missing ground-truth labels in the set of the teacher's top predictions by swapping the true label for the lowest-ranked entry of the set, thus keeping the mass and uncertainty of the set unchanged. MPD then distills this corrected distribution through separate losses that enforce relational consistency within the set, balance the mass between high- and low-confidence groups, and weight lower-confidence dependencies. Ultimately, BAC and MPD together suppress harmful ranking errors and noisy low-confidence details, while retaining all useful teacher information. Experiments on two acoustic benchmarks under multiple label budgets show that BA-MPD consistently improves over supervised-learning baselines and vanilla KD while remaining competitive with strong logit-based KD baselines. Cross-budget results further show that BA-MPD remains effective when the teacher and student models use mismatched label budgets, demonstrating its ability to exploit imperfect teachers across supervision gaps. Implementation available at https://github.com/ShuanglinLi/BA-MPD.

AI.tldr: 提出BA-MPD蒸馏目标，修正教师有偏分布并分区蒸馏，提升低资源声学学习。
AI.motivation: 低资源声学学习中，教师网络由有限或不平衡标注训练，其软化预测分布可能存在偏差，各分量可靠性不均。直接全分布匹配会传递教师偏差，扭曲学生决策边界、降低泛化性能。
AI.method: BA-MPD为基于logit的蒸馏目标，含两部分：边界锚定校正（BAC）针对教师top预测集合中缺失真实标签的情况，用真实标签替换集合中排名最低项，保持集合质量与不确定性不变；质量分区蒸馏（MPD）通过分离损失蒸馏校正后分布，分别实现集合内关系一致性、高/低置信组间质量平衡，以及对低置信依赖的加权。
AI.result: 在两个声学基准、多种标签预算下，BA-MPD持续优于监督学习基线和普通KD，并与强logit蒸馏基线相当；跨预算结果显示教师与学生标签预算不匹配时仍有效。
AI.conclusion: BAC与MPD共同抑制有害排序错误与噪声低置信细节，同时保留有用教师信息，说明该方法能利用不完美教师在监督差距下进行有效蒸馏。

title: Beyond Overparameterization: Provable Learning of Input-Convex Multi-Layer Polynomial Networks with Active Queries
summary: The theoretical understanding of multi-layer neural networks is largely confined to overparameterized settings, which obscure parameter identifiability and incur high sample complexity. Neural tangent kernel (NTK) provides a general theory for wide networks, but does not offer efficient sample-complexity guarantees. Recent feature-learning results go beyond kernel methods for single-neuron, multi-index, and hierarchical targets. However, the analysis is often restricted to shallow or specific architectures and to the overparameterized regime. We break this paradigm to achieve parameter-level recovery of deep target networks, albeit by using active data queries. Specifically, we study $L$-layer polynomial networks with even degree-$k$ monomial activations and nonnegative higher-layer weights. This structure makes the target network input-convex, while the optimization landscape remains highly nonconvex with respect to the parameters. Leveraging input convexity and active queries, we propose \textbf{ASPIRE} (\textbf{A}ctive \textbf{S}am\textbf{P}ling for \textbf{I}terative \textbf{R}ecovery via \textbf{E}igendirections), a layerwise sampling-based diagonalization algorithm that recovers all network parameters to $δ$-accuracy with sample complexity $ \widetilde O_{k,L}\left(d^{L^2+O(L)}δ^{-2e}\right) $ in polynomial time. To our knowledge, this is the \emph{first} parameter-recovery guarantee for deep target networks whose exponent grows only polynomially with depth, as well as the \emph{first} justification for the effectiveness of using high-quality data in neural network training, with a remarkably \emph{exponential} separation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ASPIRE 算法，利用输入凸性和主动查询，实现对深层目标网络参数的逐层恢复，取得了深度指数仅为多项式增长的样本复杂度保证。
AI.motivation: 多层神经网络的理论理解多局限于过参数化设定，这会模糊参数可识别性并带来高样本复杂度。NTK 理论虽适用于宽网络，却无法提供高效的样本复杂度保证。近期特征学习研究虽超越了核方法，但通常局限于浅层或特定架构以及过参数化情形。因此本文试图打破这一范式，实现深层目标网络在参数层面的恢复。
AI.method: 研究具有偶数次 k 单项式激活和更高层非负权重的 L 层多项式网络。该结构使目标网络具有输入凸性，而参数空间仍高度非凸。作者利用输入凸性与主动查询，提出 ASPIRE（基于特征方向的主动采样迭代恢复），一种逐层、基于采样的对角化算法，用于恢复全部网络参数。
AI.result: ASPIRE 能在多项式时间内以 δ 精度恢复所有网络参数，样本复杂度为 \widetilde O_{k,L}(d^{L^2+O(L)}δ^{-2e})。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个针对深层目标网络的参数恢复保证，其指数仅随深度多项式增长；也是首个为在神经网络训练中使用高质量数据的有效性提供理论依据的工作，并给出了显著的指数级差距。

title: When Agent Context Goes Stale: Incoherence in Volatile Agent Context
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Accepted to the AgenticOS Workshop at SOSP 2026
summary: Modern agents increasingly ground their reasoning in observations returned by tools, such as file contents read from a workspace. However, the data sources underlying these observations may later be modified by users, other agents, or external tools, while the model retains only the stale content in its context window. Existing agent runtimes provide little support for notifying the model that a previously observed fact has become stale, causing agents to reuse outdated observations and make incorrect claims about the current workspace state. We propose Concord, a context coherence framework that maintains the consistency between tool observation in agent context and the mutable sources from which they were derived. Concord links each observation to its source, detects source changes, and uses configurable handling policies to update, annotate, or suppress stale context before reuse. Concord is applicable across different agent runtimes and external resources, and can be easily extended to new runtime-resource settings. We implement Concord as a general framework, and instantiate a concrete use case to assess its effectiveness. We construct ConcordBench, where previously observed file contents become stale after subsequent edits. Across three evaluated frontier models, Concord produces answers consistent with the restored workspace state in all evaluated cases under these constructed conditions, matching the oracle on recover count for this benchmark, while using 46.4% fewer tokens than the strongest non-oracle baseline.

AI.tldr: Concord 是一个上下文一致性框架，用于维护智能体上下文中工具观察结果与其可变数据源之间的一致性，通过链接观察与来源、检测变更并采用可配置策略处理过期内容，在自建基准 ConcordBench 上取得优于基线的效果。
AI.motivation: 智能体越来越依赖工具返回的观察结果（如工作区文件内容）进行推理，但这些数据源可能被用户、其他智能体或外部工具修改，而模型上下文窗口中只保留过期内容。现有运行时缺乏通知机制，导致智能体复用过期观察并产生错误判断。
AI.method: 提出 Concord 框架：将每条观察链接到其来源，检测来源变更，并使用可配置的处理策略在复用前更新、标注或抑制过期上下文。该框架可跨不同运行时与外部资源使用，易于扩展到新的运行环境-资源配置。作者将其实现为通用框架，并实例化具体用例进行评估。
AI.result: 构建 ConcordBench 基准，其中先前观察到的文件内容在后续编辑后变为过期。在三个前沿模型上评估，Concord 在构造条件下所有案例中均产生与恢复后工作区状态一致的答案，在该基准的 recover 数量上匹配 oracle，同时比最强非 oracle 基线少用 46.4% 的 token。
AI.conclusion: Concord 能有效解决智能体上下文中工具观察过期的问题，提升答案与当前工作区状态的一致性，并在 token 效率上显著优于现有基线；其通用设计便于扩展到多种运行时与资源环境。

title: Physics-Augmented Graph Transformers for Patch-Antenna Forward and Inverse Design
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted for oral presentation at the 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Machine Learning for Signal Processing (MLSP 2026), Atlanta, USA. Code, dataset and Colab demo: https://github.com/AviEpstein/GNN-for-Antenna-design
summary: Full-wave electromagnetic (EM) simulation enables accurate patch-antenna analysis but is computationally expensive for large-scale forward prediction and inverse design. We present a mesh-native, physics-augmented graph-learning framework that treats radiation-pattern prediction as signal reconstruction on an irregular surface mesh. For the forward problem, a GPS graph transformer is trained with Physics-Augmented Intermediate Supervision (PAIS), an auxiliary node-level objective that predicts complex surface currents, the physical intermediate linking geometry to radiation. PAIS improves multiple GNN backbones at no inference-time cost, while shuffled-current and non-physical controls show the gain comes from physical correspondence. Direction-conditioned decoding and a differentiable radiation-integral consistency loss further exploit this structure. On an 80,000-sample CST benchmark, GPS+PAIS reaches MSE 0.17 / PSNR 19.67, generalizes to a PCA split, and transfers zero-shot to canonical patches. For inverse design, surrogate-filtered diffusion beats nearest-neighbor retrieval by 32% relative MSE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种网格原生、物理增强的图学习框架，将贴片天线辐射方向图预测视为不规则表面网格上的信号重建，通过物理增强中间监督（PAIS）提升前向预测精度，并结合可微辐射积分一致性损失与方向条件解码，实现高精度正向预测和优于最近邻检索的逆向设计。
AI.motivation: 全波电磁仿真虽能精确分析贴片天线，但在大规模正向预测与逆向设计中计算成本过高，亟需兼顾精度与效率的替代方法。
AI.method: 将辐射方向图预测建模为不规则表面网格上的信号重建；采用GPS图变换器，并引入物理增强中间监督（PAIS），以节点级辅助目标预测复表面电流这一连接几何与辐射的物理中间量；同时使用方向条件解码和可微辐射积分一致性损失。
AI.result: 在80,000样本CST基准上，GPS+PAIS达到MSE 0.17 / PSNR 19.67，可泛化到PCA划分，并能零样本迁移至典型贴片；PAIS在无推理额外开销下提升多种GNN骨干，且打乱电流与非物理对照实验表明增益源于物理对应关系；逆向设计中代理过滤扩散模型相较最近邻检索相对MSE改善32%。
AI.conclusion: 物理增强的图学习框架可有效替代昂贵的全波仿真，PAIS所提供的物理中间监督是关键增益来源，该框架在正向预测与逆向设计中均展现出良好精度、泛化与迁移能力。

title: Fusion is the New Mutation: Bandit-Guided Evolution on Workflow Graphs
summary: Automated agentic workflow optimization relies on costly evaluations, making it essential to allocate a limited evaluation budget effectively. Multi-parent fusion can reuse designs from previously discovered workflows, but identifying promising parent combinations requires learning from limited fusion feedback. We introduce DAGO (Directed Acyclic Graph Optimization), a contextual-bandit-guided framework that learns which parent workflows to fuse under a limited evaluation budget. DAGO formulates each candidate parent combination as an arm, represented by pretrained embeddings of its constituent workflows' code and prompts. A diagonal LinUCB policy learns a shared reward model across arms and balances exploitation of arms with high predicted offspring quality against uncertainty-driven exploration. After an arm is selected, an LLM generates a child workflow through summary-guided fusion, and the child's validation score serves as the reward for updating the bandit. A shared directed acyclic graph maintains discovered workflows and their multi-parent lineage, providing an expanding pool of parents for subsequent arm proposals. Across six benchmarks covering mathematical reasoning, code generation, and question answering, DAGO achieves the highest macro-average score among the evaluated baselines. Under matched validation-evaluation budgets, it improves over AFlow from 80.3 to 81.7 while reducing aggregate search expenditure by 11.2%. Ablation studies show that LinUCB-guided arm selection outperforms both random selection and its exploration-free variant, supporting the value of feedback-driven selection and exploration-exploitation balance.

AI.tldr: DAGO是一个基于上下文老虎机（contextual bandit）的自动化agent工作流优化框架，通过LinUCB策略在有限评估预算下选择最优父工作流组合进行融合。
AI.motivation: 自动化agent工作流优化依赖昂贵的评估，因此高效分配有限评估预算至关重要。多父融合可复用已发现的工作流设计，但识别有潜力的父组合需要从有限的融合反馈中学习。
AI.method: 将每个候选父工作流组合视为一个臂，用其组成工作流代码和提示的预训练嵌入表示；采用对角LinUCB策略学习跨臂的共享奖励模型，平衡对高预测后代质量的利用与不确定性驱动的探索。选中臂后，LLM通过摘要引导融合生成子工作流，子工作流的验证分数作为奖励更新老虎机；共享有向无环图维护已发现工作流及其多父谱系，为后续臂提议提供不断扩展的父池。
AI.result: 在涵盖数学推理、代码生成和问答的六个基准上，DAGO取得最高的宏平均分。在匹配的验证-评估预算下，相较AFlow从80.3提升至81.7，同时总搜索开销降低11.2%。消融实验表明LinUCB引导的臂选择优于随机选择和去除探索的变体。
AI.conclusion: 反馈驱动的臂选择与探索-利用平衡具有重要价值，DAGO在有限预算下实现了更优的工作流优化效果。

title: MetaKernelBench: Measuring GPU Kernel Knowledge Transfer Beyond Code
summary: Recent GPU kernel optimization agents retain what they learn in knowledge bases or as distilled skills. Kernel benchmarks score each attempt's implementation for correctness and speed but leave the reuse value of retained experience unmeasured. We introduce MetaKernelBench, which measures whether experience distilled from an attempt in one kernel domain-specific language (DSL) improves a fresh attempt at the same problem in another. Its 74 problems are fused subgraphs in six families, each posed as a pair of CuTe DSL and TIRx variants that differ only in the DSL. The agent first attempts each variant solo and is instructed to distill what it learns into a natural-language skill, which is transferred whether or not the source attempt passes verification. The skill is the only extra input to a skill-conditioned attempt by the same model in the other DSL. We compare each skill-conditioned attempt with the solo attempt on the same variant under matched per-attempt budgets, scoring correctness and end-to-end runtime. Across six models and both directions, paired lift over solo attempts ranges from -19% to +29%. Four models gain in both directions, yet regressions occur on 16% to 45% of problems in every model and direction. Outcomes follow the source attempt's result relative to the target's solo attempt rather than source success alone, improving in 71% of comparisons when the source stands above and regressing in 54% when it stands below. MetaKernelBench complements implementation-quality metrics by measuring same-problem cross-DSL kernel knowledge transfer.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MetaKernelBench，用于衡量从一种内核DSL蒸馏出的经验能否迁移到另一DSL中同一问题的求解。
AI.motivation: 现有GPU内核优化智能体的知识库或技能保留机制缺乏对"经验复用价值"的度量；内核基准只评估每次尝试的正确性与速度，未衡量跨DSL的知识迁移效果。
AI.method: 构建74个融合子图问题（6个家族），每个问题同时以CuTe DSL与TIRx两种变体呈现，仅DSL不同。智能体先单独尝试每个变体，并将所学蒸馏为自然语言技能；该技能作为唯一额外输入，交由同一模型在另一DSL上做技能条件化尝试。在匹配的每次尝试预算下，比较技能条件化尝试与单独尝试的正确性和端到端运行时间。
AI.result: 在6个模型和两个迁移方向上，配对提升范围为-19%至+29%；4个模型在两个方向均有增益，但每个模型和方向上仍有16%至45%的问题出现回退。结果取决于源尝试相对目标单独尝试的表现，而非源尝试是否成功：源表现更优时71%的比较得到改善，源表现更差时54%出现回退。
AI.conclusion: MetaKernelBench通过度量同一问题的跨DSL内核知识迁移，补充了以实现质量为核心的评估指标。

title: Readable Before Actionable: Causal Tracing of Indirect Prompt Injection
summary: Indirect prompt injection causes LLM agents to follow commands embedded in external data. A probe may distinguish instructions from data without identifying a state edit that changes the next action. We study this gap through counterfactual role probes, component-wise activation patching, and separate interventions on AgentDojo trajectories. Role decoding survives changes in content and format. In controlled Qwen tests, it precedes strong tool-choice effects from patches along an independently estimated role direction. On AgentDojo, directions estimated from hijacked and resisted training trajectories reduce attack success at pre-action and injected-span positions, but have little effect at random positions. In longer Qwen trajectories, single-position edits become less effective at later layers; span-wide and repeated edits reduce attack success on the same evaluation set. Removing the learned channel subspace preserves role decoding, yet effective intervention directions transfer poorly across the tested channels. These findings distinguish a readable role signal from an effective behavioral intervention: depth matters in controlled tool choice, while position and context also matter in attack trajectories.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究间接提示注入中"角色可读信号"与"有效行为干预"之间的差距，通过反事实角色探针、成分级激活修补与AgentDojo轨迹干预发现：角色解码稳定但干预有效性依赖深度、位置与上下文。
AI.motivation: 间接提示注入让LLM智能体执行嵌入外部数据中的指令。探针或许能区分指令与数据，却未必能定位到改变下一步动作的状态编辑。作者希望厘清这种"可读性"与"因果干预有效性"之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 采用三类手段：反事实角色探针（counterfactual role probes）、成分级激活修补（component-wise activation patching），以及在AgentDojo轨迹上分别进行的位置干预。在Qwen上进行受控工具选择实验，并沿独立估计的角色方向进行修补；在AgentDojo上从被劫持与抵抗的训练轨迹中估计干预方向；还测试了去除学习到的通道子空间对角色解码的影响及干预方向的跨通道迁移性。
AI.result: 角色解码在内容与格式变化下依然稳健。在受控Qwen测试中，角色解码先于沿独立估计角色方向修补所产生的强工具选择效应。AgentDojo上，从劫持/抵抗轨迹估计的方向在行动前与注入片段位置上降低攻击成功率，但在随机位置几乎无效。较长的Qwen轨迹中，单点编辑在较深层变得低效，而跨片段与重复编辑可在同一评测集上降低攻击成功率。去除学习到的通道子空间后角色解码仍保留，但有效干预方向在不同通道间迁移性差。
AI.conclusion: 研究区分了"可读的角色信号"与"有效的行文干预"：在受控工具选择中深度起决定作用，而在攻击轨迹中位置与上下文同样关键；角色可解码并不意味着干预能改变行为，有效干预方向具有通道特异性、难以迁移。

title: Operational Abstractions of Neural Network Concepts via Topological Representations
summary: Concept-based methods provide a semantic level for interpreting and manipulating learned representations, but existing editing approaches are typically specialized to particular interventions and do not provide a common and editable representation of concept organization. To achieve this, we introduce Topological Concept Representations (TCR), a post-hoc operational abstraction that jointly characterizes the concepts encoded in a learned representation and their relationships. TCR constructs an intermediate concept space from concept recoverability and interaction scores, and compactly encodes its organization through topology. Interventions are expressed through modifications of this abstraction that are propagated back to the underlying learned representation. This allows different concept-level operations to share the same optimization framework and separates the desired concept organization from the mechanism to achieve it. We establish stability and reparameterization-invariance properties of TCR and its connections to existing concept-editing formulations. We use TCR to disentangle concepts as a preprocessing step for existing erasure methods, improving worst-group accuracy by 21.89 on average at comparable concept leakage. We further use TCR to transfer concepts from teacher to student models, improving concept recoverability by up to 5.54 while also improving or maintaining competitive test top-1 accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出拓扑概念表示（TCR），一种后验操作抽象，能够联合刻画学得表示中编码的概念及其关系，并在统一优化框架下支持多种概念级编辑操作。
AI.motivation: 现有基于概念的方法多针对特定干预专门设计，缺乏一个通用且可编辑的概念组织表示，导致不同概念操作难以共享统一的编辑机制。
AI.method: TCR从概念可恢复性和交互分数构建中间概念空间，用拓扑紧凑编码其组织；编辑通过对该抽象进行修改并回传到原始学得表示，使不同概念级操作共享同一优化框架。文中还建立了TCR的稳定性与重参数化不变性性质及其与既有概念编辑公式的联系。
AI.result: 将TCR用于概念解耦作为现有擦除方法的预处理，在概念泄漏相当的情况下将最差组准确率平均提升21.89；将TCR用于教师到学生的概念迁移，概念可恢复性最高提升5.54，同时保持或维持具竞争力的测试top-1准确率。
AI.conclusion: TCR提供了统一、可编辑的概念组织抽象，将期望的概念组织与实现机制分离，在解耦和概念迁移等任务上验证了其有效性，并可推广与兼容现有概念编辑方法。

title: MESH-Harness: Self-Improving Agent Harnesses via Bandit-Guided Compositional Evolution
summary: An agent harness is the code that organizes context, maintains state, and coordinates tool calls for a language model. We study how to improve the harness under a limited evaluation budget while keeping model weights fixed. Our method, MESH-Harness, organizes each harness into functional modules with explicit role-specific interfaces, allowing alternative implementations of each module to be substituted and recombined. It uses shared module representations and full-covariance LinUCB to score candidate combinations based on predicted performance and exploration value. Mixed-start coordinate ascent selects complete configurations for evaluation without enumerating the combinatorial space. Validation traces then guide local code edits, and the resulting candidates are incorporated into fixed-capacity role-specific pools for subsequent recombination. On text tasks, retrieval-augmented mathematical reasoning, code generation, and interactive scientific tasks, MESH-Harness outperforms Meta-Harness by 5.70, 7.01, 2.00, and 5.00 points, respectively, under matched candidate-evaluation budgets. Iterative harness optimization improves MESH-Harness by 5.63-7.79 points over its first-round configurations. For the reported configurations, aggregate test-time cost is 44.2% lower than that of Meta-Harness, while total cost including search is 14.6% lower. These results show that combining module-level design reuse with feedback-driven compositional search can systematically improve agent harnesses while keeping overall optimization cost under control.

AI.tldr: 提出 MESH-Harness，将 agent harness 拆分为带角色接口的功能模块，结合模块表示、全协方差 LinUCB 与混合起点坐标上升进行组合搜索，在有限评估预算下系统性优化 harness，性能优于 Meta-Harness 且成本更低。
AI.motivation: agent harness（组织上下文、维护状态、协调工具调用的代码）对模型表现至关重要，但在模型权重固定、评估预算有限的情况下，如何系统性地改进 harness 仍缺乏有效方法。
AI.method: 将每个 harness 组织为具有明确角色接口的功能模块，允许各模块的替代实现被替换与重组；使用共享模块表示和全协方差 LinUCB 根据预测性能与探索价值为候选组合打分；用混合起点坐标上升选取完整配置进行评估，避免穷举组合空间；再用验证轨迹引导局部代码编辑，并将新候选纳入固定容量的角色专属池以支持后续重组。
AI.result: 在文本任务、检索增强数学推理、代码生成和交互式科学任务上，在相同候选评估预算下分别比 Meta-Harness 高出 5.70、7.01、2.00 和 5.00 个点；迭代优化使 MESH-Harness 相比首轮配置提升 5.63–7.79 个点；报告配置的聚合测试时成本比 Meta-Harness 低 44.2%，含搜索的总成本低 14.6%。
AI.conclusion: 将模块级设计复用与反馈驱动的组合搜索相结合，可以在控制总体优化成本的同时系统性地改进 agent harness。

title: Calibrated Weak Supervision for Post-Harvest Burned-Cropland Mapping Under Label Scarcity
summary: Mapping post-harvest burned cropland is difficult when fires are small and fragmented and reliable labels are scarce. We developed a calibrated weak-supervision framework for Punjab, India, using Sentinel-2 spectral change, VIIRS active-fire context, and MODIS MCD64A1 as a coarse external calibration and agreement reference. Three pseudo-label recipes, five feature representations, and linear, tree-based, boosted, and neural classifiers were evaluated using nested district-held-out cross-validation over three seeds and five folds. NBR and dNBR were excluded from classifier inputs. The best configuration used the very-strict recipe, a multilayer perceptron, and the full optical feature set (mean Cohen's kappa 0.395, AUROC 0.753, F1 0.747, balanced accuracy 0.703); Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM were practically tied. Higher agreement with held-out pseudo-labels did not establish improved label correctness or independent burned-area accuracy. For deployment, a Random Forest with the very-strict recipe and full optical features was retained. An externally calibrated threshold of 0.60 yielded district-level MODIS agreement of R-squared 0.636, a mapped-to-MODIS burned-area ratio of 1.005, and Spearman correlation of 0.779 with district fire counts. Pixel-level MODIS agreement remained modest (F1 0.205, kappa 0.093). Zero-shot transfer to Haryana was promising (mean kappa 0.641), but Punjab cross-year stability was weak, and Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 feature concatenation did not improve the optical baseline. Optical observations ended before the seasonal fire context, limiting coverage of late burns. The framework supports district-scale burden assessment and hotspot screening, with limited support for exact scar boundaries or temporally stable annual mapping.

AI.tldr: 该研究为印度旁遮普邦开发了一套"校准式弱监督"框架，用于绘制收获后焚烧的农田，使用哨兵2号光谱变化、VIIRS活跃火点与MODIS MCD64A1作为粗校准参考，并系统评估了多种伪标签策略、特征表示与分类器。
AI.motivation: 火烧地块小而破碎、可靠标签稀缺，收获后焚烧农田的制图十分困难，因此需要借助弱监督与外部校准参考来构建可行的监测方法。
AI.method: 构建校准式弱监督框架：以Sentinel-2光谱变化、VIIRS活跃火点上下文和MODIS MCD64A1作粗校准与一致性参照；设计3种伪标签配方、5种特征表示，并比较线性、树、提升与神经网络分类器；采用嵌套的行政区留出交叉验证（3个随机种子×5折）；NBR与dNBR被排除在分类器输入之外；最终部署配置为非常严格配方+全光学特征+随机森林，并采用外部校准阈值0.60。
AI.result: 最佳配置（非常严格配方+多层感知机+全光学特征）平均Cohen's kappa 0.395、AUROC 0.753、F1 0.747、平衡准确率 0.703，随机森林、XGBoost与LightGBM基本持平；部署配置在行政区尺度上与MODIS一致性R²为0.636、制图/MODIS火烧面积比1.005、与行政区火点数Spearman相关0.779；像素级与MODIS一致性有限（F1 0.205，kappa 0.093）；向哈里亚纳邦零样本迁移表现尚可（平均kappa 0.641），但旁遮普邦跨年稳定性较弱，Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2特征拼接未优于纯光学基线。
AI.conclusion: 该框架适合行政区尺度的焚烧负担评估与热点筛查，但对精确火烧边界刻画与跨年稳定的年度制图支持有限；与留出伪标签的更高一致性并不能证明标签正确性或独立火烧面积精度提升；光学观测在季节性火灾背景前结束，限制了晚期焚烧的覆盖。

title: AgentDiscover: Autonomous Discovery with Minimal Search Scaffolding
summary: Frameworks that use large language models for scientific discovery typically rely on a fixed, human-designed algorithm that decides what the model sees at each step, leaving the model only the role of proposer. The model knows nothing of the search beyond what it is shown. As models grow more capable, a question arises: does a search strategy chosen by a human before the run scale better than promoting the model from proposer to planner and letting it own the search? The Bitter Lesson suggests that choosing the strategy in advance is the kind of hand-designed structure that general methods eventually outscale. We introduce AgentDiscover, in which a coding agent plans the search using its context as working memory, runs experiments, and records every attempt in a database of ideas, candidates, and their relations. This database serves as the agent's long-term memory and is structured so that the selection rules of classical algorithms such as MAP-Elites and Monte Carlo tree search each reduce to a single query, which the agent is free to use, combine, or replace. A server maintains the database and steers the agent after every submission, keeping it on course over long runs. In our experiments, AgentDiscover is more cost-efficient than existing frameworks, reaching better scores at lower cost. On tasks in kernel engineering, biology, algorithm design, and mathematics, AgentDiscover outperforms prior discovery frameworks. Its programs would have placed first among human competitors in seven past AtCoder heuristic contests, and on eleven mathematical and systems optimization tasks it matches or exceeds every baseline that uses the same model. Our code is available at https://github.com/mhdfb/AgentDiscover.

AI.tldr: AgentDiscover让编码智能体自己规划科学发现的搜索过程，将搜索策略、经验与候选关系存入数据库作为长期记忆，成本更低且效果优于既有框架。
AI.motivation: 既有基于大模型的科学发现框架依赖人预先设计的固定算法决定模型每步看到什么，模型仅充当提议者，对搜索过程一无所知。作者追问：随着模型能力增强，人工预先选定的搜索策略是否比让模型从提议者升级为规划者、自主掌控搜索更具扩展性？"苦涩的教训"暗示预先选择策略属于终将被通用方法超越的人工结构。
AI.method: 提出 AgentDiscover：编码智能体利用自身上下文作为工作记忆来规划搜索、执行实验，并把每次尝试记录进一个由想法、候选及其关系构成的数据库。该数据库既是长期记忆，其结构又使得 MAP-Elites、蒙特卡洛树搜索等经典算法的选择规则均可化简为单条查询，智能体可自由使用、组合或替换。一个服务器维护数据库并在每次提交后引导智能体，使其在长程运行中保持方向。
AI.result: 实验中 AgentDiscover 比现有框架更具成本效益，以更低成本取得更好分数。在核工程、生物学、算法设计与数学任务上超越此前的发现框架。其程序在七场过往 AtCoder 启发式竞赛中若参赛将位列人类选手第一，并在十一个数学与系统优化任务上达到或超过所有使用同一模型的基线。
AI.conclusion: 将搜索规划权交给模型本身、并以结构化数据库作为长期记忆进行引导，可在多种科学发现与优化任务中实现更高效、更强的表现，支持"通用方法终将超越人工预设结构"的判断。代码已开源。

title: E$^2$-OPSD: Taming Entropy Overshoot in On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) provides dense token-level supervision without a second model: one network acts as teacher with the reference solution and as student with only the problem. We identify a specific failure mode of this recipe. During training, student token entropy rises past the teacher's and remains elevated, a pattern we call entropy overshoot. We trace it to both sides of distillation. The reference-conditioned teacher is confident along its answer-directed reasoning path, but this confidence transfers poorly to student-generated prefixes, making its supervision overly tied to answer-specific cues rather than reusable reasoning patterns; meanwhile, the forward KL used by OPSD continually diffuses the student's predictive distribution without pulling it back. We introduce E$^2$-OPSD to address both causes. Exemplar-guided teaching replaces the current answer with a retrieved solved neighboring problem, providing transferable reasoning guidance without revealing the destination and better matching student-reachable states. Entropy-aware distillation uses the student-teacher entropy gap to determine the direction and strength of each token's correction. E$^2$-OPSD improves math reasoning by up to 4.3 points in mean@16 over OPSD, while out-of-domain evaluations show gains over the corresponding base models of up to 4.9 points in mean@16 and 5.5 points in pass@8. Despite these gains, E$^2$-OPSD remains simple, requiring no additional forward passes or networks.

AI.tldr: 该论文识别了on-policy self-distillation (OPSD)中的"熵过冲"失效模式，并提出E²-OPSD方法，通过示例引导教学与熵感知蒸馏两个机制加以解决，在数学推理和域外任务上均取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: OPSD无需第二个模型即可提供密集的token级监督，但存在特定失效模式：训练过程中学生token熵超过教师并持续偏高（熵过冲）。作者追溯其根源：一是参考解条件下的教师在答案导向路径上过于自信，这种自信难以迁移到学生生成的前缀，导致监督过度绑定答案特定线索；二是OPSD使用的前向KL持续扩散学生预测分布而不将其拉回。
AI.method: 提出E²-OPSD，包含两个机制：(1) 示例引导教学（Exemplar-guided teaching）：用检索到的已解邻近问题替换当前答案，提供可迁移的推理指导而不泄露最终答案，更匹配学生可达状态；(2) 熵感知蒸馏（Entropy-aware distillation）：利用学生-教师熵差决定每个token修正的方向与强度。方法保持简洁，无需额外前向传播或网络。
AI.result: E²-OPSD相比OPSD在数学推理上mean@16最多提升4.3分；域外评测相比相应基座模型mean@16最多提升4.9分，pass@8最多提升5.5分。
AI.conclusion: E²-OPSD有效解决了OPSD的熵过冲问题，同时保持简单性，无需额外前向传播或网络即可获得显著的推理性能提升。

title: EnGRICH: Enhancing Generative Reward Modeling with Critiques from Humans
summary: Generative reward models (GRMs) are important for LLM optimization. Unlike scalar reward models, GRMs generate natural-language critiques alongside preference judgments, providing finer-grained evaluation signals. Their effectiveness depends heavily on critique reliability. However, existing GRM training typically uses final preference correctness as outcome supervision. Because the preference outcome space is highly constrained, unreliable critiques can still yield correct outcomes and thus be reinforced. Recent work leverages human critiques for process supervision, but such critiques are scarce and are often reduced to scalar rewards, leaving their fine-grained evaluative information underutilized. We argue that evaluative criteria learned from human critiques can be generalized to broader outcome-only preference data. To this end, we propose \textbf{EnGRICH}, a GRM training framework that pairs the GRM with a training-time MetaCritic learned from a small set of human critiques. MetaCritic constructs response-specific rubrics and uses them to evaluate the evidence coverage and correctness of generated critiques. The resulting signals provide both process rewards for fine-grained credit assignment and structured guidance for exploring better critiques. During GRM training, MetaCritic is further optimized to generalize human-grounded evaluative criteria to outcome-only data. At inference, the trained GRM operates independently. Experiments across seven reward-model benchmarks show that EnGRICH consistently improves over competitive baselines, while further analyses validate the effectiveness of its core mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 提出EnGRICH框架，通过训练期MetaCritic从少量人类批评中学习评估标准并泛化到纯结果偏好数据，提升生成式奖励模型批评的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 生成式奖励模型（GRM）在生成偏好判断的同时产生自然语言批评，其效果依赖批评的可靠性。但现有GRM训练仅用最终偏好正确性作为结果监督，由于偏好结果空间高度受限，不可靠的批评仍可能得到正确结果并被强化。近期工作利用人类批评做过程监督，但此类批评稀缺且常被简化为标量奖励，细粒度评估信息未被充分利用。作者认为从人类批评中学到的评估标准可泛化到更广泛的仅结果偏好数据。
AI.method: EnGRICH在训练时为一个GRM配备一个MetaCritic，该MetaCritic从少量人类批评中学习。它针对具体回答构建评分标准（rubrics），据此评估生成批评的证据覆盖度与正确性，从而提供过程奖励用于细粒度信用分配，并为探索更好的批评提供结构化指导。训练过程中MetaCritic进一步被优化，以将人类评估标准泛化到仅结果数据。推理时训练好的GRM独立运行，不依赖MetaCritic。
AI.result: 在七个奖励模型基准上的实验表明，EnGRICH持续优于竞争性基线，进一步的分析验证了其核心机制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过从少量人类批评中学习评估标准并泛化到结果监督数据，EnGRICH有效提升了GRM批评的可靠性，且推理阶段无需额外组件，具有良好的实用性与泛化性。

title: LogSig-SSM: Time-Series Modelling with Multi-Scale Log-Signature Compression for State-Space Models
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 23 pages, 2 figures, 15 tables
summary: Time-series data are often sampled irregularly at high frequencies and exhibit long-range dependencies, which makes long-horizon modelling difficult. Continuous-time models such as neural controlled differential equations (NCDEs) and neural rough differential equations (NRDEs) can handle irregular sampling, but they scale poorly to long sequences. Selective state-space models (SSMs) such as Mamba scale linearly with sequence length, but they provide limited recurrent mixing across hidden dimensions within a single block. We propose LogSig-SSM (Log-Signature Compression for State-Space Models), which first compresses long multivariate time series into a shorter sequence of tokens using multi-scale windowed log-signatures, and then processes these tokens with a selective SSM backbone. LogSig-SSM is scalable and robust to irregular sampling, combining log-signature tokens that capture higher-order cross-channel interactions with a selective SSM that models long-range dependencies. The model also admits a continuous-time interpretation as an NCDE/NRDE-style system driven by a log-signature-based input, in which selectivity induces an input-dependent rescaling of the latent dynamics. Across four benchmarks, namely long-sequence classification on UEA, high-frequency physiological regression on PPG-DaLiA, multivariate weather forecasting, and irregularly sampled clinical prediction on PhysioNet Sepsis, LogSig-SSM outperforms or matches strong SSM and continuous-time baselines while training up to $30\times$ faster and using up to $37\times$ less GPU memory than Mamba on the longest sequences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LogSig-SSM，先用多尺度窗口对数签名将长多元时间序列压缩为短token序列，再用选择性状态空间模型（SSM）骨干处理，兼顾不规则采样鲁棒性与长程依赖建模，训练更快、显存更省。
AI.motivation: 时间序列常以高频不规则方式采样且存在长程依赖，导致长时程建模困难。连续时间模型（NCDE/NRDE）能处理不规则采样但难以扩展到长序列；选择性SSM（如Mamba）随序列长度线性扩展，但单块内隐藏维度间的循环混合有限。
AI.method: 提出LogSig-SSM：首先使用多尺度窗口化对数签名（log-signature）将长多元时间序列压缩为更短的token序列，捕获高阶跨通道交互；随后用选择性SSM骨干处理这些token以建模长程依赖。模型还可解释为以对数签名为输入的NCDE/NRDE式连续时间系统，其中选择性 induces 输入相关的潜动态重缩放。
AI.result: 在四个基准上——UEA长序列分类、PPG-DaLiA高频生理回归、多元天气预测、PhysioNet Sepsis不规则采样临床预测——LogSig-SSM 超越或匹配强SSM与连续时间基线，同时在最长序列上训练速度最高快30倍、GPU显存占用最高省37倍（相比Mamba）。
AI.conclusion: LogSig-SSM通过将多尺度窗口对数签名压缩与选择性SSM结合，有效统一了不规则采样处理与长程依赖建模，并在效率上显著优于Mamba等基线，适用于多类长序列时间序列任务。

title: Learning Field Reconstruction from Incomplete Data by Globally Correcting Local Estimates
summary: Reconstructing physical fields from training samples that are always incomplete requires learning spatial structure from fragmented observations.Existing context--query work establishes how held-out observations provide valid training targets, but this does not make the complete-field distribution identifiable when every training field is incomplete.With finite data, weak evidence of sharp transitions and localized variations can further favor averaged predictions that attenuate local detail.A structural prior is therefore needed to favor plausible completions; local spatial relationships offer one grounded in the observations.We propose a locally constructed, globally revisable estimator that explicitly learns local field estimates and subsequently corrects them using full-domain observations.A shared coordinate-conditioned predictor learns from incomplete patches, allowing relatively well-observed neighborhoods to provide direct supervision of local structure.Its overlapping predictions are reconciled into an observation-conditioned consensus field.A full-domain estimator retains the original observations and learns a residual correction around this frozen field estimate, allowing locally constructed structure to be revised by broader evidence.The local estimate serves as both an explicit input, accompanied by its discrepancies with the observations, and a prediction starting point that the global model can revise.On three real-world ocean datasets with authentic observation gaps, our estimator achieves the lowest MSE and highest PSNR on withheld source-supported values, reducing MSE by 28.9\%--34.5\% against the strongest external baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出局部构建、全局修正的估计器，从残缺观测中重建物理场，在三组真实海洋数据上取得最低MSE与最高PSNR。
AI.motivation: 训练样本始终不完整，现有context-query方法虽能提供有效训练目标，但无法使完整场分布可识别；有限数据下微弱证据易偏向平滑预测，削弱局部细节，因此需要能偏好合理补全的结构先验，而局部空间关系提供了基于观测的先验。
AI.method: 提出局部构建、全局可修正的估计器：共享的坐标条件预测器从不完整patch学习局部场估计，利用观测较好的邻域提供局部结构的直接监督；将重叠预测协调为以观测为条件的共识场；再用全域估计器保留原始观测，在冻结的局部估计上学习残差修正，并将局部估计及其与观测的差异作为输入和预测起点。
AI.result: 在三组具有真实观测缺口的海洋数据集上，该方法在被保留的源支持值上取得最低MSE和最高PSNR，相比最强外部基线MSE降低28.9%–34.5%。
AI.conclusion: 显式学习局部结构并由全域证据修正，可有效应对不完整观测下的物理场重建，缓解过度平滑并提升补全精度。

title: Revealing After Overwriting: An Exponential POMDP OPE Lower Bound under History-Dependent Logging
summary: Multi-step revealing can make off-policy evaluation tractable under memoryless logging. With history-dependent logging, state decodability and target-relevant evidence can separate. For every horizon $H\ge3$, we construct two exactly realizable POMDPs with four actions, at most four states per layer, a known logger, and a memoryless target. Action overlap, history coverage, and observation-only revealing remain bounded independently of $H$, yet the target values differ by $1/2$ and the KL divergence between the logged laws is $Θ(4^{-(H-1)})$, forcing exponential sample complexity. Logger memory makes states distinguishable, while reset erases the model-distinguishing evidence preserved by the target. A separate construction retains this barrier with common, known observation-only revealing operators. Under action and history coverage, we give a finite-class OPE guarantee using common observable value representations that remain valid at every history. The sample bound depends polynomially on their second-moment cost. In the common-operator construction, the same value direction has constant marginal decoding cost but exponential history-conditioned cost. Finally, on a fixed four-action continuum, we derive matching passive and budgeted readout rates. With one known channel and unit read cost, early reads are optimal. With unknown sensor bias, early reads alone remain exponentially costly. Combining them with post-reset calibration gives sample complexity independent of $H$ when both read types receive fixed positive expected budgets per trajectory.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究历史依赖型logging下off-policy evaluation的可处理性，构造了使状态可解码性与目标相关证据分离的POMDP实例，证明其导致指数样本复杂度，并给出有限类OPE保证及预算化readout速率。
AI.motivation: 在memoryless logging下，多步揭示可使off-policy evaluation（OPE）可处理；但在history-dependent logging下，状态可解码性与目标相关证据可能分离，从而破坏可处理性。作者希望刻画这种分离带来的根本困难及其边界条件。
AI.method: 对每个horizon H≥3构造两个可精确实现的POMDP（四动作、每层至多四状态、已知logger、memoryless target）；分析action overlap、history coverage、observation-only revealing等量；给出在action与history coverage下的有限类OPE保证，使用在任意history均有效的common observable value representations；并在固定四动作连续统上推导匹配的passive与budgeted readout速率。
AI.result: 构造的实例中，action overlap、history coverage与observation-only revealing均独立于H有界，但target values相差1/2，logged laws间KL散度为Θ(4^{-(H-1)})，强制指数样本复杂度。Logger memory使状态可区分，而reset抹去target保留的模型区分证据；单独使用common known observation-only revealing operators仍保留该障碍。在common-operator构造中，同一value direction的marginal decoding cost为常数，但history-conditioned cost为指数级。单已知通道与单位读代价下早期read最优；未知sensor bias下仅早期read仍指数昂贵，结合post-reset calibration并给两类read固定正期望预算可使样本复杂度与H无关。
AI.conclusion: 历史依赖logging下，即便覆盖性条件有界，状态可解码性与目标相关证据的分离仍可导致指数样本复杂度；通过合适价值表示与校准型readout预算设计，可恢复与H无关的样本复杂度。

title: Sibyl: An Efficient Small-large Model Collaboration Framework for Long-horizon Tasks
summary: Small language models (SLMs) offer a promising foundation for on-device agents through low-latency, resource-efficient inference, yet limited reasoning and planning capabilities constrain their performance on long-horizon tasks requiring multi-step interaction with the environment. Step-level collaboration between SLMs and larger cloud-hosted models can bridge this gap, but identifying states that warrant cloud assistance remains challenging: the contribution of each cloud call is entangled with subsequent actions and can be assessed only from the final task outcome. Compounding this challenge, the SLM must balance two competing objectives: maximizing task success and minimizing cloud calls. To address this, we propose Sibyl, an algorithm that trains SLM agents to selectively consult cloud models at the step level and internalize their guidance for subsequent decisions, achieving strong task performance with minimal cloud reliance. Sibyl follows a three-stage training pipeline that (1) builds a robust base policy through consultation-free self-evolving reinforcement learning (RL); (2) cold-starts consultation behavior via decisive-disagreement state mining; and (3) jointly optimizes consultation decisions and guidance internalization through consultation-aware RL. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop demonstrate that Sibyl, using only a 0.6B-parameter model, outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, including agent training and routing methods, by 95.2% and 80.4% in success rate while averaging only 0.8 and 3.9 cloud calls per trajectory, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Sibyl 算法，训练小型语言模型代理在步骤级别选择性地向云端大模型求助，并在后续决策中内化其指导，从而以极少云端调用实现强任务表现。
AI.motivation: 小型语言模型适合端侧低延迟、资源高效的推理，但其推理与规划能力有限，难以完成需要多步环境交互的长时程任务。步骤级的 SLM 与云端大模型协作可弥补此差距，但难点在于：识别哪些状态值得求助很困难，因为每次云端调用的贡献与后续动作纠缠、只能从最终结果评估；同时 SLM 需在最大化任务成功率与最小化云端调用两个目标间取得平衡。
AI.method: Sibyl 采用三阶段训练流程：(1) 通过无求助的自演化强化学习构建稳健的基础策略；(2) 通过"决定性分歧"状态挖掘冷启动求助行为；(3) 通过求助感知强化学习联合优化求助决策与指导内化。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上的实验表明，仅使用 0.6B 参数模型的 Sibyl 在成功率上超越包括代理训练与路由方法在内的最先进基线，分别提升 95.2% 与 80.4%，平均每条轨迹仅需 0.8 与 3.9 次云端调用。
AI.conclusion: Sibyl 通过步骤级的求助决策学习与指导内化，使小型语言模型代理在极少云端依赖下达成优异的任务表现，验证了选择性云端协作在端侧代理中的有效性。

title: Outcome-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) provides denser token-level supervision and better computational efficiency than Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR). However, this denser supervision may introduce substantial noise and training instability. Existing improvements often rely on high-variance per-token statistics and introduce extra hyperparameters and trade-offs. Based on the advantage formulation in RLVR, we analyze the OPSD objective from the same perspective, incorporating outcome correctness signals. We find that vanilla OPSD imposes insufficient penalties and excessive rewards on incorrect trajectories because it applies a fixed divergence objective regardless of outcome correctness. Furthermore, the reliability of teacher supervision is associated with both trajectory outcome and the cumulative average teacher entropy along the rollout. Based on these observations, we propose Outcome-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation (OG-OPSD), which dynamically adapts both the divergence objective and distillation position according to binary outcome rewards and the cumulative average teacher entropy. Extensive experiments show that OG-OPSD consistently improves the performance of vanilla OPSD and multiple strong baselines in mathematical reasoning, multimodal reasoning, and out-of-distribution tasks across Qwen3 models at 1.7B, 4B, and 8B scales, as well as Qwen3-VL-2B.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Outcome-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation (OG-OPSD)，通过结果正确性信号和教师熵动态调整蒸馏目标与位置，缓解 vanilla OPSD 的奖励/惩罚失衡问题，在多种推理任务上稳定提升性能。
AI.motivation: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) 相比 RLVR 提供更密集的 token 级监督且计算效率更高，但这种密集监督会引入大量噪声和训练不稳定。已有改进多依赖高方差的 per-token 统计量，并需要额外超参数与权衡。
AI.method: 作者从 RLVR 的优势公式出发分析 OPSD 目标，发现 vanilla OPSD 对错误轨迹惩罚不足、奖励过度，因为它不区分结果正确性而施加固定散度目标。同时，教师监督的可靠性既与轨迹结果相关，也与 rollout 过程中累积平均教师熵相关。据此提出 OG-OPSD，依据二元结果奖励和累积平均教师熵动态调整散度目标与蒸馏位置。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，OG-OPSD 在数学推理、多模态推理以及分布外任务上，于 Qwen3 系列的 1.7B、4B、8B 规模以及 Qwen3-VL-2B 上，均一致优于 vanilla OPSD 和多个强基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入结果正确性信号与教师熵来指导 on-policy self-distillation，可以更合理地分配奖励与惩罚，从而在多种模型规模和任务上稳定提升推理性能。

title: MMPostTrainBench: Benchmarking Autonomous Research for Multimodal Post-Training
summary: Autonomous research seeks sustained model improvements through iterative experimentation and feedback. LLM agents show promise in automating machine learning and language-model post-training, but their ability to sustain multimodal improvement remains unclear. We introduce MMPostTrainBench, a benchmark spanning eight tasks in image, audio, video, and joint audio-video understanding and image-grounded software repair. Agents operate from a common base model within fixed budgets, using development feedback before independent evaluation of their submitted models. Evaluation covers target and non-target model outcomes, iterative model improvement and selection, and research integrity. Across all eight tasks, 52.1% of model--task means fall below the base, and evaluated submissions also exhibit non-target regressions. Model performance does not consistently improve across research iterations, and agents do not reliably select the best evaluated candidate for submission; final submissions trail that candidate by up to 5.38 percentage points. Extending autonomous research from text-only to multimodal tasks introduces additional sources of error in perception, cross-modal alignment, and temporal grounding. The observed regressions and selection gaps highlight the need to balance targeted improvements with non-target capability preservation and to retain gains across research iterations. These requirements motivate MMResearch, a multimodal research framework that connects media-grounded evidence to hypotheses and interventions, carries findings across rounds through hierarchical memory, and retains candidates using development evaluation. Added to existing code-agent runtimes, it improves submitted-model accuracy by up to 7.75 percentage points for Claude Opus 4.8 with Claude Code and 2.33 points for GPT-5.6-sol with Codex.

AI.tldr: 论文提出多模态自主研究基准 MMPostTrainBench，揭示现有 LLM 智能体在多模态模型改进中存在性能退化与候选选择缺陷，并提出 MMResearch 框架加以缓解。
AI.motivation: 自主研究在文本任务上已有进展，但 LLM 智能体能否持续改进多模态模型尚不明确；多模态任务引入感知、跨模态对齐与时间定位等新误差来源，亟需系统性评估与改进方法。
AI.method: 构建覆盖图像、音频、视频及音视频联合理解、图像软件修复共八项任务的 MMPostTrainBench，智能体在固定预算下从统一基座模型出发，先利用开发反馈迭代，再独立评估提交模型；同时提出 MMResearch 框架，将媒体证据与假设和干预相连接，通过分层记忆跨轮次传递发现，并借助开发评估保留候选。
AI.result: 八项任务中 52.1% 的模型-任务均值低于基座，提交模型出现非目标能力退化；迭代中性能未稳定提升，且智能体难以选出最佳候选，最终提交落后最佳候选最多 5.38 个百分点。加入既有代码智能体运行时后，Claude Opus 4.8 with Claude Code 提升最多 7.75 个百分点，GPT-5.6-sol with Codex 提升 2.33 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 从纯文本扩展到多模态自主研究会带来新的误差与退化，需在定向改进与保持非目标能力之间取得平衡并跨轮次保留收益；MMResearch 验证了面向多模态的研究框架可有效提升提交模型表现。

title: Discrete Action Matching: Learning Stochastic Dynamics from Samples via State Graphs
summary: Learning population dynamics from unpaired temporal marginals is an ill-posed inverse problem that requires structural assumptions on the underlying dynamics. We introduce $\textit{Discrete Action Matching}$ (DAM), a finite-state counterpart of Action Matching based on discrete Wasserstein geometry. For a prescribed marginal path and transport geometry, we derive an action-minimization objective for its canonical minimum-kinetic-energy current. Our key observation is that the density dependence of the discrete action reduces to neighboring density ratios. Along an empirical interpolation of the snapshots, DAM first estimates these ratios and then learns an action potential. The learned fields also define a graph-supported Markov sampler. Experiments on controlled synthetic dynamics and real mouse gastrulation data evaluate marginal reconstruction and interpolation. Additional experiments approximate numerical surface-transport paths from paired samples.

AI.tldr: 本文提出离散动作匹配（DAM），一种基于离散Wasserstein几何的有限状态动作匹配方法，用于从非配对的时序边缘分布中学习群体动态。
AI.motivation: 从非配对时序边缘分布学习群体动态是一个病态逆问题，需要对底层动态施加结构假设。现有方法在有限状态场景下缺乏合适的几何框架。
AI.method: DAM构建在离散Wasserstein几何之上。对给定的边缘路径与传输几何，推导出规范最小动能流（minimum-kinetic-energy current）的动作最小化目标。关键观察是离散动作的密度依赖性可简化为相邻密度比。在快照的经验插值路径上，DAM先估计这些密度比，再学习动作势（action potential）。所学场还定义了一个图支撑的马尔可夫采样器。
AI.result: 在受控合成动态和真实小鼠原肠胚（gastrulation）数据上进行实验，评估了边缘重建与插值性能；额外实验从配对样本近似数值表面传输路径。
AI.conclusion: DAM为有限状态下的非配对时序边缘学习提供了基于离散Wasserstein几何的动作匹配框架，兼具动态学习与采样能力。

title: CASE: Cost-Aware Stopping for Efficient Long-Video Agents
summary: Long-video agents can actively gather question-relevant evidence, but they typically leave a central decision implicit: when has the agent seen enough to answer? We propose CASE, a plug-in termination framework that frames this decision as policy-conditioned sequential stopping. At each causal checkpoint, CASE combines an auxiliary multiple-choice assessment of accumulated evidence with the host agent's execution state. From complete native trajectories, we construct a cost-aware target that compares answering now with stopping later along the same search path, accounting jointly for answer correctness and the full cost of continued reasoning. A lightweight Ridge regressor learns this decision gap and produces STOP/CONTINUE decisions. We evaluate three vision-language models with VideoSeek and AVP. On Video-MME, end-to-end accuracy changes by +0.67 percentage points on average while CASE reduces model-token use by 53.63%. The same frozen policies then transfer zero-shot to LongVideoBench and MLVU, with end-to-end accuracy changes of +3.38 and +4.58 points while saving 58.78% and 51.28% of model tokens, respectively. Across all agent-model-benchmark combinations, CASE attains the highest accuracy-efficiency Pareto-frontier coverage among the compared stopping methods (83.3%) at the selected operating points. Online execution preserves this favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off and additionally reduces measured runtime by 54.1% on average. CASE provides a plug-in termination framework for long-video reasoning agents, enabling them to decide when further evidence acquisition is no longer worthwhile.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CASE，一个即插即用的终止框架，将长视频智能体"何时证据足够"的决策建模为策略条件下的序贯停止问题，在保持甚至提升准确率的同时大幅降低token消耗与运行时。
AI.motivation: 长视频智能体能够主动收集与问题相关的证据，但通常留下一个核心决策未明确：智能体何时已看到足够信息可以作答？过早停止会损害正确性，过晚停止则浪费推理成本，因此需要一个显式的、成本感知的终止机制。
AI.method: CASE在每一个因果检查点，将累积证据的辅助多选评估与宿主智能体的执行状态相结合。从完整的原生轨迹中构造成本感知目标，比较"现在作答"与"沿同一搜索路径稍后停止"的差异，并联合考虑答案正确性与继续推理的总成本。随后用一个轻量级Ridge回归器学习该决策间隙，输出STOP/CONTINUE决策。该框架为即插即用式，不改变宿主模型参数。
AI.result: 在VideoSeek与AVP上评估三个视觉语言模型。Video-MME上端到端准确率平均变化+0.67个百分点，模型token使用减少53.63%。同一冻结策略零样本迁移至LongVideoBench与MLVU，准确率分别变化+3.38和+4.58个百分点，节省token 58.78%和51.28%。在所有智能体-模型-基准组合中，CASE在所选操作点取得最高的准确率-效率帕累托前沿覆盖率（83.3%）。在线执行保持该权衡，平均运行时降低54.1%。
AI.conclusion: CASE为长视频推理智能体提供了一个即插即用的终止框架，使其能够判断继续获取证据何时不再值得，从而在多个基准和模型上同时改善准确率与效率，并具备良好的零样本迁移能力。

title: ReDiffNet: Differential RGB-Infrared Learning for Low-Light UAV Oriented Vehicle Detection
summary: Low-light UAV-based RGB-infrared oriented small-vehicle detection is important for nighttime traffic monitoring, emergency response, and urban inspection. Illumination variations, headlight glare, local shadows, and thermal-response degradation cause spatially varying modality reliability, while the small visual extent of vehicles further weakens boundaries, orientation cues, and thermal responses. Accordingly, selecting trustworthy observations based on local modality reliability while further exploiting complementary discriminative information in regions with ambiguous modality preference is key to constructing effective multimodal representations. Based on this insight, we propose ReDiffNet, a reliability-conditioned differential representation network in which modality reliability guides both evidence selection and complementary recovery. Specifically, degradation-aware reliability learning estimates relative spatial reliability, uncertainty-guided differential recovery exploits cross-modal differences to recover complementary cues in ambiguous regions, and reliability-conditioned reconstruction integrates retained and recovered evidence into a unified representation. ReDiffNet achieves 85.3% and 73.9% mAP50 on DroneVehicle and VEDAI, respectively, supporting its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReDiffNet，一个可靠性条件化的差分表示网络，用于低光无人机RGB-红外定向小目标车辆检测，通过可靠性学习引导证据选择与互补恢复。
AI.motivation: 低光无人机RGB-红外定向小目标车辆检测对照明变化、车灯眩光、局部阴影和热响应退化敏感，导致模态可靠性随空间变化；同时车辆视觉范围小，进一步削弱了边界、方向线索和热响应。因此，需要依据局部模态可靠性选择可信观测，并在模态偏好模糊区域挖掘互补判别信息，以构建有效的多模态表示。
AI.method: 提出ReDiffNet，包含三个部分：退化感知可靠性学习，估计相对空间可靠性；不确定性引导的差分恢复，利用跨模态差异恢复模糊区域的互补线索；可靠性条件化重建，将保留和恢复的证据整合为统一表示。模态可靠性同时引导证据选择与互补恢复。
AI.result: ReDiffNet在DroneVehicle和VEDAI数据集上分别取得85.3%和73.9%的mAP50。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果支持ReDiffNet在低光无人机RGB-红外定向小目标车辆检测中的有效性。

title: PharmAgent: Constraint-Aware Search with Frozen Language Models for Molecular Optimization
summary: Molecular optimization must improve target activity and satisfy developability constraints within limited evaluation budgets. Classical methods require tailored rules or training to incorporate chemical instructions and property feedback. Frozen language models can condition edits on this information, but need explicit constraint control and relevant experience. We therefore present PharmAgent, a constraint-aware molecular search method driven by adaptive external state. Its Lagrangian controller translates violations in accepted states into accumulated constraint pressure, keeping this history separate from current property measurements. Structure-indexed replay complements this feedback with relevant evaluated transitions that guide subsequent proposals. As a curriculum progressively activates constraints, candidates and the incumbent are compared under the same current objective, and the accepted state determines the next multiplier update. We derive an exact identity that characterizes how accepted-state violations accumulate in the controller's multipliers. Across five tasks with five independent runs, PharmAgent achieves a summed area under the target-score curves (AUC) of 3.9208 in target-only search, improving over MOLLEO by 37.3%. With online constraints, it achieves a property-adjusted AUC of 0.7076, improving over the strongest online baseline, ExLLM, by 53.8%. These results rank first among all evaluated methods in both target-only and constraint-aware search. The online comparison covers all five baseline frameworks. The full system leads every ablation variant in target quality, property-adjusted performance, and Pareto hypervolume. All five molecular cases reach feasible final states, documenting target gains and trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 提出 PharmAgent：一种由自适应外部状态驱动的约束感知分子搜索方法，用拉格朗日控制器累积约束压力并结合结构索引经验回放，在有限预算下兼顾目标活性与可成药性约束。
AI.motivation: 分子优化需在有限评估预算内提升目标活性并满足可成药性约束。经典方法需专门规则或训练来融入化学指令与性质反馈；冻结语言模型虽可据此条件化编辑，但缺乏显式约束控制与相关经验利用。
AI.method: PharmAgent 使用拉格朗日控制器将已接受状态中的违反量转化为累积约束压力，并与当前性质测量分离存储；结构索引回放提供相关已评估转移引导后续提议；课程式逐步激活约束，候选与当前解在同一目标下比较，接受状态决定下一乘子更新；并推导刻画接受状态违反量在乘子中累积的精确恒等式。
AI.result: 在5个任务、各5次独立运行中，仅目标搜索的累计AUC达3.9208，较MOLLEO提升37.3%；在线约束下性质调整AUC为0.7076，较最强在线基线ExLLM提升53.8%。两类搜索中均排名第一，在线对比覆盖全部五个基线框架；完整系统在目标质量、性质调整性能与Pareto超体积上均优于所有消融变体；五个分子案例均达可行终态。
AI.conclusion: PharmAgent 通过自适应外部状态实现约束感知的分子搜索，在目标优化与约束满足上均优于现有方法与消融变体，验证了显式约束控制与相关性经验回放的有效性。

title: How Execution Assumptions Change Short-Horizon Sharpe Rankings: Evidence from a Synthetic Trading Benchmark
summary: Backtests of LLM trading agents often assume that every order fills at the closing price. We ask whether this choice changes only reported returns or also the order of the agents. Five prompted LLM signal policies and seven classical baselines trade the same synthetic price paths under six execution settings, from near-ideal fills to latency, spread, participation, and impact stresses. The main experiment contains $2{,}462$ runs with matched decision frequencies and paired market paths. On the compressed two-asset board, agreement between the near-ideal and default-stress rankings falls to Kendall $τ_b=0.21$ in the high-volatility regime, compared with $0.82$ in the calm regime. The seed-bootstrap intervals, $[0.00,0.52]$ and $[0.48,0.94]$, are wide and overlap. On a fixed 11-policy board, agreement rises from 0.24 with two assets to 0.85 with ten; the two-asset point estimate differs substantially from the wider settings we tested. Rank changes are related to turnover, and comparisons with buy-and-hold also depend on how that anchor is initialized. The experiment does not compare LLM trading skill. It shows that, on a short horizon, an execution convention can become part of the benchmark's headline. Execution assumptions and rank stability should be reported alongside returns.

AI.tldr: 用2462次配对回测检验发现：成交价格假设（理想成交vs.含延迟、价差、冲击等压力成交）不仅改变报告收益，还会改变LLM交易智能体的排名。高波动下两种执行设定排序一致性仅τ_b=0.21（平静期0.82），资产数增加后一致性升到0.85。
AI.motivation: LLM交易智能体的回测普遍假设所有订单按收盘价成交，但已有研究较少追问：这一执行假设只是改变报告收益数值，还是会改变智能体之间的排名。若排名本身对执行假设敏感，那么回测结论的可比性和稳健性都值得怀疑，因此需要量化执行设定对排序的影响。
AI.method: 5个提示式LLM信号策略与7个经典基线策略，在同一批合成价格路径上、6种执行设定（从近似理想成交到延迟、价差、参与率与市场冲击压力）下交易；主实验含2462次运行，决策频率匹配、市场路径成对。用Kendall τ_b衡量排序一致性，并用seed-bootstrap给出区间，同时比较不同资产数（2到10）与不同买入持有锚初始化方式。
AI.result: 两资产压缩盘面上，高波动区近似理想与默认压力排序一致性降至τ_b=0.21（平静区0.82），bootstrap区间分别为[0.00,0.52]与[0.48,0.94]，较宽且重叠；固定11策略盘面上，一致性随资产数从2增至10由0.24升至0.85，两资产点估计与更宽设定差异明显。排名变化与换手率相关，与买入持有的对比也依赖该锚的初始化方式。
AI.conclusion: 本实验不评价LLM的交易能力，只说明在短时间尺度上，一个执行约定可能成为基准结论的核心部分。因此报告收益时应同时报告执行假设与排名稳定性，否则回测排名可能只是执行设定的产物。

title: TeleTune: Evolving Agent Skills From Offline Telemetry
summary: Computer-use agents need to capture procedural knowledge of how people use software. User telemetry offers a scalable source of this knowledge. However, learning reusable skills from these logs requires addressing three challenges: (1) Goal Underspecification, since logs do not record the goal behind each action; (2) Non-Replayability, since past activity cannot be replayed to evaluate skill updates; and (3) Interleaved Trajectories, since logs may mix several tasks without marking their boundaries. To address these, we introduce TeleTune, a framework for learning a textual skill library from offline logs without recorded goals, cannot be replayed during optimization, and may interleave tasks. TeleTune uses action-prediction errors on logged trajectories to propose library edits and keep only those that improve held-out action-prediction accuracy, which we call skill-guided progress. The learned workflows also enable retrieval of demonstrations that cover the subgoals of a new task. At test time, the agent is provided with the learned library and the workflow-based retrieved demonstrations. Experiments on WorkArena and Online-Mind2Web show that TeleTune outperforms random retrieval, Agent Workflow Memory (AWM), and their combination.
