However, the performance of these models on the melanoma datasets such as SIIM-ISIC melanoma classification dataset is a challenge due to the class imbalance. One of the methods to deal with this challenge is using loss function modifications. In this work, we have investigated the effect of different loss functions on the performance of deep neural networks. We trained these networks using focal loss, logit-adjusted softmax cross-entropy (CE) loss, and weighted softmax CE loss, and we report different metrics for evaluating performance and uncertainty calibration. Our results suggest that focal loss delivers a good combination of performance in terms of AUC and uncertainty calibration in terms of expected calibration error (ECE) simultaneously.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了不同损失函数对深度神经网络在黑色素瘤图像分类（SIIM-ISIC数据集）上的性能影响，发现focal loss在AUC与ECE上能同时取得较好平衡。
AI.motivation: 黑色素瘤是最致命的皮肤癌，早期诊断对患者生存至关重要。深度学习图像分类已展现出潜力，但SIIM-ISIC等数据集存在严重的类别不平衡问题，影响模型性能。
AI.method: 采用损失函数改进策略应对类别不平衡，分别使用focal loss、logit-adjusted softmax交叉熵损失和加权softmax交叉熵损失训练深度神经网络，并报告性能评估与不确定性校准的多项指标。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，focal loss在AUC（性能）和ECE（不确定性校准）两方面能同时取得良好的综合表现。
AI.conclusion: focal loss是处理黑色素瘤分类类别不平衡问题的较优选择，可兼顾预测性能与不确定性校准。

title: GNN-CB: A Graph Neural Network Competition Benchmark for Human and LLM Evaluation
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026. 28 pages, 16 figures, 4 tables. Benchmark and leaderboards: https://basiralab.github.io/GNN-CB/
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on coding and reasoning benchmarks; however, their ability to solve graph-structured machine learning problems remains largely unexplored. In particular, no benchmark currently evaluates whether LLMs can autonomously solve end-to-end Graph Neural Network (GNN) coding tasks under realistic competition settings. To address this gap, this paper introduces GNN-CB, the first competition-based benchmark for evaluating both humans and LLMs on GNN coding tasks. GNN-CB consists of 18 curated competitions spanning node-, edge-, and graph-level prediction across diverse graph categories, domains, and difficulty tiers. All submissions are evaluated through a unified automated pipeline with hidden test sets and standardized scoring. Human participants solve tasks under controlled competition constraints, while LLMs are evaluated using a frozen zero-shot prompting protocol based on a plan-then-code paradigm with bounded execute-and-repair loops. The benchmark additionally supports both non-agent and autonomous agent-based evaluation within the same protocol. Under our evaluated protocol, LLMs rarely match Human Top performance and show less stable performance across competitions. No single model dominates: a few competitions are won by LLMs, yet humans still hold the top score on most tasks. We release GNN-CB as a living benchmark with automated evaluation infrastructure, dynamic leaderboards, and reproducible execution pipelines. Beyond benchmarking, GNN-CB provides a practice-oriented resource for studying GNN implementation across progressively diverse graph-learning tasks. The benchmark and evaluation framework are publicly available at https://basiralab.github.io/GNN-CB/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GNN-CB，首个基于竞赛的 GNN 编码基准，同时评测人类与大语言模型在 18 个图学习任务上的端到端实现能力。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在编码与推理基准上表现强劲，但其解决图结构机器学习问题的能力尚未被充分探索，尤其缺乏在真实竞赛设置下评测 LLM 能否自主完成端到端 GNN 编码任务的基准。
AI.method: 构建 GNN-CB 基准，包含 18 个覆盖节点级、边级、图级预测的竞赛任务，涉及多样图类别、领域与难度层级。所有提交通过统一自动化流程评测，使用隐藏测试集与标准化评分。人类参与者在受控竞赛约束下解题；LLM 采用冻结的零样本提示协议，基于"先规划后编码"范式并配有有界执行—修复循环，同时支持非智能体与自主智能体两种评测方式。
AI.result: 在评测协议下，LLM 很少能达到人类顶尖水平，且跨竞赛表现稳定性较差；没有单一模型占据主导——少数竞赛由 LLM 获胜，但多数任务上人类仍保持最高分。
AI.conclusion: GNN-CB 作为持续更新的基准发布，提供自动化评测基础设施、动态排行榜与可复现执行流程，并可作为研究跨多样图学习任务 GNN 实现的实践导向资源，基准与评测框架已公开。

title: Impact of Data Augmentation on Confidence Calibration in Melanoma Classification
comment: Presented at the 30th Conference on Medical Image Understanding and Analysis (MIUA 2026)
summary: Accurately quantifying the predictive uncertainty or improving model calibration plays an important role in medical image classification, in particular in melanoma diagnosis, where accurate uncertainty quantification can have significant implications for patient care. One of the methods for calibration improvement is data augmentation. In addition, data augmentation as a method for synthetically increasing the size of the dataset has been proven to improve the performance of models trained on imbalanced datasets. However, the impact of data augmentation, as a transformation of a part of the original data, on calibration of models trained on imbalanced datasets, in particular in melanoma classification is under-explored. We train neural networks on SIIM-ISIC 2020 melanoma classification dataset under two conditions: with and without data augmentation, and compare the differences in AUC and expected calibration error (ECE) in both scenarios. Our results shows improvements in uncertainty calibration using different augmentation methods.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨数据增强对不平衡数据集上黑色素瘤分类模型校准的影响，在SIIM-ISIC 2020数据集上比较有无数据增强时的AUC与期望校准误差（ECE）。
AI.motivation: 在医学图像分类尤其是黑色素瘤诊断中，准确量化预测不确定性或改善模型校准对患者护理具有重要意义。数据增强虽已被证实能提升不平衡数据集的模型性能，但其作为原始数据变换对不平衡数据（尤其是黑色素瘤分类）模型校准的影响尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 在SIIM-ISIC 2020黑色素瘤分类数据集上，分别在有无数据增强两种条件下训练神经网络，比较两种情形下AUC与期望校准误差（ECE）的差异，并使用不同增强方法进行评估。
AI.result: 结果显示，使用不同的数据增强方法能够改善不确定性校准效果。
AI.conclusion: 数据增强有助于提升不平衡数据集上黑色素瘤分类模型的不确定性校准，表明其在医学图像分类的校准改进中具有应用价值。

title: Efficient Graph Generation via Direct Prediction and Flow Matching
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Geometric Distributional Deep Learning (Oral)
summary: Generative modeling of graph-structured data is crucial for tasks ranging from drug discovery to social network simulation. Among these models, denoising diffusion models have achieved great success in graph generation by learning to progressively reverse a process that adds noise to the original graph. However, the standard noise-prediction approach of diffusion models is suboptimal for graph data. The goal for a graph generative model is to learn the clean graphs' topological properties, such as connectivity and degree distribution. Because a diffusion model that predicts noise does not explicitly learn these topological properties, it is challenging for the model to output graphs with the desired structural statistics. To address this challenge, we introduce Direct Graph Flow Matching (DiGFM), a novel graph transformer model guided by two goals: predict clean graphs and improve sampling efficiency. Distinct from the prevailing diffusion approach, DiGFM employs a continuous flow-matching paradigm and integrates direct graph prediction. Specifically, DiGFM maps the prior noise distribution to the clean graph distribution via a multi-step process: the model repeatedly predicts the underlying clean graph, and a transformation is employed to convert the model output to the velocity vector that points in the direction toward the clean graph distribution. This design enables DiGFM to generate high-quality samples using only 2.5% to 15.6% of the steps required by diffusion-based models, which leads to a 5.3x to 257x speedup in wall-clock inference time. Experiments demonstrate that DiGFM outperforms or matches prior state-of-the-art models across general graph benchmarks and molecular datasets, generating graphs with strong adherence to ground-truth structural statistics at significantly faster inference speeds.

AI.tldr: DiGFM 是一种基于连续流匹配与直接图预测的图生成模型，通过预测干净图而非噪声，显著提升采样效率与结构统计一致性。
AI.motivation: 图生成模型的目标是学习干净图的拓扑属性（如连通性、度分布）。然而，标准扩散模型采用噪声预测方式，并未显式学习这些拓扑性质，因此难以生成符合期望结构统计量的图。
AI.method: 提出 Direct Graph Flow Matching (DiGFM)，一种由图 transformer 驱动的模型。它不采用主流扩散范式，而是使用连续流匹配范式并融合直接图预测。模型通过多步过程将先验噪声分布映射到干净图分布：反复预测底层干净图，并通过变换将模型输出转换为指向干净图分布方向的 velocity 向量。
AI.result: DiGFM 仅需扩散模型 2.5% 至 15.6% 的步数即可生成高质量样本，壁钟推理时间加速 5.3 倍至 257 倍。在通用图基准和分子数据集上，DiGFM 优于或匹配现有最先进模型，并在显著更快的推理速度下生成高度符合真实结构统计量的图。
AI.conclusion: DiGFM 通过直接预测干净图并结合流匹配，有效解决了扩散模型在图结构统计学习上的不足，兼顾生成质量与采样效率。

title: MS-Exam-Gen: Source-Grounded Benchmark Construction for Evaluating LLMs on Textual Multiple Sclerosis MRI Knowledge
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures. Accepted for publication to BHI 2026
summary: Biomedical large language model (LLM) evaluation requires auditable assessment of narrow, evolving, source-grounded subspecialty knowledge. Multiple sclerosis MRI (MS-MRI) provides a high-stakes textual-knowledge test case because correct reasoning requires current diagnostic criteria, standardized acquisition and reporting knowledge, longitudinal monitoring concepts, lesion morphology, and recognition of difficult mimics. We present MS-Exam-Gen, a reproducible framework for constructing and auditing a text-based multiple-choice question (MCQ) benchmark for MS-MRI knowledge; it does not evaluate direct MRI image interpretation. MS-Exam-Gen targets source-grounded criteria, protocols, reporting, and differential diagnosis. The framework combines expert-source indexing, exam-oriented topic induction, evidence-grounded MCQ generation, automated quality audits, a same-family consistency screen, and empirical calibration. From a 66-source corpus indexed into 4,289 retrieval chunks, the pipeline produced a locked 3,058-item candidate benchmark spanning 16 topics and 53 subtopics. Evaluation across 12 primary LLM endpoints yielded 36,696 item-level predictions and separated performance over a 42.8-percentage-point accuracy range (89.7% to 46.9%). Across these endpoints, 25.5% of items were missed by at least four. Post-generation audits showed that refreshed construction reduced measurable answer cues, while option-order testing showed that absolute MCQ scores remain position-sensitive. Generated construction labels remain metadata rather than validated psychometric categories. Because expert adjudication and full option-order counterbalancing remain future work, MS-Exam-Gen is not a clinically certified examination. It should be interpreted as an automatically filtered, source-grounded candidate benchmark and reproducible audit workflow for item-level and topic-specific LLM evaluation.

AI.tldr: MS-Exam-Gen 是一个可复现的框架，用于构建和审计基于文本的 MS-MRI 知识多选题基准，从 66 个来源生成 3,058 道题，在 12 个大模型端点上产生 36,696 条预测，准确率跨度为 89.7%–46.9%，并强调其仅为候选基准而非临床认证考试。
AI.motivation: 生物医学大模型评测需要可审计地评估狭窄、动态演进且有来源依据的亚专科知识。多发性硬化 MRI 是高风险的文本知识测试场景：正确推理需要现行诊断标准、标准化采集与报告知识、纵向监测概念、病灶形态学以及疑难模仿病变的识别能力。
AI.method: MS-Exam-Gen 框架整合了专家来源索引、面向考试的主题归纳、有证据支撑的 MCQ 生成、自动化质量审计、同族一致性筛查与经验校准。它聚焦来源依据的标准、方案、报告和鉴别诊断，不评测直接的 MRI 图像解读。基于 66 个来源语料、索引为 4,289 个检索块，生成并锁定 3,058 道候选题，覆盖 16 个主题、53 个子主题。
AI.result: 在 12 个主要 LLM 端点上评估，产生 36,696 条条目级预测，准确率跨度达 42.8 个百分点（89.7% 至 46.9%）；25.5% 的题目被至少四个端点答错。生成后审计显示，刷新式构建减少了可测答案线索，但选项顺序测试表明绝对 MCQ 分数仍对位置敏感。生成的构建标签仍属元数据，而非经心理测量学验证的类别。
AI.conclusion: 由于专家裁决与完整的选项顺序平衡仍属未来工作，MS-Exam-Gen 不是临床认证考试，应被理解为自动筛选、有来源依据的候选基准与可复现审计流程，用于条目级与主题特定的 LLM 评测。

title: No Concept Escapes the Audit: Auditing-Aware Unlearning for Verifiable Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models can generate prohibited content, which motivates concept erasure through machine unlearning. Most erasure methods intervene at the text interface, through prompt modification or localized updates to text-conditioning weights, and they are evaluated by what the model outputs for given prompts. Such evaluation cannot see what the network still encodes. Latent-space auditing, which bypasses text conditioning and probes the denoising network directly, shows that erased concepts remain recoverable from internal representations. We find that this also holds for methods built to be robust against adversarial prompts, and that the problem grows with the number of erased concepts. We propose Auditing-Aware Unlearning for Verifiable Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models (AVCE), a framework that grounds erasure in the model's latent representations. AVCE audits the embedding neighborhood of each concept and condenses the discovered vulnerable directions into an anchor at the weakest geometric point. It edits cross-attention and self-attention projections in closed form at this anchor, then fine-tunes the two pathways with pathway-level auditing losses, using orthogonal gradient projection to consolidate multiple concepts. Experiments on SD v1.5, SDXL, and Flux 1.0 across object, explicit-content, and artistic-style unlearning show that AVCE reduces attack success rates by 5.07x and improves auditing scores by 3.84x over the strongest baseline, while preserving competitive generation quality.

AI.tldr: 提出 AVCE 框架，从潜在表征层面进行概念擦除，显著降低攻击成功率并提升审计分数。
AI.motivation: 现有概念擦除方法多在文本接口干预，仅通过给定提示的输出进行评估，无法检测网络内部仍编码的内容；潜在空间审计表明被擦除概念仍可从内部表征中恢复，且该问题随擦除概念数量增加而加剧。
AI.method: AVCE 审计每个概念的嵌入邻域，将发现的脆弱方向浓缩为最弱几何点的锚点；在该锚点以闭式解编辑交叉注意力和自注意力投影，再用路径级审计损失微调两条路径，并通过正交梯度投影整合多个概念。
AI.result: 在 SD v1.5、SDXL 和 Flux 1.0 上针对物体、显式内容和艺术风格擦除的实验表明，相比最强基线，攻击成功率降低 5.07 倍，审计分数提升 3.84 倍，同时保持有竞争力的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 将擦除建立在模型潜在表征之上，可实现更可验证的概念擦除，有效应对内部表征中概念残留的问题。

title: Auditable Clinical Timeline Reconstruction with Provenance-Aware Evidence Graphs
summary: A patient-timeline reconstruction system is auditable only if it keeps the mentions behind each answer, records how facts were revised, and declines to answer when the evidence is not in the text. This study tests these three properties on a fully synthetic corpus (1,000 patients, 3,353 notes, 220 revision edges). Two provenance-aware Evidence Graph operators reduced the node-plus-edge count to 67% and 63% (77-78% of serialized size) while preserving every answer and mention link across 6,813 query points answerable by recency; a fixed-window baseline returned no value for 53.4% of points, unflagged. On evidence-unavailable controls that announce the omission, a BioClinicalBERT gate and a zero-shot LLM gate responded mainly to the announcement. On marker-free controls, BERT abstained on 0 of 81 notes while its accuracy fell from 93.8% to 59.3% across all three relation classes; the LLM's coverage fell from 75.6% to 27.7% on notes its own model family judged undeterminable. Against 482 regenerated gold spans, the LLM's cited evidence reached recall 0.850 and precision 0.864; BERT's span head, trained without span labels, did not localize evidence. A temporally versioned provenance graph stored abstentions as typed, queryable edges. The clean task admits a 0.651-accuracy shortcut, and results describe implementation behaviour on synthetic data, not clinical performance.

AI.tldr: 在1,000名患者、3,353份笔记的合成语料上，检验患者时间线重建系统的三项可审计属性：保留答案背后的提及、记录事实修订、证据不足时拒答。溯源感知的Evidence Graph算子将节点加边数降至67%和63%（序列化大小的77-78%）并保持全部答案与提及链接；LLM引用证据的召回率0.850、精确率0.864，而BERT的跨度头无法定位证据。
AI.motivation: 患者时间线重建系统要真正可审计，必须满足三点：保留每个答案背后的文本提及、记录事实如何被修订、以及在证据不在文本中时拒答。当前系统缺乏对这些属性的系统检验，尤其缺少对溯源压缩、拒答行为与证据定位能力的量化评估。
AI.method: 在完全合成的语料（1,000名患者、3,353份笔记、220条修订边）上测试三项属性。使用两种溯源感知的Evidence Graph算子与固定窗口基线对比，在6,813个可由recency回答的查询点上评估；设置证据不可用对照（有省略声明）与无标记对照；采用BioClinicalBERT门控与零样本LLM门控；并以482个重新生成的gold span评估引用证据的召回与精确率。
AI.result: 两种算子将节点加边数降至67%和63%（序列化大小的77-78%），同时保留全部答案与提及链接；固定窗口基线在53.4%的查询点上无值返回且未标记。证据不可用对照中，两个门控主要对声明本身作出反应。无标记对照中BERT在81份笔记上拒答0次，准确率从93.8%降至59.3%；LLM覆盖率从75.6%降至27.7%。LLM引用证据召回0.850、精确0.864；BERT跨度头（无跨度标签训练）未能定位证据。时间版本化溯源图将弃权存储为带类型的可查询边。干净任务存在0.651准确率的捷径。
AI.conclusion: 溯源感知的Evidence Graph可在压缩存储的同时保持答案与提及链接，LLM在证据引用定位上表现良好而BERT门控与跨度头在无标记与证据缺失场景下失效。结果仅描述合成数据上的实现行为，不代表临床性能，且干净任务中存在0.651准确率的捷径，说明评估需谨慎。

title: Task Vector Descent: Learning from Non-IID Batches
summary: A central challenge in continual learning is to acquire new knowledge without forgetting what the model has already learned. This challenge appears in language model training when training data comes from various domain-, user-, or task-specific distributions that are encountered unevenly over time. In such settings, successive minibatches are temporally clustered by distribution instead of being sampled i.i.d. from the overall data mixture. Training on temporally clustered data induces a stability-plasticity tradeoff. Adapting the model to the active distribution can improve the model on the active distribution but may lead to a performance degradation on data it previously trained on. We find that this tradeoff intensifies with longer exposure to the same distribution. We therefore ask if the parameter displacement produced by such a sequence (the task vector) should be fully retained or applied partially. We compare applying the full displacement ($λ=1$) with partial integration, which scales the task vector by $λ$ before applying it to the continuing model and scales the optimizer state by the same coefficient. Across continual pretraining, pretraining from random initialization, supervised post-training, and reinforcement post-training, we find that intermediate values of $λ$ often improve average continuing-model performance relative to full integration, particularly after longer same-distribution sequences. In continual-pretraining experiments with both controlled streams and naturally defined adaptation sequences, task-vector scaling outperforms full integration at the matched learning rate, showing that its benefits are not reproduced by learning-rate scaling alone.

AI.tldr: 本文研究持续学习中任务向量（参数位移）应完全保留还是部分应用的问题，发现对任务向量和优化器状态按系数λ缩放的部分整合，在多种训练场景中常优于完全整合（λ=1）。
AI.motivation: 持续学习的核心挑战是在获取新知识的同时不遗忘旧知识。当训练数据来自不同领域、用户或任务的分布且随时间不均匀遇到时，连续的minibatch按分布时间聚集而非i.i.d.采样，这会引发稳定性-可塑性权衡，且该权衡随同一分布暴露时间延长而加剧。
AI.method: 对比完全应用参数位移（λ=1）与部分整合：部分整合在应用到延续模型前将任务向量按λ缩放，并以相同系数缩放优化器状态。在持续预训练、随机初始化预训练、有监督后训练和强化后训练等多种设置下进行实验。
AI.result: 中间值λ常能提升延续模型的平均性能，尤其在较长的同分布序列之后。在受控数据流和自然定义的适应序列的持续预训练实验中，任务向量缩放在匹配学习率下优于完全整合，说明其收益无法仅通过学习率缩放来复现。
AI.conclusion: 部分整合（任务向量缩放）是一种有效缓解持续学习中稳定性-可塑性权衡的方法，其优势来自任务向量本身的缩放而非单纯的学习率调整。

title: Bridging the Evidence-to-Execution Gap:A Reflective Agent for Multi-Objective Peptide Design
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can reason over scientific literature to devise design strategies, yet fail to reliably implement them for biological sequences. While protein generative models learn sequence patterns, they lack the capacity to incorporate literature evidence for multi-step reflective reasoning, forming an evidence-to-execution gap between scientific reasoning and sequence manipulation. We present EASER (Evidence-Aware Sequence Engineering with Reflection), a reflective agent bridging reasoning and sequence generation via a learned property interface of offline-trained, fixed low-rank matrices. The agent steers a diffusion generator by combining these matrices, proposing intervention hypotheses (anchors, editable positions, control coefficients) grounded in retrieved evidence, sequence context and past results. A Probe-and-Steer mechanism validates interventions and allocates samples according to predicted property responses, with outcome reflection informing subsequent decisions. Evaluated on multi-objective antimicrobial peptide design (optimizing activity, non-hemolysis and non-toxicity), explicit hypothesis formulation delivers better multi-objective performance than direct action generation under identical decision conditions. Ablation studies verify the importance of evidence retrieval, episodic history, reflection and Probe-and-Steer. Over six repeated trials, EASER obtains the highest mean hypervolume and lowest mean IGD+ on screened candidates compared with competing baselines. Our work demonstrates how an executable property interface and iterative feedback link scientific reasoning to targeted peptide sequence generation.

AI.tldr: EASER是一种反思型智能体，通过学习到的属性接口连接科学推理与蛋白质序列生成，在多目标抗菌肽设计上优于基线。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能对科学文献进行推理并制定设计策略，但难以可靠地将其落实到生物序列实现上；蛋白质生成模型虽能学习序列模式，却无法融入文献证据进行多步反思推理，导致科学推理与序列操作之间存在“证据到执行”的鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出EASER（Evidence-Aware Sequence Engineering with Reflection），利用离线训练的固定低秩矩阵构成可学习的属性接口来桥接推理与序列生成。智能体结合这些矩阵引导扩散生成器，基于检索证据、序列上下文与历史结果提出干预假设（锚点、可编辑位置、控制系数）。Probe-and-Steer机制验证干预并按预测属性响应分配样本，结果反思用于指导后续决策。
AI.result: 在多目标抗菌肽设计任务（优化活性、非溶血性与非毒性）中，显式假设表述在相同决策条件下取得优于直接动作生成的多目标表现。消融实验验证了证据检索、情景历史、反思和Probe-and-Steer的重要性。六次重复试验中，EASER在筛选候选上取得最高平均超体积和最低平均IGD+。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，可执行的属性接口与迭代反馈能够将科学推理与定向肽序列生成有效连接起来。

title: BeliefGraph-JEPA: Structured Latent World Models for Action-Conditioned Time Series
summary: Action-conditioned time-series forecasting requires accounting for how future actions and exogenous forcings influence multiple targets through partially observed effects with different delays and persistence. Direct conditioning leaves the evolution and target-specific influence of these effects implicit in the predictor, while static relational graphs specify connections without tracking evolving effects. This motivates representing future-driver influence through structured latent states that evolve over the forecast horizon and route information to individual targets. We introduce BeliefGraph-JEPA, a structured latent world model that factorizes driver influence into typed latent-effect states. These states are rolled forward under future drivers and routed through a graph to target-specific nodes, forming the predictive base of a joint-embedding predictive architecture. A capacity-controlled residual supplements this base with direct driver information. On four multi-target clinical, agricultural, environmental, and industrial systems, the framework outperforms a range of pretrained and supervised known-future-covariate baselines. Matched controls isolate latent dynamics, future rollout, graph routing, and residual capacity; future rollout and graph-first residual routing improve forecasting across all four systems.

AI.tldr: 提出 BeliefGraph-JEPA，通过结构化潜在效应状态建模未来驱动因素对多目标的影响，在四类多目标系统中优于基线。
AI.motivation: 动作条件时间序列预测中，未来动作和外生强迫通过不同延迟和持续性的部分可观测效应影响多目标。直接条件化会将该效应的演化及目标特异性影响隐式留在预测器中；静态关系图只规定连接而不追踪演化中的效应。
AI.method: BeliefGraph-JEPA 是一个结构化潜在世界模型，将驱动影响分解为有类型的潜在效应状态；这些状态在未来驱动下向前滚动，并通过图路由到目标特定节点，构成联合嵌入预测架构的预测基础；由容量控制的残差补充直接驱动信息。
AI.result: 在临床、农业、环境和工业四类多目标系统上，优于多种预训练和有监督的已知未来协变量基线；匹配对照实验分离了潜在动力学、未来滚动、图路由和残差容量的作用。
AI.conclusion: 未来滚动和图优先残差路由在全部四个系统中均提升预测性能，表明结构化潜在效应状态与图路由是关键机制。

title: Judged Useless, Queried Anyway: Tool-Using Agents Rarely Turn Their Own Evidence Judgments into Stopping Decisions
summary: An agent whose tool keeps returning nothing useful should stop relying on it. In a retrieval environment with controlled source failures, we separate how agents judge results from what they do. We compare stopping at the same step after longer and shorter runs of results the agent judged useless; this contrast is zero for clock- or deadline-driven stopping. Where we record their judgments, the seven agents we test call a failing source's results useless 97-100% of the time, yet most of them rarely stop on that judgment. Prompt cues change when they stop but not what they stop on. Permission to answer from memory and a reasoning mode can bring early stops regardless of evidence, a stated budget moves the 7-8B models' stops to the deadline, and a stopping rule or call cost in the prompt is followed at most partly. Stopping follows the evidence only when the harness enforces an integration step that makes the agent answer after five consecutive results it judged useless. This step raises failing-source success for every model, keeps the stopping point fixed when the budget doubles, and needs no extra judgment call when the agent states its judgments. A pre-registered replication on 300 fresh questions confirms the dissociation and the rule's effect.

AI.tldr: 本文研究智能体在检索环境中面对失效信息源时的停止行为，发现智能体能高准确率判断结果无用，却很少据此停止；只有在外部强制执行"连续五次判为无用后作答"的整合步骤时，停止才真正跟随证据。
AI.motivation: 智能体在工具持续返回无用结果时理应停止依赖该工具，但其判断与行动可能存在分离。作者希望厘清：智能体是否能识别失效来源，以及这种判断是否真正驱动其停止行为，并寻找能让停止跟随证据的机制。
AI.method: 在受控源失效的检索环境中，将"如何判断结果"与"实际行为"分离。对比在更长和更短的无用结果序列后于同一步停止的情形（该对比对时钟或截止时间驱动的停止为零）。测试七个智能体，记录其判断，并施加多种提示线索（允许凭记忆作答、推理模式、声明预算、停止规则或调用成本），最后引入harness强制的整合步骤。另在300个新问题上进行预注册复制。
AI.result: 七个智能体在97-100%的情况下将失效来源的结果判为无用，但多数很少据此停止。提示线索改变的是何时停止，而非停止所依据的内容：凭记忆作答和推理模式导致不顾证据的提前停止；声明预算使7-8B模型的停止移至截止时间；停止规则或调用成本最多只被部分遵循。强制整合步骤提升了所有模型的失效源成功率，且在预算翻倍时停止点保持不变，当智能体陈述判断时无需额外判断调用。
AI.conclusion: 智能体对失效来源的判断与停止行为之间存在系统性脱节，提示难以弥合；只有外部harness强制执行基于证据的整合步骤，才能使停止真正跟随证据并提升任务成功率，该结论经预注册复制验证。

title: Hierarchical Time-aware Bootstrapping for Off-Policy Subgoal Value Learning
summary: Off-policy hierarchical reinforcement learning must estimate the values of high-level decisions while the low-level policy changes. HIRO adapts replay data through subgoal relabeling, but after a label change, the value update targets the relabeled subgoal instead of the subgoal the high-level policy originally needed to update. We propose Hierarchical Time-aware Bootstrapping (HTB), which evaluates specified subgoals under the current low-level policy while retaining accumulated task rewards. Remaining execution time distinguishes subgoal continuation from a new high-level decision. Together with primitive-action conditioning, it enables off-policy Bellman updates based on the stationary environment transition law. HTB combines these one-step updates with multi-step suffix returns and truncated relabeling, reducing dependence on intermediate value estimates. A shared value component supports learning across actions, while nonnegative residuals constrain upward corrections relative to that component. At a fixed mixture weight of 0.95, HTB achieves 32.8% AntFall success versus 9.6% for matched local HIRO over five paired seeds at 10M environment steps. Ablations identify contributions from recursive continuation and mixed supervision; fixed-policy tests show more accurate predictions for actions whose returns were excluded from fitting.

AI.tldr: HTB通过指定子目标评估、时间感知续接与混合监督改进HIRO的off-policy分层强化学习价值估计。
AI.motivation: HIRO通过子目标重标记适配回放数据，但标签变更后价值更新指向重标记子目标而非高层策略原本需要更新的子目标，导致off-policy分层RL的价值估计不准确。
AI.method: 提出Hierarchical Time-aware Bootstrapping（HTB）：在当前低层策略下评估指定子目标并保留累积任务奖励；用剩余执行时间区分子目标续接与新高层决策；结合原语动作条件实现基于平稳环境转移律的off-policy Bellman更新；融合一步更新、多步后缀回报与截断重标记；采用共享价值组件与非负残差约束向上修正。
AI.result: 在混合权重0.95、10M环境步、五个配对种子的设置下，HTB在AntFall任务上取得32.8%成功率，而匹配的局部HIRO为9.6%。消融实验确认了递归续接与混合监督的贡献；固定策略测试显示对未参与拟合的动作回报预测更准确。
AI.conclusion: HTB有效缓解了子目标重标记带来的价值目标错位问题，提升了off-policy分层强化学习的效率与价值预测准确性。

title: Copies or Sources? Measuring How LLM Aggregators Count Restated Evidence in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent systems built on large language models (LLMs) restate observations as a matter of course: relays forward them, shared boards repeat them and discussion rounds echo them. An aggregator that pools such messages should count sources, not statements. We convert a reported probability into units of independent readings, which assigns every restatement a copy weight, 0 for an aggregator that counts sources and 1 for one that counts every statement, and yields the implied decision under any cost structure. Three testbeds hold the evidence fixed and vary how it is restated: message logs with an exact Bayesian oracle, web documents with appended copies, and logs written by LLM agent teams under four communication protocols. Across four models from three providers, a forwarded copy counts for 0.06 to 0.42 of a new reading, mostly because some replies count every statement. On 5% to 40% of logs that state one reading three times, the reported belief implies an early commitment that the oracle never makes. The models that count copies least and most on controlled logs do so on web copies and agent-written logs as well. A one-paragraph declaration of what a copy contributes brings the copy weight on controlled logs to 0.08 or less. A rule that has agents refer to readings instead of restating them cuts belief-implied early commitment from 11.2% to 1.1% and preserves genuine corroboration.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究LLM多智能体系统中"复述"消息被聚合器重复计数的问题，提出将上报概率换算为"独立读数"单位，为每次复述赋予复制权重。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统基于LLM构建，观察信息常被反复转述、转发与共享，但聚合器若把这些复述当作独立证据重复计数，会高估证据强度、导致错误的过早决策。因此需要量化"复制"对信念聚合的污染程度。
AI.method: 将上报概率转换为独立读数单位，为每次复述分配复制权重（0=只计来源的聚合器，1=计每条陈述的聚合器），并推出任意成本结构下的隐含决策。三个测试平台固定证据、只改变复述方式：带精确贝叶斯oracle的消息日志、附加副本的网页文档、四种通信协议下LLM智能体团队写的日志；覆盖三家提供商四个模型。另测试一段关于"副本贡献"的声明规则和"让智能体引用而非复述"的规则。
AI.result: 一次转发的副本仅相当于0.06到0.42个新读数，主要因为部分回复把每条陈述都计数。在5%到40%的日志中同一读数被陈述三次，其上报信念隐含了oracle从不做出的过早承诺。模型在受控日志上的复制计数倾向可外推到网页副本与智能体日志。一段声明可使受控日志复制权重降至0.08以下；引用规则将信念隐含的过早承诺从11.2%降到1.1%，并保留真实佐证。
AI.conclusion: LLM多智能体聚合应计数来源而非陈述，复述被重复计权是普遍且可跨场景外推的偏差；通过简单的声明或引用规则可显著降低该偏差，同时不损害真正的多元佐证。

title: Groupwise Distortion Guarantees for Preference-Based Alignment
summary: Preference-based alignment methods such as reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) and Nash learning from human feedback (NLHF) aggregate pairwise preferences to learn an LLM policy, but a natural goal is maximizing social welfare (average cardinal utility), which comparisons alone need not identify. Gölz, Haghtalab, and Yang (GHY) measure the gap by distortion: the worst-case ratio between the welfare of the best fixed lottery (distribution over responses) and of the learned lottery. They show NLHF is optimal when every user receives the same lottery. Account-based LLMs, however, have information about their users and can serve different lotteries to different people. We give an efficient algorithm, GLHF, that learns a single group-conditioned policy from one comparison per user. Under individual Bradley--Terry comparisons, GLHF asymptotically matches GHY's optimal population distortion bound simultaneously on every group in a prespecified, possibly overlapping collection, with sample complexity growing logarithmically in the number of groups and inversely with the smallest group mass. A sharper guarantee for groups with similar preferences approaches distortion of one when members share a feasible favorite response. In experiments using human coffee ratings and synthetic LLM-generated ratings, GLHF lowers distortion in every evaluated group and substantially reduces worst-group distortion relative to NLHF and other group-agnostic baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出GLHF算法，从每位用户一次比较中学习群体条件策略，在重叠群体上同时达到GHY最优群体失真界，实验降低最差群体失真。
AI.motivation: 偏好对齐（RLHF、NLHF）通过成对偏好学习策略，但真正的目标是最大化社会福利（平均基数效用），而比较数据未必能识别效用。GHY用失真度量这一问题，并证明当所有用户共享同一彩票时NLHF最优。然而账户制LLM可获取用户信息、为不同人群提供不同彩票，因此需要研究群体条件化的策略学习。
AI.method: 提出高效算法GLHF，仅需每位用户一次比较，即可学习单一群体条件策略。在个体Bradley-Terry比较模型下，GLHF在预设的（可能重叠的）群体集合上同时逼近GHY的最优群体失真界；样本复杂度随群体数量对数增长，与最小群体质量成反比。对偏好相似的群体给出更紧保证，当成员共享可行偏好响应时失真趋近于1。
AI.result: 在人类咖啡评分与合成LLM生成评分的实验中，GLHF在每一个评估群体上都降低了失真，且相比NLHF及其他群体不可知基线显著降低了最差群体失真。
AI.conclusion: GLHF表明可利用账户信息实现群体条件化对齐，在单次比较预算下同时优化多个（含重叠）群体的社会福利，是群体感知偏好对齐的有效方法。

title: Do Small Language Models Learn to Negotiate? A Controlled Scaling Study of RL-Trained Sellers
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Accepted (poster) at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on SLMs for Agentic Systems (SLM-Agents), Paris
summary: LLM agents are starting to own the full customer experience. Soon, LLMs may be selling and buying on behalf of companies and customers respectively. Small models are more cost-efficient at scale, but can reinforcement learning train them into competent sellers? We train four Gemma 4 checkpoints (2.3B to 31B effective parameters) with GRPO on a programmatic utility reward for bilateral multi-issue bargaining, and evaluate every arm on the same 1,152 negotiations against two frontier buyers it never saw in training. With the same learning rate ($10^{-6}$) for every size, the gain of the RL model over its base rises from $+0.001$ at 2.3B to $+0.078$ at 31B. Each size was trained once and the two smallest checkpoints use a different architecture, so we fit no scaling law. Tripling the learning rate, with the same or fewer training steps, improves on the shared rate at every size by $+0.032$ (2.3B) to $+0.081$ (4.5B). In exploratory comparisons with two frontier models run as sellers, the 12B seller trained at the tripled rate scores above both, though its untrained base already scores as high as they do. The 4.5B seller at that rate shows no detectable difference from either and fits on one 48 GB GPU. A further 2.3B arm at ten times the shared rate raises pooled score, but its gain concentrates on the evaluation buyer that shares a model family with the training pool. These results suggest tuning the learning rate before concluding that a small model cannot learn to negotiate, and testing against buyers from more than one model family.

AI.tldr: 用 GRPO 在程序化效用奖励上训练 4 个不同规模的 Gemma 4 检查点做双边多议题议价，发现提高学习率比扩大模型规模更能提升小模型的议价能力。
AI.motivation: LLM 代理将逐渐代表公司或客户完成买卖，小模型在大规模部署下更具成本优势，但能否通过强化学习把小模型训练成合格的"卖方"尚不清楚。
AI.method: 以 GRPO 在程序化效用奖励上训练 4 个 Gemma 4 检查点（2.3B 至 31B 有效参数），每个模型只训练一次；在相同的 1,152 场双边多议题谈判中，与两个训练中未见过的前沿买方模型对战评估；并额外测试三倍、十倍学习率以及不同卖家规模（4.5B、12B、2.3B）的探索性对照。
AI.result: 相同学习率（1e-6）下，RL 模型相对基座的增益从 2.3B 的 +0.001 升至 31B 的 +0.078；学习率提高三倍后，各规模均优于共享学习率（2.3B 为 +0.032，4.5B 为 +0.081）。探索性对比中，三倍学习率的 12B 卖方得分高于两个前沿模型，但其未训练基座已与二者相当；4.5B 卖方与二者无显著差异且可运行于单张 48GB GPU；十倍学习率的 2.3B 虽提升总分，但增益集中在与训练池同族的评估买方上。
AI.conclusion: 在断定小模型无法学会议价之前，应先调节学习率；同时应使用来自多个模型族的买方进行测试，以避免评估偏差。

title: VERA: Verdict-Conditioned Reliability for Adaptive LLM Judges
summary: Accurately estimating judgment reliability is a central challenge in adapting LLM judges to newly verified feedback while preserving previously learned behavior. However, existing approaches often rely on output-level confidence, which can be overconfident and poorly aligned with judgment correctness. We propose VERA, a VErdict-conditioned Reliability Axis that estimates reliability from hidden activations by distinguishing correct from incorrect judgments within each predicted-verdict group. Using VERA as a control signal, we develop a VERA-guided periodic adaptation framework that integrates reliability-ranked corrective updates, reliability-residual replay, and periodic refresh of the reliability directions. After VERA-guided adaptation on Chatbot Arena, 8B- and 14B-parameter judges outperform the strongest baseline on each of four held-out public benchmarks, with relative gains of up to 23.01%. The framework also improves focal-class recall by up to 16.1% relative to the strongest adaptive baselines on a separate proprietary temporal auditing task.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出VERA（判决条件可靠性轴），通过隐藏激活区分每个预测判决组内的正确与错误判断，从而更准确估计LLM评判器的可靠性，并基于此构建周期性自适应框架以提升评判器性能。
AI.motivation: 在将LLM评判器适配到新验证反馈的同时保持已学行为，核心挑战在于准确估计评判可靠性。现有方法依赖输出层置信度，往往过度自信且与判断正确性对齐不佳。因此需要一个更可靠的可靠性估计信号。
AI.method: 提出VERA（VErdict-conditioned Reliability Axis，判决条件可靠性轴），从隐藏激活中估计可靠性，通过在每一预测判决组内区分正确与错误判断。以VERA作为控制信号，构建VERA引导的周期性自适应框架，整合三项机制：可靠性排序的纠正更新、可靠性残差回放，以及可靠性方向的周期性刷新。
AI.result: 在Chatbot Arena上进行VERA引导自适应后，8B和14B参数的评判器在四个留出公开基准上均优于最强基线，相对提升最高达23.01%；在另一独立专有时间审计任务上，焦点类召回率相对最强自适应基线提升最高16.1%。
AI.conclusion: 基于隐藏激活的判决条件可靠性估计（VERA）比输出层置信度更能有效指导LLM评判器的自适应，配合周期性自适应框架可在多个基准和任务上带来显著且一致的性能提升，验证了内部激活信号在可靠性估计中的价值。

title: AI-Decision Checkpoints for AI-Augmented Business Process Management: Framework and Educational Instantiation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI agents are increasingly embedded in operational business processes. Yet Business Process Management (BPM) curricula and frameworks still largely treat artificial intelligence (AI) as an add-on technology, leaving graduates (as potential future process developers) unprepared to reason about AI as a first-class design element of end-to-end processes. This paper addresses that gap by proposing \emph{AI-decision checkpoints}: explicit moments in a process development trajectory where process developers identify AI-candidate sub-processes, assess expected effects on time, cost, quality, and flexibility, consider legal and organisational constraints, and document a reasoned decision to adopt, constrain, or reject specific AI components. The checkpoints are instantiated through a fictitious customer onboarding process as a \textit{BPM Teaching Case}, embedded in a lifecycle-driven framework spanning six modules that combine process modeling, simulation, workflow execution with AI agents, and process mining, with each module's output serving as the next module's input. A preliminary formative reflection draws on instructor observations, submitted artifacts, and discovered process maps from learning-management-system logs. These exploratory observations suggest that the approach supported clearer distinctions between task-level automation and process-level value.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"AI决策检查点"，将AI作为端到端业务流程的一等设计要素嵌入BPM教学，通过虚构的客户入驻流程与六模块生命周期框架进行教学实践。
AI.motivation: LLM、RAG与AI代理已深度嵌入业务运营流程，但BPM课程与框架仍将AI视为附加技术，导致未来流程开发者无法将AI作为端到端流程的一等设计要素来思考，形成教学与实务之间的缺口。
AI.method: 提出AI决策检查点：在流程开发轨迹中的明确节点，让开发者识别AI候选子流程、评估其对时间/成本/质量/灵活性的预期影响、考虑法律与组织约束，并记录采纳、限制或否决特定AI组件的理性决策。以虚构的客户入驻流程作为BPM教学案例，嵌入涵盖六模块的生命周期驱动框架，整合流程建模、仿真、含AI代理的工作流执行与流程挖掘，各模块输出作为下一模块输入。
AI.result: 基于教师观察、学生提交作品以及从学习管理系统日志中发现的过程图，进行初步形成性反思。探索性观察表明，该方法有助于更清晰地区分任务级自动化与流程级价值。
AI.conclusion: AI决策检查点与生命周期驱动的教学框架展现出帮助学习者将AI视为流程设计一等要素的潜力；但当前仅为探索性、形成性的初步证据，尚需进一步验证。

title: Measuring and Reducing Cross-Vendor Mismatch in Language Models
summary: Running the same language model on different graphics processing unit (GPU) vendors can produce different logits, even when the model weights and inputs are the same. We analyze cross-vendor mismatch in two dense and two mixture-of-experts (MoE) models with five metric families, namely bitwise equality, logit differences, top-K consistency, token agreement, and task accuracy. We trace one source of the mismatch to accumulation order inside vendors' matrix instructions. Upcasting to FP32 reduces the dense model's logit error by 43% at three times the runtime, yet keeping only the MLPs in BF16 retains 94% of this gain at 1.3 times the runtime, so most of the cost of full upcasting buys little. In the MoE models, FP32 and FP16 both lower the probability error but raise the logit error and change expert selection, and FP16 fails in the dense model. An output-head low-rank adapter (LoRA) does not help either, since the final hidden state does not predict the mismatch. The mismatch also carries into training. With every seed fixed, a student distilled from a teacher running on AMD answers 431 MMLU questions differently from one distilled from the same teacher on NVIDIA. Under FP32 upcasting, bitwise equality barely changes while the output distributions move most of the way to the reference, so judging cross-vendor agreement by a single measure misreads both its cost and its gains. Code is available at https://github.com/crova-project/crova.

AI.tldr: 同一语言模型在不同GPU厂商上会产生不同的logits；论文用五个指标族分析跨厂商差异，追溯其累积顺序来源，并评估FP32上采样、LoRA与知识蒸馏等缓解手段的成本与效果。
AI.motivation: 模型权重与输入相同，但不同GPU厂商运行同一语言模型却得到不同logits，这种跨厂商不一致性会影响结果的可复现性与公平比较。作者希望系统刻画这一差异的来源、规模与传播范围，并评估各类缓解方案的真实收益与代价。
AI.method: 在两个稠密模型与两个MoE模型上，用五个指标族（逐位相等、logit差异、top-K一致性、token一致性、任务准确率）衡量跨厂商差异；将部分不匹配追溯到厂商矩阵指令内部的累加顺序；测试FP32上采样、仅MLP保持BF16、MoE下的FP32/FP16、输出头LoRA等方案，并通过固定随机种子的知识蒸馏检验差异向训练的传播。
AI.result: FP32上采样把稠密模型的logit误差降低43%，但运行时间增至3倍；仅将MLP保持BF16可以1.3倍运行时间保留94%的收益。MoE模型中，FP32与FP16都降低概率误差却抬高logit误差并改变专家选择，FP16在稠密模型中失效。输出头LoRA无效，因为最终隐状态无法预测该不匹配。训练中，固定全部种子后，从AMD教师蒸馏的学生与从NVIDIA教师蒸馏的学生在431道MMLU题上给出不同答案。FP32上采样下逐位相等几乎不变，但输出分布已大部分逼近参考，说明用单一指标判断跨厂商一致性会误判其成本与收益。
AI.conclusion: 跨厂商不匹配源于硬件累加顺序，且会传播到训练与蒸馏结果；单纯逐位相等指标低估了实际分布层面的改善，评估跨厂商一致性需要多指标联合判断。作者建议以适度成本（仅MLP保留BF16）获得大部分精度收益，并公开了代码。

title: From Papers to Mechanisms: An Evidence-Grounded Knowledge Substrate for Scientific Language Models
summary: Scientific language models often access literature through untyped text chunks, which fragment the functional and evidential structure required for mechanism-rich questions. We introduce an evidence-grounded mechanism knowledge substrate that organizes scientific literature into provenance-linked evidence units, role-typed entities, and directed mechanism paths. We instantiate it as MS$^3$, a Material-Sensor-Signal-System schema for conductive-fiber flexible sensors, over 13,689 papers, 131,083 evidence items, and 26,648 mechanism objects. On in-domain and coverage-shift question-answering benchmarks, we compare closed-book generation, Web search, Raw-PDF RAG, and MS$^3$ retrieval across ten language models. MS$^3$ improves macro-averaged scientific correctness. It also improves citation entailment and answer completeness. These results support mechanism substrates as a reliable representation layer for scientific language models and motivate a source-repair workflow in which insufficient MS$^3$ evidence triggers targeted retrieval from its linked papers rather than assuming that a user has already supplied the correct PDFs.

AI.tldr: 提出证据锚定的机理知识基底 MS³，将文献组织为可溯源证据单元、角色化实体与有向机理路径，提升科学问答的正确性、引用蕴含与答案完整性。
AI.motivation: 科学语言模型通常以无类型文本块检索文献，割裂了机理型问题所需的功能与证据结构，难以支撑富含机理的问答。
AI.method: 构建证据锚定的机理知识基底，实例化为面向导电纤维柔性传感器的 MS³（材料-传感器-信号-系统）模式，覆盖13,689篇论文、131,083条证据、26,648个机理对象；在域内与覆盖迁移的问答基准上，对10个语言模型比较闭卷生成、Web搜索、Raw-PDF RAG与MS³检索。
AI.result: MS³ 提升了宏平均科学正确性，同时改善引用蕴含与答案完整性。
AI.conclusion: 机理基底可作科学语言模型可靠的表示层，并支持源修复工作流——当 MS³ 证据不足时，触发对关联论文的定向检索，而非假设用户已提供正确 PDF。

title: Population Scaling or Data Dilution? Dynamics of Local Topology Evolution in Decentralized Learning
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures. Accepted as a poster at DynaFront @ NeurIPS 2026
summary: Scaling decentralized learning changes not only the number of clients $N$, but also the dynamics of information propagation and consensus. We argue that the effect of increasing $N$ cannot be understood in isolation, because data allocation, topology-dependent mixing, and communication capacity may change simultaneously. We study these coupled effects on CIFAR-10 with $N\in\{10,50,100,200\}$, comparing a degree-two Ring, a Static Random graph, and Local-First Heuristic Evolution (LFHE), a locally adaptive topology process based on friend-of-friend discovery. The Ring provides an analytically transparent failure mode: its Metropolis spectral gap decays as $Θ(N^{-2})$, implying progressively slower contraction of model disagreement as the population grows. Experiments show that holding the nominal local dataset size fixed substantially reduces the apparent population penalty observed when a fixed total dataset is divided among more clients. The remaining degradation depends strongly on communication structure: Ring enters a high-disagreement regime, whereas Static Random and LFHE remain close to consensus. Increasing LFHE's degree threshold further improves accuracy and consensus, but at a substantially higher model-transmission cost. These results show that decentralized scaling is governed by coupled learning and communication dynamics, rather than by the number of clients alone.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究去中心化学习中客户端数量N扩大时，数据分配、拓扑混合与通信容量耦合对性能的影响，发现"人口惩罚"并非仅由N决定。
AI.motivation: 去中心化学习规模扩大不仅改变客户端数量N，还同时改变信息传播与共识动态。作者认为不能孤立理解N增大的影响，因为数据分配、依赖拓扑的混合过程以及通信容量可能同时变化，因此需要研究这些耦合效应。
AI.method: 在CIFAR-10上设置N∈{10,50,100,200}，比较三种拓扑：二度Ring、静态随机图（Static Random）以及基于朋友的朋友发现的局部自适应拓扑过程LFHE。通过Metropolis谱隙分析Ring的理论失效模式，并进行固定名义本地数据量与固定总数据量两种设置的实验对比。
AI.result: Ring的Metropolis谱隙按Θ(N^{-2})衰减，表明随着群体增大，模型分歧的收缩逐步变慢。保持名义本地数据量固定可显著降低"固定总数据量分摊给更多客户端"时观测到的明显人口惩罚。剩余性能退化强烈依赖通信结构：Ring进入高分歧状态，而Static Random与LFHE保持接近共识。提高LFHE的度阈值可进一步提升准确率与共识，但模型传输成本大幅增加。
AI.conclusion: 去中心化扩展由学习动态与通信动态的耦合所主导，而非仅由客户端数量N决定。

title: Evolving in Thought Space: Training a Small Model at Test Time Unlocks Better Discoveries
summary: Open-ended scientific discovery often requires repeatedly proposing and evaluating candidate solutions. LLM-based systems can support this process by generating and refining executable solutions from verifier feedback. Methods such as TTT-Discover use test-time training (TTT) to update the solution-generating LLM from verifier feedback, adapting its generation policy to improve subsequent proposals on the target problem. However, this becomes expensive when reliable execution requires a large model, since training must maintain gradients, optimizer states, and policy statistics while repeatedly generating long, structured outputs. It also complicates credit assignment: outcome-level verifier feedback must jointly evaluate the high-level strategy and its low-level implementation. In this work, we introduce Guidance-TTT, which separates these roles. A compact guidance model is trained at test time to propose high-level strategic changes, while a frozen execution model implements them as complete executable solutions. At each step, the system selects a promising previously discovered solution, proposes a change, executes and verifies it, and updates only the guidance model using an adaptive group-relative RL objective. This concentrates test-time learning on short strategic decisions while retaining the implementation capability of a substantially stronger model without adapting it. Without web access, Guidance-TTT produces strong solutions across four distinct domains: combinatorial optimization (Polyomino Packing), heuristic programming (AHC058), machine learning (Lasso), and GPU kernel optimization (TriMul). Across these tasks, it outperforms the best solutions reported in prior work while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art results on public online leaderboards. Code is available at https://github.com/Human-Agent-Society/reef/tree/guidance-ttt-support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Guidance-TTT，将开放式科学发现中的"策略提议"与"方案实现"解耦：以小模型在测试时学习高层策略，冻结的大模型负责实现可执行方案，在四个领域均超过先前最佳结果。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的开放式科学发现方法（如 TTT-Discover）用验证器反馈在测试时更新生成解的 LLM。但当需要大模型才能可靠执行时，这一做法代价高昂：需维持梯度、优化器状态与策略统计，并反复生成长结构化输出；同时信用分配困难——结果级反馈需同时评估高层策略与底层实现。
AI.method: 提出 Guidance-TTT，分离上述两种角色：一个紧凑的指导模型（guidance model）在测试时训练，用于提出高层策略性修改；一个冻结的执行模型（execution model）将这些策略实现为完整可执行解。每一步选取一个有潜力的已发现解，提出修改、执行并验证，仅用自适应组相对强化学习目标更新指导模型。这样把测试时学习集中在短策略决策上，同时保留强模型的实现能力而无需微调它。
AI.result: 在无网络访问条件下，Guidance-TTT 在四个不同领域生成强解：组合优化（Polyomino Packing）、启发式编程（AHC058）、机器学习（Lasso）和 GPU 内核优化（TriMul）。在这些任务上，它超过先前工作报告的最佳解，并与公开在线排行榜的最新结果保持竞争力。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过将高层策略学习与底层实现解耦，仅对小指导模型做测试时训练，可在显著降低训练成本与信用分配难度的同时，借助冻结大模型的实现能力取得跨领域领先性能，为 LLM 驱动的开放式科学发现提供了一种更高效的范式。

title: Universal Test-Time Training
summary: Recent Test-Time Training (TTT) architectures compress context into fast weights that are updated online and queried as memory. Existing TTT designs keep this memory private to each layer: it recurs only over time, and depth merely indexes L separate memories. We argue that memory ownership need not be tied to depth, and introduce Universal Test-Time Training (uTTT), in which all layers read and write one shared memory while retaining layer-specific backbone parameters. The shared memory thus recurs over two dimensions, time and depth, with chunks and layers as their units: a write by a deep layer in one chunk can be read by a shallow layer in the next. We instantiate this idea as uTTT-MoE and uTTT-Dense. uTTT-MoE routes each token head to a few experts in a pool shared by all layers; uTTT-Dense applies the whole shared memory at every layer without routing. In language modeling, uTTT-MoE reaches 15.5 and 27.9 RULER accuracy at 124M and 760M, 2.6 and 2.1 points above its layer-private counterpart at equal state and active compute, the highest among tested bounded-state models, with per-token loss matching or beating full attention. In novel view synthesis, sharing at fixed per-layer compute gains 0.92 dB in view-23 object PSNR in routed models and 0.76 dB in dense models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 uTTT，将所有层共享同一个快速权重记忆，使记忆在时间与深度两个维度递归，并在语言建模与新颖视图合成中取得更优效果。
AI.motivation: 现有 Test-Time Training 架构将上下文压缩为在线更新的快速权重，但记忆为每层私有，只在时间上递归，深度仅索引 L 个独立记忆。作者认为记忆归属不必与深度绑定。
AI.method: 提出 Universal Test-Time Training (uTTT)：所有层读写同一共享记忆，同时保留各层专属骨干参数，使记忆以 chunk 和 layer 为单位在时间和深度两维递归。实例化为 uTTT-MoE（每个 token head 路由到全层共享专家池中的少数专家）与 uTTT-Dense（每层应用完整共享记忆，无需路由）。
AI.result: 语言建模中，uTTT-MoE 在 124M 和 760M 上达到 15.5 与 27.9 RULER 准确率，在相同状态与激活计算下分别比层私有版本高 2.6 与 2.1 分，为受测有界状态模型中最高，且每 token 损失匹配或优于全注意力。新颖视图合成中，固定每层计算下，路由模型 view-23 物体 PSNR 提升 0.92 dB，稠密模型提升 0.76 dB。
AI.conclusion: 共享跨深度记忆的 uTTT 优于层私有记忆设计，在有界状态语言建模与视图合成任务上均带来一致增益。

title: DPNL: A DPLL-based Algorithm for Probabilistic Neurosymbolic Learning
summary: Probabilistic Neurosymbolic Learning (PNL) combines neural predictions with symbolic reasoning, enabling end-to-end learning from final-output supervision without labels for intermediate concepts. A central challenge is probabilistic inference: state-of-the-art approaches often rely on materializing the logical provenance of a query, which can itself become a major computational bottleneck. We introduce Dynamic Probabilistic Neurosymbolic Learning (DPNL), an oracle-guided framework that avoids requiring complete provenance materialization before inference. DPNL lazily explores the space of intermediate assignments, while oracles resolve entire regions that can already be certified to produce or exclude the target output. We establish conditions ensuring soundness and termination. ApproxDPNL extends the same search with early termination while maintaining certified bounds on the exact output probability, providing controlled approximation guarantees. The oracle interface decouples inference from the representation of the symbolic component, enabling problem-specific reasoning within the same framework. Experiments on several neurosymbolic tasks show that DPNL and ApproxDPNL substantially extend the range of problem instances tractable by probabilistic neurosymbolic inference.

AI.tldr: 提出DPNL与ApproxDPNL两种动态概率神经符号学习框架，通过oracle引导的惰性搜索避免完整provenance物化，支持带认证界的近似推理。
AI.motivation: 概率神经符号学习（PNL）需结合神经预测与符号推理实现从最终输出监督的端到端学习，但概率推断中现有方法往往需先物化查询的逻辑provenance，这本身成为主要计算瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出oracle引导的DPNL框架：惰性探索中间赋值空间，由oracle一次性判定可认证地产生或排除目标输出的整片区域，并给出保证可靠性与终止性的条件。ApproxDPNL在此基础上引入提前终止，保持对精确输出概率的认证界，从而提供可控近似保证。oracle接口将推断与符号组件表示解耦。
AI.result: 在若干神经符号任务上的实验表明，DPNL与ApproxDPNL显著扩展了概率神经符号推断可处理的问题实例范围。
AI.conclusion: 动态、oracle引导的惰性推断可在避免完整provenance物化的同时保持可靠性与近似保证，并通过解耦接口支持问题特定推理，从而提升PNL的可扩展性。

title: Underscoring the Problem: Why Softpick Fails at Initialization
summary: Softmax attention gives every token a nonzero weight, which in trained models concentrates into attention sinks and massive activations that widen the dynamic range low-precision inference must cover. Softpick removes this constraint by rectifying scores, eliminating sinks and lowering hidden-state kurtosis, but its advantage fades at scale. We reframe this failure as a normalization problem. Softpick's denominator splits into positive- and negative-shifted sums $D^+$ and $D^-$, used identically in the forward and backward pass, preventing their roles from being isolated. We separate them into a family of operators that independently choose each denominator. The failure originates at initialization: every layer contains rows where $D^+$ is exactly zero, while near-dead rows produce gradient norms above $10^{12}$ regardless of the backward denominator. Only Softpick and a stop-gradient variant, which keeps $D^+ + D^-$ forward but backpropagates through $D^+$ alone, train from scratch. At 230M parameters, the stop-gradient operator matches Softpick on quantization, has fewer dead heads, and retrieves passkeys more reliably, trailing only on peak attention-weight kurtosis.

AI.tldr: 该论文将Softpick在规模扩大后优势衰减的问题重新定义为归一化问题，通过解耦正负分母来诊断并修复初始化失败。
AI.motivation: Softmax注意力给每个token非零权重，训练后集中于attention sinks和巨型激活，扩大了低精度推理需覆盖的动态范围。Softpick通过整流分数消除sink并降低隐状态峰度，但其优势随规模扩大而消失，作者欲找出原因。
AI.method: 作者将Softpick的分母拆分为正偏移和负偏移两部分D⁺和D⁻，构建一个可独立选择各分母的算子族；并分析初始化时各层存在D⁺恰为零的行，以及近死行产生超过10^12的梯度范数。
AI.result: 只有Softpick和stop-gradient变体（前向保留D⁺+D⁻，反向仅通过D⁺传播）能从零训练。在230M参数下，stop-gradient算子量化性能与Softpick相当，死头更少，passkey检索更可靠，仅在峰值注意力权重峰度上略逊。
AI.conclusion: Softpick的规模化失败源于归一化与初始化的耦合；通过独立控制前向与反向分母可修复该问题，stop-gradient变体是更稳健的替代方案。

title: Teaching a Minimalist Machine to Discover Recursive Programs for Arithmetic
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures. Accepted for oral presentation at the 6th International Joint Conference on Learning and Reasoning 2026. Code: https://github.com/cognitive-modeling/minimalist-machine/tree/IJCLR-2026
summary: Humans can often acquire and synthesize complex, recursive concepts from minimal experience. Leveraging cognitive insights, we propose the Minimalist Machine, a framework for inductive program synthesis designed to model such conceptual learning. The system uses a compact relational subset of Prolog: Programs are searched within a fixed schema of body-free facts and two-body conjunctive Horn clauses. Recursion is not defined by a dedicated metarule. Instead, it emerges when a target predicate is reused inside the body of a learned clause. Inspired by a primary school curriculum, the model is taught through a human-curated, sequential introduction of new concepts in arithmetic. Starting from initially empty knowledge base, it first acquires simple structural predicates, then successor-based state transformations, and finally recursive programs for addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Ultimately, this approach yields the fully transparent, inductive reasoning trace necessary for human-like conceptual learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"极简机器"（Minimalist Machine），一个基于Prolog关系子集的归纳程序合成框架，用于建模人类从极少经验中习得递归概念的过程。系统通过人类策划的、类似小学课程的概念顺序教学，从空知识库出发，逐步学会算术概念与递归程序。
AI.motivation: 人类能从极少的经验中获取并综合复杂的递归概念，现有程序合成方法难以模拟这种类人的概念学习。作者希望借鉴认知科学洞见，构建一个能够以透明、可追踪方式实现归纳推理的概念学习系统。
AI.method: 采用精简的Prolog关系子集：程序在固定模式（schema）中搜索，模式由无体会事实（body-free facts）和双体合取Horn子句构成。递归不通过专门的元规则（metarule）定义，而是当目标谓词在学习到的子句体中被复用时自然涌现。受小学课程启发，模型按顺序引入算术新概念进行训练。
AI.result: 从初始空知识库出发，系统依次习得：简单的结构谓词、基于后继（successor）的状态变换，以及加法、减法、乘法和除法的递归程序。
AI.conclusion: 该方法最终产生了完全透明的归纳推理轨迹，为类人概念学习提供了可行路径。

title: Universality and Convergence of Generative Flows
summary: Generative flows sample from an unnormalized target by training a flow to be balanced, and the training loss is the signal a practitioner watches. We ask what that signal is worth: whether a small loss certifies an accurate sampler, whether the loss can be driven to zero, and how fast gradient descent does so. The loss decides the first. Losses that compare the two sides of the balance by their difference bound, in total variation, the error of the sampler the flow implies, with explicit constants that do not involve the policy; flow-matching losses that compare them through a ratio admit no such bound, already on a single cycle, whenever their generator is continuous at balance. On graphs, the backward policy decides the other two. Once it is frozen, balance becomes invariance under the backward chain, so that existence is free on finite graphs, and one constant --- the norm of that chain's Green operator, which plays the role of an inverse spectral gap --- fixes the order of the curvature of the loss around the balanced flow, from above and below, and sets a floor under the rate at which training converges near it. The mechanism is that gradient descent diffuses the flow along the backward policy. For the squared-logarithm generator of detailed and trajectory balance, training the balance loss on states converges globally on every finite path-connected graph, from every positive initialization. The constant can be infinite while backward trajectories are short on average, and exact flow matching can then fail. The bounds and rates are tested by exact computation on enumerable state spaces, and every theorem carries a certification status computed from a Lean~4 development.

AI.tldr: 本文研究生成流（generative flows）中平衡损失作为训练信号的价值：它能否证明采样器准确、能否被驱动到零、以及梯度下降收敛的速度。结果表明，差式损失可界定采样器总变差误差，而比率式流匹配损失一般无此保证；在图上，冻结反向策略后，反向链Green算子范数决定损失曲率阶数与收敛率下限，且在特定生成器下训练可全局收敛。
AI.motivation: 实践中研究者依赖训练损失作为采样质量的信号，但损失值究竟能提供何种保证尚不明确，例如小损失是否意味着采样器准确、损失能否归零、梯度下降收敛多快。本文旨在厘清平衡损失这一训练信号的理论含义。
AI.method: 从理论上分析两类平衡损失：以差比较两侧的损失与以比率比较的流匹配损失；在一般情形下推导损失与总变差误差的关系，并在图上固定反向策略后，将平衡问题转化为反向链下的不变性，借助Green算子范数（类似逆谱间隙）刻画损失曲率与收敛率，并用Lean 4对定理进行形式化认证，在可枚举状态空间上做精确计算验证。
AI.result: 差式损失可用显式、不依赖策略的常数界定采样器总变差误差；比率式流匹配损失即使在单循环上、生成器连续时也无此类界。冻结反向策略后，有限图上平衡流的存在性自动成立，Green算子范数同时从上下两侧锁定损失曲率阶数并给出训练收敛率下限。对detailed及trajectory balance的平方对数生成器，从任意正初始化出发，状态上的平衡损失训练在有限路径连通图上全局收敛；该常数可有限而平均反向轨迹短，此时精确流匹配可能失败。
AI.conclusion: 平衡损失作为训练信号具有可量化的理论价值，但其保证因损失类型而异：差式损失可认证采样精度，比率式损失则不能；图结构下反向策略及其Green算子范数主导训练动力学与可收敛性。所有结论均经可枚举状态空间精确计算验证，并通过Lean 4形式化给出认证状态。

title: RollPlace: Improving Macro Placement via Monte Carlo Rollout Search
summary: The application of Reinforcement Learning (RL) in Electronic Design Automation (EDA), particularly for chip placement, has attracted considerable attention in recent years. While existing machine learning (ML)-based approaches have achieved notable progress, they predominantly focus on generating optimal layouts in a single attempt, often producing solutions that require subsequent refinement. To address this limitation, we propose RollPlace, a novel and generalized macro placement framework. RollPlace adopts a two-stage optimization strategy: generating initial placement solutions via machine learning methods or heuristic-based strategies, and refining these layouts efficiently by adjusting specific macros derived from the initial stage. This strategy circumvents the sequential generation constraints inherent in traditional RL-based placement methods. Furthermore, RollPlace seamlessly integrates Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to balance exploration and exploitation, and employs a rollout mechanism for efficient local search. Extensive experiments on the ISPD 2005 benchmark demonstrate that RollPlace outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Additionally, end-to-end experimental results based on OpenROAD across 19 benchmarks show that RollPlace excels in multiple metrics. The proposed framework offers a robust and scalable solution for addressing the growing complexity of modern chip design challenges.

AI.tldr: 提出RollPlace，一种两阶段宏单元布局框架：先用ML或启发式生成初始布局，再通过调整特定宏单元进行精细化，结合MCTS与rollout机制实现高效局部搜索。
AI.motivation: 现有基于机器学习的芯片布局方法多追求一次性生成最优布局，所得方案常需后续修正，且传统强化学习布局受顺序生成约束限制。
AI.method: 采用两阶段优化策略：第一阶段通过机器学习方法或启发式策略生成初始布局方案；第二阶段针对初始阶段选出的特定宏单元进行调整以精细化布局。同时集成蒙特卡洛树搜索以平衡探索与利用，并引入rollout机制实现高效局部搜索。
AI.result: 在ISPD 2005基准测试上优于现有最先进方法；基于OpenROAD在19个基准上的端到端实验显示在多项指标上表现优异。
AI.conclusion: RollPlace为应对现代芯片设计日益增长的复杂性提供了稳健且可扩展的解决方案。

title: When Does Retrieval Help? A Study of In-Context Adaptation in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong potential as generalist robot policies, but adapting them to unseen tasks often requires costly parameter updates. Recent work such as RICL introduces in-context adaptability by retrieving expert demonstrations based on the current VLA observation and providing them as additional context at test time. The effectiveness of this adaptation therefore depends critically on the retrieval mechanism. In this work, we systematically study how different retrieval methods affect both retrieval quality and task performance within the RICL framework. Specifically, we compare four different methods: image-based retrieval, retrieval augmented with VLA's state, retrieval using features from the VLA backbone, and random retrieval. Our experiments yield three main findings. First, no retrieval method consistently dominates the others in task success, while surprisingly, random retrieval achieves a non-trivial success rate. Second, standard retrieval-quality diagnostics do not reliably reflect downstream VLA performance. Third, demonstrations from different but related tasks can provide useful transferable information. Together, these results provide an initial step toward understanding how retrieval mechanisms shape the in-context learning capability of VLA models and their downstream task performance, while highlighting the need for more careful design and evaluation of retrieval mechanisms for reliable test-time adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究RBCL框架中不同检索机制对视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型在上下文适应中检索质量与任务性能的影响，对比了四种检索方法并得出三点主要发现。
AI.motivation: VLA模型作为通用机器人策略潜力巨大，但适应未见任务需昂贵的参数更新。RICL等工作通过检索专家演示提供上下文实现上下文适应，其效果关键取决于检索机制，但检索机制如何影响性能尚缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 在RICL框架内系统对比四种检索方法：基于图像的检索、结合VLA状态的检索增强、使用VLA骨干网络特征的检索，以及随机检索；并评估检索质量与下游任务性能。
AI.result: 三点主要发现：(1) 没有一种检索方法在任务成功率上持续占优，随机检索也取得非平凡的成功率；(2) 标准检索质量诊断指标不能可靠反映下游VLA性能；(3) 来自不同但相关任务的演示可提供有用的可迁移信息。
AI.conclusion: 研究初步揭示了检索机制如何塑造VLA模型的上下文学习能力与下游任务表现，强调需要更谨慎地设计和评估检索机制以实现可靠的测试时适应。

title: CRAFTER: Causality-based Self-adaptation for Autonomous IoT Systems
summary: This paper presents CRAFTER, an automated framework for designing and deploying self-adaptive IoT systems using Causal Reinforcement Learning (CRL). As IoT devices increasingly populate pervasive computing spaces, smart environments are enabled with advanced monitoring and interactive services. The dynamic nature of these environments, such as fluctuating workloads and evolving application demands, poses significant challenges in maintaining consistent Quality of Service (QoS) levels of IoT applications. While existing self-adaptation techniques offer adaptive capabilities, they are often designed to deal with specific application domains, hindering the design of self-adaptive solutions that can be re-used across multiple IoT verticals. In addition, there is a lack of automated pipelines that act on identifying key performance drivers to take effective adaptation decisions. CRAFTER addresses these issues by using Causality as a formal framework for performance analysis of IoT systems. CRAFTER generates causal graphs to uncover dependencies among system components and guide adaptation decisions based on cause-effect relationships. Then, adaptation agents can leverage this knowledge to take more effective adaptation decisions in dynamic situations. Our experimental evaluation demonstrates how CRAFTER enables deriving causal graphs spanning diverse IoT use cases. Furthermore, we showcase how CRAFTER improves self-adaptation performance by 25% compared to state-of-the-art Reinforcement Learning-based approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CRAFTER，一个基于因果强化学习（CRL）的自动化框架，用于设计并部署自适应 IoT 系统，通过因果图识别关键性能驱动因素并指导自适应决策，实验表明其自适应性能比最先进的强化学习方法提升 25%。
AI.motivation: IoT 设备在普适计算空间中日益普及，但环境动态性（如工作负载波动、应用需求演变）给维持 IoT 应用的 QoS 带来挑战。现有自适应技术多针对特定应用领域，难以跨 IoT 垂直领域复用，且缺乏识别关键性能驱动因素并据此做出有效自适应决策的自动化流水线。
AI.method: CRAFTER 将因果性作为 IoT 系统性能分析的形式化框架，自动生成因果图以揭示系统组件间的依赖关系，并基于因果关系指导自适应决策；自适应代理利用这些知识在动态情境中做出更有效的自适应决策。
AI.result: 实验评估表明，CRAFTER 能够为多种不同的 IoT 用例生成因果图；并且相比最先进的基于强化学习的方法，其自适应性能提升了 25%。
AI.conclusion: CRAFTER 通过引入因果性框架与因果强化学习，实现了跨 IoT 垂直领域的自动化自适应系统设计，克服了现有方法领域受限、缺乏自动化性能驱动识别的不足，并显著提升了自适应效果。

title: LEON: Location Embeddings from OSM Neighborhoods via Hexagonal Graph Masked Autoencoders
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Pre-review preprint version of a paper published in Advances in Computational Collective Intelligence (ICCCI 2026), CCIS 3044, Springer, pp. 274-287
summary: Geographic information systems increasingly rely on sophisticated spatial representation learning techniques to extract meaningful patterns from complex geospatial data. This paper introduces LEON, a novel self-supervised framework that adapts Graph Masked Autoencoders (GraphMAE) for geospatial region representation learning. Our method leverages the inherent spatial structure of geographic data by constructing hexagonal grid graphs using H3 indexing and applying masked autoencoding techniques to learn robust spatial embeddings from OpenStreetMap (OSM) amenity distribution patterns. We evaluate LEON on multiple real-world datasets including EuroSAT satellite imagery classification and various geographic prediction tasks (housing prices, crime prediction, and urban analytics). Experimental results demonstrate that LEON achieves significant improvements in spatial understanding, with up to 1.87% accuracy improvement on EuroSAT classification and consistent performance gains across geographic prediction benchmarks. The learned embeddings exhibit highly structured and distinct properties, making them particularly suitable for downstream spatial analysis tasks. Our findings suggest that self-supervised learning provides an effective paradigm for geospatial region representation learning using widely available crowdsourced data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LEON，一种基于图掩码自编码器（GraphMAE）的自监督框架，利用H3六边形网格构建图结构，从OSM设施分布学习地理区域空间表征。
AI.motivation: 地理信息系统需要先进的空间表征学习技术来从复杂地理空间数据中提取有意义的模式，而现有方法对广泛可得的众包数据利用不足，亟需有效的自监督地理区域表征学习范式。
AI.method: 将GraphMAE适配到地理空间区域表征学习：利用地理数据固有的空间结构，通过H3索引构建六边形网格图，并对OpenStreetMap设施分布模式应用掩码自编码技术，学习鲁棒的空间嵌入。
AI.result: 在EuroSAT卫星影像分类上准确率最高提升1.87%，并在房价预测、犯罪预测、城市分析等地理预测基准上取得一致的性能增益；所学嵌入呈现高度结构化且区分性强的特性，适合下游空间分析任务。
AI.conclusion: 自监督学习为利用广泛可得的众包数据进行地理空间区域表征学习提供了有效范式。

title: ImproveAnyTask: An Autonomous Post-Training Harness for Iterative Model Self-Improvement
summary: Adapting general-purpose large language models to specific tasks requires substantial human effort in designing data and training strategies. Sustaining improvement is especially challenging because model updates change the error distribution, requiring strategies to be continually refined. We introduce ImproveAnyTask, an autonomous post-training harness that improves task performance under a limited compute budget. Drawing inspiration from gradient-based parameter optimization, the harness organizes adaptation into error attribution, update-direction selection, and executable model updates. It combines metric-level and case-level analysis to identify a focal problem, then investigates research-backed strategies and compares their reported gains and reproduction difficulty. The selected strategy is translated into training data and a training configuration, with small-scale execution checks preceding full post-training. Subsequent evaluation guides model selection and further adaptation, while validated strategies and scripts are retained for reuse. Across 11 tasks, ImproveAnyTask achieves mean gains of 18.29 and 11.97 percentage points on the Base and Instruct models, respectively, with a maximum gain of 41.96 points, under a 24-hour budget with resources equivalent to eight H20 GPUs.

AI.tldr: 提出 ImproveAnyTask，一种自主后训练框架，在有限算力下自动提升任务性能，11个任务上平均提升18.29和11.97个百分点。
AI.motivation: 将通用大模型适配到具体任务需要大量人工投入来设计数据和训练策略，且模型更新会改变错误分布，策略需持续调整，难以维持改进。
AI.method: 受梯度参数优化启发，将适配组织为错误归因、更新方向选择和可执行模型更新三步。结合指标级与案例级分析定位核心问题，调研有研究支撑的策略并比较其增益与复现难度，将选定策略转化为训练数据和配置，先小规模执行检查再进行完整后训练，评估结果用于模型选择与后续适配，并保留验证过的策略与脚本。
AI.result: 在11个任务上，Base和Instruct模型分别平均提升18.29和11.97个百分点，最大提升41.96个百分点，预算为24小时、相当于8张H20 GPU的资源。
AI.conclusion: ImproveAnyTask 能够以有限算力自主、可复用地提升多任务性能。

title: Logic-Logit: A Logic-Based Approach to Choice Modeling
comment: 21 pages. Published at ICLR 2025. Code (educational implementation): https://github.com/Asimov-Chuang/Logic-Logit
summary: In this study, we propose a novel rule-based interpretable choice model, Logic-Logit, designed to effectively learn and explain human choices. Choice models have been widely applied across various domains---such as commercial demand forecasting, recommendation systems, and consumer behavior analysis---typically categorized as parametric, nonparametric, or deep network-based. While recent innovations have favored neural network approaches for their computational power, these flexible models often involve large parameter sets and lack interpretability, limiting their effectiveness in contexts where transparency is essential. Previous empirical evidence shows that individuals usually use heuristic decision rules to form their consideration sets, from which they then choose. These rules are often represented as disjunctions of conjunctions (i.e., OR-of-ANDs). These rules-driven, consider-then-choose decision processes enable people to quickly screen numerous alternatives while reducing cognitive and search costs. Motivated by this insight, our approach leverages logic rules to elucidate human choices, providing a fresh perspective on preference modeling. We introduce a unique combination of column generation techniques and the Frank-Wolfe algorithm to facilitate efficient rule extraction for preference modeling---a process recognized as NP-hard. Our empirical evaluation, conducted on both synthetic datasets and real-world data from commercial and healthcare domains, demonstrates that Logic-Logit significantly outperforms baseline models in terms of interpretability and accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于规则的可解释选择模型 Logic-Logit，通过逻辑规则（OR-of-ANDs）刻画人类"先筛选后选择"的决策过程，并结合列生成与 Frank-Wolfe 算法高效提取规则，在合成数据及商业与医疗真实数据上于可解释性和准确率上优于基线模型。
AI.motivation: 选择模型广泛应用，但现有方法要么参数化、要么非参数化、要么基于深度网络。近期神经网络方法虽计算能力强，却参数庞大、缺乏可解释性，在需要透明度的场景下效果受限。已有实证表明人们常用启发式决策规则（OR-of-ANDs 形式的析取合取规则）构建考虑集，再从中选择，这种"先考虑后选择"的过程能快速筛选大量选项并降低认知与搜索成本。作者据此希望用逻辑规则解释人类选择，为偏好建模提供新视角。
AI.method: 提出 Logic-Logit：一种基于规则的可解释选择模型，利用逻辑规则刻画偏好。由于规则提取属于 NP-hard 问题，作者创新性地结合列生成技术与 Frank-Wolfe 算法，实现高效的规则提取。
AI.result: 在合成数据集以及来自商业和医疗领域的真实数据上进行实证评估，Logic-Logit 在可解释性与准确率两方面均显著优于基线模型。
AI.conclusion: Logic-Logit 通过逻辑规则建模偏好，兼顾可解释性与预测性能，为选择建模提供了一种兼具高效性与透明度的新方法。

title: GraphDecide: Benchmarking System One Models on Graph Tasks
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for graph understanding and decision-making, while System One models such as Jev select directly from supplied options. However, the capabilities of System One models on graph-related tasks remain unclear. We introduce GraphDecide, a model-independent benchmark that combines structural task profiles, matched graph-text input contrasts and heuristic-proposal controls to diagnose graph decision performance. We evaluate Jev and related choice-based models alongside language-model baselines, covering fourteen model-interface configurations. Jev's results illustrate the benchmark's central distinctions: accurate adjacency recognition does not guarantee broader structural correctness, joint graph-text input does not consistently improve prediction, and feasible construction does not establish high solution quality. Its task contracts, candidate interfaces and scoring rules support comparison across native selectors and language-model adapters. Code and aggregate results are available at https://github.com/VictorYXL/JevGraphBench.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 GraphDecide——一个模型无关的图决策基准，用于诊断 System One 类模型（如 Jev）在图相关任务上的表现，并揭示邻接识别、图-文本联合输入与解质量之间的关键区别。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型被越来越多地用于图理解与决策，而 Jev 等 System One 模型直接从给定选项中选取；但这类模型在图相关任务上的能力仍不清晰，缺乏系统性评估手段。
AI.method: 提出 GraphDecide 基准，结合结构任务画像、匹配的图-文本输入对照与启发式候选控制；评估 Jev 及相关基于选择的模型与语言模型基线，覆盖十四种模型-接口配置，并设计任务契约、候选接口与评分规则以支持原生选择器与语言模型适配器的比较。
AI.result: Jev 的结果揭示了核心区别：准确的邻接识别并不保证更广泛的结构正确性；图-文本联合输入并不总是提升预测；可行构造并不代表高解质量。
AI.conclusion: GraphDecide 可作为模型无关的诊断工具，通过任务画像与控制机制系统评估图决策能力，为比较原生选择器与语言模型适配器提供统一框架。

title: Lightweight Semantic EEG Foundation Model for Frozen Cross-Disorder Transfer
summary: Large-scale EEG foundation models have demonstrated promising transferability across neurological disorders, but often require millions of parameters and substantial computational resources. In this paper, we present the Universal Semantic EEG Foundation Model (USE-FM), a lightweight EEG foundation model that learns transferable neural representations through self-supervised signal reconstruction on the Temple University Hospital EEG Corpus (TUEG). After pretraining, the encoder is frozen and evaluated on two clinically distinct downstream tasks, abnormal EEG detection (TUAB) and epileptic seizure recognition (TUEP), using a unified frozen-transfer protocol against recent EEG foundation models, including LUNA-Base and CBraMod. With only 1.46 million parameters, approximately one-fifth the size of existing models, USE-FM achieves competitive overall performance, including strong sensitivity and F1-score on TUEP (SEN $75.00 \pm 14.14$, F1 $70.37 \pm 4.01$), while maintaining competitive performance on TUAB (AUC $85.24 \pm 5.61$). Beyond downstream classification, latent representation analysis using $k$-means clustering together with PCA and t-SNE demonstrates that USE-FM learns organized semantic EEG representations comparable to substantially larger foundation models. These results suggest that large-scale self-supervised pretraining enables lightweight architectures to learn transferable semantic EEG representations, providing a computationally efficient foundation for cross-disorder analysis and future clinical decision support in neurological disorders.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级EEG基础模型USE-FM（146万参数），自监督重建预训练后冻结编码器，在TUAB与TUEP任务上取得有竞争力表现，并学到可迁移的语义表征。
AI.motivation: 大规模EEG基础模型虽具跨神经疾病迁移能力，但参数规模大、计算资源需求高，难以在资源受限场景下应用，亟需轻量化且可迁移的替代方案。
AI.method: 在TUH EEG语料库（TUEG）上进行自监督信号重建预训练；预训练后冻结编码器，采用统一的冻结迁移协议，在异常EEG检测（TUAB）与癫痫发作识别（TUEP）两个临床任务上评估；并与LUNA-Base、CBraMod等近期模型比较；此外用k-means聚类结合PCA与t-SNE分析潜在表征。
AI.result: 仅146万参数（约为现有模型的五分之一），USE-FM达到有竞争力的整体性能：TUEP上SEN 75.00±14.14、F1 70.37±4.01；TUAB上AUC 85.24±5.61；潜在表征分析显示其语义EEG表征的组织性与更大模型相当。
AI.conclusion: 大规模自监督预训练可使轻量架构学到可迁移的语义EEG表征，为跨疾病分析及未来神经系统疾病的临床决策支持提供计算高效的基础模型。

title: Capability-Driven Self-Evolution of Agent Memory
summary: Memory self-evolution uses task feedback to iteratively improve executable memory programs that store and retrieve information from past interactions. Existing approaches typically adopt holistic evolution, deriving revision directions from mixed feedback and judging progress by overall performance. This can obscure optimization directions and hide capability-specific gains offset by regressions elsewhere, leaving promising directions underexplored. We introduce capability-driven evolution, which extends search guidance from overall performance to individual capability dimensions, preserving promising revisions and expanding exploration beyond the boundaries of holistic evolution. We propose PrisMem, which uses dependency-aware capability selection to prioritize targets with potential cross-capability benefits and history-guided diagnosis to refine capability specialists. Trace-guided integration compares evaluated programs on paired differential cases, using their behavioral differences to consolidate complementary gains into a unified memory program. Experiments show that PrisMem outperforms the strongest baselines by 10.54 and 7.83 percentage points on BEAM-1M and LongMemEval-M, respectively, demonstrating its effectiveness on million-token histories.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出能力驱动的记忆自进化方法PrisMem，通过按能力维度引导进化，突破整体进化局限，在长历史记忆任务上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆自进化方法采用整体进化，从混合反馈中推导改进方向并以整体性能判断进展，这会模糊优化方向、掩盖被其他退化抵消的能力收益，导致有潜力的方向未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出能力驱动进化，将搜索引导从整体性能扩展到单个能力维度；PrisMem包含三个组件：依赖感知的能力选择（优先选择具跨能力收益潜力的目标）、历史引导的诊断（细化能力专家）、轨迹引导的整合（在成对差异案例上比较程序，利用行为差异将互补收益整合为统一记忆程序）。
AI.result: 在BEAM-1M和LongMemEval-M上，PrisMem分别比最强基线高出10.54和7.83个百分点，证明其在百万token历史上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 能力驱动的进化可保留有潜力的修订并拓展整体进化边界之外的探索，PrisMem在长历史记忆任务上有效且性能优越。

title: What Does a Harness Repair? A Preregistered Study of Visibility, Baseline Adequacy and Evaluation Defects
comment: 43 pages, 2 figures, 35 tables. Ancillary files in anc/: the frozen preregistration, its addenda (row keys of five rows withheld) and the aggregate analysis report, with a README
summary: Harness search keeps a change to the prompts, reasoning switches, token budgets or parsers around a frozen model if the change raises a score. Such a gain can come from answers the parser could not read before, a weak comparison, or a defect in the evaluation. We preregistered a study of where these gains come from, with three small models, three benchmarks, replication and test partitions, a GEPA search arm and six evaluation defects injected one at a time, and we report all 47 primary endpoints. Turning thinking off raised accuracy over a capped thinking setting in 5 of 9 model-benchmark cells, and in each the gain came mostly from questions where the capped setting gave no readable answer. The thinking-off setting was not meaningfully worse than a rescue configuration or four GEPA-selected harnesses in 11 of 13 comparisons, and lost to the rescue on GSM8K for two models. GEPA repaired its broken starting points, but none of its selected harnesses was more accurate than the thinking-off setting. A thinking budget in the serving engine, which also allows a longer answer, lowered truncation and raised the parse rate in 6 of 9 cells. In 6 of 15 evaluable defect-model pairs, replication through the same pipeline reproduced the defect's distortion instead of revealing it. On the LongevityBench multiple-choice tasks, only the longevity-tuned model beat the strongest constant-label baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文预注册研究了"harness search"带来的分数增益来源，用3个小模型、3个基准、GEPA搜索臂及6种注入的评估缺陷，报告全部47个主要终点。核心发现是多数增益来自无答案或弱对比，而非真实能力提升。
AI.motivation: harness search在冻结模型下通过修改提示、推理开关、token预算或解析器来提高分数，但这类增益可能来自解析器原本无法读取的答案、弱对比或评估缺陷。作者希望系统性地厘清这些增益的真实来源。
AI.method: 预注册研究设计：3个小模型、3个基准、复制与测试分区、一个GEPA搜索臂，以及一次性注入一种共6种评估缺陷，报告全部47个主要端点进行完整评估。
AI.result: 关闭思考在9个模型-基准单元中的5个提升了准确率，且增益主要来自有上限设置下无答案的问题；关闭思考在13次比较中的11次不弱于rescue配置或4个GEPA选定harness，但在GSM8K上对两个模型输给rescue；GEPA修复了破碎起点，但无选定harness优于关闭思考；服务引擎中的思考预算在6/9单元降低截断并提高解析率；15个可评估缺陷-模型对中有6个在相同流水线复制时重现了缺陷扭曲；LongevityBench上仅longevity微调模型超过最强常数标签基线。
AI.conclusion: harness search观测到的增益常常并非源于真实能力提升，而是来自无答案问题、弱对比或评估缺陷；需要在评估中谨慎辨识这些虚假增益。

title: CVIF: A Criticality-Driven Visual Intervention Framework for Geometric Diagram Understanding in MLLMs
summary: Despite significant progress in visual tasks by Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), geometric diagram understanding remains challenging due to the presence of sparse visual cues and ambiguous symbol-primitive associations. MLLMs may therefore rely on textual priors, producing interpretations that conflict with visual evidence. We introduce the training-free Criticality-Driven Visual Intervention Framework (CVIF), an inference-time method that localizes critical layers and executes visual interventions during the transition from evidence aggregation to semantic decoding. At these layers, a Geometry-Constrained Local Relation Reconstruction (GCLR) module selects and weights vertex-centered visual evidence, while an Adaptive Visual Steering Operator (AVSO) redistributes attention mass toward the selected tokens. Experiments on PGPS9K and PGDP5K show that CVIF raises Overall F1 from 77.85 to 85.58 and from 75.23 to 82.84, respectively, establishing a novel inference-time visual intervention paradigm.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的CVIF框架，通过定位关键层并施加视觉干预，提升MLLMs对几何图形的理解能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在视觉任务上有进展，但几何图形理解仍困难，原因在于视觉线索稀疏、符号与图元关联模糊，导致模型依赖文本先验、解读与视觉证据冲突。
AI.method: CVIF为推理时方法，定位从证据聚合向语义解码过渡的关键层；在这些层上用GCLR模块选取并加权以顶点为中心的视觉证据，用AVSO自适应视觉引导算子将注意力质量重新分配到所选token上；全程无需训练。
AI.result: 在PGPS9K和PGDP5K数据集上，Overall F1分别从77.85提升到85.58，从75.23提升到82.84。
AI.conclusion: CVIF验证了推理时视觉干预范式的有效性，为几何图形理解提供新思路。

title: LiFT: Loop Flow Transformers
summary: We introduce Loop Flow Transformers (LiFT), a family of looped generative models that scales computation by repeatedly applying a shared Diffusion Transformer (DiT) core, with only light changes to the standard architecture. Rather than asking every recurrent step for the final prediction, LiFT trains each step with a single regression target: a point on a straight path from the model's initial estimate to the flow-matching target. Because we index these targets by a continuous depth coordinate, a trained model can loop far beyond its training depth with no retraining, early exits, or other modifications. In our experiments, these longer rollouts improve generation, so inference computation can grow without adding parameters. On ImageNet at 256x256, LiFT-L/2 achieves an FID 3.34 points lower than our dense DiT-XL/2 baseline while using approximately 60% fewer parameters, 32% fewer training FLOPs, and 52% fewer inference FLOPs.

AI.tldr: 提出Loop Flow Transformers (LiFT)，通过重复应用共享的Diffusion Transformer核心来扩展计算，仅需微小架构改动，训练时以连续深度坐标为索引的回归目标，可远超训练深度循环推理而不需重训练，在ImageNet 256x256上以更少参数和FLOPs实现更低FID。
AI.motivation: 标准扩散模型通常通过增加参数量或模型规模来提升生成质量，导致计算和内存成本高。作者希望在不增加参数的前提下扩展推理计算量，从而改善生成效果，探索"循环复用同一核心模块"的生成建模范式。
AI.method: LiFT对标准DiT架构仅做轻微修改，反复应用共享的DiT核心。训练时每个循环步骤只回归单一目标：从模型初始估计到流匹配目标之间直线上的一点。这些目标由连续深度坐标索引，因此训练后的模型可以循环推理到远超训练深度的步数，无需重训练、早退或其他修改。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256x256上，LiFT-L/2相比稠密DiT-XL/2基线FID低3.34点，同时参数减少约60%，训练FLOPs减少32%，推理FLOPs减少52%；更长的循环rollout进一步提升了生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过循环共享DiT核心并以连续深度坐标索引训练目标，LiFT实现了推理计算可随循环步数增长而无需增加参数的生成模型，在参数效率和计算效率上均优于稠密基线，为可扩展的生成建模提供了新思路。

title: What Did the Agent Actually Do? Evidence-Grounded Oversight for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: As agents take on long-horizon tasks, users shift from making individual decisions to overseeing autonomous execution. Yet the volume of agent activity and the fragmentation of supporting evidence make it difficult to determine which decisions warrant user verification. We study monitors that identify consequential decisions and locate evidence to help users assess their implications.
